"""<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
[The following are Huleeya's notes for Caius Cosades.]<BR>
<BR>
The History of the Ashlanders and the Nerevarine Cult<BR>
In First Era barbaric Dunmer culture, settled Dunmer clans (the Great Houses) and nomadic Dunmer tribes (like the Ashlanders) were roughly equal in numbers and wealth. Under the civilized peace of the Grand Council, and with the strong central authority of the Temple, the economic and military power of the settled Dunmer quickly outstripped that of the nomadic Dunmer. The nomadic Dunmer were marginalized into the poorest, most hostile land, in particular, into the Vvardenfell wastes. For the Ashlanders, the return of a reincarnated Nerevar represents a longed for and largely romanticized Golden Age of Nerevar's Peace, when the nomadic tribes enjoyed equality with the settled Dunmer, and before the Dunmer people had for the most part abandoned traditional ancestor worship for the autocratic theocracy of the Tribunal Temple.<BR>
<BR>
The Nerevar of the Ashlanders<BR>
<BR>
This is the story of Nerevar as an Ashlander might tell it.<BR>
<BR>
In ancient days, the Deep Elves and a great host of outlanders from the West came to steal the land of the Dunmer. In that time, Nerevar was the great khan and warleader of the House People, but he honored the Ancient Spirits and the Tribal law, and became as one of us. So, when Nerevar pledged upon his great Ring of the Ancestors, One-Clan-Under-Moon-and-Star, to honor the ways of the Spirits and rights of the Land, all the Tribes joined the House People to fight a great battle at Red Mountain. Though many Dunmer, Tribesman and Houseman, died at Red Mountain, the Dwemer were defeated and their evil magicks destroyed, and the outlanders driven from the land. But after this great victory, the power-hungry khans of the Great Houses slew Nerevar in secret, and, setting themselves up as gods, neglected Nerevar's promises to the Tribes. But it is said that Nerevar will come again with his ring, and cast down the false gods, and by the power of his ring will make good his promises to the Tribes, to honor the Spirits and drive the outsiders from the land.<BR>
<BR>
Persecution of the Nerevarine Cult<BR>
<BR>
The Tribunal Temple regards the mysticism and prophecy of the Nerevarine cult as primitive superstition. The Ashlander Ancestor cults and the Nerevarines in particular have always decried the worship of living Dunmer as abominations, suspecting the unnatural lifetimes of the Tribunal to be signs of profane sorcery or necromancy. Though the authoritarian and intolerant Temple priesthood has always been inclined to tolerate Ashlander ancestor cult practices, they have always threatened Nerevarine claimants with death or imprisonment. And while generally tolerant of various cult worships, the Imperial Commission of the Occupation outlaws cults hostile to the Emperor and the Empire, and threatens members of such cults with imprisonment or death. The Ordinators are allowed a free hand when dealing with outlawed cults like the Nerevarines.<BR>
<BR>
Peakstar and other Incarnates in the Past<BR>
<BR>
In the past, others have claimed to be the reincarnated Nerevar of prophecy. The most recent is known as Peakstar, a mysterious figure who has reportedly appeared and disappeared among the Wastes tribes over the last 30 years. The Temple notes that these False Incarnates discredit the Nerevarine prophecies. Singularly, and illogically, the Ashlanders acknowledge a history of false claimants, calling them "Failed Incarnates," but they regard them as proof of the validity of the prophecies, rather than contradiction. Among the Nerevarines there is a fable of a Cavern of the Incarnates, where the spirits of the Failed Incarnates dwell. The Nerevarine cult is a mystical cult, and it glorifies, rather than shrinks from, contradictions.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
[以下是胡利亚给凯乌斯·科萨德斯的笔记]<BR>
<BR>
灰烬之民和尼瑞瓦因教派的历史<BR>
在第一纪元的原始丹莫文化中，定居的丹莫氏族（大家族）和游牧的丹莫部落（如灰烬之民）在数量和富裕程度上大致相等。在大议会的和平文明下，加上神殿强大的中央权威，定居的丹莫的经济和军事实力迅速超过了游牧的丹莫。游牧的丹莫被边缘化到最贫穷、最危险的土地上，尤其是瓦登费尔北部的荒地。对于灰烬之民来说，尼瑞瓦转世的回归代表着尼瑞瓦对和平的向往和浪漫化的黄金时代的回归，那时游牧部落与定居的丹莫享有平等地位，而大部分丹莫放弃了传统的先祖崇拜，转而崇拜独裁神权的审判席神殿。<BR>
<BR>
灰烬之民的尼瑞瓦<BR>
<BR>
以下就是灰烬之民可能会讲述的尼瑞瓦的故事。<BR>
<BR>
在远古时代，深精灵和一大群来自西方的外邦人来到了丹莫的土地上。那个时候，尼瑞瓦是大可汗，是各大家族的战争领袖，但他尊重古代精神和部落法律，成为了我们中的一员。因此，当尼瑞瓦在他的伟大先祖之戒——辰星与皓月上发誓，以尊重神灵的方式战斗和尊重土地的权利的时候，所有部落都加入了各大家族人民的战斗，参与了红山之战。虽然许多丹莫、部落的灰烬之民、大家族的族人都死在了红山，但锻莫被打败了，他们的邪恶魔法被摧毁了，外邦人也被赶出了这片土地。但在这场伟大的胜利之后，大家族中渴望权力的可汗暗中杀死了尼瑞瓦，并自立为神，忽视了尼瑞瓦对部落的承诺。但据说尼瑞瓦将带着他的戒指再次降临，击退伪神，并凭借他的戒指的力量兑现他对部落的承诺，尊重神灵并将外来者赶出这片土地。<BR>
<BR>
对尼瑞瓦因教派的迫害<BR>
<BR>
审判席神殿将尼瑞瓦因教派的神秘主义预言视为原始迷信。灰烬之民的先祖教派，尤其是尼瑞瓦因教派，一直谴责世间对活着的莫丹的崇拜是一种恶行，他们怀疑审判席的超自然生命是亵渎神明的巫术或死灵法术。尽管专制和偏狭的神殿神职人员一直倾向于容忍大多灰烬之民先祖教派的做法，但他们一直威胁着尼瑞瓦因教派并声称自称尼瑞瓦因的人要处以死刑或监禁。虽然帝国对各种教派崇拜大体上是宽容的，但帝国殖民地委员会也会取缔敌视皇帝和帝国的教派，并同样以监禁或死刑威胁这些教派的成员。在处理像尼瑞瓦因教派这样的非法教派时，帝国默许神殿卫兵可以使用任意手段。<BR>
<BR>
峰之星等曾经的化身<BR>
<BR>
过去，也有人自称是预言当中的尼瑞瓦转世。最近的一位名叫峰之星，据说是过去三十年来在废土的部落中出现又消失的神秘人物。神殿指出，这些虚假的化身抹黑了尼瑞瓦因的预言。诡异且不合逻辑的是，灰烬之民承认虚假化身的历史，称他们为“失败的化身”，但他们认为这是预言有效性的有力证据，而不是矛盾。在尼瑞瓦因预言当中有一个关于化身洞穴的传说，失败的化身的灵魂就居住在那里。尼瑞瓦因教派是一种神秘的教派，它颂扬而不是回避矛盾。<BR>"""

Though House Telvanni does recruit from their own lower classes, they must go outside their house to hire the craftsmen and specialists they need. Most disconcerting for some potential candidates is House Telvanni's casual acceptance of murder and assassination of rivals as a means to advancement. <BR>

"""Zainsubani's Notes<p>

[The following are notes on the Ashlanders and the Nerevarine cult prepared for you by Hassour Zainsubani]<p>

The Ashlanders are the direct descendants of the Aldmeri peoples who followed the Prophet Veloth into the lands we now call Morrowind. The Ashlanders retain the modest nomadic life and simple ancestor worship of their forebears, and despise the soft lives and decadent worships of the settled Great House Dunmer cultures. The Wastes are harsh and unforgiving, and we are a hard people. But there is a beauty and honor in our simple lives, and the snobs of the Temple and Great Houses are fools to dismiss us as crude savages.<p>

Ashlanders and foreigners<br>
Most Ashlanders wish all foreigners and their false gods could be driven from Morrowind. At very least, Ashlanders wish the foreign devils would leave them in peace. Ashlanders think it shameful to attack unarmed persons, but they will kill without hesitation an armed person who offends them or their clan laws. No Ashlander is fool enough to make war against the Empire. However, if such a war might be won, many Ashlanders might cheerfully give their lives to win such a war.<p>

Ashlander courtesy<br>
Ashlanders may challenge a stranger who enters a yurt without invitation. Customs differ with different tribes, but leave when requested, and you may be forgiven. Be particularly careful about ashkhans -- tribal chiefs -- and wise women -- tribal seers and counselors. Some are welcoming, some are hostile. Be courteous, and leave if requested. If offended, they may attack.<p>

Ashlander challenges<br>
When challenged for sport, it is acceptable to decline. When challenged for honor, it is shameful to decline. Honor challenges come from offense given in speech or action, or may represent customary formal challenges of status or ritual.<p>

Ashlander worship<br>
All Ashlanders in a tribe, young and small, are born into the Ancestor cult of their clan. The Nerevarine cult is different, though; it is a very small cult, with only a few wise women with the gift of prophecy, and a few holy warrior-heroes who guard and protect the seers. Sul-Matuul, Ashkhan of the Urshilaku, is the Warrior-Protector of the cult, and Nibani Maesa, also of the Urshilaku, is the Oracle-Seer of the cult.<p>

Nerevarine cult<br>
They worship the Great Ashkhan and Hortator, Nerevar Moon-and-Star, who in ages past destroyed the evil, godless dwarves and banished the treacherous Dagoth Ur and his foul hosts beneath Red Mountain. The cult is of small consequence in Ashlander worship, and only among the Urshilaku do its followers have any influence. Others Ashlanders tribes share the sentiments of the cult, but regard the Nerevarine prophecies with suspicion and skepticism.<p>

Nerevarine prophecies<br>
It is said that prophecies foretell the return of a reincarnated Nerevar, who shall drive the foreigners from the Ashlands and who shall cast down the false gods of the Temple, and restore the true worships of the Ancestors. It is a dream that would appeal to every Ashlander, but many Ashlanders think it is a silly ancient legend, and little more.<p>

The Urshilaku Ashlanders<br>
The Urshilaku are the Ashlanders of the northern Ashlands and the West Gash, in the northwest of Vvardenfell. Ashkhan Sul-Matuul is their chief, a brave and respected war leader, and Warrior-Protector of the Nerevarine cult. Nibani Maesa is their wise woman, a deep and shrewd counselor, and seer of the Nerevarine cult. The Urshilaku camp moves with the herds, but usually lies close to the Sea of Ghosts, north of the village of Maar Gan, on the northern coast of the northern Ashlands.<p>"""
"""扎因苏巴尼的笔记<p>

[以下是哈苏尔·扎因苏巴尼准备的关于灰烬之民与尼瑞瓦因教派的笔记]<p>

灰烬之民是奥德莫瑞人民的直系后裔，他们跟随先知维洛斯进入现在被我们称为晨风的土地。灰烬之民保留了祖先朴素的游牧生活和朴素的先祖崇拜，鄙视定居的丹莫大家族文化和他们软弱的生活还有颓废的崇拜。灰烬之地是严酷无情的，我们是一个坚强的民族。但在我们朴素的生活中有一种美和荣誉，神殿和大家族的势利小人都是傻瓜，将我们视为粗野的野蛮人。<p>

灰烬之民和外邦人<br>
大多数灰烬之民都希望能将所有外邦人和他们的伪神赶出晨风。至少，灰烬之民希望这些外来恶魔能别打扰他们。灰烬之民认为攻击手无寸铁的人是可耻的，但他们会毫不犹豫地杀死冒犯他们或其部族法律的武装人员。没有一个灰烬之民会傻到向泰姆瑞尔帝国开战。但是，如果这场战争能够取得胜利，许多灰烬之民可能会乐于献出自己的生命来赢得这场战争。<p>

灰烬之民的礼节<br>
灰烬之民可能会挑战那些未经邀请进入他们营帐的陌生人。不同部落的风俗不同，但如果被呵斥了，请按要求离开，这样还有可能会被原谅。要特别小心灰烬可汗——也就是部落首领，还有女智者——部落的先知和顾问。有些人会欢迎外人，有些人则对外人怀有敌意。要懂礼节，如果有要求就离开。如果他们感到被冒犯了，他们可能会发起攻击。<p>

灰烬之民的挑战<br>
当受到一般切磋性质的挑战时，拒绝挑战是没问题的。但是当受到正式的荣誉挑战时，拒绝挑战就是可耻的。荣誉挑战一般来自言语或行动中的冒犯，或者可能代表对地位或仪式传统的正式挑战。<p>

灰烬之民的崇拜<br>
部落中的所有灰烬之民，无论年龄大小，都出生在他们氏族的先祖崇拜当中。然而，尼瑞瓦因教派是不同的。这是一个很小的教派，只有几个有预言天赋的女智者，以及几个保护先知的神圣守护英雄。乌尔希拉库的灰烬可汗苏尔-玛图尔就是该教派的神圣守护英雄，同样属于乌尔希拉库的尼巴妮·玛伊沙是该教派的先知。<p>

尼瑞瓦因崇拜<br>
他们崇拜伟大的灰烬可汗和统谏使：尼瑞瓦-星与月，在过去的岁月里，尼瑞瓦摧毁了邪恶的，不信神的矮人，并将奸诈的达格斯·乌尔和他的邪恶追随者驱逐到红山之下。该教派在其他灰烬之民的崇拜中影响不大，只有在乌尔希拉库这个灰烬之民部族当中它的追随者才有影响力。其他灰烬之民部落也赞同该教派的观点，但对尼瑞瓦因的预言持怀疑态度。<p>

尼瑞瓦因预言<br>
据说预言当中预言了转世的尼瑞瓦的回归，他将把外邦人赶出灰烬之地，他将推翻神殿的伪神，恢复真正的先祖崇拜。这是一个足以吸引每个灰烬之民的梦想，但许多灰烬之民依然认为这只是一个愚蠢的古老传说，仅此而已。<p>

乌尔希拉库的灰烬之民<br>
乌尔希拉库部族是位于瓦登费尔灰烬之地北部和西部峡谷附近的灰烬之民。灰烬可汗苏尔-玛图尔是他们的首领，他是一位勇敢而受人尊敬的战争领袖，也是尼瑞瓦因教派的神圣守护者。尼巴妮·玛伊沙是他们的女智者，深谋远虑的谋士，尼瑞瓦因教派的先知。乌尔希拉玛库营地随牧群而动，但通常位于靠近鬼魂之海的地方，位于灰烬之地北部海岸，玛尔-甘村以北。<p>"""

Listen, faithful, to Vivec's words, for he says five times and five ways --<BR>
Forge a keen Faith in the crucible of suffering.<BR>
Engrave upon thy eye the image of injustice.<BR>
Death does not diminish; the ghost gilds with glory.<BR>
Faith conquers all. Let us yield to Faith.<BR>
Better to suffer a wrong than to do one.<BR>
<BR>
Hear the words of Lord Vivec, and heed his sermons on the Seven Graces, for he names them seven times and seven ways --<BR>
<BR>
VALOR<BR>
DARING<BR>
JUSTICE<BR>
COURTESY<BR>
PRIDE<BR>
GENEROSITY<BR>
HUMILITY<BR>
<BR>
The Grace of Valor<BR>
Thank you for your valor, Lord Vivec. I shall not quail, nor turn away, but face my enemies and my fear.<BR>
<BR>
The Grace of Daring<BR>
Thank you for your daring, Lord Vivec. I shall not shun risk, nor hide behind the mask of cautious counsel, for fortune favors the bold.<BR>
<BR>
The Grace of Justice<BR>
Thank you for your justice, Lord Vivec. I shall be neither cruel nor arbitrary, for fair dealing earns the love, trust, and respect of our people.<BR>
<BR>
The Grace of Courtesy<BR>
Thank you for your courtesy, Lord Vivec. I shall speak neither hurtful nor harsh word, but shall speak respectfully, even of my enemies, for temperate words may turn aside anger.<BR>
<BR>
The Grace of Pride<BR>
Thank you for your pride, Lord Vivec. I shall not doubt myself, or my people, or my gods, and shall insist upon them, and my ancient rights.<BR>
<BR>
The Grace of Generosity<BR>
Thank you for your generosity, Lord Vivec. I shall neither hoard nor steal, nor encumber myself with profitless treasures, but shall share freely among house and hearth.<BR>
<BR>
The Grace of Humilty<BR>
Thank you for your humility, Lord Vivec. I shall neither strut nor preen in vanity, but shall know and give thanks for my place in the greater world.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
萨里奥尼的布道词<BR>
祝福奥姆希维，慈悲，掌握与神秘<BR><BR>

<BR>

勇气之恩典<BR>

<BR>
胆识之恩典<BR>
感谢您的胆识，维威克大人。我不会因为有风险就回避，也不会躲藏在他人的谨慎建议这一面具之后，因为幸运会眷顾勇敢的人。<BR>
<BR>
公正之恩典<BR>
感谢您的公正，维威克大人。我将既不对人残忍也不过于武断，因为公平的交流会赢得人民的爱戴、信任和尊敬。<BR>
<BR>
礼节之恩典<BR>

<BR>
自豪之恩典<BR>
感谢您的自豪，维威克大人。我不会怀疑我自己、我的人民或我的神，我将坚决维护他们与自己所应得的古老的权利。<BR>
<BR>
慷慨之恩典<BR>
感谢您的慷慨，维威克大人。我既不会囤积居奇，也不会小偷小摸，更不会用无利可图的财宝来徒增自己的负担，而是会在家中坐在壁炉前分享自己的宝藏。<BR>
<BR>
谦逊之恩典<BR>
感谢您的谦逊，维威克大人。我既不会趾高气扬，也不会虚荣炫耀，而会知道自己在大千世界中的地位，并为之感恩。<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Honor Among Thieves<BR>
by Arnie the Scrib<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Many admirers ask, "Arnie, how can I become a flash and prosperous fellow like you?"<BR>
<BR>
And I tell them, "You want to join the Guild. Make friends. Be a part of something."<BR>
<BR>
"But who can join?" they ask.<BR>
<BR>
We're just like any other trade guild. We've got requirements. And if you want to advance in the ranks, we've got standards.<BR>
<BR>
You want to be fast and agile. You want to move undetected. You want to know about security -- locks, traps, and how to get around them. You want to defend yourself. You travel light and fast, and want light arms like daggers and shortswords. You don't want to get into a slugging match, so you want the marksman's weapons -- the bow, crossbow, throwing star, and dart. You want light armor, so you can keep moving, and moving fast.<BR>
<BR>
Why belong? Simple. Everybody needs friends.<BR>
<BR>
The help of friends includes information. Your friends at the Thieves Guild know where the action is, and where the action is safe, and where it is not. The help of friends includes a place to rest, and a place to buy supplies and services -- training and tools. The help of friends includes fixing things with the guards at a discount rate. That's where the 'honor among thieves' part comes in. Friends stick together, and help each other.<BR>
<BR>
"But what about the competition?" my admirers ask.<BR>
<BR>
The competition is the Camonna Tong. And you don't want to join them, because they don't want you. They have this thing about outlanders. They want them all dead. So, unless your ambition is to be dead, you don't want to join them.<BR>
<BR>
And the Camonna Tong are bad people. The Camonna Tong don't mind killing people. Heck, they LIKE killing people. The Thieves Guild, on the other hand, thinks killing people is bad business. You want to be good people, right? So join the Thieves Guild, and stay far, far away from the Camonna Tong.<BR>
<BR>
So you want to join. But where do you look?<BR>
<BR>
Being a thief is not like being a fighter. You don't just go to the local guild Hall. The Thieves Guild doesn't have Guild Halls. But thieves like to be where their friends are. And where are their friends? At the local cornerclub or tradehouse. In Vvardenfell, look for friends in Balmora, Ald'ruhn, Sadrith Mora, and the Foreign Quarter of Vivec.<BR>
<BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
盗贼中的荣誉<BR>
作者：抄写员阿尔涅<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
很多仰慕者曾问过我：“阿尔涅，我怎么才能像你一样一夜暴富？”<BR>
<BR>
我告诉他们，“你需要加入公会，结交更多朋友。成为某个团体的一部分。”<BR>
<BR>
“但什么样的人能加入？”他们问道。<BR>
<BR>
我们和其他贸易公会一样，我们有一套要求。如果你想晋级，我们也有一套标准。<BR>
<BR>
你得要变得快速且敏捷，你得在移动时不被发现，你得了解安保相关——锁、陷阱以及如何绕过它们。你得能够保护自己。你需要轻快地行动，要了解匕首和短剑之类的轻型武器。你不会想要正面一场激烈的战斗，因此你也必须要熟练掌握射术武器——弓、弩、手里剑和飞镖。你会需要轻型装备，这样你就可以顺利，脚步轻盈。<BR>
<BR>
为什么为得加入组织不可？很简单。每个人都需要朋友来为自己提供照应。<BR>
<BR>
朋友的帮助包括提供信息，你在盗贼公会的朋友们会知道在哪里行动，怎么安全地行动，如何避开危险。朋友的帮助包括提供休息的地方，以及购买所需用品和服务的地方——培训和工具交易。朋友的帮助还包括以折扣价与卫兵一起解决问题。这就是“盗贼之间的荣誉”部分的用武之地。朋友们能够团结在一起，互相帮助。<BR>
<BR>
“那么我们又要与什么人竞争呢？”我的仰慕者这样问道。<BR>
<BR>
我们的敌人是卡莫纳堂。你不会想要加入他们，因为他们也不会收留你。他们对于外地人恨之入骨，他们希望所有外地人都死无葬身之地。所以，除非你希望自己去送死，否则你不会想加入他们的。<BR>
<BR>
卡莫纳堂的人是坏人。卡莫纳堂的人也不介意杀人。哎呀，他们可喜欢杀人了。而盗贼公会却认为杀人是一件坏事。你想做个好人，对吧？所以加入盗贼公会，远离卡莫纳堂。<BR>
<BR>
所以你想加入公会？但是你应该在哪里加入呢？<BR>
<BR>
做小偷可不像那些战士，只是去一趟当地的公会大厅就完事了。盗贼公会没有公会大厅，但是小偷们喜欢在他们的朋友所在的地方。他们的朋友在哪里？在当地的街角酒吧或贸易行里面歇脚。在瓦登费尔，在巴尔莫拉、奥德-汝因、萨德里斯-莫拉、维威克城的外邦区，都能找到亲爱的朋友。<BR>
<BR>

The Seven Curses
《七大诅咒》

> BOOK.TEXT bk_thesevencurses
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
The Seven Curses<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[from the Apographa of the Dissident Priests, annotated by Gilvas Barelo, Abbot of Holamayan]<BR>
<BR>
through the doors of the unmourned house<BR>
where scoffers scoff and schemers scheme<BR>
from the halls of the oath-breaking house<BR>
rings seven curses of gods blasphemed<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
first curse, Curse-of-Fire<BR>
second curse, Curse-of-Ash<BR>
third curse, Curse-of-Flesh<BR>
fourth curse, Curse-of-Ghosts<BR>
fifth curse, Curse-of-Seed<BR>
sixth curse, Curse-of-Despair<BR>
seventh curse, Curse-of-Dreams<BR>
<BR>
Notes<BR>
<BR>
Lines 1-3: Ambiguous. May refer to the impiety of the god-mocking House Dwemer, or the treacherous diplomacy of the subtle House Dagoth, or both. House Dagoth, however, was reviled as oath-breakers for their treachery at Red Mountain. It may, however, refer to unspecified broken oaths of peace between Lord Nerevar and Lord Dumac, founders of the Grand Council. Nerevar and Dumac were loyal friends until the disagreements between the Dwemer and the other Great Houses broke out in open conflict.<BR>
<BR>
Line 4: The Dwemer were the mockers and profaners of the divine. <BR>
<BR>
Lines 5-6: The curses of fire and ash would come from Red Mountain where Dagoth Ur rules. These were the earliest reported threats from Red Mountain.<BR>
<BR>
Line 7: Curse of flesh suggest blight diseases, especially corprus. The fire and ash storms preceded the threats of blight and corprus.<BR>
<BR>
Line 8-10: Obscure. May refer to as-yet-unrecognized threats from Dagoth Ur.<BR>
<BR>
Line 11: Recent reports of soul sickness and disturbed dreams come from townfolk and Ashlanders alike. That the seventh and final curse has begun suggests the threat presented is about to reach a crisis.<BR>
<BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
七大诅咒<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[摘自《异见神职人员记》，霍拉马扬住持吉尔瓦斯·巴雷洛注解]<BR>
<BR>
穿过无人哀悼的家族的门<BR>
嘲笑者讥讽着，野心家谋划着<BR>
从违背誓言的家族的大厅里<BR>
响起亵渎神灵的七个诅咒<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
第一个诅咒，火之诅咒<BR>
第二个诅咒，灰烬之诅咒<BR>
第三个诅咒，肉体之诅咒<BR>
第四个诅咒，魂魄之诅咒<BR>
第五个诅咒，种子之诅咒<BR>
第六个诅咒，绝望之诅咒<BR>
第七个诅咒，梦之诅咒<BR>
<BR>
注解<BR>
<BR>
第1-3行：模棱两可。可能是指嘲讽锻莫对神的不虔诚，或者是狡猾的达格斯家族的奸诈外交，或者两者兼而有之。然而，达格斯家族因在红山背信弃义而被斥责为背信弃义者。然而，它可能指尼瑞瓦大人和大议会创始人杜马克大人之间未指明的和平誓言。尼瑞瓦和杜马克一直是忠实的朋友，直到锻莫与其他大家族之间的分歧在公开冲突中爆发。<BR>
<BR>
第4行：锻莫是神的嘲笑者和亵渎者。<BR>
<BR>
第5-6行：火和灰烬的诅咒来自达格斯乌尔统治的红山。这些是最早已知的来自红山的威胁。<BR>
<BR>
第7行：肉体诅咒暗示枯萎病，尤其是尸化病。火灾和灰烬风暴先于枯萎病和尸化病的威胁。<BR>
<BR>
第8-10行：晦涩难懂。可能指的是来自达格斯乌尔的尚未识别的威胁。<BR>
<BR>
第11行：最近不断有来自城镇居民和灰烬之民的关于灵魂疾病和噩梦的报告。第七个也是最后一个诅咒已经开始，这表明所呈现的威胁即将达到危机的程度。<BR>
<BR>"""

> BOOK.FNAM bk_thelostprophecy
The Lost Prophecy
《失落的预言》

> BOOK.TEXT bk_thelostprophecy
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
The Lost Prophecy<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[from the Apographa of the Dissident Priests, annotated by Gilvas Barelo, Abbot of Holamayan]<BR>
<BR>
From seventh sign of eleventh generation,<BR>
Neither Hound nor Guar, nor Seed nor Harrow, <BR>
But Dragon-born and far-star-marked,<BR>
Outlander Incarnate beneath Red Mountain,<BR>
Blessed Guest counters seven curses,<BR>
Star-blessed hand wields thrice-cursed blade,<BR>
To reap the harvest of the unmourned house.<BR>
<BR>
Notes<BR>
<BR>
Lines 1-3: 'Of ancient family, but not of the four great Ashlander clans. Born under foreign stars and the sign of the Dragon -- the Imperial sign.'<BR>
<BR>
Line 4-5: 'Outlander Incarnate' appears as a formal epithet, stressing the linkage between the words. The Outlander Incarnate is a 'blessed guest', one not born of the tribes but accepted as a guest with rights of hearth and hospitality. Under Red Mountain he will confront and balance against seven curses. See the 'Seven Curses' prophecy; also, Dagoth Ur is served by his seven kin, once great wizard-lords, called 'ash vampires' by the Ashlanders.<BR>
<BR>
Line 6-7: 'Star-blessed' suggests Azura, the Daedra Lord and patron of magic, fate, and prophecy. 'Thrice-cursed blade' may refer to  a weapon called Keening, associated in certain legends with the Battle of Red Mountain and Dwemer craftlord Kagrenac. 'Reap the harvest' is a reference to the proverb, "You harvest from the seeds you plant," which means you get what your labors deserve, in both a positive sense of reward and negative sense of punishment. The 'unmourned house' could be either or both of the lost Great Houses of the Dunmer -- House Dwemer and House Dagoth.<BR>
<BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
失落的预言<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[本文摘自异见祭司的《匿典》，注解人：吉尔瓦斯·巴雷洛，霍拉马扬住持。]<BR>
<BR>
从第十一代的第七个标志开始，<BR>
既非猎犬亦非瓜尔，既非种子亦非钉耙，<BR>
惟有龙之裔与远星之印，<BR>
外地人化身于红山之下，<BR>
受祝的来客能够抵御七个诅咒，<BR>
星辰庇佑之手挥舞着受三度诅咒之刃，<BR>
收割着无人哀悼的家族的果实。<BR>
<BR>
注解<BR>
<BR>
1-3行：“属于古代家族，但并不是瓦登费尔的四大灰烬之民部落宗族。出生于外邦的星空与龙的标志之下——指的是帝国的标志。”<BR>
<BR>
4-5行：“外地人化身”作为一个正式的词缀出现，强调着上下文之间的联系。外地来的化身是一个“受祝的来客”，他/她并非灰烬之民部落出身，但却是可以和他们一同拥坐在火炉旁受到热情款待的客人。在红山之下，这个人能够面对并平衡七种诅咒，详情见《七个诅咒》的预言；此外，达格斯乌尔也被他/她曾经的七个亲属侍奉着，他们曾是伟大的巫师领主，被灰烬之民称为“灰烬吸血鬼”。<BR>
<BR>
6-7行：“星辰庇佑”表示的是迪德拉领主，同时也是魔法、命运与预言的守护神——阿祖拉。“受三度诅咒之刃”指的可能是一把名为哀恸的武器，在某些传说中与红山之战还有锻莫工匠卡格瑞纳克有关。“收割果实”指的是谚语“所种即有所得”，这意味着不管是获得奖励也好惩罚也罢，你付出了一份劳动就会得到一些收获。“无人哀悼的家族”指的可能是锻莫家族和达格斯家族其中一个，或者两者皆是。<BR>
<BR>"""

> BOOK.FNAM bk_kagrenac'stools
Kagrenac's Tools
《卡格瑞纳克的工具》

> BOOK.TEXT bk_kagrenac'stools
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Kagrenac's Tools<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[summarized from the Apographa by Gilvas Barelo, Abbot of Holamayan, and various of the Dissident Priests ]<BR>
<BR>
Beneath Red Mountain, Dwemer miners discovered a great magical stone. By diverse methods, Lord Kagrenac, High Priest and Magecrafter of the ancient Dwemer, determined that this magical stone was the heart of the god Lorkhan, cast here in the Dawn Era as a punishment for his mischief in creating the mortal world. Determined to use its divine powers to create a new god for the exclusive benefit of the Dwemer, Kagrenac forged three great enchanted artifacts, which are called "Kagrenac's Tools." Wraithguard is an enchanted gauntlet to protect its wearer from destruction when tapping the heart's power. Sunder is a enchanted hammer to strike the heart and produce the exact volume and quality of power desired. Keening is an enchanted blade that is used to flay and focus the power that rises from the heart.<BR>
<BR>
When Kagrenac used these tools on the heart in the Battle of Red Mountain, no one knows what happened, but the Dwemer race disappeared entirely from the mortal world. Lord Nerevar and Lord Dagoth retrieved these tools, and didn't know what to do with them. Nerevar asked Dagoth to guard the tools while he went to consult with his counselors, Vivec, Almalexia, and Sotha Sil. He left and spoke with his three counselors, and they decided to return together to Red Mountain to decide what to do.<BR>
<BR>
But while Nerevar was gone, Dagoth was tempted and confused by the powers of the tools. When Nerevar and the counselors arrived, he refused to give up the tools, claiming he had sworn to Nerevar to protect them. Then Dagoth fought with Nerevar and the counselors, and was mortally wounded and driven off, and the tools were recovered.<BR>
<BR>
Then Nerevar and his counselors decided to take the tools for safekeeping. They all swore a great oath never to use the tools, but after Nerevar's death, Vivec, Almalexia, and Sotha Sil yielded to temptation. They took these tools themselves and went to Lorkhan's heart buried beneath Red Mountain, and gave themselves divine powers.<BR>
<BR>
But Dagoth had not died. We don't know what happened, but this is what we believe. His experiments with Kagrenac's Tools had joined him to the heart's divine nature in some way, so that he learned to draw power directly from the heart.<BR>
<BR>
We conjecture that Dagoth Ur, driven by anger and greed, used the heart without caution and restraint, and, as a result, he has become terribly powerful, and terribly mad. But the Tribunal showed great care and restraint in their use of the tools, and so they were not driven mad, and they did many good things. Nonetheless, the Tribunal, too, appear to heave been corrupted by the heart's power, though more subtly.<BR>
<BR>
Kagrenac's Tools are cursed. Stealing power from the heart of a god is a terrible folly, and fated to disaster. The Tribunal is losing its battle to control the power of the heart. They are sustained by the same tainted power that drives Dagoth Ur mad. They grow weak, and cannot protect us from Dagoth Ur. But even if they could, would we be wise to worship gods such as these? They conceal the truth from us out of shame. They persecute the Nerevarine and the Dissident priests out of shame, when they should be welcoming them and enlisting their aid against Dagoth Ur.<BR>
<BR>
The Tribunal have done much good for Morrowind and the Dunmer. But they succumbed to the temptation of Kagrenac's Tools, and though these tools once may have seemed the instruments of salvation, now they must be seen as instruments of doom.<BR>"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
卡格瑞纳克的工具<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[摘自霍拉马扬住持吉尔瓦斯·巴雷洛和其他异见祭司的手记]<BR>
<BR>
在红山之下，锻莫矿工发现了一块巨大的魔法石。古代锻莫的大祭司兼法师卡格瑞纳克大人通过多种方法确定这块魔法石就是神明洛克汗的心脏。作为对他创造凡间的恶作剧的惩罚，早在黎明纪元就被铸造于此处。为了锻莫的种族利益，卡格瑞纳克决心用自己的魔法创造一个新的神，他锻造了三件伟大的附魔神器，被称为“卡格瑞纳克的工具”。幽魂影卫是一只魔法腕甲，可在提取心脏的力量的同时保护其佩戴者免受伤害。决裂是一把附魔锤子，可以敲击心脏并产生所需的精确音量和质量。哀恸是一把附魔短刀，用于从心脏中剥削和收集力量。<BR>
<BR>
当卡格瑞纳克在红山之战中将这些工具用在心脏上时，谁也不知道发生了什么，但锻莫一族却彻底从凡间消失了。尼瑞瓦大人和达格斯大人取回了这些工具，但是他们不知道这些工具是拿来做什么的。尼瑞瓦请求达格斯在他去咨询他的顾问维威克、阿玛莱西娅和索萨·希尔时，保护好这些工具。他离开之后，与他的三位顾问交谈，他们决定一起回到红山再决定接下来应该做什么。<BR>
<BR>
但是当尼瑞瓦不在的时候，达格斯被这些工具的力量所诱惑和迷惑。尼瑞瓦和谋士们到达时，达格斯拒绝交出工具，声称他曾向尼瑞瓦发誓要保护他们。随后达格斯与尼瑞瓦和谋士们发生了战斗，身负重伤被赶走，工具也被取回。<BR>
<BR>
于是尼瑞瓦和他的谋士们决定把这些工具封存起来，他们都发誓永不使用这些工具。但在尼瑞瓦死后，维威克、阿玛莱西娅和索萨·希尔屈服于诱惑。他们亲自带着这些工具，来到了埋藏在红山下的洛克汗的心脏，赋予了自己神力。<BR>
<BR>
但达格斯并没有死。我们并不知道具体发生了什么，但这就是我们所相信的。他对卡格瑞纳克工具的实验以某种方式让他与心脏的神性结合，因此他学会了直接从心脏汲取力量。<BR>
<BR>
我们猜想，达格斯乌尔在愤怒和贪婪的驱使下，毫无节制地使用了心脏的力量，结果他变得非常强大，非常疯狂。但审判席对工具的使用非常谨慎和克制，他们并没有被逼疯，反而为群众做了很多好事。尽管如此，审判席似乎也被心脏的力量腐蚀了，尽管效果更微妙。<BR>
<BR>
卡格瑞纳克的工具被诅咒了。从神明的心脏中窃取力量是一种可怕的愚蠢行为，注定会遭受灾难。审判席正在失去对心脏力量的控制。他们同样靠着被污染的力量苦苦支撑着，这让达格斯·乌尔发疯了。他们变得虚弱，无法保护我们免受达格斯·乌尔的伤害。但即使他们可以，我们崇拜这样的神是明智的吗？他们出于羞耻而向我们隐瞒真相。他们出于羞耻而迫害尼瑞瓦因和异见祭司，他们本应该欢迎他们并争取他们的援助来对抗达格斯·乌尔。<BR>
<BR>
审判席为晨风和丹莫做了很多好事。但他们屈服于卡格瑞纳克工具的诱惑，虽然这些工具曾经似乎是用于拯救世间的工具，但现在它们必须被视为灾厄的工具。<BR>"""

> BOOK.FNAM bk_vivecs_plan
Plan to Defeat Dagoth Ur
《击败达格斯·乌尔的计划》

> BOOK.TEXT bk_vivecs_plan
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
The Plan to Defeat Dagoth Ur<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
For the past twenty years the Tribunal have tried unsuccessfully to execute this plan. However, we failed because we were required to stage an assault and simultaneously maintain the Ghostfence to prevent the threatened large-scale breakout of Dagoth Ur's blighted hosts. With the Nerevarine leading the assault, and the Tribunal free to devote their full energies to maintaining the Ghostfence, this plan has a greater chance of success. Unfortunately, however, the loss of the artifacts Sunder and Keening, and the recent increase in Dagoth Ur's strength, poses new problems for the execution of the plan.<br>
<br>
Therefore, our proposed plan has the following five phases:<br>
<br>
1. A series of aggressive raids to scout inside the Ghostfence.<br>
2. A series of aggressive raids to neutralize Dagoth Ur's ash vampire kin, and recover artifacts from the bodies of his kin.<br>
3. An assault of Gate Citadel Vemynal to neutralize Dagoth Vemyn and recover the artifact hammer Sunder.<br>
4. An assault of Gate Citadel Odrosal to neutralize Dagoth Odros and recover the artifact blade Keening.<br>
5. An assault of Citadel Dagoth with the artifacts Wraithguard, Sunder, and Keening to sever Dagoth Ur's connection to the Heart of Lorkhan, and thus to Destroy Dagoth Ur.<br>
<br>
Phase 1: Raids inside the Ghostfence<br>
<br>
The Tribunal, Ordinators, and Buoyant Armigers are familiar with the terrain, and will provide maps and current intelligence reports. The region inside the Ghostfence is dangerous, and the Nerevarine will need to be familiar with its particular challenges. After measuring skills and resources against Dagoth Ur's defenses, the Nerevarine will know better how to pace a campaign, alternating raids with improving skills, getting better equipment, and stockpiling resources.<br>
<br>
Phase 2: Raids upon Ash Vampire Citadels<br>
<br>
Dagoth Ur's kin have become markedly more powerful in recent decades, after remaining stable for thousands of years. If they can be individually isolated and destroyed, they will not be able to support Dagoth Ur in later stages of the war. It may also be that the dramatic increase in their power comes from items enchanted by Dagoth Ur. Salvage of such items might contribute to our resources.<br>
<br>
Phase 3: Assault on Gate Citadel Vemynal<br>
<br>
Essential to recover the artifact hammer Sunder for Phase 5. The Ash Vampire Dagoth Vemyn has possession of Sunder, and probably seeks to discover the secrets of its enchantments. He may also have access to notebooks and journals of Kagrenac that have survived in the Dwemer workshops of Vemynal.<br>
<br>
Phase 4: Assault on Gate Citadel Odrosal<br>
<br>
Essential to recover the artifact blade Keening for Phase 5. The Ash Vampire Dagoth Odros has possession of Keening, and probably seeks to discover the secrets of its enchantments. He may also have access to notebooks and journals of Kagrenac that have survived in the Dwemer workshops of Odrosal.<br>
<br>
Phase 5: Assault on Citadel Dagoth<br>
<br>
All the previous stages are preparations for this stage. Recent expeditions show that Citadel Dagoth has undergone extensive expansion; the location will need to be explored carefully. The known route to the Heart Chamber will be well-defended; alternative routes may exist. Dagoth Ur will have anticipated our plan to destroy him by attacking the Heart, and he will almost certainly personally oppose approach to the Heart Chamber. Together the Tribunal could not defeat him, and he has grown stronger since then. Admittedly, the Tribunal had the distraction of maintaining the Ghostfence simultaneous with fighting Dagoth Ur, but, even so, the challenge seems daunting.<br>
<br>
The adoption of this phased campaign seems to offer the best chances for success. In retrospect, the Tribunal's decision to directly assault Citadel Dagoth rather than proceed step-by-step through lesser objectives must be seen to have been a serious error. The Tribunal did not feel it had the option of a slow-paced and deliberate campaign, given that they had many other competing priorities, not the least of which was the maintenance of the Ghostfence and the outer defenses surrounding Red Mountain. The Nerevarine, on the other hand, should be best served by a careful, step-by-step advance, with the additional advantage of building confidence along the way while successes would undermine Dagoth Ur's own assurance in his defenses.<br>
<br>
Employing Kagrenac's Tools against Dagoth Ur<br>
<br>
The source of Dagoth Ur's supernatural power is the Heart of Lorkhan. The Heart is also the source of the Tribunal's divine powers.<br>
<br>
During mythic times, the gods took and hid Lorkhan's heart beneath Red Mountain as a punishment for creating the mortal plane. The Dwemer discovered the heart while building underground colonies. High Craftlord Kagrenac created enchanted tools intended to tap the power of the heart. The War of the First Council was fought to prevent this sacrilege. Kagrenac's use of these tools and the disappearance of the Dwemer race marked the end of the war. Kagrenac's tools were recovered by Lord Nerevar and Dagoth Ur. Dagoth Ur was left to guard the tools while Nerevar came to consult with us, his advisors. In Nerevar's absence, Dagoth Ur experimented with the tools upon the heart, and was corrupted. We returned to discover a deranged Dagoth Ur who refused to turn over the tools. When he attacked us, we drove him away.<br>
<br>
We left Red Mountain with the tools, and subsequently Sotha Sil discovered their secrets. Collectively we used the tools to establish a connection with the Heart, enabling ourselves to transform our mortal natures. Thus we became the Tribunal.<br>
<br>
Dagoth Ur had survived our attacks, and without the tools, in a manner not well understood, Dagoth Ur also managed to establish a connection with the Heart and to transform himself into an immortal being.<br>
<br>
Our plan to destroy Dagoth Ur also runs the risk of destroying the Tribunal. The plan is to permanently disrupt Kagrenac's enchantments upon the Heart, severing connections with Dagoth Ur and ourselves, and rendering us all once again mortal. A mortal Kagrenac may then be destroyed by mundane means. The loss of godhood and the possible death of the Tribunal are judged a necessary risk and sacrifice.<br>
<br>
The normal procedure for establishing connection with the Heart is a three-step process. The wearer of Wraithguard strikes the Heart with the hammer Sunder, causing the Heart to produce a pure tone. Then the wearer of the Wraithguard strikes the Heart with the blade Keening, shattering the pure tone into a prism of tone-shades. These tone-shades are then imprinted upon the substance of the wearer of Wraithguard, giving him an immortal and divine nature.<br>
<br>
The Nerevarine will not be taught the secret rituals required to perform the third step. Instead, The Nerevarine will strike the Heart with Keening for a second time, causing its tones to diverge into unstable patterns of interference. Further repeated strikes with Keening will further disrupt the tones, with the ultimate result of shattering and dispelling Kagrenac's original enchantments binding the Heart, thereby severing the Heart's links with Dagoth Ur, and with any surviving Heartwights, and with the Tribunal. Destroying Kagrenac's enchantments on the Heart will also stop the corrupt effusion of the Heart's divine power, and end the Blight on Morrowind.<br>
<br>
The Nerevarine may be tempted to steal the power of the Heart. Dagoth Ur and Sotha Sil alone know this secret. Dagoth Ur may, in extremity, propose to teach the Nerevarine to use Kagrenac's tools to become a god. We doubt that the Nerevarine is fool enough to trust Dagoth Ur, and are content to take this risk.<br>
<br>
Be warned! The Nerevarine cannot safely equip either Keening or Sunder unless wearing Wraithguard. The Nerevarine will be injured every moment while holding either of these artifacts unless protected by Wraithguard; persistence will be rewarded with death. If Nerevarine can equip an item while not wearing Wraithguard and receive no injury, the item is a counterfeit.<br>
<br>
One last note. Dagoth Ur must not get hold of Wraithguard. The Nerevaine must prepare and use a Recall or Almsivi Intervention if there is any risk of death or capture.<br>
<br>
<br>
The Element of Surprise<br>
Dagoth Ur will not expect you to destroy Kagrenac's enchantments on the Heart. He does not know it is possible, he would not do it himself, and he knows we have never tried it. He will not believe anyone would want to sacrifice the promise of such power. Further, advancement in House Dagoth, as in all Great Houses, is by challenge and confrontation within the hierarchy. The Nerevarine's challenges and defeats of ash vampires and battles with the Sixth House will be viewed in that light. <br>
<br>
Dagoth Ur and his kin may assume The Nerevarine's ambition is to control the Heart. Given that assumption, it is only reasonable that the Nerevarine would try to defeat each of Dagoth Ur's subordinates in turn, working up to Dagoth Ur. If the Nerevarine can defeat Dagoth Ur, and control the Heart, so much the better. But logically the Nerevarine would wish rise as high in the hierarchy as possible before cutting a deal with head of the House.<br>
<br>
Dagoth Ur should try to recruit the Nerevarine into House Dagoth. It may be possible to pretend to join him, then betray him. However, any attempt to deceive him will be very risky. House Dagoth has a tradition of subterfuge and treachery, and because he is a deceiver, he will expect deception.<br>
<br>
Closing Remarks<br>
<br>
We place no compulsion upon the Nerevarine to adhere to the plans described here. We believe that they offer the best chance of destroying Dagoth Ur. But we have also chosen to place our trust in the Nerevarine's judgement and skill. Frankly, we see no alternative. <br>
<br>
If there are doubts or questions, speak with Vivec. He has agreed to serve as the Nerevarine's guide and counselor for this campaign.<br>
<br>
It may be that if the Nerevarine succeeds, the Tribunal will not survive. Such sentiments as might have been expressed to the Tribunal should, in that case, be addressed to the land and people of Morrowind.<br>
<br>
May the happy convergence of fortune and prayer meet in our destiny.<br>
<br>
On behalf of Lady Almalexia and Lord Sotha Sil,<br>
<br>
Vivec<br>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
击败达格斯·乌尔的计划<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
在过去的二十年里，审判席一直试图执行这个计划，但没有成功。然而，我们失败的原因，是因为我们需要在发动进攻的同时维持鬼魂之墙，以防止达格斯·乌尔的枯萎病宿主大规模从红山突围。有了尼瑞瓦因的带头进攻，审判席也可以将全部精力投入到维护鬼魂之墙上，这个计划成功的几率就更大了。但不幸的是，神器决裂和哀恸的遗失，以及达格斯·乌尔近期实力的增强，都给计划的执行带来了新的问题。<br>
<br>
因此，我们建议的计划分为以下五个阶段：<br>
<br>
1. 突袭鬼魂之墙内部，并进行一系列的侦察。<br>
2. 进行一系列侵略性突袭，消灭达格斯·乌尔的灰烬吸血鬼族人，并从其族人的身上找回神器。<br>
3. 突袭维密纳，削弱达格斯·维明的战斗力并将其击败，然后夺回神器之锤决裂。<br>
4. 突袭欧德罗萨，削弱达格斯·欧德罗萨的战斗力并将其击败，然后夺回神器之刃哀恸。<br>
5. 用神器幽魂影卫、决裂和哀恸与达格斯·乌尔进行战斗，切断达格斯·乌尔与洛克汗之心的联系，从而彻底摧毁达格斯·乌尔。<br>
<br>
第一阶段：突袭鬼魂之墙内部<br>
<br>
审判席、神殿卫兵和灵动扈从熟悉红山的地形，他们将提供地图和当前的情报报告。鬼魂之墙内的区域很危险，尼瑞瓦因需要熟悉其所面临的难关。在根据达格斯·乌尔在红山展开的防御情况衡量技能与资源后，尼瑞瓦因将更清楚如何把握战役的节奏，在提高技能、获得更好的装备和储备资源的同时交替发动突袭。<br>
<br>
第二阶段：突袭灰烬吸血鬼的城堡<br>
<br>
达格斯·乌尔的族人在保持稳定数千年后，近几十年来明显变得更加强大。如果能单独孤立并逐个消灭它们，它们将无法在战争后期支援达格斯·乌尔。它们力量的剧增也可能来自达格斯·乌尔的附魔之力。获取这些物品可能能够为我们的战役增添所需的资源。<br>
<br>
第三阶段：进攻维密纳城堡<br>
<br>
这是为第五阶段找回神器之锤决裂的必要条件。灰烬吸血鬼达格斯·维明拥有神器决裂之锤子，并可能试图研究其附魔的秘密。他还可能获得了在维密纳的锻莫工坊中留存下来的卡格瑞纳克的笔记和日志。<br>
<br>
第四阶段：进攻欧德罗萨城堡<br>
<br>
这是为第五阶段找回神器之刃哀恸的必要条件。灰烬吸血鬼达格斯·欧德罗萨拥有哀恸之刃，他很可能想研究哀恸之刃附魔的秘密。他还可能获得了在欧德罗萨的锻莫工坊中留存下来的卡格瑞纳克的笔记和日志。<br>
<br>
第五阶段：进攻达格斯·乌尔的城堡<br>
<br>
之前所有阶段都是为这一阶段做准备。最近的探索表示，达格斯·乌尔城堡经历了大规模的扩张；需要对该地点进行仔细的探索。通往心脏之间的已知路线将被严密防守；可能存在其他路线。达格斯·乌尔肯定已经预料到我们要通过攻击心脏来消灭他的计划，而且他几乎肯定会亲自阻止我们前往心脏之间。即使审判席三神合力也无法将其击败，而他自那以后变得更加强大了。诚然，审判席在与达格斯·乌尔战斗的同时还得分心维持鬼魂之墙，但即便如此，挑战似乎也很艰巨。<br>
<br>
采用这种分阶段作战的方式似乎最有可能取得成功。现在回过头来看，审判席决定直接攻打达格斯·乌尔的城堡，而不是通过较小的目标逐步推进，必须被视为一个严重的错误。审判席认为自己无法选择节奏缓慢、深思熟虑的战役，因为他们还有许多其他优先事项，其中最重要的就是维护鬼魂之墙和红山周围的外围防御。而对尼瑞瓦因来说，最好的办法应该是小心翼翼、步步为营地推进，这样做的另一个好处是可以在成功的同时建立信心，从而削弱达格斯-乌尔对自己防御的信心。<br>
<br>
使用卡格瑞纳克的工具击败达格斯·乌尔<br>
<br>
达格斯·乌尔超自然力量的源泉是洛克汗之心。这颗心脏也是审判席神力的来源。<br>
<br>
在神话时代，众神将洛克汗的心脏拿走并藏于红山之下，作为对其创造凡人位面的惩罚。锻莫在建造地下殖民地时发现了这颗心脏。高级锻莫工匠卡格瑞纳克的创造了带有附魔的工具，旨在挖掘心脏的力量。第一议会之战就是为了阻止这种亵渎神明行为而展开的。卡格瑞纳克使用这些工具和锻莫种族的消失标志着战争的结束。卡格瑞纳克的工具被尼瑞瓦领主和达格斯·乌尔找回。达格斯·乌尔被留下来保卫这些工具，而尼瑞瓦则前来与我们这些顾问商议。尼瑞瓦不在的时候，达格斯·乌尔用这些工具在心脏上做了实验，结果被心脏的力量腐蚀了。我们回来后发现达格斯·乌尔精神错乱，他拒绝交出工具。当他攻击我们时，我们把他驱逐了。<br>
<br>
我们带着工具离开了红山，索萨·希尔随后发现了工具的秘密。我们集体使用这些工具建立了与心脏的联系，使我们能够改变我们的凡人本性。这样，我们就成了审判席三神。<br>
<br>
达格斯·乌尔在我们的攻击下幸存了下来，在没有工具的情况下，达格斯·乌尔也以一种不为人知的方式，成功地与心脏建立了联系，并将自己变成了不朽的存在。<br>
<br>
我们消灭达格斯·乌尔的计划也冒着毁灭审判席的风险。我们的计划是永久性地破坏卡格瑞纳克在心脏上施加的附魔之术，切断达格斯·乌尔和我们与心脏之间的联系，使我们再次成为凡人。然后，降为凡人的活神就可以被世俗手段摧毁了。失去神性和审判席可能灭亡被认为是必要的风险和牺牲。<br>
<br>
与心脏建立联系的正常程序分为三个步骤。第一步是幽魂影卫佩戴者使用锤子“决裂”敲击心脏，使心脏发出纯净的音调。然后第二步则是幽魂影卫佩戴者使用刀刃“哀恸”刺击心脏，将纯净的音调击碎，变成由音调阴影组成的棱镜。然后，这些色调就会烙印在幽魂影卫佩戴者的身体上，赋予他不朽的神性。<br>
<br>
尼瑞瓦因不会被传授执行第三步所需的秘密仪式。相反，尼瑞瓦因需要用哀恸第二次刺击心脏，使其音调再次分化成不稳定的干扰模式。然后再用哀恸反复刺击会进一步扰乱音调，最终粉碎并驱散卡格雷纳克束缚之心的远古附魔之术，从而切断心脏与达格斯·乌尔和所有残余的与心脏建立联系的达格斯族人，以及审判席与心脏间的联系。摧毁卡格瑞纳克在心脏上施加的附魔之术也将停止心脏神力的枯萎，结束晨风的枯萎病风暴。<br>
<br>
尼瑞瓦因可能会受到诱惑而窃取神之心的力量。但只有达格斯·乌尔和索萨·希尔知道窃取神之心力量的秘密。达格斯·乌尔可能会在极端的情况下提议教导尼瑞瓦因使用卡格瑞纳克的工具成为神。但我们并不认为尼瑞瓦因会傻到相信达格斯·乌尔，并愿意冒这个险。<br>
<br>
请注意！若不佩戴幽魂影卫，尼瑞瓦因将无法安全地使用哀恸或决裂。除非有幽魂影卫的保护，否则尼瑞瓦因在持有这两件神器的过程中每时每刻都会受到致命的伤害；坚持使用的代价就是死亡。如果尼瑞瓦因可以在不佩戴幽魂影卫的情况下装备其中的某个神器，并且不会受到任何伤害，那么这件神器就是假冒的。<br>
<br>
最后一个注意事项：绝不能让达格斯·乌尔得到幽魂影卫。如果有任何死亡或被俘的风险，尼瑞瓦因必须准备并使用召回或奥姆希维干预。<br>
<br>
<br>
出其不意的计划<br>
达格斯·乌尔不会料到你想要摧毁卡格瑞纳克施加在心脏上的附魔。他根本没有预想过这种可能，他自己不可能这么做，他知道我们也不可能这么做。他不会相信有人愿意毁灭这种独一无二的力量。此外，在达格斯家族，就和在所有大家族一样，晋升是通过等级制度内的互相挑战和对抗来实现的。尼瑞瓦因挑战并击败灰烬吸血鬼，以及与第六家族的战斗，都将从这个角度来看待。<br>
<br>
达格斯·乌尔和他的族人可能会认为尼瑞瓦因的野心是控制心脏。有鉴于此，尼瑞瓦因想依次击败达格斯·乌尔的每一个部下，直至达格斯·乌尔，也就在情理之中了。如果尼瑞瓦因能打败达格斯·乌尔并控制心脏，那就更好了。但从逻辑上讲，尼瑞瓦因希望在与家族领袖达成协议之前，尽可能地提升自己的地位。<br>
<br>
达格斯·乌尔可能会设法招募尼瑞瓦因加入达格斯家族。也许可以假装加入他，然后再背叛他。然而，任何欺骗他的企图都是非常冒险的。达格斯家族有着诡计多端、背信弃义的传统，而且因为他本身就是一个欺诈者，所以他可能也会料到尼瑞瓦因的计策。<br>
<br>
结束语<br>
<br>
我们并不强迫尼瑞瓦因严格遵守以上描述的计划。但我们相信，这些计划提供了消灭达格斯·乌尔的最佳机会。但我们也选择相信尼瑞瓦因自身的判断力和技能。坦率地说，我们认为别无选择。<br>
<br>
如果有疑问或问题，请与维威克本人交谈。他已同意担任尼瑞瓦因在此次战役中的向导和顾问。<br>
<br>
如果尼瑞瓦因成功了，审判席就可能无法再存活下去。在这种情况下，可能向审判席表达的情感应该向晨风的土地和人民表达。<br>
<br>
我代表阿玛莱西娅女士和索萨·希尔大人致辞，<br>
<br>
愿幸运与祈祷在我们的命运中交汇。<br>
<br>
维威克<br>

Nerevar at Red Mountain
《红山上的尼瑞瓦》

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Nerevar at Red Mountain<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[The following is from the Apographa, the hidden writings of the Tribunal Temple. It is a scholarly retelling of a tradition transmitted through the Ashlanders concerning the battle at Red Mountain and subsequent events. The Ashlanders associate this tale with the telling of Alandro Sul, a shield-companion of Nerevar who came to live among the Ashlanders after the death of Nerevar and during the ascension of the Tribunal. There are many variant treatments of this story, but the primary elements are consistent throughout the tradition. The murder of Nerevar, the tragic fate of Dagoth Ur, and the profane source of the Tribunal's divine power are denied by Temple doctrine as ignorant Ashlander superstition, and not widely known among civilized Dunmer.] <BR>
<BR>
Resdayn, present day Morrowind, was contested ground between two very different types of mer: the Chimer, who worshipped Daedra, and the Dwemer, who worshipped a profane and secret power. These two people warred with each other constantly until their lands were invaded by a young, vibrant, and violent alien culture, the Nords. <BR>
<BR>
Two heroes, one from the Chimer and one from the Dwemer, Indoril Nerevar and Dumac Dwarf-Orc, made peace between their people and together ousted the alien invaders. Then these two heroes worked long and hard to maintain that peace thereafter, though their counselors thought it could not last or, worse, that it shouldn't. Nerevar's queen and his generals-- Almalexia, Sotha Sil, Vivec-- told him to claim all Resdayn for his own. But Nerevar would not listen, for he remembered his friendship with Dumac. There would be only peace. <BR>
<BR>
Until Dagoth-Ur arrived. House Dagoth had discovered the source of the profane and secret power of the Dwemer: the legendary Heart of Lorkhan, which Dumac's people had used to make themselves immortal and beyond the measure of the gods. In fact, one of the their high priests, Kagrenac, was building a New God so that the Dwemer could claim Resdayn for their own. <BR>
<BR>
The Tribunal urged Nerevar again to make war on the Dwarves. Nerevar was troubled. He went to Dumac, his friend of old, and asked if what Dagoth-Ur said was true. But Kagrenac and the high priests of the Dwemer had kept their New God secret from their King, and Dumac said the Dwemer were innocent of any wrongdoing. Nerevar was troubled again and made pilgrimage to Holamayan, the sacred temple of Azura, who confirmed that all that Dagoth-Ur said was indeed true and that the New God of the Dwemer should be destroyed for the safety of not only Resdayn, but for the whole world. When Nerevar went back and told his Tribunal what the goddess had said, his queen and generals felt themselves proved aright and again counseled him to war. There were reasons that the Dwemer and Chimer had hated each other forever. <BR>
<BR>
Finally, Nerevar, angered that his friend Dumac would lie to him, went back to Vvardenfell. This time the Chimer King was arrayed in arms and armor and had his hosts around him, and he spoke harshly to Dumac Dwarf-Orc, King of Red Mountain. "You must give up your worship of the Heart of Lorkhan or I shall forget our friendship and the deeds that were accomplished in its name!" And Dumac, who still knew nothing of Kagrenac's New God, but proud and protective as ever of his people, said, "We shall not relinquish that which has been our way for years beyond reckoning, just as the Chimer will not relinquish their ties to the Lords and Ladies of Oblivion. And to come at my door in this way, arrayed in arms and armor and with your hosts around you, tells me you have already forgotten our friendship. Stand down, my sweet Nerevar, or I swear by the fifteen-and-one golden tones I shall kill you and all your people." <BR>
<BR>
And so the Chimer and Dwemer went to war. The Dwemer were well-defended by their fortress at Red Mountain, but the bravery and cleverness of Nerevar's queen and generals drew most of Dumac's armies out into the field and kept them there, so that Nerevar and Dagoth-Ur could make their way into the Heart Chamber by secret means. There, Nerevar met Dumac and the Dwarf King and they both fell from grievous wounds. Dagoth-Ur slew Kagrenac and took the tools the Dwemer used to tap the power of the Heart. He went to his dying lord Nerevar and asked him what to do with these tools. And Nerevar summoned Azura again, and she showed them how to use the tools to separate the power of the Heart from the Dwemer people. <BR>
<BR>
And on the fields, the Tribunal and their armies watched as the Dwemer turned into dust all around them as their stolen immortality was taken away. <BR>
<BR>
Back in Red Mountain, Nerevar told Dagoth-Ur to protect the tools and the Heart Chamber until he returned. Dagoth-Ur said, "But shouldn't we destroy these tools at once, so that they might never be used for evil again?" But Nerevar was confused by his wounds and his sorrow (for he still loved Dumac and the Dwemer people) and so went to the fields outside of Red Mountain to confer with his queen and his generals, who had foreseen that this war would come and whose counsel he would not ignore again. "I will ask the Tribunal what we shall do with them, for they have had wisdom in the past that I had not. Stay here, loyal Dagoth-Ur, until I return." <BR>
<BR>
Then Nerevar told his queen and generals all that had transpired under Red Mountain and how the Dwemer had used special tools to turn their people into immortals and of the wondrous power of the Heart of Lorkhan. The Tribunal decided that the Chimer should learn how to use this power so that Nerevar might claim Resdayn and the world for their people. Nerevar did not expect or want this, so he asked his queen and generals to help him summon Azura yet again for her guidance. But the Tribunal had become as greedy as Kagrenac upon hearing of the power of the Heart and they coveted it. They made ritual as if to summon Azura as Nerevar wanted but Almalexia used poisoned candles and Sotha Sil used poisoned robes and Vivec used poisoned invocations. Nerevar was murdered. <BR>
<BR>
Then Azura came forth anyway and cursed the Tribunal for their foul deeds. She told them that she would use her powers over dusk and dawn to make sure Nerevar would come back and make things right again. But the Tribunal laughed at her and said that soon they would be gods themselves and that the Chimer people would forget their old ways of worship. And Azura knew this would be true and that it would take a long time before her power might bring Nerevar back. "What you have done here today is foul beyond measure and you will grow to regret it, for the lives of gods are not what mortals think and matters that weigh only years to mortals weigh on gods forever." And so that they might know forever their wicked deeds Azura changed the Chimer into Dunmer, and their skin turned ashen and their eyes into fire. "Let this mark remind you of your true selves who, like ghouls, fed on the nobility, heroism, and trust of their king." <BR>
<BR>
And then the Tribunal went into Red Mountain and met with Dagoth-Ur. Dagoth-Ur saw what had been done, for his skin had changed as well, and he tried to avenge the death of Nerevar but to no avail. He was driven off and thought dead. The Tribunal found the tools he had been guarding and, through study of Kagrenac's methods, turned themselves into gods. <BR>
<BR>
Thousands of years after their apotheosis, the Tribunal are still the gods of Morrowind and the old ways of worship are remembered only by a few. And the murder of Nerevar is known to fewer. But his queen and generals still fear his return, for the words of Azura linger long and they see the mark of her curse on their people every day. <BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
红山上的尼瑞瓦<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[以下内容摘抄自匿典，因审判席神殿所隐藏起来的著作。该作是一部通过灰烬之民的传统进行传播的关于红山之战及后续事件的学术性复述文章。灰烬之民将这一经历与阿兰德罗·苏尔所述的内容联系在了一起，作为尼瑞瓦的盾牌战士他在尼瑞瓦死后与审判席飞升期间来到了灰烬之民中间一同生活。关于这一故事有许多不同的讲述方式，但重要的部分在整个传统当中都是一致的。被谋杀的尼瑞瓦，达格斯乌尔的悲惨命运，以及神殿教义拒绝承认的审判席神圣力量源自于亵渎神灵一说并将其认定为愚昧的灰烬之民的迷信观念，导致其在丹莫的文明之中鲜为人知。]<BR>

瑞斯戴恩，即如今的晨风，是两种截然不同的精灵族之间的角逐之地：歧莫、崇拜迪德拉的精灵族，以及锻莫、崇拜神秘且非宗教性质力量的精灵族。这两个种族不断地相互争执直至他们的土地被另一个年轻、强劲、且暴力的异域文化，即被诺德人所入侵。<BR>
<BR>
两位英雄人物，一位来自歧莫而一位则来自锻莫，因多瑞尔·尼瑞瓦以及矮人王杜马克，曾在两方的人民之间建立起了和平并一同驱逐了外来的侵略者。后来这两位英雄通过不断的努力艰难地维护着和平，尽管他们的参谋都认为这样的和平不会持续太久或者说、这是件坏事，不应该继续。尼瑞瓦的王后以及他的将军们——阿玛莱西娅、索萨·希尔、维威克——劝告他应该宣称瑞斯戴恩的一切都归属于自己。但尼瑞瓦不愿听从，因为他十分看重自己与杜马克的友谊。一心只想着和平。<BR>
<BR>
直至达格斯·乌尔的到来。他称达格斯家族发现了锻莫的神秘力量来源于亵渎神明：那是传说中的洛克汗之心，杜马克的那些族人曾试图使用它让自己拥有超越神明的力量并且得到永生。而实际上，他们的一位大祭司，卡格瑞纳克，确实在试图打造一个新的神明好让锻莫可以靠着它将整个瑞斯戴恩据为己有。<BR>
<BR>
同时审判席也再次催促尼瑞瓦向矮人族宣战。尼瑞瓦感到了不安。于是他去杜马克，他的老朋友，想问清楚达格斯乌尔所说是否属实。然而卡格瑞纳克和锻莫的大祭司们并没有将打造新神的秘密告知他们的国王，所以杜马克确信锻莫并没有犯下任何错误。仍旧不安的尼瑞瓦选择去霍拉玛扬，阿祖拉的神圣祭所进行朝圣，从阿祖拉那证实了达格斯乌尔所说全都是事实并且不仅是为了这里的安全，也是为了瑞斯戴恩以外的世界必须阻止并摧毁锻莫的新神计划。当尼瑞瓦带着女神的话语回去并告知审判席后，他的王后以及将军们都确信自己的猜想果然是对的并再次建议他开战。总而言之锻莫和歧莫相互间的怨恨会永久持续不是没有理由的。<BR>
<BR>
最终，尼瑞瓦愤怒了，因为他的朋友竟会对自己撒谎，于是他回到了瓦登费尔。这一次歧莫之王穿戴好了武器与盔甲并且让他的随从跟在自己身边，接着他对红山之王，矮兽人杜马克怒斥道。“你必须放弃你们对洛克汗之心的崇拜不然就是我抛弃你我之间的友谊以及依靠它的名誉达成的一切成就！”而杜马克表示，他虽然对卡格瑞纳克的新神计划一无所知，但这不妨碍他为自己的族人感到骄傲并且保护他们，回道。“我们不会放弃自己多年以来所坚持走着的道路，就像你们歧莫不会放弃追随湮灭领域的女士以及自己的领主们一样。而以这样的方式来到我的城门前，穿戴着武器与盔甲并且让你的随从跟在自己身边，就等于在告诉我你们早就忘记了我们之间的友谊。撤退吧，我亲爱的尼瑞瓦，否则我以十五加一黄金声调发誓我会将你和你们的族人全部杀掉。”<BR>
<BR>
接着歧莫与锻莫的战争开始了。由于锻莫在红山上建了堡垒所以有着不错的保护效果，不过尼瑞瓦的王后和将军们聪明且勇敢地将杜马克的大部分兵力从堡垒里吸引出来并将他们牵制在了战场上，使得尼瑞瓦和达格斯乌尔能够秘密地找到一条通往心室的路潜入进去。在那里，尼瑞瓦和锻莫之王杜马克一见面就大打出手直至伤势过重而倒下。一边达格斯乌尔解决了卡格瑞纳克并取走了锻莫用来摄取心脏力量的工具。他找到了陷入垂死状态的领主尼瑞瓦并询问他这些工具该如何处置。而尼瑞瓦则再次召唤了阿祖拉，接着她就向他们展示了如何使用这些工具将心脏的力量从锻莫的体内分离出来。<BR>
<BR>
同时在原野上，审判席和他们的军队亲眼目睹了锻莫他们因为窃取而来的永生被夺走后化作了尘土褪去的样子。<BR>
<BR>
回到红山这里，尼瑞瓦吩咐达格斯·乌尔待在心室并在这里守护工具知道他回来。当时达格斯·乌尔问道，“难道我们不应该立即销毁这些工具，确保它们永远不会被恶意地利用吗？”然而尼瑞瓦由于自己伤势过重以及过于悲痛没能意识到这点（毕竟他其实很在乎杜马克以及锻莫人民）并且他稍后需要到了红山外部的原野与他的王后和他的将军们协商，因为他们曾预感到这场战争的到来而现在他们的建议将不再被当作空谈。“我需要问问审判庭我们该怎么处理这些工具，毕竟他们拥有我所没有的来自过去的智慧。待在这里，忠实的达格斯·乌尔，直到我回来为止。”<BR>
<BR>
之后尼瑞瓦将红山下所发生的事包括锻莫如何使用特殊的工具让自己的族人获得永生以及洛克汗之心的奇妙力量全部一五一十得告诉了他的王后以及将军们。这使得审判席认为歧莫应当学习如何使用这股力量以便尼瑞瓦能够为了自己的人民掌控瑞斯戴恩甚至是整个世界。显然尼瑞瓦没有此计划甚至不希望它发生，因此他要求他的王后以及将军们帮助他再一次为了得到她的引导而召唤出阿祖拉。然而审判席此时因得知了心脏的力量变得和卡格瑞纳克一样贪婪并渴望得到它。于是他们假装按照尼瑞瓦的要求进行召唤阿祖拉的仪式，只不过阿玛莱西娅使用了带毒的蜡烛，而索萨希尔提供的是带毒的长袍，还有维威克念诵了带毒的祈祷。尼瑞瓦就这样被谋杀了。<BR>
<BR>
然而阿祖拉还是回应了召唤并因为审判席的恶行诅咒了他们。她告诉他们自己会在黎明和黄昏到来时使用能力以保证尼瑞瓦能够再度回归并且让事情回到正轨。但是审判席却嘲笑她并表示自己很快就会成为神明同时歧莫的人民则会因此舍弃他们那古老的信仰方式。即便阿祖拉清楚这种事真的会发生然而要想用她的力量让尼瑞瓦回来还需要花费很长一段时间。“你今日的所作所为乃不可估量之罪而你绝对会为此感到后悔，因为对于凡人来说的十年在神看来只是永恒不变的每一天并且神的存在不是凡人能够轻易想象的。”接着阿祖拉将他们的称呼从歧莫变为了丹莫为的就是让他们能够永远地记住自己的罪孽，还将他们的皮肤和眼睛变成了灰白色和火红色。“让这个烙印时刻提醒着你们何为真实的自我，就像食尸鬼一般，以蚕食贵族、英雄精神、还有你们国王的信任为生吧。”<BR>
<BR>
在那之后审判席进入红山并见到了达格斯·乌尔。达格斯·乌尔显然知道了刚刚发生的一切，因为他的肤色也发生了变化，接着他试图为死去的尼瑞瓦报仇但没有成功。他就这么被赶了出去还被认为已经死亡。审判席则在这里找到了他本该守护的工具，并且通过研究卡格瑞纳克的方案，使他们自己成为了神明。<BR>
<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
[a package sealed with an anonymous wax seal, containing a single-page, unsigned note]<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
[on the cover of the package]<BR>
To the Outlander lately proclaiming his identity as the Nerevarine, to be delivered with haste --<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
[the note itself]<BR>
The assertions made being in direct contradiction of the doctrine of the Tribunal, namely, that you are the Nerevarine, the reincarnation of the Sainted Lord Nerevar, are, in addition to being against Temple teaching, incredible and implausible in the extreme.<BR>
<BR>
The revelations made by the Inquisition, namely, that you yourself are in fact an agent of the Imperial Intelligence Service, otherwise known as the Order of Blades, lately made with substantial evidence by the Lord High Archordinator, Berel Sala, further calls into question the validity of and motivations behind your claims.<BR>
<BR>
However, as incredible as your claims are, as much as they are in direct contradiction of the teachings of the Temple, and tainted as they are by the inferences to be made upon your close association with the covert policies and interests of the Emperor, the interests of the Temple and its leadership, and in particular, the interests of His Immortal Lordship, Vivec, are best served by a close and personal examinations of the claims being made, and close and personal examinations of the motivations and character of the claimant.<BR>
<BR>
The Temple, through its examinations of its records, in particular, the records of the Heirographa and Apographa, is intimately familiar with the many and varied claims of signs and feats that would mark the Nerevarine according to prophecy.<BR>
<BR>
Therefore, in the event of the fulfillment of certain of those most remarkable and scarcely credible claims -- namely, that the claimant should, at one time, be the acknowledged holder of several ancient titles of power and authority of the Dunmer people, to whit, Hortator of the Great Houses and Nerevarine of the Ashlander tribes -- the Temple proposes that the claimant of the identity of the Nerevarine shall present himself for inspection before his Reverend Honor, Archcanon Lord Tholer Saryoni, High Archcanon and Chancellor of Vivec, Archcanon of the Canonry of Vvardenfell, Arch-Priest of the High Fane, for a review and consideration of his claims and identity. However, until such time as the claimant actually has been named Hortator separately and jointly by the three Great Houses of Vvardenfell, and at the same time has been named Nerevarine separately and jointly by the four tribes of the Ashlanders, there is no purpose in reviewing or discussing these claims.<BR>
<BR>
Because of the Temple's official position on the prophecies of the Nerevarine, and in the interests of preserving the security of the claimant from those parties who might wish to do him harm, it is convenient that the claimant of the title Nerevarine shall present himself in secret to Archcanon Saryoni in the archcanon's private quarters in the High Fane of Vivec. <BR>
<BR>
To signify agreement with these terms and conditions for a meeting with the archcanon, the Nerevarine claimant may present himself to the healer of the High Fane of Vivec, Danso Indules, and the necessary arrangements will be made. Once again, no purpose is served by a meeting until the claimant is named Hortator of the three Great Houses and is named Nerevarine of the four Ashlander tribes.<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
written at the request of and in the name of his Reverend Honor Tholer Saryoni, Archcanon and Chancellor of Vivec,<BR>
<BR>
Dileno Lloran, priest of Vivec, assistant to the Archcanon<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
[蜡封无署名的包裹，内含一页无署名的便条]<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
[包裹封面]<BR>
至近日自称是尼瑞瓦因的外地人，务必尽快送达 --<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
[便条内容]<BR>
你所宣称之事，即你是尼瑞瓦因——圣·瑞瓦转世——与审判席教义直接相悖。此举不仅有违神殿教诲，更是难以置信、荒谬至极。<BR>
<BR>
宗教审判席所揭露的事实，即你本人实际上是帝国情报局（亦即“刀锋”）的一名特工——该事实由至高殿卫统领，贝瑞尔·萨拉最近以充足证据公开——进一步对你声称的合法性与背后的动机提出了质疑。<BR>
<BR>
然而，无论你的宣称多么难以置信，无论它多么直接地违背神殿的教义，也无论它因你与皇帝的隐秘政策及利益的密切联系而蒙受多少嫌疑，为了神殿及其领导层，尤其是为了不朽之主维威克大人自身的利益，最妥善的做法仍是对你所宣称之事，以及对你本人的动机与品格，进行近距离的、当面的审查。<BR>
<BR>
神殿通过查阅其文献记录，尤其是《圣典》与《匿典》的档案，对诸多预示尼瑞瓦因身份的征兆与事迹的种种说法了如指掌。<BR>
<BR>
因此，一旦那些最为卓越且难以置信的预言实现——即宣称者，须同时成为丹莫人民某些古老权力与权威头衔的公认持有者，即：大家族的统谏使与灰烬之民部落的尼瑞瓦因——届时，神殿建议这位尼瑞瓦因的宣称者，应亲自前往维威克至高神殿，觐见尊敬的索勒·萨里奥尼大主教——维威克的大主教兼执政官、瓦登费尔教区大牧首、至高神殿大祭司——接受其对你身份与宣称的审查与考量。然而，在该宣称者尚未分别且共同地被瓦登费尔的三大氏族命名为统谏使，并同时分别且共同地被四大灰烬之民部落命名为尼瑞瓦因之前，审查或讨论这些宣称毫无意义。<BR>
<BR>
鉴于神殿对尼瑞瓦因预言的官方立场，并为了保护宣称者免受那些可能加害于他之人的威胁，尼瑞瓦因头衔的宣称者应秘密前往维威克至高神殿内大主教萨里奥尼的私人居所，向其觐见。<BR>
<BR>
若同意上述与大主教见面的条款与条件，尼瑞瓦因宣称者可向维威克神殿的治疗师丹索·因杜勒斯报到，届时将做出必要安排。再次重申，在该宣称者尚未被三大家族命名为统谏使、被四大灰烬之民部落称为尼瑞瓦因之前，会面毫无意义。<BR>
<BR>

奉尊敬的托勒·萨里奥尼大人（维威克的大主教兼执政官）之命，并以其名义撰写。<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
The Battle of Red Mountain, and the Rise and Fall of the Tribunal<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[The following is a transcript of the words of Lord Vivec, addressed to a Dissident Priest, Malur Omayn, who confronted Vivec with the Ashlander traditions surrounding the Battle of Red Mountain and with prophecies of the Nerevarine, and to unnamed magistrates of the Inquisition who joined Vivec in interrogating the Dissident Priest.]<BR>
<BR>
Who can clearly recall the events of the distant past. But you have asked me to tell you, in my own words, the events surrounding the Battle of Red Mountain, the birth of the Tribunal, and the prophecies of a Nerevar reborn. Here is what I can tell you.<BR>
<BR>
When the Chimer first abandoned the herds and tents of their nomadic ancestors, and built the first Great Houses, we loved the Daedra, and worshipped them as gods. But our brethren, the Dwemer, scorned the Daedra, and mocked our foolish rituals, and preferred instead their gods of Reason and Logic. So the Chimer and Dwemer were always at bitter war, until the Nords came and invaded Resdayn. Only then did the Chimer and Dwemer put away their strife and join together to cast out the invaders.<BR>
<BR>
Once the Nords were driven out, General Nerevar of the Chimer and General Dumac of the Dwemer, who had come to love and respect one another, resolved to make peace between their peoples. In that time I was but a junior counselor to Nerevar, and Nerevar's queen, Almalexia, and his other favorite counselor, Sotha Sil, always doubted that such a peace might long survive, given the bitter disputes between Chimer and Dwemer, but by negotiation and compromise, Nerevar and Dumac somehow managed to preserve a fragile peace.<BR>
<BR>
But when Dagoth Ur, Lord of House Dagoth, and trusted as a friend by both Nerevar and the Dwemer, brought us proof that High Engineer Kagrenac of the Dwemer had discovered the Heart of Lorkhan, and that he had learned how to tap its powers, and was building a new god, a mockery of Chimer faith and a fearsome weapon, we all urged Nerevar to make war on the Dwarves and to destroy this threat to Chimer beliefs and security. Nerevar was troubled. He went to Dumac and asked if what Dagoth Ur said was true. But Kagrenac took great offense, and asked whom Nerevar thought he was, that he might presume to judge the affairs of the Dwemer. <BR>
<BR>
Nerevar was further troubled, and made pilgrimage to Holamayan, the sacred temple of Azura, and Azura confirmed that all that Dagoth Ur said was indeed true and that the creation of a New God of the Dwemer should be prevented at all costs. When Nerevar came back and told us what the goddess had said, we felt our judgements confirmed, and again counseled him to war, chiding Nerevar for his na$EFve trust in friendship, and reminding Nerevar of his duty to protect the faith and security of the Chimer against the impiety and dangerous ambitious of the Dwemer.<BR>
<BR>
Then Nerevar went back to Vvardenfell one last time, hoping that negotiations and compromise might once again preserve the peace. But this time the friends Nerevar and Dumac quarreled bitterly, and as a result, the Chimer and Dwemer went to war. <BR>
<BR>
The Dwemer were well-defended by their fortress at Red Mountain, but Nerevar's cunning drew most of Dumac's armies out into the field and pinned them there, while Nerevar, Dagoth Ur, and a small group of companions could make their way into the Heart Chamber by secret means. There, Nerevar the Chimer King met Dumac the Dwarf King and they both collapsed from grievous wounds and draining magics. With Dumac fallen, and threatened by Dagoth Ur and others, Kagrenac turned his tools upon the Heart, and Nerevar said he saw Kagrenac and all his Dwemer companions at once disappear from the world. In that instant, Dwemer everywhere disappeared without a trace. But Kagrenac's tools remained, and Dagoth Ur seized them, and he carried them to Nerever, saying, "That fool Kagrenac has destroyed his own people with these things. We should destroy them, right away, lest they fall into the wrong hands."<BR>
<BR>
But Nerevar was resolved to confer with his queen and his generals, who had foreseen that this war would come and whose counsel he would not ignore again. "I will ask the Tribunal what we shall do with them, for they have had wisdom in the past that I had not. Stay here, loyal Dagoth Ur, until I return." So Nerevar told Dagoth Ur to protect the tools and the Heart Chamber until he returned.<BR>
<BR>
Then Nerevar was carried to us where we waited on the slopes of Red Mountain, and he told us all that had transpired under Red Mountain. What Nerevar had said was that the Dwemer had used special tools to turn their people into immortals and that the Heart of Lorkhan held wondrous powers. [Only later did we hear from others present that Dagoth Ur had thought the Dwemer destroyed, not made immortal. And no one knows for sure what really happened there.]<BR>
<BR>
After hearing Nerevar, we gave our counsel as he requested, proposing, "We should preserve these tools in trust for the welfare of the Chimer people. And who knows, perhaps the Dwemer are not gone forever, but merely transported to some distant realm, from which they may some day return to threaten our security once again. Therefore, we need to keep these tools, to study them and their principles, so that we may be safe in future generations."<BR>
<BR>
And though Nerevar voiced his grave misgivings, he was willing to be ruled by our counsel, under one condition: that we all together should swear a solemn oath upon Azura that the tools would never be used in the profane manner that the Dwemer had intended. We all readily agreed, and swore solemn oaths at Nerevar's dictation.<BR>
<BR>
So then we went with Nerevar back into Red Mountain and met with Dagoth Ur. Dagoth Ur refused to deliver the tools to us, saying they were dangerous, and we could not touch them. Dagoth Ur seemed to be irrational, insisting that only he could be trusted with the tools, and then we guessed that he had somehow been affected by his handling of the tools, but now I feel sure that he had privately learned the powers of the tools, and had in some confused way decided he must have them for himself. Then Nerevar and our guard resorted to force to secure the tools. Somehow Dagoth Ur and his retainers escaped, but we gained the tools, and delivered them to Sotha Sil for study and safe-keeping.<BR>
<BR>
For some years we kept the oaths we swore to Azura with Nerevar, but during that time, in secret, Sotha Sil must have studied the tools and divined their mysteries. And at last he came to us with a vision of a new world of peace, with justice and honor for nobles, and health and prosperity for the commoners, with the Tribunal as immortal patrons and guides. And dedicating ourselves to this vision of a better world, we made a pilgrimage to Red Mountain and transformed ourselves with the power of Kagrenac's tools.<BR>
<BR>
And no sooner than we had completed our rituals and begun to discover our new-found powers, the Daedra Lord Azura appeared and cursed us for our foresworn oaths. By her powers of prophecy, she assured us that her champion, Nerevar, true to his oath, would return to punish us for our perfidy, and to make sure such profane knowledge might never again be used to mock and defy the will of the gods. But Sotha Sil said to her, "The old gods are cruel and arbitrary, and distant from the hopes and fears of mer. Your age is past. We are the new gods, born of the flesh, and wise and caring of the needs of our people. Spare us your threats and chiding, inconstant spirit. We are bold and fresh, and will not fear you."<BR>
<BR>
And then, in that moment, all Chimer were changed into Dunmer, and our skins turned ashen and our eyes into fire. Of course, we only knew at that time that this had happened to us, but Azura said, "This is not my act, but your act. You have chosen your fate, and the fate of your people, and all the Dunmer shall share your fate, from now to the end of time. You think yourselves gods, but you are blind, and all is darkness." And Azura left us alone, in darkness, and we were all afraid, but we put on brave faces, and went forth from Red Mountain to build the new world of our dreams.<BR>
<BR>
And the new world we shaped was glorious and generous, and the worship of the Dunmer fervent and grateful. The Dunmer were at first afraid of their new faces, but Sotha Sil spoke to them, saying that it was not a curse but a blessing, a sign of their changed natures, and sign of the special favor they might enjoy as New Mer, no longer barbarians trembling before ghosts and spirits, but civilized mer, speaking directly to their immortal friends and patrons, the three faces of the Tribunal. And we were all inspired by Sotha Sil's speech and vision, and took heart. And over time, we crafted the customs and institutions of a just and honorable society, and the land of Resdayn knew millennia of peace, equity, and prosperity unknown to other savage races.<BR>
<BR>
But beneath Red Mountain, Dagoth Ur had survived. And even as the light of our bold new world shined ever more brightly, beneath Red Mountain, the darkness gathered, a darkness that was close kin to the bright light that Sotha Sil coaxed from the Heart of Lorkhan with the Tools of Kagrenac. As the darkness grew, we fought it, and crafted walls to confine it, but we never could destroy it, for the source of the darkness was the same source as the source of our own divine inspiration.<BR>
<BR>
And in these latter days of Morrowind, reduced to a subjugated province of the Western Empire, as the glory of the Temple fades, and the dark tide rises from Red Mountain, we are reminded of Azura and her promised champion's return. We have waited, blind, and in darkness, mere shadows, drained of our ardent vision, in shame of our folly, in fear of our judgement, and in hope of our deliverance. We do not know if the outlander claiming to fulfill the prophecies of the Nerevarine is our old companion Nerevar reborn, or a pawn of the Emperor, or a catspaw of Azura, or some simple twist of fate. But we insist you adhere to Temple doctrine, and conform to the strictures dividing the Hierographa from the Apographa, and that you not speak that which must not be spoken openly. Act as a dutiful priest should, in accordance with your vows of obedience to the canons and archcanons, and all will be forgiven. Defy me, and you will know what it is to stand against a god.<BR>
<BR>
-- Vivec<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
红山之战，和审判席的兴起与衰落<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[下述是维威克大人话语的文字记录，谈话对象为一位异端祭司，马鲁尔·奥曼，其以灰烬民风俗相关的尼瑞瓦因预言和红山之战向维威克发出了质疑，而后异端审判所的某位法官与维威克一同审讯了这位异端祭司。]<BR>
<BR>
有谁能够一字不差地复述出那些遥远过去的回忆？而你却想让我亲自向你复述，在我看来，围绕着红山之战发生了一系列事件，包括审判席的诞生，尼瑞瓦重生的预言。这就是我能告诉你的。<BR>
<BR>
当歧莫第一次离开了他们的游牧祖先生活的牧群和帐篷，建立起第一个大家族时，我们曾信仰迪德拉，像神明一样崇拜他们。但我们的同胞，锻莫，却对迪德拉不屑，还嘲笑我们的宗教仪式愚蠢，以此来显摆他们崇拜的逻辑与理性之神。所以那时歧莫和锻莫之间一直处在激烈的冲突之中，直到诺德人要来侵略瑞斯戴恩。直到这一刻歧莫和锻莫才放下仇恨并团结一致将侵略者驱逐出去。<BR>
<BR>
在诺德人被驱逐之后，相互赏识相互尊敬的歧莫领袖尼瑞瓦将军和锻莫领袖杜马克将军，决心要一起实现两族共同的和平。彼时我还只是尼瑞瓦的一个初级参事，并与尼瑞瓦的王后阿玛莱西娅，以及他偏爱的参事索萨·希尔，一同对在歧莫和锻莫之间存在的世仇争端中，能否存在长久的和平表示过怀疑，但是在通过不断地谈判和折中后，尼瑞瓦和杜马克以某种方式为两族带来了脆弱的和平。<BR>
<BR>
但是当尼瑞瓦和锻莫共同的好友，达格斯家族的领袖，达格斯·乌尔向我们透露锻莫的至高工匠卡格瑞纳克已经发现洛克汗之心，而且已经知晓如何使用心脏的力量，并用其来建造一个新神明，一个嘲弄歧莫信仰的相当恐怖的武器，于是我们全员一起催促着尼瑞瓦做好准备向锻莫矮人开战并且摧毁这个威胁到歧莫的安全与教义的存在。尼瑞瓦陷入苦恼当中。他去质问杜马克以求证达格斯·乌尔的消息。但是卡格瑞纳克勃然大怒，他怒斥尼瑞瓦不把他当回事，借此机会他得以擅自断定锻莫内部的事务。<BR>
<BR>
尼瑞瓦更加感到不安，于是他决定前往霍拉马扬，阿祖拉的神圣祭所朝圣，而阿祖拉也证实了达格斯·乌尔所说所言均属事实并且应不惜万难阻止锻莫企图创造新神的亵渎行为。当尼瑞瓦返回并向我们转述我们女神的神谕时，我们都认为我们早先的判断是正确的，并且责备他相信那幼稚的友谊，再次劝说他开战，还提醒尼瑞瓦说他有责任保护歧莫的信仰与安全与反对锻莫的亵渎行为以及危险的野心。<BR>
<BR>
接着尼瑞瓦第一时间回到瓦登费尔岛，希望谈判和妥协折中能够再一次维护两族之间的安宁。但这一次尼瑞瓦和杜马克这对好友直接反目成仇，其结果就是，歧莫和锻莫再次开战。<BR>
<BR>
锻莫依托着红山中堡垒的强大庇护进行防守，但尼瑞瓦用计策引诱出杜马克的大部分军队来到主战场，并将他们牵制在那，紧接着尼瑞瓦、达格斯·乌尔以及一小队勇士顺利地秘密潜入了心室。在那里，歧莫的王尼瑞瓦与矮人的王杜马克相遇后他们都因为严重的战伤和魔法的耗尽而筋疲力竭。就在杜马克败下阵来，将要被达格斯·乌尔等人挟持的时候，卡格瑞纳克用他的工具对准了心脏，接下来尼瑞瓦说他只看到卡格瑞纳克和他的所有锻莫战友一瞬间就从世界上消失了。事实上就在这一瞬间，所有存在于世间的锻莫都消失的无影无踪。不过卡格瑞纳克的工具留了下来，而达格斯·乌尔夺得这些工具，并将它们献给尼瑞瓦，说道：“那个愚蠢的卡格瑞纳克用这些工具消灭了他自己的族人。我们应该立即摧毁这些工具，以免它们落入坏人之手。”<BR>
<BR>
但是尼瑞瓦决定要与他的王后和将军们协商，他们早就预见了这场战争的到来并且他们的决策现在不再会被他搁置了。“我得询问审判席我们应该如何处理这些工具，因为他们拥有我所没有的来自过去的智慧。坚守这里吧，忠诚的达格斯·乌尔，直到我回来。”就这样尼瑞瓦命令达格斯·乌尔守护这些工具并在心室中等候他归来。<BR>
<BR>
在那之后尼瑞瓦来到了我们在红山山坡上休息的地方，然后他告知了我们红山下所发生的事情。尼瑞瓦所描述的是锻莫用特殊的工具使他们的人民进化成了不朽的存在而洛克汗之心有着能做到这种程度令人惊讶的强大力量。[后来我们才从当时其他在场的人那里听说达格斯·乌尔认为所有的锻莫都被从这个世界抹除了，而不是变得不朽。然而没有人能确切地理解那时到底发生了什么。]<BR>
<BR>
听尼瑞瓦说完后，遵从他的要求我们也给出了自己的建议、计划，“我们应该为了歧莫人民的安全与健康将这些工具保管起来。而锻莫他们也许并不是永远消失了，只不过是被传送到了遥远的国度里，谁知道呢，也许他们什么时候就会卷土重来再次威胁我们的安宁。退一步来说，我们也需要保存这些工具，以便研究它们的原理，这样我们未来的后代才能生活得高枕无忧。”<BR>
<BR>
尽管尼瑞瓦神情严肃地表明了他的忧虑，但他还是同意按照我们的建议处理，但有一个条件：我们都必须以庄严的誓词向阿祖拉发誓，绝不会像锻莫那般用这些工具做出亵渎神明的事。我们无不同意，并且也如尼瑞瓦所说庄严地宣誓了。<BR>
<BR>
之后我们跟随尼瑞瓦返回红山并见到了达格斯·乌尔。但达格斯·乌尔拒绝将工具交给我们，他说这工具很危险，我们不应该触碰工具。达格斯·乌尔看起来不太正常，固执的认为只有他才可以托付保存工具的重任，于是我们猜测他可能在接触这些工具时被影响了心智，但现在我预感他一定是私下里了解了这些工具里蕴含的力量，并且还莫名其妙地认为这些工具只属于他自己。于是尼瑞瓦和我们的守卫只好采取强硬手段夺回工具进行保护。虽然达格斯·乌尔和他的党羽以某种办法逃脱了，不过我们夺得了工具，并把它们交给索萨·希尔来进行妥善的研究和保管。<BR>
<BR>
多年以来我们一直遵守着与尼瑞瓦一同向阿祖拉宣誓的诺言，但与此同时，在暗处，索萨·希尔一定也在秘密研究这些工具并揭示它们的秘密。而最后他确实为我们带来了一个崭新和平纪元的美好愿景，贵族能享有公平与名誉，而平民也能保证健康和繁荣，由不朽的审判席带来引导与庇护。为了实现这个美好世界的愿景，我们去往红山朝圣并且用卡格瑞纳克的工具改变了自己的形态。<BR>
<BR>
就在我们刚刚完成仪式就要从心脏汲取我们新发现的力量的时候，迪德拉领主阿祖拉突然出现并为我们违背诺言的行为降下诅咒。通过她那预言的神力，她向我们保证她的捍卫者，守护誓言之人，尼瑞瓦，将会回归惩罚我们的背信弃义，并且确保这些亵渎神明的知识决不再被滥用于嘲弄和蔑视神的意志上。但是索萨·希尔却对她说：“旧神是残酷而武断专制的，与精灵的希望和恐惧相隔遥远。您的时代已经结束了。我们才是新的神明，从血肉中获得新生，充满智慧且在乎我们人民需求的新神。把你的威胁和责难收起来吧，变化无常的幽灵。我们既新颖又勇敢，而且不会畏惧你。”<BR>
<BR>
接着，就在那一刻，所有的歧莫都变成了丹莫的样子，我们也变成了灰烬色的皮肤和火红的眼眸。当然，那时我们以为这只是发生在我们身上的事情，但阿祖拉说“这不是我强加与此，而是你们咎由自取。你已经选择了你们自己的命运，也为你们的人民选择了命运，于是从现在起直到时光之末，所有丹莫的命运都联系于此。你盲目认为自己就是神明，但你们的前路将只有黑暗。”之后阿祖拉将我们留在黑暗当中，而我们惊恐不已，但我们又都摆出一副故作勇敢的样子，为了开始建造我们理想中的新世界而走出红山。<BR>
<BR>
而我们塑造的新世界辉煌而又雅量，丹莫热烈又感激地对我们献上崇拜。一开始丹莫恐惧他们肤色的巨大变化，但索萨·希尔告诉他们，说这变化不是诅咒而是一种祝福，是标志着他们本质的革新，也是标志着他们作为新精灵族可能享受到的特殊恩惠，将没有无知的人会在孤魂野鬼面前颤抖恐惧，只有文明开化的精灵，以及他们可以直接面见的永远的挚友和守护者，审判席的三神。而我们都被索萨·希尔的演说和梦想打动，充满了动力。时过境迁，我们已经建立起了正当且荣耀的社会风俗和制度，为瑞斯戴恩这片土地带来了其他野蛮种族都没有的千年的安宁，繁荣和公正。<BR>
<BR>
但就在红山之下，达格斯·乌尔存活了下来。甚至在我们外界的新世界越发文明的时候，黑暗也在红山之下，聚集了起来，这道黑暗与索萨·希尔用卡格瑞纳克的工具从洛克汗之心中带出的光明是共生的。随着黑暗愈发强大，我们尝试与他抗衡，建造了屏障来将他禁锢在红山内，但我们从未能摧毁它，因为黑暗的力量与我们神圣的力量是同一个源头。<BR>
<BR>
而在后来的晨风，沦为了被西方帝国所征服的省份，随着神殿的荣耀日渐衰退，加上红山的黑潮涌动，我们才想起阿祖拉以及她许诺将会归来的勇士。我们等待着，盲目地，在黑暗中，虚度时光，看着阴影逐渐笼罩，我们强烈的期望渐渐冷淡下来，为我们所做的蠢事而倍感羞愧，也为必将到来的审判惶惶终日，然而我们依旧心存侥幸。我们无法料到预言中作为尼瑞瓦因的外乡人是否真的是我们昔日的同伴尼瑞瓦的转世，亦或是帝国的走狗，亦或是阿祖拉的棋子，亦或是那个被命运折磨的人。但是我们坚持要你的存在贴合神殿的教义，并且严格按照匿典中象形文字所述的要求，同时要注意你不能泄露这些不可公开的秘密。你要像一个充满责任感的牧师一样行动，要严格履行自己服从教众和大主教的诺言，这样过去发生的事情才都会得到原谅。若敢蔑视我的话，你就会知道公然对抗神明的下场是什么样子。<BR>
<BR>
——维威克<BR>"""

Dagoth Ur's Plans
达格斯·乌尔的计划
