"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Dagoth Ur's Plans<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[The following documents were prepared by Temple scholars and agents of the Inquisition for Lord Vivec.]<BR>
<BR>
From interrogation of captured Sleepers and other Sixth House cultists, from study of manuscripts written by cultists and victims of dream-induced mania, from interviews with Lord Vivec concerning historical campaigns against Red Mountain, and from broad conjectures and inferences made upon these materials, this is our best estimate of Dagoth Ur's motivations and objectives in this most recent phase of his war upon Morrowind.<BR>
<BR>
Basic Objectives<BR>
<BR>
1. Establish a theocracy in Morrowind based on the worship of the new-born god Akulakhan [Second Numidium] to be created by Dagoth Ur from the heart of Lorkhan and a body constructed according to the principles and rituals pioneered by the Dwemer Kagrenac. Establish the ancient heirs of House Dagoth as the god-priests of Akulakhan, and the Sixth House of Dagoth Ur as the dominant political power in Morrowind. Through charismatic conversion, unite the Dunmer under the guidance of Dagoth Ur to battle against the foreign animals who hold Morrowind in subjection. [Note: Dagoth Ur has apparently adopted the views and motivations of the Dwemer High Craftlord Kagrenac. In effect, he recapitulates the ancient blasphemous folly of the Dwemer.]<BR>
<BR>
2. Expose the false worship of the Tribunal and destroy the ecclesiastical authority and political power of the Temple. [How much the Dissident Priests or the Cult of the Nerevarine may be controlled or influenced by the Sixth House in this regard is open to speculation.] <BR>
<BR>
3. Extirpate all remaining individuals of inferior and mongrel races from Morrowind.<BR>
<BR>
4. Drive the Empire from Morrowind.<BR>
<BR>
5. Recover ancient territories stolen by Skyrim and Argonia.<BR>
<BR>
6. Extend the worship of Akulakhan to all nations of Tamriel through subversion and conquest.<BR>
<BR>
Plans to Establish and Expand the Sixth House<BR>
<BR>
Phase 1: Secure Red Mountain against Tribunal intruders. Deny Tribunal access to the Heart, weakening the Temple while securing Red Mountain for the creation of Akulakhan. Keep the construction of Second Numidium a secret.<BR>
<BR>
Phase 2: Create passive servants in ever-widening circles around Red Mountain by broadcasting compulsions couched in dream imagery to susceptible subjects in their sleep. Establish a major operational base at Kogoruhn for further operations in the ash wastes. Establish smaller bases near small port villages and in lower-class waterfront districts in Vivec. Infiltrate and subvert smuggling syndicates. Recruit willing followers from disaffected populations, including the underworld, the poor, and rabid anti-Imperial activists.<BR>
<BR>
Phase 3: Expand from smaller bases to other towns and villages, and recruit and indoctrinate subjects made susceptible by dream sendings. Occupy abandoned towers and ruins, and train corrupted cultists as raiders and irregular troops. Identify, discredit, and decimate possible sources of political resistance.<BR>
<BR>
Phase 4: Use assassination and terror to weaken, distract, and disrupt the Legions and the Imperial bureaucracy, along with their Hlaalu sympathizers. Inspire popular uprisings of the native poor against the foreign rich and powerful. Summon Sleepers and Dreamers to Dagoth Ur to work on Second Numidium.<BR>
<BR>
Inferring Dagoth Ur's Perspectives<BR>
<BR>
Dagoth Ur thinks on a large time scale -- for the most part, in the outside-of-time scale of the divine consciousness. He thinks that only obstacles of mythic scale are worth consideration. He believes he is fated to rule Morrowind, to free Morrowind of the Empire, and to become the new hard-loving Father of Morrowind. Given that perspective, the only opposing forces Dagoth Ur worries about are the Tribunal, the Daedra, the Emperor, and the Incarnate.<BR>
<BR>
With the Tribunal's loss of Sunder and Keening, and with the diminishing resources of Vivec, Almalexia, and Sotha Sil, Dagoth Ur believes he has permanently gained a decisive strategic advantage. On a mortal timescale, the battle may last for centuries, but the outcome is not in doubt. And Akulakhan may be a device for dramatically reducing the time scale for a decisive victory.<BR>
 <BR>
The myth of dynamic invincibility of the Emperor and the Empire has long been an unquantifiable and intimidating threat, but recent rumors of unrest in Cyrodiil, of the Emperor's failing health, and the unsettled question of the succession have diminished the scale of that threat. Nonetheless, the revelation that the Nerevarine is a pawn of Imperial intelligence, hand-picked and sent to Morrowind by the Emperor himself, may cause Dagoth Ur considerable anxiety.<BR>
<BR>
The Daedra represent no coherent obstacle to Dagoth Ur. Nonetheless, their personal abilities and their influence upon their fanatic followers is considerable, their motives and actions obscure, and Dagoth Ur remains concerned about them.<BR>
<BR>
The Incarnate represents Saint Nerevar, a mythic force that has previously defeated Dagoth Ur, and Dagoth Ur is obsessed with this threat. At the same time, Dagoth Ur knew Nerevar personally, knew that he was a mortal man with faults and weaknesses. Dagoth Ur may have some hope of seducing or negotiating with Nerevar's reincarnation. Further, when Nerevar and the Tribunal defeated Dagoth Ur, they were strong and allied; now the Nerevarine and the Tribunal are weak, opposed, and divided. Therefore, though the Nerevarine and the Tribunal represent the most serious threat to Dagoth Ur's plans, he still has good reason to believe that this time he will prevail.<BR>
<BR>
A Recent Timescale of Dagoth Ur's Activities<BR>
[Much of the following timescale is based on inference from incomplete information.]<BR>
<BR>
before 2E 882: Dagoth Ur and his kin lie dreaming beneath the sills of Red Mountain.<BR>
<BR>
2E 882: Dagoth Ur and his ash vampires awake refreshed and emerge from lower Red Mountain into the Heart Chamber. Dagoth Ur ritually binds himself and his brethren as heartwights in a ritual of his own devising. First stages of construction of Second Numidium [conceived during the Long Sleep] are begun by heartwights and atronach constructs in a chamber near the Heart of Lorkhan. Keeping the Second Numidium project a secret from the Tribunal is a high priority.<BR>
<BR>
2E 882: The Tribunal arrive at Red Mountain for their annual ritual bathing in the heart's power. Dagoth Ur and ash vampires ambush the Tribunal. The Tribunes are driven away, and prevented from restoring themselves with Kagrenac's tools at the Heart of Lorkhan.<BR>
<BR>
2E 882-3E 417: Intermittent Tribunal campaigns assault Red Mountain. The Tribunal and supporting forces seek to force access to the Heart Chamber, but are repeatedly driven back. Dagoth Ur recruits Sleepers and Dreamers through dream sendings. Cultists are recruited through dream compulsion. Weaker cultists become corprus beasts; stronger cultists advance through stages towards the powers of the Ascended Sleepers.<BR>
<BR>
3E 400: Kogoruhn reoccupied by Dagoth Uthol and fortified as an advance base for Sixth House operations. Blight storms more frequent and widespread. Soul sickness spreads in regions close to Red Mountain.<BR>
<BR>
3E 410: Sixth House bases founded near Gnaar Mok and in waterfront areas of Vivec. Sixth House operatives exploit smuggler organizations and communications to spread their influence among victims unbalanced by Dagoth Ur's dream sendings.<BR>
<BR>
3E 415: Small cells of Sixth House cultists in every town in Vvardenfell. Larger Sixth House operations are concealed in remote dungeons where creatures are bred and cultists are trained for the coming struggle.<BR>
<BR>
3E 417: Almalexia and Sotha Sil lose the artifacts Keening and Sunder to Dagoth Odros and Vemyn. Vivec rescues Almalexia and Sotha Sil, but failing to recover Keening and Sunder, the Tribunal retreat from Red Mountain in disorder. Surviving Buoyant Armiger companions know the Tribunal was forced to retreat, but do not know how serious a reversal the Tribunal has suffered. The Three Tribunes return to their respective capitals and continue to perform their ritual functions. The Tribunes continue to grow weaker without access to the Heart, and because of resources required to support the Ghostfence. The inner circle of the Temple priesthood has begun to suspect the Tribunes have suffered seriously from wounds and demoralization in the wake of reverses at Red Mountain, but do not recognize the scale of the problem.<BR>
<BR>
3E 426-427: Campaign of Sixth House assassinations of prominent Imperial citizens and Hlaalu Imperial sympathizers. Sudden increase in number and seriousness of attacks by cultists and victims deranged by soul sickness.<BR>
<BR>
Noted with Concern<BR>
<BR>
1. Dagoth Ur can apparently perceive and communicate directly through his cultists. Sleepers and Dreamers are often reported speaking as though with Dagoth Ur's voice and intention.<BR>
<BR>
2. Little is known about the features, scale, or stage of completion of Akulakhan [Second Numidium]. No one has gained entrance to the Heart Chamber since 2E 282. In 3E 417, Keening and Sunder were captured, and may substantially aid in Akulakhan's construction.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
达格斯乌尔的计划<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[以下文件由神殿学者和审判席宗教特工为维威克大人所准备。]<BR>
<BR>
基于对被俘“沉睡者”及其他第六家族信徒的审讯、对信徒及梦境狂躁症患者所撰写手稿的研究、与维威克大人关于红山历次战役的访谈，并结合对这些材料的广泛推测与推论，我们得出以下关于达格斯·乌尔在其对晨风发动的最新阶段战争中的动机与目标的最佳评估。<BR>
<BR>
基本目标<BR>
<BR>
1. 以达格斯·乌尔从洛克汗的心脏所创造的新生神阿库拉可汗（第二努米迪文）的崇拜为基础，在晨风建立一个神权政体，并按照由锻莫卡格瑞纳克开创的原则和仪式为阿库拉可汗建造一个身体。将达格斯家族的古老继承人确立为阿库拉可汗的神祭司，并使达格斯·乌尔的第六家族成为晨风的主导政治力量。通过富有魅力的皈依，团结在达格斯·乌尔的指引下，共同对抗那些奴役着晨风的外来异族。[注：达格斯·乌尔显然已采纳了锻莫大工匠卡格瑞纳克的观念与动机。实际上，他是在重蹈锻莫古老而亵渎神明的愚行。]<BR>
<BR>
2. 揭露审判席的虚伪崇拜，并摧毁神殿的宗教权威与政治权力。[在此方面，异见祭司或尼瑞瓦因教派在多大程度上受到第六家族的控制或影响，尚有待推测。]<BR>
<BR>
3. 从晨风彻底清除所有劣等及混血种族的残余个体。<BR>
<BR>
4. 将帝国逐出晨风。<BR>
<BR>
5. 收复天际和阿尔贡尼亚侵占的古代领土。<BR>
<BR>
6. 通过颠覆和征服，将阿库拉可汗的崇拜扩展到泰姆瑞尔的所有国度。<BR>
<BR>
建立与扩张第六家族的计划<BR>
<BR>
第1阶段：确保红山地区免受审判席的侵入。阻止审判席接触洛克汗之心，从而削弱神殿，同时确保红山地区的安全，用以建造阿库拉可汗。将第二努米迪文的建造工程保密。<BR>
<BR>
第2阶段：通过对易感者在睡梦中施加以梦境意象包装的强制意念，在红山周边不断扩大的区域内制造出被动的仆从。在科戈汝因建立一处主要行动基地，以便在灰烬地区开展进一步行动。在小型港口村落附近以及维威克城内穷困的水岸区建立小型基地。渗透并颠覆走私集团。从心怀不满的人群中招募自愿的追随者，包括地下势力、穷人和狂热的反帝国活动分子。<BR>
<BR>
第3阶段：从小型基地向其他城镇和村庄扩张，并从受梦境传讯影响而变得易感的人群中招募并灌输思想。占领废弃的塔楼和遗迹，并将堕落了的信徒训练成突袭者和非正规部队。识别、诋毁并削弱可能构成政治抵抗的源头。<BR>
<BR>
第4阶段：利用暗杀与恐怖手段来削弱、分散和扰乱帝国军团与帝国官僚体系，以及他们的哈拉鲁同情者。煽动本地穷苦民众对外来富豪与权贵的暴力起义。召集“沉睡者”与“梦游者”前往达格斯·乌尔处，为第二努米迪文工作。<BR>
<BR>
推断达格斯·乌尔的观点<BR>
<BR>
达格斯·乌尔以宏大的时间尺度来思考——在很大程度上，那是神圣意识超脱时间的尺度。他认为，只有神话级别的障碍才值得考量。他相信自己命中注定要统治晨风，将晨风从帝国的枷锁中解放出来，并成为晨风那位严厉而又慈爱的新“父亲”。基于这一视角，达格斯·乌尔唯一担心的对立力量就是审判席、迪德拉大君、皇帝以及那位预言中的化身。<BR>
<BR>
随着审判席失去了“哀恸”与“决裂”，以及维威克、阿玛莱希娅与索萨·希尔的资源日益枯竭，达格斯·乌尔坚信他已永久性地获得了决定性的战略优势。以凡人的时间尺度来看，这场战斗或许会持续数个世纪，但其结果已毋庸置疑。而阿库拉可汗，或许正是一种能戏剧性地缩短取得决定性胜利所需时间尺度的装置。<BR>
 <BR>
关于皇帝与帝国那不可战胜的神话，长久以来一直是一种无法量化且令人胆寒的威胁。但近来关于西罗帝尔动荡不安、皇帝龙体欠安以及皇位继承问题悬而未决的流言，已削弱了这种威胁的程度。尽管如此，有消息揭露尼瑞瓦因是帝国情报局的一枚棋子，由皇帝亲自挑选并派往晨风，这可能引起了达格斯·乌尔相当大的焦虑。<BR>
<BR>
迪德拉大君们对达格斯·乌尔而言，并不构成什么连贯的障碍。然而，他们各自的能力、对其狂热追随者的巨大影响力、其动机与行为的隐晦不明，依然让达格斯·乌尔心存顾忌。<BR>
<BR>
那位预言中的化身代表着圣·尼瑞瓦——一股曾击败过达格斯·乌尔的神话力量。达格斯·乌尔对此威胁深感困扰。同时，达格斯·乌尔也曾与尼瑞瓦本人相识，深知他不过是个有着缺点与弱点的凡人。达格斯·乌尔或许仍抱有一丝希望，能引诱尼瑞瓦的转世者与之谈判。此外，当年尼瑞瓦与审判席击败达格斯·乌尔时，他们正值强盛且结为同盟；而今，尼瑞瓦因与审判席彼此衰弱、对立且分裂。因此，尽管尼瑞瓦因和审判席对达格斯·乌尔的计划构成了最严重的威胁，他仍有充分理由相信自己此次终将获胜。<BR>
<BR>
达格斯·乌尔近期活动时间表<BR>
[以下时间表中的大部分内容均基于对不完整信息的推断。]<BR>
<BR>
第二纪元882年之前：达格斯·乌尔及其亲族在红山深处沉睡。<BR>
<BR>
第二纪元882年：达格斯·乌尔与他那些恢复了精力的灰烬吸血鬼从红山深处苏醒，并现身于心之室。达格斯·乌尔以其自创的仪式，将自己及其兄弟以仪式性的方式与心脏捆绑，成为“心之守卫”。第二努米迪文的初期建造工程（构思于“长眠”期间）由心之守卫与元素构装体在洛克汗之心附近的一个密室内启动。对这第二努米迪文项目保守秘密，不让审判席得知，是重中之重。<BR>
<BR>
第二纪元882年：审判席抵达红山，进行一年一度的借助心脏力量沐浴的仪式。达格斯·乌尔及其灰烬吸血鬼伏击了审判席。诸位审判席被击退，并被阻止利用卡格瑞纳克的工具在洛克汗之心处恢复力量。<BR>
<BR>
第二纪元882年-第三纪元417年：审判席间歇性地发动对红山的攻势。审判席及其支援力量试图强行进入心之室，但屡次被击退。达格斯·乌尔通过梦境传讯招募“沉睡者”与“梦游者”。通过梦境强制意念招募信徒。较弱的信徒变成尸化兽；较强的信徒则逐阶晋升，向“升魂沉睡者”的力量迈进。<BR>
<BR>
第三纪元400年：科戈汝因被达格斯·尤索尔重新占领，并加固为第六家族行动的前沿基地。枯萎风暴愈发频繁且广泛。靠近红山地区的灵魂之疾开始蔓延。<BR>
<BR>
第三纪元410年：在纳尔-莫克附近及维威克城滨水区建立了第六家族基地。第六家族的特工利用走私组织及其联络网，在那些因达格斯·乌尔的梦境传讯而心神不宁的受害者中扩散其影响力。<BR>
<BR>
第三纪元415年：在瓦登费尔的每一座城镇中，都潜伏着第六家族信徒的小型秘密据点。而更大规模的第六家族行动，则隐匿于偏远的洞穴与地牢深处——那里正培育着用于战争的凶兽，也训练着信徒，为即将到来的斗争做准备。<BR>
<BR>
第三纪元417年：阿玛莱希娅与索萨·希尔手中的神器“哀恸”与“决裂”被达格斯·欧德罗斯与维明夺走。维威克救出了阿玛莱希娅与索萨·希尔，但因未能夺回“哀恸”与“决裂”，审判席被迫溃败地撤出红山。幸存的灵动扈从们知道审判席是被迫撤退，但不知审判席遭此重创的程度。三位审判席返回各自的首都，继续履行其仪式性的职责。由于无法接触心脏，又需将资源用于维持幽魂之墙，审判席们持续衰弱。神殿高阶祭司团内部的圈内人士开始怀疑审判席们在红山失利后身受重伤、士气低落，但尚未认清问题的严重性。<BR>
<BR>
第三纪元426-427年：第六家族展开了一系列针对帝国知名公民及哈拉鲁家族中帝国同情者的暗杀行动。由信徒及因灵魂之疾而心智失常的受害者发动的袭击，其数量与严重程度急剧增加。<BR>
<BR>
值得关注的事项<BR>
<BR>
1. 达格斯·乌尔似乎能通过其信徒进行感知和直接沟通。常有报告称，“沉睡者”与“梦游者”说话时，仿佛带着达格斯·乌尔的意志与口吻。<BR>
<BR>
2. 关于阿库拉可汗（第二努米迪文）的特征、规模及建造进展现状，人们知之甚少。自第二纪元282年以来，再无人进入过心脏密室。在第三纪元417年，“哀恸”与“决裂”被俘获，这可能会大大加速阿库拉可汗的建造。<BR>

> BOOK.FNAM bk_BeramJournal1
Beram Journal Entry 1
《贝拉姆日志（其一）》

> BOOK.TEXT bk_BeramJournal1
"""<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Today we finally finished hewing out the two main jail rooms and all six cells, and almost as if in response to our celebration, several of those damned roots grew through the wall and took out two of our cells. I wonder constantly what those wizards could be up to up there in the tower, but I guess this is the nature of working for the Telvanni. I will inform them again of our construction plans (which THEY provided to us) and request that they refrain from such actions in the future. In the meantime, my men have begun setting up the necessary ramps and equipment to begin work on the next section of dungeon. Here's hoping it goes better than the first.<BR>
<BR>
Beram<BR>
Foreman<BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
今天我们终于把两个主要的牢房和所有六个房间都挖出来了，几乎就像是为了回应我们的庆祝，那几根该死的树根马上就从墙上长出来，占据了我们的两个牢房。我一直想知道那些巫师在塔上会做什么，但我想这就是为泰瓦尼工作的本质。我将再次通知他们我们的建设计划（他们委托我们做的），并要求他们今后不要采取此类行动。与此同时，我的手下已经开始搭建必要的坡道和设备，以便开始下一个地牢的工作。这里希望它比第一个更好。<BR>
<BR>
贝拉姆<BR>
工头<BR>
"""

> BOOK.FNAM bk_BeramJournal2
Beram Journal Entry 2
《贝拉姆日志（其二）》

> BOOK.TEXT bk_BeramJournal2
"""<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
The lower dungeon rooms have been proving much more difficult than we originally thought. We must be working near some lava flows, as the rock of the cave walls is exceptionally hard stuff. It's hard enough to see in here without all our proper lighting installed, I don't need this delay too. I have sent off for some new volcanic glass tools, and in the meantime, one of my men has found a section of cave softer than the rest, and we have continued our work there, bypassing this first room. A few men have expressed their concern over the light rumblings that we have been feeling lately, but I am convinced that it is just more of those Telvanni and their hocus-pocus mushroom magic. They assured us of this site's stability.  The rats and bugs are annoying to us, but do not pose a threat. Hopefully we can find the source of this infestation soon and eliminate it. I don't have time for this.<BR>
<BR>
Beram<BR>
Foreman<BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
事实证明，挖掘较下层的地牢房间比我们最初想象的要困难得多。我们必须在一些熔岩流附近工作，因为洞穴墙壁的岩石非常坚硬。如果没有安装所有适当的照明设备，在这里很难看清周围的环境，我也不希望因为这些延误工期。我已经派人去拿一些新的火山玻璃工具，与此同时，我的一个手下发现了一段比其他洞穴更柔软的洞穴，我们继续在那里工作，绕过了第一个房间。一些人表达了他们对我们最近感受到的轻微隆隆声的担忧，但我相信这更多的是那些泰瓦尼和他们的恶作剧蘑菇魔法。他们向我们保证过该站点的稳定性。老鼠和虫子对我们来说很烦人，但不会构成威胁。希望我们能尽快找到这种侵扰的来源并消除它。我没有那么多时间浪费在这上面。<BR>
<BR>
贝拉姆<BR>
工头<BR>
"""

> BOOK.FNAM bk_BeramJournal3

《贝拉姆日志（其三）》

> BOOK.TEXT bk_BeramJournal3
"""<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
The worst has happened. This morning a boulder came loose from the ceiling and fell directly onto our major ramp, causing it to collapse and killing two of my men in the process. The remaining three of us are now stranded alone down here, with the cave walls being too sheer to climb, and the wizards obviously having more important things to deal with than a few errant laborers. With our water supplies diminishing rapidly, I sent Norvus and Gilam further down into the caves to look for any natural exits we might have missed when first surveying the site. Damn those wizards. They told us this site was safe. What could they be doing up there? Why are these bugs and rats getting more aggressive by the hour? And why is it getting so blasted hot?<BR>
<BR>
Beram<BR>
Foreman<BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
最坏的情况还是发生了。今天早上，一块巨石从天花板上砸了下来，直接砸到了我们的主要坡道上，导致了坡道的倒塌而且在这个过程中还让我的两个人遇难了。剩下的三个人被困在这里，洞壁太陡，爬不上去，巫师们显然有比几个走失的劳工更重要的事情要处理。随着我们的水供应迅速减少，我派诺夫斯和吉拉姆进一步深入洞穴，寻找我们在第一次勘测该地点时可能错过的任何自然出口。那些该死的巫师，他们向我们保证过这个站点是安全的。他们在上面做什么？为什么这些虫子和老鼠每时每刻都变得更具攻击性？为什么它变得如此暴躁？<BR>
<BR>
贝拉姆<BR>
工头<BR>

> BOOK.FNAM bk_BriefHistoryEmpire1_oh
Odral's History of the Empire 1
奥德拉尔的《帝国简史·卷一》

> BOOK.TEXT bk_BriefHistoryEmpire1_oh
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
A Brief History of the Empire<BR>
Part One<BR>
by Stronach k'Thojj III<BR>
Imperial Historian<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Before the rule of Tiber Septim, all Tamriel was in chaos.  The poet Tracizis called that period of continuous unrest "days and nights of blood and venom."  The kings were a petty lot of grasping tyrants, who fought Tiber's attempts to bring order to the land.  But they were as disorganized as they were dissolute, and the strong hand of Septim brought peace forcibly to Tamriel.  The year was 2E 896.  The following year, the Emperor declared the beginning of a new Era-thus began the Third Era, Year Aught.<BR>
<BR>
For thirty-eight years, the Emperor Tiber reigned supreme.  It was a lawful, pious, and glorious age, when justice was known to one and all, from serf to sovereign.  On Tiber's death, it rained for an entire fortnight as if the land of Tamriel itself was weeping.  <BR>
<BR>
The Emperor's grandson, Pelagius, came to the throne.  Though his reign was short, he was as strong and resolute as his father had been, and Tamriel could have enjoyed a continuation of the Golden Age.  Alas, an unknown enemy of the Septim Family hired that accursed organization of cutthroats, the Dark Brotherhood, to kill the Emperor Pelagius I as he knelt at prayer at the Temple of the One in the Imperial City.  Pelagius I's reign lasted less than three years.  <BR>
<BR>
Pelagius had no living children, so the Crown Imperial passed to his first cousin, the daughter of Tiber's brother Agnorith.  Kintyra, former Queen of Silvenar, assumed the throne as Kintyra I.  Her reign was blessed with prosperity and good harvests, and she herself was an avid patroness of art, music, and dance.  <BR>
<BR>
Kintyra's son was crowned after her death, the first Emperor of Tamriel to use the imperial name Uriel.  Uriel I was the great lawmaker of the Septim Dynasty, and a promoter of independent organizations and guilds.  Under his kind but firm hand, the Fighters Guild and the Mages Guild increased in prominence throughout Tamriel.  His son and successor Uriel II reigned for eighteen years, from the death of Uriel I in 3E64 to Pelagius II's accession in 3E82.  Tragically, the rule of Uriel II was cursed with blights, plagues, and insurrections.  The tenderness he inherited from his father did not serve Tamriel well, and little justice was done.  <BR>
<BR>
Pelagius II inherited not only the throne from his father, but the debt from the latter's poor financial and judicial management.  Pelagius dismissed all of the Elder Council, and allowed only those willing to pay great sums to resume their seats.  He encouraged similar acts among his vassals, the kings of Tamriel, and by the end of his seventeen year reign, Tamriel had returned to prosperity.  His critics, however, have suggested that any advisor possessed of wisdom but not of gold had been summarily ousted by Pelagius.  This may have led to some of the troubles his son Antiochus faced when he in turn became Emperor.  <BR>
<BR>
Antiochus was certainly one of the more flamboyant members of the usually austere Septim Family.  He had numerous mistresses and nearly as many wives, and was renowned for the grandeur of his dress and his high good humor.  Unfortunately, his reign was rife with civil war, surpassing even that of his grandfather Uriel II.  The War of the Isle in 3E110, twelve years after Antiochus assumed the throne, nearly took the province of Summurset Isle away from Tamriel.  The united alliance of the kings of Summurset and Antiochus only managed to defeat King Orghum of the island-kingdom of Pyandonea due to a freak storm.  Legend credits the Psijic Order of the Isle of Artaeum with the sorcery behind the tempest.  <BR>
<BR>
The story of Kintyra II, heiress to her father Antiochus' throne, is certainly one of the saddest tales in imperial history.  Her first cousin Uriel, son of Queen Potema of Solitude, accused Kintyra of being a bastard, alluding to the infamous decadence of the Imperial City during her father's reign.  When this accusation failed to stop her coronation, Uriel bought the support of several disgruntled kings of High Rock, Skyrim, and Morrowind, and with Queen Potema's assistance, he coordinated three attacks on the Septim Empire.  <BR>
<BR>
The first attack occurred in the Iliac Bay region, which separates High Rock and Hammerfell.  Kintyra's entourage was massacred and the Empress taken captive.  For two years, Kintyra II languished in an Imperial prison believed to be somewhere in Glenpoint or Glenmoril before she was slain in her cell under mysterious circumstances.  The second attack was on a series of Imperial garrisons along the coastal Morrowind islands.  The Empress' consort Kontin Arynx fell defending the forts.  The third and final attack was a siege of the Imperial City itself, occurring after the Elder Council had split up the army to attack western High Rock and eastern Morrowind.  The weakened government had little defence against Uriel's determined aggression, and capitulated after only a fortnight of resistance.  Uriel took the throne that same evening and proclaimed himself Uriel III, Emperor of Tamriel.  The year was 3E 121.  Thus began the War of the Red Diamond, described in Volume II of this series.  <BR>
<BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
帝国简史<BR>
卷一<BR>
帝国历史学家<BR>
斯托纳治·克'托伊三世　著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
在泰伯·塞普汀的统治到来以前，整个泰姆瑞尔帝国处于一片混乱之中，以致于诗人特拉西翠斯把那段时期称之为持续动荡的“洋溢着鲜血和邪恶的日日夜夜”。各王国的国王们是一群贪得无厌的暴君，他们心胸狭窄，鼠目寸光，不但不思进取，反而抵制泰伯把秩序带入这片土地的尝试和努力。这些人荒淫无度，朝纲混乱，泰伯·塞普汀不得不靠铁腕手段扫荡群雄，用武力把和平带入泰姆瑞尔。这一年是第二纪元896年。到了第二年，大帝泰伯·塞普汀改元称制，宣布了新纪元——第三纪元的开始，是年即为第三纪元元年。<BR>
<BR>
一代雄主泰伯·塞普汀在位三十八年，这是一个守法、虔诚、辉煌的黄金时代。这个时代从奴隶到君主人人知晓公平，个个追求正义，堪称帝国历史上最伟大的统治时期。泰伯大帝崩逝时大雨整整下了两个星期，似乎整个泰姆瑞尔帝国都在为他而哭泣。<BR>
<BR>
泰伯大帝驾崩后，他的孙子，佩拉基乌斯继承了皇位，史称佩拉基乌斯一世。尽管他的统治时间很短，他却完全继承了乃父坚毅果敢的性格，颇有一代英主的风范。照此看来泰姆瑞尔帝国的泰伯盛世将延续下去，前景一片大好。然而，一个不为人所知的塞普汀家族的敌人，雇佣了那个杀人不眨眼且臭名昭著的杀手组织——黑暗兄弟会，趁佩拉基乌斯一世在首都至高神殿下跪祈祷的时候刺杀了他，此时佩拉基乌斯一世的统治时间还不足三年。<BR>
<BR>
佩拉基乌斯膝下无子，因而皇位的继承权落到了他的堂姑母金泰拉，也就是他父亲泰伯大帝的兄弟阿格诺瑞斯的女儿头上。金泰拉，亦即原希尔维纳王国的女王承继大统，嗣位为君，史称金泰拉一世。得益于众神的佑护，金泰拉女皇治下的泰姆瑞尔帝国经济繁荣，收成富足，而女皇本人也是一个艺术、音乐和舞蹈事业的热心支持者。<BR>
<BR>
金泰拉女皇逝世后，她的儿子继位。这位皇帝是第一位名叫尤利尔的泰姆瑞尔皇帝，因而史称尤利尔一世。尤利尔一世是塞普汀王朝伟大的立法者，同时也是独立社团和公会的促进者和推动者。在他恩威并施的政策推动下，战士公会和法师公会在整个泰姆瑞尔帝国有了长足的发展。他的儿子，同时也是他的嗣君——尤利尔二世从第三纪元64年，也就是他父亲尤利尔一世逝世的那一年开始，到第三纪元82年，即佩拉基乌斯二世继位之年在位，一共统治了帝国十八年。然而富有悲剧色彩的是，同他的前任们海晏河清的盛世相比，枯萎病、瘟疫、叛乱等等使他的统治似乎被蒙上了一层受诅咒的阴影。他从他父亲那遗传的温和性格此时根本不对泰姆瑞尔帝国的路数，公理和正义几乎荡然无存。<BR>
<BR>
第三纪元82年，佩拉基乌斯二世继位。他不但继承了他父亲尤利尔二世的帝位，同时也继承了他父亲统治后期窘迫的财政状况和糟糕的司法运作。为了改变这种状况，佩拉基乌斯收回了长老会所有议员们的议席，并规定只有那些愿意出巨资的议员才能重新获得他们的席位。他同时也在他的诸侯们，也就是泰姆瑞尔各王国的国王们中，公然鼓励这种类似卖官的做法，藉以充实国库，所以到他为期十七年的统治时期的末期，泰姆瑞尔又恢复了繁荣的景象。然而，他的批评者们指出在这种政策之下，所有“有才但无财”的贤士都这样被佩拉基乌斯皇帝草率地疏远和驱逐，而这种亲小人远贤臣的做法也为他的继任者安条克皇帝继位后将要面对的一些麻烦埋下了伏笔。<BR>
<BR>
塞普汀家族一向作风简朴，然而于第三纪元98年继位的安条克皇帝绝对是这个家族中追求奢靡生活的异类之一。他有数不清的情妇和几乎同等数量的妻子，并以其富丽堂皇的穿着和幽默诙谐的谈吐而闻名一时。然而很不幸的是，在他统治期间似乎有打不完的内战，其兵荒马乱的状况甚至比其祖父尤利尔二世统治时期有过之而无不及。第三纪元110年，也就是安条克皇帝即位后的第十二年爆发的岛屿战争几乎把夏暮岛省从泰姆瑞尔帝国分离出去。只是靠着一场突如其来的奇怪风暴，由安条克皇帝和夏暮省的国王们组成的联盟才击败了岛国派安多尼亚国王奥格诺姆的叛军。传说阿泰乌姆岛上的塞伊克修会使用的巫术是这场暴风雨的幕后功臣。<BR>
<BR>
安条克皇帝的继任者，也就是他的女儿——金泰拉二世女皇的故事绝对是帝国历史上最悲惨的传说之一。她的表兄尤利尔，即独孤城王国的波特玛女王的儿子觊觎堂妹的皇位，指控金泰拉是安条克皇帝的私生女，借以影射在她父亲统治期间帝国首都声名狼藉的颓废和淫乱。尤利尔的这一指控并未能影响金泰拉二世的加冕典礼，不甘心失败的他又联合了同样心存不满的高岩省、天际和晨风省的国王们，以及他母亲波特玛女王的盟友们，自己居中协调、调度，发动了对塞普汀家族的帝国的三次进攻。<BR>
<BR>
第一次进攻发生在髂骨湾地区，该地区恰好处于高岩和落锤的分界线上。此战金泰拉二世的军队和随从遭到了残忍的大屠杀，女皇本人也被俘虏。在被处死前的两年中，女皇金泰拉二世被关在葛兰角（一说是格伦摩利）的一处暗无天日的帝国监狱，整天受着非人的折磨。他们的第二次进攻针对晨风岛沿岸的一系列军事要塞而发动，女皇的皇夫寇提·阿伦克斯在这些要塞的卫兵战中阵亡。第三次，也是最后一次进攻，是围攻帝都的战争。这场战争发生在长老会调动军队主力分兵去镇压西面的高岩省和东面的晨风省的叛乱，而帝都守备空虚之时。此时帝都脆弱的城防已经无法阻挡尤利尔众志成城的大兵压境，勉强抵抗十四天后投降，帝都陷落。城破的当天晚上尤利尔就迫不及待地加冕并自封为泰姆瑞尔帝国的尤利尔三世皇帝。这一年是第三纪元121年，但也就是因为这一事件而开启了红钻战役的战端。这一战役将在本书系列的第二卷中讲述。<BR>
<BR>

A Brief History of the Empire<BR>
Part Two<BR>
by Stronach k'Thojj III<BR>
Imperial Historian<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Volume I of this series described in brief the lives of the first eight Emperors of the Septim Dynasty, beginning with the glorious Tiber Septim and ending with his great, great, great, great, grandniece Kintyra II.  Kintyra's murder in Glenpoint while in captivity is considered by some to be the end of the pure strain of Septim blood in the imperial family.  Certainly it marks the end of something significant.<BR>
<BR>
Uriel III not only proclaimed himself Emperor of Tamriel, but also Uriel Septim III, taking the eminent surname as a title.  In truth, his surname was Mantiarco from his father's line.  In time, Uriel III was deposed and his crimes reviled, but the tradition of taking the name Septim as a title for the Emperor of Tamriel did not die with him.  <BR>
<BR>
For six years, the War of the Red Diamond (which takes its name from the Septim Family's famous badge) tore the Empire apart.  The combatants were the three surviving children of Pelagius II-Potema, Cephorus, and Magnus-and their various offspring.  Potema, of course, supported her son Uriel III, and had the combined support of all of Skyrim and northern Morrowind.  With the efforts of Cephorus and Magnus, however, the province of High Rock turned coat.  The provinces of Hammerfell, Summurset Isle, Valenwood, Elsweyr, and Black Marsh were divided in their loyalty, but most kings supported Cephorus and Magnus.  <BR>
<BR>
In 3E127, Uriel III was captured at the Battle of Ichidag in Hammerfell.  En route to his trial in the Imperial City, a mob overtook his prisoner's carriage and burned him alive within it.  His captor and uncle continued on to the Imperial City, and by common acclaim was proclaimed Cephorus I, Emperor of Tamriel.  <BR>
<BR>
Cephorus' reign was marked by nothing but war.  By all accounts, he was a kind and intelligent man, but what Tamriel needed was a great warrior -- and he, fortunately, was that.  It took an additional ten years of constant warfare for him to defeat his sister Potema.  The so-called Wolf Queen of Solitude who died in the siege of her city-state in the year 137.  Cephorus survived his sister by only three years.  He never had time during the war years to marry, so it was his brother, the fourth child of Pelagius II, who assumed the throne.  <BR>
<BR>
The Emperor Magnus was already elderly when he took up the imperial diadem, and the business of punishing the traitorous kings of the War of the Red Diamond drained much of his remaining strength.  Legend accuses Magnus' son and heir Pelagius III of patricide, but that seems highly unlikely-for no other reason than that Pelagius was King of Solitude following the death of Potema, and seldom visited the Imperial City.  <BR>
<BR>
Pelagius III, sometimes called Pelagius the Mad, was proclaimed Emperor in the 145th year of the Third Era.  Almost from the start, his eccentricities of behaviour were noted at court.  He embarrassed dignitaries, offended his vassal kings, and on one occasion marked the end of an imperial grand ball by attempting to hang himself.  His long-suffering wife was finally awarded the Regency of Tamriel, and Pelagius III was sent to a series of healing institutions and asylums until his death in 3E153 at the age of thirty-four.  <BR>
<BR>
The Empress Regent of Tamriel was proclaimed Empress Katariah I upon the death of her husband.  Some who do not mark the end of the Septim bloodline with the death of Kintyra II consider the ascendancy of this Dark Elf woman the true mark of its decline.  Her defenders, on the other hand, assert that though Katariah was not descended from Tiber, the son she had with Pelagius was, so the imperial chain did continue.  Despite racist assertions to the contrary, Katariah's forty-six-year reign was one of the most celebrated in Tamriel's history.  Uncomfortable in the Imperial City, Katariah travelled extensively throughout the Empire such as no Emperor ever had since Tiber's day.  She repaired much of the damage that previous emperor's broken alliances and bungled diplomacy created.  The people of Tamriel came to love their Empress far more than the nobility did.  Katariah's death in a minor skirmish in Black Marsh is a favorite subject of conspiracy minded historians.  The Sage Montalius' discovery, for instance, of a disenfranchised branch of the Septim Family and their involvement with the skirmish was a revelation indeed.  <BR>
<BR>
When Cassynder assumed the throne upon the death of his mother, he was already middle-aged.  Only half Elven, he aged like a Breton.  In fact, he had left the rule of Wayrest to his half-brother Uriel due to poor health.  Nevertheless, as the only true blood relation of Pelagius and thus Tiber, he was pressed into accepting the throne.  To no one's surprise, the Emperor Cassynder's reign did not last long.  In two years he joined his predecessors in eternal slumber.  <BR>
<BR>
Uriel Lariat, Cassynder's half-brother, and the child of Katariah I and her Imperial consort Gallivere Lariat (after the death of Pelagius III), left the kingdom of Wayrest to reign as Uriel IV.  Legally, Uriel IV was a Septim:  Cassynder had adopted him into the royal family when he had become King of Wayrest.  Nevertheless, to the Council and the people of Tamriel, he was a bastard child of Katariah.  Uriel did not possess the dynamism of his mother, and his long forty-three-year reign was a hotbed of sedition.  <BR>
<BR>
Uriel IV's story is told in the third volume of this series.  <BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
帝国简史<BR>
卷二<BR>
帝国历史学家<BR>
斯托纳治·克'托伊三世　著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
在《帝国简史》这套丛书系列的第一卷里概述了塞普汀王朝前八位皇帝的生平，这段历史从雄才大略的开国皇帝泰伯·塞普汀起，到他的六世孙女金泰拉二世为止。女皇金泰拉二世被俘后囚禁于暗无天日的葛兰角监狱，两年后被秘密处死。而她的死则被认为是塞普汀皇族纯皇室血统的某种终结，这一事件也是历史上一个重要的分水岭。<BR>
<BR>
尤利尔三世，这位靠武力夺得帝位的篡位者，不但宣称自己是泰姆瑞尔帝国的皇帝，同时为了表明自己继位的正统性和合法性，他还把塞普汀皇族的显赫姓氏塞普汀加入他的皇帝名讳中，称尤利尔·塞普汀三世。而事实上，他原来姓的是他父亲的姓曼提亚科，而不是正统的皇家姓氏塞普汀。<BR>
<BR>
卷一的末尾提及了由此而引发的红钻之战，红钻是塞普汀皇族的族徽。持续时间长达六年的红钻战争使帝国派系林立、四分五裂。在帝国长期的动乱中存活下来的皇室后裔们是皇帝佩拉基乌斯二世三个勇武的子女：波特玛、塞弗鲁斯和玛格努斯，以及他们为数众多的子孙们。波特玛女王毋庸置疑全力支持她的儿子尤利尔三世，同时她还拥有整个天际和晨风省北部地方所组成的联盟的支持；然而塞弗鲁斯和玛格努斯也不是省油的灯，他们通过自己的努力成功地使高岩省背叛了波特玛女王的同盟。余下的落锤省、夏暮岛省、威木省、艾斯维尔省以及黑沼泽省表面上宣称只忠于帝国皇帝，不过实际上这些省的大部分国王都是塞弗鲁斯和玛格努斯的支持者。<BR>
<BR>
第三纪元127年，尤利尔三世在落锤省的伊奇达格战役中被俘，迎接他的即将是审判。当装载他的囚车行进在帝都的大道上时，一个暴徒突然袭击了囚车并纵火把这个暴君活活烧死在里面。他的舅舅，同时也是那个在战场上将他生擒的人随后赶到帝都，在众人的欢呼声中被拥立为泰姆瑞尔帝国的新任皇帝，即塞弗鲁斯一世。尤利尔三世的罪行被昭告天下，受世人唾骂。尽管尤利尔三世数典忘祖地把塞普汀这个姓加到了自己的尊号和头衔中，然而将塞普汀这一皇家姓氏作为泰姆瑞尔帝国皇帝荣誉头衔的这一传统却没有随着尤利尔三世的死而烟消云散。<BR>
<BR>
塞弗鲁斯皇帝统治期间值得一提的事情除了战争还是战争。虽然总的来说他是一个睿智与温和的人，但此时诸侯割据的泰姆瑞尔帝国需要的是一个伟大的军事家，不过很幸运的是，他恰好也能胜任这份工作。为了击败他的姐姐，即号称“独孤城狼女王”的波特玛，塞弗鲁斯皇帝与她进行了长达十年的持续战争。第三纪元137年，正值她的独孤城王国王城被围攻之际，波特玛女王去世，战争结束。塞弗鲁斯皇帝虽然是胜利者，但他也只比他的姐姐多活了三年。在长期戎马倥偬的岁月里，他根本无暇顾及个人的婚姻大事，所以也没有留下一儿半女。因此他的弟弟玛格努斯，也就是皇帝佩拉基乌斯二世的第四个儿子，继承了哥哥的皇位。<BR>
<BR>
玛格努斯皇帝即位的时候年纪已经比较大了，而惩罚和处置在红钻战争期间对帝国不忠的国王和诸侯们的工作几乎耗尽了他余生的精力。他的儿子，继任者佩拉基乌斯三世在传说中被指控为弑父者，不过此说并不太可信——因为波特玛女王去世后，佩拉基乌斯即继任为独孤城王国的国王，一当就是八年。而在此期间，亦即他登基为帝前的这段时间他都几乎没怎么去过帝都。<BR>
<BR>
第三纪元145年，佩拉基乌斯登基成为泰姆瑞尔帝国的皇帝，史称佩拉基乌斯三世，不过有时人们更愿意用另一个名号，即“疯子佩拉基乌斯”来称呼他。自打即位起这位疯子皇帝种种稀奇古怪、离经叛道的行为在皇宫里就层出不穷：他经常使他的亲贵高官们下不了台，他还故意冒犯他的诸侯国王们；更让人匪夷所思的是他甚至还在帝国一次很重要的舞会上当众宣布判处他自己绞刑。最终，饱受他这种疯疯癫癫的状况折磨的妻子，也就是帝国皇后卡塔瑞亚，一个暗精灵女性，不得不代行摄政，而皇帝佩拉基乌斯三世则被送往一系列的疗养院和精神病院休养和治疗，一直到第三纪元153年，也就是他三十四岁时去世为止。<BR>
<BR>
第三纪元153年，佩拉基乌斯三世逝世，他的妻子，也就是代行摄政的卡塔瑞亚皇后登基，是为女皇卡塔瑞亚一世。这位女皇的即位引起了一场不大不小的风波：一些纯血统论者认为，自从女皇金泰拉二世逝世后，已不再有纯塞普汀皇族血统的继承人出现，故而他们对这位暗精灵女性的统治持保留意见。不过她的拥护者们却从另一个方面予以反驳：他们认为虽然卡塔瑞亚女皇和泰伯大帝没有血缘关系，然而她和佩拉基乌斯三世所生的儿子卡辛德却是名副其实的泰伯大帝的子孙，将来传位于子，帝国皇室的血脉仍将延续下去，不至于因她的继位而中断。尽管一直受到种族主义者的非议和反对，卡塔瑞亚一世为期四十六年的统治仍是泰姆瑞尔帝国历史上最值得赞美的时期之一。女皇并不待在帝都养尊处优地过活，她的足迹几乎踏遍了帝国辽阔的国土，有些地方甚至自泰伯大帝开国以来还未蒙圣眷。她修复了很多被前任皇帝们搞砸的联盟，整顿了一团糟的外交局面。正因为女皇勤政爱民，泰姆瑞尔帝国的平民远比那些贵族们要爱戴她。然而天公不作美，女皇卡塔瑞亚一世在黑沼泽省一场小规模的冲突中不幸罹难，不过这倒正好中了某些阴谋家的意。但事情可能没有这么简单，一位名叫蒙塔里奥斯的贤者有这样一个发现：这场小冲突与塞普汀家族被剥夺了皇族权利的一支后裔有关系，不排除由于非族人继位引发这家人的新仇旧恨从而报复的可能性。<BR>
<BR>
卡塔瑞亚一世逝世后，她的儿子卡辛德继位，此时卡辛德已经是一个中年人了。虽然身上有一半精灵族的血统，然而他衰老的程度却比得上一个布莱顿人。早在登基以前他就是途歇王国的国王，但由于健康问题他就已经把王国政事全权交由他的同母异父兄弟尤利尔·拉瑞亚特处理。尽管如此，作为与泰伯大帝和佩拉基乌斯皇帝有直接血缘关系的唯一皇室成员，这个皇帝还是只能由他来当。未出乎任何人的意料，卡辛德皇帝的统治只持续了很短时间，两年后他就追随自己的先祖长眠地下。<BR>
<BR>
卡辛德皇帝逝世后，他的同母异父兄弟，也就是女皇卡塔瑞亚和她续弦的皇夫加利维尔·拉瑞亚特的儿子尤利尔·拉瑞亚特，离开自己的途歇王国登基为帝，史称尤利尔四世。从法律上来说，尤利尔四世也是塞普汀皇族的一分子，早在他成为途歇王国的国王时，女皇卡塔瑞亚就把他吸纳为家族成员了。然而对于长老会和帝国老百姓们来说，他只不过是卡塔瑞亚女皇的一个私生子而已。尤利尔皇帝并没有他母亲那种充沛的精力，而他长达四十三年的统治反而成了滋生各式离经叛道行为的温床。<BR>
<BR>
尤利尔四世的故事将在本系列丛书的第三卷中介绍。<BR>

帝国简史<BR>
卷三<BR>
帝国历史学家<BR>
斯托纳治·克'托伊三世　著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
在本系列丛书的第一卷中叙述了塞普汀王朝从泰伯一世到金泰拉二世一共八位皇帝的生平。第二卷描述了其后从尤利尔三世到卡辛德一世的六位皇帝。在第二卷的末尾也顺便提及了卡辛德皇帝的同母异父兄弟尤利尔四世于第三纪元202年取得泰姆瑞尔帝国帝位一事。<BR>
需要指出的是尽管尤利尔四世的暗精灵母亲，也就是卡塔瑞亚一世，嫁给了一位具有真正塞普汀皇室血统的皇帝（佩拉基乌斯三世），并在佩拉基乌斯三世驾崩后成为女皇统治了泰姆瑞尔达数十年之久，他仍然算不上是一位具有塞普汀皇室血统的皇帝。尤利尔四世的父亲，一位名叫加利维尔·拉瑞亚特的布莱顿贵族，其实是佩拉基乌斯三世崩逝后女皇卡塔瑞亚一世续弦的皇夫。在登基为帝前，卡辛德一世就是途歇王国的国王，然而他孱弱的病体使得他不得不退位。<BR>
卡辛德一世皇帝没有任何子嗣，因而他于第三纪元192年合法地吸纳了他的同母异父兄弟尤利尔进入塞普汀皇族并将自己原来的领地——途歇王国也一并托付给了他。七年之后，也就是第三纪元199年，女皇卡塔瑞亚一世驾崩，卡辛德皇帝嗣位为君。三年之后的第三纪元202年，尤利尔发现他再次继承了卡辛德皇帝的遗产——帝位。尤利尔四世的统治虽然为期漫长却很艰辛。尽管皇帝卡辛德一世已经赋予了他作为塞普汀皇族一员的合法地位，而且他父亲加利维尔·拉瑞亚特的拉瑞亚特家族的确算得上是一个名门望族，然而他们在血缘上仍然不过是塞普汀皇族的远房表亲而已。这使得长老会中几乎没有人承认他是具有神圣泰伯皇帝血统的继承人。<BR>
长老会在卡塔瑞亚一世和卡辛德一世母子长达四十九年的统治时期内逐渐夺取了很大的权力，到尤利尔四世时已呈尾大不掉之势。尽管尤利尔四世是一位坚明果敢的帝王，然而本身就不那么名正言顺的他根本就指挥不动长老会。皇帝和长老会又一次无可避免地站到了对立面上，而这一次又是长老会取得了最后的胜利。自从百余年前佩拉基乌斯二世推行卖官政策时起，长老会就被泰姆瑞尔帝国中最富有的一群权贵们所占据，而帝国真正具有决定性的权力都掌控在他们手里。<BR>
长老会对尤利尔四世的最后一次胜利发生在他驾崩之后。尤利尔四世的儿子安朵拉克在长老会的投票中被剥夺了皇位的继承权，而另一位具有更接近塞普汀皇族本脉血统的表亲被长老会选中，并于第三纪元245年继位，史称塞弗鲁斯二世。在塞弗鲁斯二世统治的前九年里，忠于安朵拉克的势力一直在与帝国军队较量。在一项被贤者伊莱提尼称之为“泰伯·塞普汀大帝伟大的心脏停止了跳动”的法案中，长老会作出了如下妥协：他们把高岩王国封给了安朵拉克以结束这场内战。直到现在安朵拉克的后代仍然统治着那个地方。<BR>
大体上说，塞弗鲁斯二世皇帝面对的对手比之安朵拉克更加野心勃勃和贪得无厌。一个用贤者伊莱提尼的话来说是“从幽暗梦魇中浮现”，并自称为“僭越者”卡莫兰的神秘男子，带领着一支由迪德拉和亡灵战士们组成的魔域大军横扫威木省全境，征服了泰姆瑞尔帝国一个又一个的诸侯王国。几乎没有人能抵挡得住这种迅猛的攻击，整个第三纪元249年的日历差不多被他以血改写，人们几乎已经放弃了抵抗。塞弗鲁斯二世派遣了很多佣兵前往落锤以阻挡“僭越者”的北伐，但这些佣兵要么被贿赂倒戈，要么被杀死然后复活为亡灵战士——无论什么结局都助长了“僭越者”的嚣张气焰。<BR>
卡莫兰的故事值得单列一本书来记载（推荐读者参阅帛琉克斯·伊尔萨雷所着之《僭越者覆灭记》一书）。然而一言以蔽之，“僭越者”最后的覆灭与皇帝塞弗鲁斯二世并没有多大关系。这一局部地区的成功叛乱反而从侧面助长了其它地区对表面上虚弱无力的帝国的敌意。塞弗鲁斯二世的儿子和继承者尤利尔五世，通过展示帝国潜在力量的方式扭转了这种观点。<BR>
为了将泰姆瑞尔帝国的注意力从伤痕累累的内乱中转移出来，尤利尔五世从第三纪元268年继位伊始就发动了一系列的对外战争。他于第三纪元271年征服了罗斯科雷，276年征服卡斯诺奎，279年征服伊内斯里，284年征服艾思龙涅特。在第三纪元288年，他踏上了毕生最为雄心勃勃的征途：征服整个阿卡维尔大陆。这场战争最终以失败告终，两年之后也就是第三纪元290年，尤利尔五世战死在阿卡维尔大陆上的奥尼斯战场。然而，尤利尔五世获得了这样一个荣誉：他被公认为仅次于泰伯大帝的两位武功最盛的皇帝之一。<BR>
本系列丛书将要介绍的最后四位皇帝，也就是从尤利尔五世的幼子尤利尔六世开始的四位皇帝，将在第四卷，也是本丛书的最后一卷中详述。<BR>
<BR>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
A Brief History of the Empire<BR>
Part Four<BR>
by Stronach k'Thojj III<BR>
Imperial Historian<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
The first book of this series described, in brief, the first eight Emperors of the Septim Dynasty beginning with Tiber I.  The second volume described the War of the Red Diamond and the six Emperors who followed.  The third volume described the troubles of the next three Emperors-the frustrated Uriel IV, the ineffectual Cephorus II, and the heroic Uriel V.  <BR>
<BR>
On Uriel V's death across the sea in distant, hostile Akavir, Uriel VI was but five years old.  In fact, Uriel VI was born only shortly before his father left for Akavir.  Uriel V's only other progeny, by a morganatic alliance, were the twins Morihatha and Eloisa, who had been born a month after Uriel V left.  Uriel VI was crowned in the 290th year of the Third Era.  The Imperial Consort Thonica, as the boy's mother, was given a restricted Regency until Uriel VI reached his majority.  The Elder Council retained the real power, as they had ever since the days of Katariah I.  <BR>
<BR>
The Council so enjoyed its unlimited and unrestricted freedom to promulgate laws (and generate profits) that Uriel VI was not given full license to rule until 307, when he was already 22 years old.  He had been slowly assuming positions of responsibility for years, but both the Council and his mother, who enjoyed even her limited Regency, were loath to hand over the reins.  By the time he came to the throne, the mechanisms of government gave him little power except for that of the imperial veto.  <BR>
<BR>
This power, however, he regularly and vigorously exercised.  By 313, Uriel VI could boast with conviction that he truly did rule Tamriel.  He utilized defunct spy networks and guard units to bully and coerce the difficult members of the Elder Council.  His half-sister Morihatha was (not surprisingly) his staunchest ally, especially after her marriage to Baron Ulfe Gersen of Winterhold brought her considerable wealth and influence.  As the Sage Ugaridge said, "Uriel V conquered Esroniet, but Uriel VI conquered the Elder Council."  <BR>
<BR>
When Uriel VI fell off a horse and could not be resuscitated by the finest Imperial healers, his beloved sister Morihatha took up the imperial tiara.  At 25 years of age, she had been described by (admittedly self-serving) diplomats as the most beautiful creature in all of Tamriel.  She was certainly well-learned, vivacious, athletic, and a well-practised politician.  She brought the Archmagister of Skyrim to the Imperial City and created the second Imperial Battlemage since the days of Tiber Septim.  <BR>
<BR>
Morihatha finished the job her brother had begun, and made the Imperial Province a true government under the Empress (and later, the Emperor).  Outside the Imperial Province, however, the Empire had been slowly disintegrating.  Open revolutions and civil wars had raged unchallenged since the days of her grandfather Cephorus II.  Carefully coordinating her counterattacks, Morihatha slowly claimed back her rebellious vassals, always avoiding overextending herself.  <BR>
<BR>
Though Morihatha's military campaigns were remarkably successful, her deliberate pace often frustrated the Council.  One Councilman, an Argonian who took the Colovian name of Thoricles Romus, furious at her refusal to send troops to his troubled Black Marsh, is commonly believed to have hired the assassins who claimed her life in 3E 339.  Romus was summarily tried and executed, though he protested his innocence to the last.  <BR>
<BR>
Morihatha had no surviving children, and Eloisa had died of a fever four years before.  Eloisa's 25-year-old son Pelagius was thus crowned Pelagius IV.  Pelagius IV continued his aunt's work, slowly bringing back under his wing the radical and refractory kingdoms, duchies, and baronies of the Empire.  He exercised Morihatha's poise and circumspect pace in his endeavours-but alas, he did not attain her success.  The kingdoms had been free of constraint for so long that even a benign Imperial presence was considered odious.  Nevertheless, when Pelagius died after an astonishing forty-nine-year reign, Tamriel was closer to unity than it had been since the days of Uriel I.  <BR>
<BR>
Our current Emperor, His Awesome and Terrible Majesty, Uriel Septim VII, son of Pelagius IV, has the diligence of his great-aunt Morihatha, the political skill of his great-uncle Uriel VI, and the military prowess of his great grand-uncle Uriel V.  For twenty-one years he reigned and brought justice and order to Tamriel.  In the year 3E389, however, his Imperial Battlemage, Jagar Tharn, betrayed him.  <BR>
<BR>
Uriel VII was imprisoned in a dimension of Tharn's creation, and Tharn used his sorcery of illusion to assume the Emperor's aspect.  For the next ten years, Tharn abused imperial privilege but did not continue Uriel VII's schedule of reconquest.  It is not yet entirely known what Tharn's goals and personal accomplishments were during the ten years he masqueraded as his liege lord.  In 3E399, an enigmatic Champion defeated the Battlemage in the dungeons of the Imperial Palace and freed Uriel VII from his other-dimensional jail.  <BR>
<BR>
Since his emancipation, Uriel Septim VII has worked diligently to renew the battles that would reunite Tamriel.  Tharn's interference broke the momentum, it is true -- but the years since then have proven that there is hope of the Golden Age of Tiber Septim's rule glorifying Tamriel once again.  <BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
帝国简史<BR>
卷四<BR>
帝国历史学家<BR>
斯托纳治·克'托伊三世　著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
本系列丛书的第一卷简要叙述了塞普汀王朝自泰伯大帝开始的八位皇帝的生平。第二卷描述了红钻战役以及之后的六位皇帝。第三卷记叙了接下来三位皇帝的艰难岁月：失败的尤利尔四世，无能的塞弗鲁斯二世，以及英雄的尤利尔五世。<BR>
<BR>
在武勇的尤利尔五世战死在隔海相望的遥远大陆——阿卡维尔上时，他的儿子尤利尔六世才五岁大。事实上，尤利尔六世是在他父亲尤利尔五世行将出征阿卡维尔大陆之际降生的。尤利尔五世除尤利尔六世之外的唯一后裔，就是他和平民通婚生下的双胞胎姐妹莫里哈萨和埃洛伊萨，这对姐妹在尤利尔五世出征阿卡维尔大陆一个月后出生。尤利尔六世于第三纪元290年加冕为帝。皇太后瑟尼卡，同时也是小皇帝尤利尔六世的亲生母亲，获得了尤利尔六世成年前有限的摄政权。然而实际权力仍然掌握在长老会手里，一如百年前女皇卡塔瑞亚一世统治时期以来那样。<BR>
<BR>
长老会沉醉于无拘无束、无休无止地制定各项法律的自由（并从中谋取私利），以至于尤利尔六世直到第三纪元307年，也就是他二十二岁的时侯才获得亲政的权力。十七年来他一步步缓慢地试图取得本属于他自己的权力，然而早就沉溺于权力的长老会对他的这一行动设定了很多障碍，使得他举步维艰，甚至连他的亲生母亲，也就是皇太后瑟尼卡也陷于她那有限的摄政权力中而不能自拔，也对他束手束脚。最后当他亲政时，帝国的官僚机构除了否决权之外几乎没给这位皇帝什么实权。<BR>
<BR>
然而就是这一项否决权，尤利尔六世频繁而又热切地动用了很多次。第三纪元313年，尤利尔六世终于可以自豪地宣称他终于获得了泰姆瑞尔帝国的实际统治大权。他构建了致命的间谍网和堪称他死士的卫队，并通过威胁和恫吓的手段使得长老会中的顽固分子就范。他同父异母的妹妹莫里哈萨是他坚定的同盟者，尤其是当她嫁给冬堡的城主伍尔夫·葛森男爵后，更给她带来了可观的财富和影响力。正如贤者乌加里奇所说的那样，“尤利尔五世将艾思龙涅特踩在脚下，然而尤利尔六世却把长老会收拾得服服贴贴。”<BR>
<BR>
尤利尔六世在一次坠马事故中身受重伤，甚至连帝国顶尖的医生都束手无策。他所挚爱的妹妹莫里哈萨戴上了象征皇权的三重冠，继位为君。在她二十五岁的时侯，她被外交官们公认为泰姆瑞尔第一美人（必须承认这是私下的举动）。她学识渊博，精力旺盛，活泼好动，同时也是一位训练有素的政治家。她将天际的大导师请回帝都，并将之钦封为自泰伯大帝时期以来的第二位帝国战法师。<BR>
<BR>
莫里哈萨完成了她哥哥尤利尔六世未竟的事业，并将帝国中央行省西罗帝尔置于皇权的掌控之下。然而在中央行省以外的外省，帝国正在潜移默化之中走向分裂。自从她祖父塞弗鲁斯二世执政以来，公开起义和内战的势头就愈演愈烈。在每一场战役都周密估量双方态势之后，莫里哈萨女皇稳扎稳打地将叛乱的诸侯们一一镇压，期间她都一直注意不过分扩张自身。<BR>
<BR>
尽管女皇莫里哈萨的军事策略取得了重大胜利，然而她深思熟虑的战略步骤和平稳谨慎的军事策略经常激怒长老会。长老会的一位名叫索瑞克·洛马斯的阿尔贡议员，对女皇拒绝派遣大军收复他饱受战火肆虐的家乡黑沼泽震怒不已。一般都认为是他雇杀手于第三纪元339年刺杀了女皇。洛马斯随后被逮捕并处以死刑，尽管直到最后他仍然声称自己是无辜的。<BR>
<BR>
女皇莫里哈萨的子女都早年夭折，她的双胞胎妹妹埃洛伊萨也在数年前去世。埃洛伊萨二十五岁的儿子佩拉基乌斯因而被加冕为佩拉基乌斯四世。佩拉基乌斯四世继续着他大姨莫里哈萨女皇的事业，他逐步将那些位置重要而又张狂的诸侯国、公爵和男爵们的领地收归治下。他秉承了他大姨莫里哈萨女皇那谨慎平稳的作风——然而遗憾的是，他并未取得像她那样的成功。那些诸侯国们已经脱离帝国的管束太久，以至于就算是帝国实行温和仁慈的政策，他们也觉得难以忍受。然而，在佩拉基乌斯四世为期四十九年的统治结束后，泰姆瑞尔帝国比自尤利尔一世以来的任何时期都要接近统一。<BR>
<BR>
我们的当朝皇帝，尊贵和威严的尤利尔塞普汀七世皇帝陛下，是佩拉基乌斯四世之子。他像其姨祖母莫里哈萨一样勤政，他拥有其舅祖父尤利尔六世的治政才华，还具备其舅曾祖父尤利尔五世的军事头脑。在承继大统后的二十一年，尤利尔七世将正义和秩序带入了泰姆瑞尔帝国。然而在第三纪元389年，他的帝国战斗法师杰迦尔·萨恩却背叛了他。<BR>
<BR>
尤利尔七世被囚禁在萨恩所创造出的一个维度里，之后萨恩利用自己的幻术系法术伪装成尤利尔七世的样子。在接下来的十年里，萨恩无限制地滥用皇权，将尤利尔七世重整山河的宏愿束之高阁。萨恩伪装龙颜的这十年里，其个人目的到底是什么至今未为人所知。第三纪元399年，一位神秘的勇士在皇宫地牢里击败了这个战斗法师并将尤利尔七世从维度中解救出来。<BR>

> BOOK.FNAM bk_provinces_of_tamriel
Provinces of Tamriel
《泰姆瑞尔诸省》

> BOOK.TEXT bk_provinces_of_tamriel
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
PROVINCES OF TAMRIEL<BR>
<IMG SRC="theempire.tga" WIDTH="377" HEIGHT="253"><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
The Empire of Tamriel encompasses the nine Imperial provinces: Skyrim, High Rock, Hammerfell, Summerset Isle, Valenwood, Elsweyr, Black Marsh, Morrowind, and the ancient Imperial province itself, Cyrodiil. Morrowind was among the last of the provinces to be integrated into the Empire, and because it was added by treaty, and not by conquest, Morrowind retains exceptional power to define local law by reference to ancient Great House precedents. <BR>
<BR>
Skyrim, also known as the Old Kingdom or the Fatherland, was the first region of Tamriel settled by humans from the continent of Atmora: the hardy, brave, warlike Nords, whose descendants still occupy this rugged land. Though more restrained and civilized than their barbarian ancestors, the Nords of the pure blood still excel in the manly virtues of red war and bold exploration. <BR>
<BR>
Hammerfell is primarily an urban and maritime province, with most of its population confined to the great cities of Sentinel and Stros M'Kai and to other small ports among the islands and along the coast. The interior is sparsely populated with small poor farms and beastherds. The Redguard love of travel, adventure, and the high seas has dispersed them as sailors, mercenaries, and adventurers in ports of call throughout the Empire. <BR>
<BR>
High Rock encompasses the many lands and clans of Greater Bretony, the Dellese Isles, the Bjoulsae River tribes, and, by tradition, the Western Reach. The rugged highland strongholds and isolated valley settlements have encouraged the fierce independence of the various local Breton clans, and this contentious tribal nature has never been completely integrated into a provincial or Imperial identity. Nonetheless, their language, bardic traditions, and heroic legends are a unifying common legacy. <BR>
<BR>
The Summerset Isle is a green and pleasant land of fertile farmlands, woodland parks, and ancient towers and manors. Most settlements are small and isolated, and dominated by ruling seats of the local wizard or warlord. The Isle has few good natural ports, and the natives are unwelcoming to foreigners, so the ancient, chivalric high culture of the Aldmer is little affected by modern Imperial mercantilism. <BR>
<BR>
Valenwood is a largely uninhabited forest wilderness. The coasts of Valenwood are dominated by mangrove swamps and tropical rain forests, while heavy rainfalls nurture the temperate inland rain forests. The Bosmer live in timber clanhouses at sites scattered along the coast and through the interior, connected only by undeveloped foot trails. The few Imperial roads traverse vast dense woodlands, studded with tiny, widely separated settlements, and carry little trade or traffic of any kind. <BR>
<BR>
The Khajiit of the southern Elsweyr jungles and river basins are settled city dwellers with ancient mercantile traditions and a stable agrarian aristocracy based on sugarcane and saltrice plantations. The nomadic tribal Khajiit of the dry northern wastes and grasslands are, by contrast, aggressive and territorial tribal raiders periodically united under tribal warlords. While the settled south has been quick to adopt Imperial ways, the northern nomadic tribes cling to their warlike barbarian traditions. <BR>
Most of the native Argonian population of Black Marsh is confined to the great inland waterways and impenetrable swamps of the southern interior. There are few roads here, and most travel is by boat. The coasts and the northwestern upland forests are largely uninhabited. For ages the Dunmer have raided Black Marsh for slaves; though the Empire has made this illegal, the practice persists, and Dunmer and Argonians have a long-standing and bitter hatred for one another. <BR>
<BR>
Morrowind, homeland of the Dunmer peoples, is the northeastmost province of the Tamrielic Empire. Most of the population is gathered in the high uplands and fertile river valleys of central Morrowind, especially around the Inland Sea. The island Vvardenfel is encircled by the Inner Sea, and is dominated by the titanic volcano Red Mountain and its associated ash wastelands; most of the island's population is confined to the relatively hospitable west and southwest coast. <BR>
<BR>
Cyrodiil is the cradle of Human Imperial high culture on Tamriel. It is the largest region of the continent, and most is endless jungle. The Imperial City is in the heartland, the fertile Nibenay Valley. The densely populated central valley is surrounded by wild rain forests drained by great rivers into the swamps of Argonia and Topal Bay. The land rises gradually to the west and sharply to the north. Between its western coast and its central valley are deciduous forests and mangrove swamps. <BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
泰姆瑞尔诸省<BR>
<IMG SRC="theempire.tga" WIDTH="377" HEIGHT="253"><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
泰姆瑞尔帝国包括九个省：天际、高岩、落锤、夏暮岛、瓦伦森林、艾斯维尔、黑沼泽、晨风，以及古老的帝国省份西罗帝尔。晨风是最后一批被纳入帝国的省份之一，由于它是通过条约而非征服添加的，晨风省保留了特殊的自治权力，该省可以通过参考古代大家族的先例来制定地方法律。<BR>
<BR>
天际，又称“旧王国”或“祖国”，是从阿特莫拉大陆迁徙至泰姆瑞尔的人类最早定居的地区：坚韧、勇敢、好战的诺德人，他们的后裔至今仍居住在这片崎岖的土地上。虽然比野蛮人的先祖更加克制和文明，但血统纯正的诺德人仍然擅热血征战和大胆探索的男子汉美德。<BR>
<BR>
落锤主要是一个城市化的海洋省份，其人口主要集中在哨兵和斯特罗斯·姆'凯等大城市以及岛屿之间和沿海的其他小港口。内陆地区人烟稀少，多是贫穷的小农场和野生动物。红卫一族热爱旅行、冒险和航海，他们常常作为水手、雇佣兵和冒险家出现在帝国各地的港口。<BR>
<BR>
高岩省包括了许多土地和多个布莱顿大部族，德勒斯群岛、比约萨河部落，以及传统上的西河。崎岖的高地要塞和孤立的山谷定居点给了当地各布莱顿氏族强烈的独立性，而这种有争议的部落性质从来没有完全融入一个省或帝国的身份中。尽管如此，他们的语言、吟游诗人的传统和英雄的传说扔是他们共同的遗产。<BR>
<BR>
夏暮岛是一片绿色宜人的土地，这里有肥沃的农田、林地公园、古老的塔楼和庄园。大多数定居点都很小，与世隔绝，由当地的巫师或军阀统治。岛上几乎没有天然良港，当地人也不欢迎外邦人，因此奥德莫古老的骑士高尚文化几乎没有受到现代帝国人重商主义的影响。<BR>
<BR>
瓦伦森林基本上是无人居住的森林荒野。瓦伦森林的海岸主要是红树林和热带雨林，而大量降雨滋养了内陆雨林。波斯莫住在沿着海岸和内陆散布的木制族屋里，只有原始的步道连接着他们。仅有的几条皇家大道横贯大片茂密的林地，其间散布着分散的小居民点，几乎没有贸易或任何形式的交通设施。<BR>
<BR>
艾斯维尔南部丛林以及河流流域的卡吉特是定居在城市居民，他们是有着古老的商业传统和以收成稳定的甘蔗和盐碱地种植园为基础的地主。相比之下，北方干旱荒漠和草原上的游牧部落中的卡吉特则是侵略性的，这些土地的掠夺者会在部落军阀的统治下周期性地联合起来。当定居的南方卡吉特迅速接受帝国的传统和法律时，北方游牧部落则坚持他们好战的野蛮传统。<BR>
<BR>
黑沼泽的大部分土著阿尔贡生活在广阔的内陆水道和南部内陆无法渗透的沼泽里。这里的道路很少，大多数旅行都是靠坐船。沿海和西北部的山地森林基本上无人居住。多年来，丹莫一直在黑沼泽搜捕奴隶，虽然帝国已经将这种行为定为非法，但这种行为依然存在，而丹莫和阿尔贡的彼此仇恨也由来已久。<BR>
<BR>
晨风是丹莫的家园，是泰姆瑞尔帝国最东北的一个省。大部分人口聚集在高地和中部晨风的肥沃河谷，特别是在内海附近。瓦丹费尔岛被内海包围，主要是由巨大的火山“红山”及其相关的火山灰荒原组成。岛上的大部分人口集中在相对适宜居住的西部和西南部海岸。<BR>
<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Notes - Kagouti Mating Habits<BR>
Edras Oril<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Observations made on wild kagouti in southeastern Morrowind.<BR>
<BR>
Kagouti do not seem to travel in large packs, as previously believed. Perhaps they group into larger packs when mating season is imminent.<BR>
<BR>
Females seem to be dominant sex. Males will bring gifts of food in exchange for mating advantage. Males sometimes attacked.<BR>
<BR>
Loud vocalizations heard exchanged (believed to be from males), especially at night. Fascinating.<BR>
<BR>
Males do not seem to engage in physical confrontation for reproductive rights. Some posturing, but no conflict.<BR>
<BR>
All kagouti display increased aggressiveness during mating. Must be careful not to be seen.<BR>
<BR>
Mating kagouti found to be increasingly territorial.<BR>
<BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
笔记——盾角蜥的交配习性<BR>

对晨风东南部野生盾角蜥的观察报告。<BR>
<BR>
盾角蜥似乎并不像从前认知的那样成群结队地旅行。当交配季节即将到来时，它们可能会聚成更大的族群。<BR>
<BR>
雌性似乎占据主导地位。雄性会带上食物作为礼物以换取交配优势。雄性有时会攻击。<BR>
<BR>
尤其在晚上，能听到彼此交互发出的响亮叫声（应当来自雄性）。真迷人啊。<BR>
<BR>
雄性似乎不会为了生殖权而进行身体对抗。有些装腔作势，但没有冲突。<BR>
<BR>
所有的盾角蜥在交配期间都表现出更强的攻击性。谨慎行事，别被发现。<BR>
<BR>
交配的盾角蜥愈发具备领土意识。<BR>
<BR>"""

《尸体处理·卷二》

> BOOK.TEXT bk_corpsepreperation2_c
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
On the Preparation of the Corpse<BR>
Volume Two: The Skeletal Corpse<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
When raising a skeleton servant, it is most important that the body of the skeleton be complete. If the skeleton is missing crucial bones, the results can be frustrating. One should only attempt to raise skeletons when you are sure that all or nearly all the bones are present.<BR>
<BR>
While the magic involved in raising a skeleton will assemble the bones in the proper order, skeletons may be strengthened considerably by the addition of support on their joints. The most common are leather straps that bind the bones together more tightly. Some practitioners also drive metal spikes are between the joints, which is more expensive and time consuming, but they protect the servant where it is weakest. The details of this are unimportant as even an amateur can strengthen a skeleton significantly. Only practice will reveal the best methods of binding and reinforcing the skeletal servant. Amateurs often make the mistake of binding the bones too tightly, limiting the skeleton's movements and making it useless. Again, only practice can give the necessary experience in these matters, though it is best to err towards tight bindings. One may always loosen them at a later date.<BR>
<BR>
One more note to the student: While most undead can be raised again and again, skeletons are often damaged in ways that make raising them again impossible. This is another reason that care should be given to the skeleton's preparation. Too many young Necromancers raise every skeleton they see with little or no preparation at all. Given the difficulty of obtaining corpses, this kind of inefficiency cannot be tolerated.<BR>
<BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
尸体处理<BR>
卷二：骷髅仆从<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
当复生一个骷髅仆从时，最重要的是骨架要完整。如果骨架缺少关键的骨骼，结果可能会令人沮丧。只有当你确信所有或几乎所有的骨头都存在的时候，你才应该尝试去复生骷髅。<BR>
<BR>
虽然复生骷髅所涉及的魔法会将骨骼按适当的顺序组合起来，但骷髅可以通过在其关节上增加支撑而大大加强。最常见的做法是用皮带将骨头绑紧。一些习艺者也会在关节之间加入可驱动的金属钉，这比较昂贵，也很费时间，但它们确实保护了仆从最脆弱的部分。这些细节并不重要，因为即使是一个外行也可以显著地增强骷髅。只有实践才能揭示出约束和加强骷髅仆从的最佳方法。外行人经常会犯这样的错误：把骨头绑得太紧，限制了骨骼的活动，使得骷髅毫无用处。同样，只有实践才能在这些问题上提供必要的经验，尽管刚开始的时候最好还是用错误的方法绑严实了。在以后的日子里，人们总可以松开它们的。<BR>
<BR>
对学生的另一个提示：虽然大多数不死生物可以被一次又一次地复生，但是骷髅经常被毁坏，这使得多次复生它们变得不可能。这是另一个需要注重骨骼前期准备的原因。太多年轻的亡灵巫师在几乎没有任何准备的情况下复生起他们看到的每一具骷髅。考虑到获取尸体的困难程度，这种低效率是不能容忍的。<BR>
<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
On the Preparation of the Corpse<BR>
Volume 3: The Fresh Corpse<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Fresh and decayed corpses are those that still have flesh upon them. If their decay is advanced, or if you wish a skeletal servant instead, place the corpse along a coast or in a swamp or marsh. Animals are the Necromancer's greatest allies when it comes to stripping the flesh from a corpse. The ravenous mudcrabs of Morrowind can strip a corpse down to its bones in a matter of days. Lesser crabs in other provinces can do the same in a matter of weeks.<BR>
<BR>
If you wish to create a zombie servant, one need only bring the corpse to a suitable site and enact the proper rituals. However, there are a few tips that a young Necromancer might want to know. For instance, a decayed servant may be raised many times, even if they have been dismembered by those who do not appreciate our Art. If one of your servants comes to an unfortunate end, you may raise the servant again by carefully gathering as many parts as you can find, binding the bones with leather straps, and sewing the flesh (if it not too decayed) with catgut. Your servant may be weaker each time this is done, but with care and maintenance, one may raise zombies dozens of times.<BR>
<BR>
However, creating a mere zombie is a method best left to lazy or desperate practitioners. With only a bit more time and effort, one may create a far more useful mummified servant.<BR>
<BR>
The first step to creating a mummified servant is to soak the decaying corpse in a bath of salt or natron for at least one month. This will halt the decay of the corpse, and if the corpse is fresh enough to have an unpleasant odor, the salts will remove that as well. In a moist climate, such as Argonian or Thras, you may have to apply more salts if they become saturated. Some Necromancers remove the vital organs before or after this process, but I have never found any practical reason for doing this.<BR>
<BR>
The next step is to wrap the servant in cloth or linen. This will further preserve the body against decay and, if done properly, will offer some protection as well. Do not worry if the corpse seems too stiff or desiccated to be a useful servant, the proper rituals will imbue the mummified corpse with the strength to move itself. Most importantly, you will have a much stronger servant who will follow your commands with more independence and understanding.<BR>
<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
尸体处理<BR>
卷三：新鲜的尸体<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
“新鲜”的腐尸是那些身上还有肉的。如果尸体腐烂的速度很快，或者你想要一个骷髅仆从，那就把尸体放在海边或者沼泽里。当需要给尸体除肉时，动物是亡灵巫师最好的盟友。饥饿的晨风泥蟹可以在几天内把尸体吃光。其他省份的小螃蟹在几周内也能做到这一点。<BR>
<BR>
如果你想创造一个僵尸仆从，你只需要把尸体带到一个合适的地点，并进行适当的仪式。然而，这里有一些年轻的亡灵巫师可能想知道的忠告。例如，一个腐烂的仆从可能会被多次复生，即使他们被那些不欣赏我们技艺的人肢解。如果你的一个仆从到了不幸的结局，你可以通过仔细收集尽可能多的部分，用皮带绑住骨头，用肠线缝上肉（如果不是腐烂得太厉害的话），来让仆从复生。每复生一次，你的仆从都可能变弱，这是肯定的，但是只要用心维护，一具僵尸或许可以被复生几十次。<BR>
<BR>
然而，创造一个纯粹的僵尸是一种最好留给懒惰或绝望的习艺者的方法。只要多一点时间和努力，就可以创造出一个有用得多的木乃伊仆从。<BR>
<BR>
制作木乃伊仆从的第一步是将腐烂的尸体浸泡在盐或碱中至少一个月。这将停止尸体的腐烂，如果尸体足够新鲜，有一种令人不愉快的气味，盐也会消除这种气味。在潮湿的气候中，如阿尔贡或瑟拉斯，要让它们浸透，你就可能需要使用更多的盐。一些亡灵巫师在这个过程之前或之后会移除重要的器官，但是我从来没有找到任何实际的理由这样做。<BR>
<BR>
下一步是用布或亚麻包裹仆从。这将进一步保护尸体免于腐烂，如果处理得当，这还将为尸体提供一些保护。如果尸体看起来太僵硬或干枯，不能成为有用的仆从，不要担心，适当的仪式将赋予干尸移动自身的力量。最重要的是，你会有一个更强壮的仆从，他会更独立，也更能理解你的命令。<BR>

> BOOK.FNAM bk_poisonsong1
Poison Song I
《毒药之颂·卷一》

> BOOK.TEXT bk_poisonsong1
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
The Poison Song<BR>
Book I<BR>
By Bristin Xel<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
It was beginning again.  Even though everything seemed serene (the last embers crackling in the hearth; young servant girl and her child slumbering in a chair by the door; a tapestry half-finished against the wall, waiting to be completed tomorrow; one of the moons visible through a milky cloud outside the window; a lone bird, out of sight in the rafters, cooing placidly), Tay heard the first chords of the Song strike dissonantly somewhere far away.<BR>
<BR>
The bird in the rafters croaked and took flight through the window.  The baby in the girl's arms woke and began to scream.  The Song swelled in intensity, yet still remained subtle and stately in tempo.  The movement of everything seemed to take on the rhythm of the music as if strange choreography had been staged: the girl rising to the window, the clouds reflecting back red from the inferno below, her scream, all muted, consumed by the Song.  Everything that came thereafter Tay had seen so many times, it had almost ceased to be a nightmare.<BR>
<BR>
He did not remember anything of his life before coming to the island of Gorne, but he understood that there was something different in his past that set him apart from his cousins.  It wasn't simply that his parents were dead.  His cousin Baynarah's parents had also died in the War.  Nor were the other Housemen on Gorne or nearby Mournhold unusually cruel to him.  They treated him with the same polite indifference that any Indoril has for every other eight-year-old boy that got underfoot.<BR>
<BR>
But somehow, with absolutely certainty, Tay knew he was alone.  Different.  Because of a Song he always heard, and his nightmares.<BR>
<BR>
$93You're certainly imaginative,$94 his aunt Ulliah would smile patiently, before waving him away so she could return to her scriptures and chores.<BR>
<BR>
$93Different?  Everyone in the world thinks they're 'different,' that's what makes it such a common sentiment,$94 said his older cousin Kalkorith who was studying to be Temple priest and had a firm grasp on paradoxes.<BR>
<BR>
$93If you tell anyone else that you keep hearing music where there's no music to be heard, they'll call you mad and bury you in the Shrine of Sheogorath,$94 his uncle Triffith would snarl, before striding away to attend his business.<BR>
<BR>
Only his nursemaid Edebah would listen to him seriously, and just nod with a faint look of pride.  But she would never say another word.<BR>
<BR>
His cousin and chief playmate Baynarah was by far the least interested in the stories of his Song and his dreams.  <BR>
<BR>
"How tiresome you are with all this, Tay," said Baynarah, after luncheon the summer of his eighth year. He, she, and a younger cousin Vaster walked into a clearing in the midst of flowering trees. The grass was very low, barely up to their ankles, and there were big black piles of leaves from the previous autumn.  $93Now, shall we get back to it?  What shall we play?"<BR>
<BR>
Tay thought for a moment. "We could play the Siege of Orsinium."<BR>
<BR>
"What's that?" asked Vaster, their constant companion, three years their junior.<BR>
<BR>
"Orsinium was the home of the orcs, off in the Wrothgarian Mountains. For hundreds of years, it kept growing bigger and bigger and bigger. The orcs would come down out of the mountains and rape and pillage all over High Rock. And then, King Joile of Daggerfall and Gaiden Shinji of the Order of Diagna and someone else, I forget, from Sentinel all joined together against Orsinium. For thirty years they fought and fought. Orsinium had walls made out of iron and, try as they might, they couldn't break through."<BR>
<BR>
"So what happened?" asked Baynarah.<BR>
<BR>
"You're so good at making up things that never happened, why don't you make it up?"<BR>
<BR>
So they did. Tay was the King of the Orcs, perched up in a tree they called Orsinium. Baynarah and Vaster played King Joile and Gaiden Shinji and they threw pebbles and sticks up at Tay while he taunted them in his most guttural voice. The three decided that the Goddess Kynareth (played by Baynarah in dual role) answered the prayers of Gaiden Shinji and drenched Orsinium in a torrent of rain. The walls rusted and dissolved. On cue, Tay obligingly fell from the tree and let King Joile and Gaiden Shinji mangle him with their enchanted blades.<BR>
<BR>
For the most of that summer, the year 675 of the First Era, Tay was nearly insensible by the power of the sun.  There were no clouds, but it rained most every night, so the vegetation on the island of Gorne was bewildering lush. The stones themselves seemed to glow with sunlight, and the ditches burned with white meadowsweet and parsleydown; all around him were soft smells of flower and tree untroubled by wind; the foliage was purple green, blue green, ash green, white green. The wide cupolas, twisting cobbled streets, and thatched roofs of the little village of Gorne, and massive bleached rock of Sandil House all were magical to him.<BR>
<BR>
Yet the dreams haunted his nights and the Song continued whether he was awake or not.<BR>
<BR>
Against Aunt Ulliah's admonishments, Tay, Baynarah, and Vaster had breakfast outdoors every morning with the servants. Ulliah would hold an interior breakfast for herself and any visiting dignitaries: guests were rare, so she often ate alone. At first the servants would dine in silence, attempting gentility, but they broke down and would regale the children with gossip, reports, stories, and rumors.<BR>
<BR>
"Poor Arnyle is laid up with a fever again."<BR>
<BR>
"I'm telling you, they're cursed. The whole lot of 'em. Piss on the faerie and they piss right back on you."<BR>
<BR>
"Doesn't Little Miss Starsia look, oh, just a wee bit tight around the belly region late-ly?"<BR>
<BR>
"She's not!"<BR>
<BR>
The only servant who didn't speak at all was Tay's nursemaid Edebah.  She wasn't pretty like the other maids, but the scars on her face did not deform her. Her poorly set broken nose and her short hair gave her a certain alien mystique. She would merely quietly smile at the gossip, and look at Tay with almost frightening love and devotion.<BR>
<BR>
One day, after breakfast, Baynarah whispered to Tay and Vaster, "We have to go to the hills on the other side of the island."<BR>
<BR>
She had used such imperatives before and always had something wonderful to show: a waterfall, tucked away behind ferns and tall rocks; a sunny grove of figs; a discreet still some peasants had set up; a sickly oak, twisted into a kneeling human figure; a collapsed stone wall that they imagined was thousands of years old, the last refuge of a doomed princess they named Merella. <BR>
<BR>
The three walked across through the forest until they came to a clearing.  A few hundred feet beyond, the meadow sank to a dry creek bed, filled with small, smooth stones. They followed that into the dark woods where trees canopied high over their heads. Sporadic red and yellow blossoms burst along the moist underbrush, but they became rarer and rarer as the children marched on under the umbrageous oaks and elms. The air crackled with birds ticking a staccato choral piece, a minor chord of the Song.<BR>
<BR>
$93Where are we going?$94 asked Tay.<BR>
<BR>
$93It's not where we're going, it's what we're going to see,$94 replied Baynarah.<BR>
<BR>
The forest surrounded the three children completely, bathed them in its tenebrous hues, and breathed on them with wet chirrups and sighs. It was easy for them to imagine that they were within a monster, walking along its twisted spine of stones. <BR>
<BR>
Baynarah scrambled up the steep hill and peered through the thick mass of shrub and tree.  Tay lifted Vaster out of the creek bed and climbed out, gripping soft grass for support. There was no path through the forest here. Brambles and low hanging branches struck at them like the claws of chained beasts. The cries of the birds became ever more stentorious, as if angered at the invasion. One limb drew blood on Vaster's cheek, but he didn't cry out. Even Baynarah, who could pass like an ethereal creature through impenetrable forests, had a braid catch on a bramble, ruining the intricate pattern a servant had woven hours before. She paused to pull out the other braid, so her bright unruly tresses fell freely behind her. Now she was something wild, a nymph guiding the other two through her woodland domain.  The Song began to beat like a wild pulse.<BR>
<BR>
They were on a shelf of stone below a cliff overlooking a tremendous gorge, staring over an expanse of cinder.  It looked like the scene of a tremendous battle, a holocaust of fire.  Charred boxes, weaponry, animal bones, and detritus too annihilated to be identifiable littered the ground.  Speechless, Tay and Vaster stepped into the black field.  Baynarah smiled, proud that she had finally found something of true wonder and mystery.<BR>
<BR>
$93What is this place?$94 asked Vaster at last.<BR>
<BR>
$93I don't know,$94 Baynarah shrugged. $93I thought at first that it was some kind of ruin, but now I think it's a junk pile, just not like any junk pile I've ever seen.  Just look at this stuff.$94<BR>
<BR>
The three began an unorganized survey of the dusty mounds of refuse.  Baynarah found a twisted sword only lightly blackened by flame and began polishing it to read the inscriptions on the blade.  Vaster amused himself by breaking brittle boxes with his hands and feet, imagining himself a giant of unbelievable strength.  A battered shield attracted Tay: there was something about it that reverberated with the sound of the Song.  He pulled it out, and wiped its surface clean.  <BR>
<BR>
$93I've never seen that crest before,$94 said Baynarah, looking over Tay's shoulder.<BR>
<BR>
$93I think I have, but I don't remember,$94 Tay whispered, trying to conjure the memory from his dreams. He was sure he had seen it there.<BR>
<BR>
$93Look at this!$94 Vaster cried, interrupting Tay's thoughts.  The boy was holding up a crystal orb.  As his hand moved over the surface, brushing away grit and dust, a key in the Song rose which sent a shiver through Tay's entire body.  Baynarah ran over to look at Vaster's treasure, but Tay felt paralyzed.<BR>
<BR>
$93Where did you find that?$94 she gasped, gazing into the swirl beneath the crystal surface.<BR>
<BR>
$93Over in that wagon,$94 Vaster gestured toward a heap of blackened wood, barely discernible from the other piles but for its cart spokes.  Baynarah began digging into the half-collapsed structure, so only her feet could be seen.  The Song built in potency, sweeping over Tay.  He began walking toward Vaster slowly.<BR>
<BR>
$93Give me that,$94 he whispered in a voice he could barely recognize as his own.<BR>
<BR>
$93No,$94 Vaster whispered back, his eyes locked on the colors reflected in the heart of the globe.  $93It's mine.$94<BR>
<BR>
Baynarah dug through the remains of the wagon for several more minutes, but she could find no treasures like Vaster's.  Most everything within was destroyed, and what remained was common-place by any standards: broken arrows, armor shards, guar bones.  Frustrated, she pulled herself out into the sunlight.<BR>
<BR>
Tay was alone, at the edge of the great gorge.<BR>
<BR>
$93Where's Vaster?$94<BR>
<BR>
Tay blinked and then turned back to his cousin with a shrug and a grin: $93He went back to show everyone his new plunder.  Did you find anything interesting?$94<BR>
<BR>
$93Not really,$94 said Baynarah. $93We probably ought to get back home before Vaster tells them anything that'll get us in trouble.$94<BR>
<BR>
Tay and Baynarah started the walk back at a quick pace.  Tay knew that Vaster would not be there when they got back.  He would never be returning home again.  The crystal globe rested snugly in Tay's satchel, hidden under a pile of junk he had picked up.  With all his heart, he prayed for the Song to return and drown out the memory of the gorge and the long, silent fall down.  The boy had been so surprised, he hadn't even time to scream.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
毒药之颂<BR>
第一册<BR>
毕斯汀·谢尔　著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
又开始了。虽然一切看似宁静（壁炉里的余火劈里啪啦作响；年轻女仆和孩子在门边的椅子上酣睡；墙上织到一半的挂毯等着明天被完成；窗外可见其中一个月亮从乳白云朵后探出脸；孤立的鸟儿藏身在屋梁，平静地咕咕叫），泰伊却听到那首歌的第一道和弦，从远处不协调地响起。<BR>
<BR>
藏身屋梁的鸟儿粗叫几声，飞出窗外。女孩怀中的婴孩乍醒，嚎哭不已。那首歌回荡不去，不过节奏依旧隐微平缓。所有事物仿佛都随音乐的韵律而动，好像正上演着一出怪异的舞码：女孩爬上窗，云朵映射下方地狱的鲜红，她的尖叫没有声音，被那首歌吞噬了。其后的一切，泰伊看过好多次了，几乎停格脑中成为梦魇。<BR>
<BR>
来到葛尼岛之前的事，他全不记得，但他知道他的过去必定有些特殊之处，将他和堂兄弟姐妹区隔开。不是因为他父母双亡，他的堂姐蓓娜拉也在战争中失去父母；也不是其他葛尼岛上或附近哀伤之城的家族成员对他不好，他们跟因多瑞尔家族的所有人一样，待他跟其他碍手碍脚的八岁孩子没什么不同。<BR>
<BR>
不过，泰伊无比肯定，自己是孤单的。与众不同。因为他总是听到一首歌，而且还作那些恶梦。<BR>
<BR>
“你只是想象力过剩”他的姑姑乌黎雅会先耐心笑笑，然后摆摆手要他离开，以便重拾她的经文和杂事。<BR>
<BR>
“不一样？世界上每个人都觉得自己‘与众不同’，于是大家都一样变得多愁善感”泰伊的堂哥凯寇里斯如是说，他正努力学习，准备成为神殿祭司，对似是而非的悖论非常有一套。<BR>
<BR>
“如果你跟其他人说你老是在没音乐的地方听到音乐，他们会说你疯了，然后把你埋在席欧钩拉思祭坛”他的叔叔崔斐斯会先这样大吼，然后大步走开做自己的事。<BR>
<BR>
只有他的保母艾蒂芭会认真听他说话，不怎么自豪地点头，但她从不曾多言。<BR>
<BR>
堂姐蓓娜拉是泰伊主要的玩伴，也是目前为止对他的歌和恶梦最不感兴趣的人。<BR>
<BR>
“整天说这个你不烦吗，泰伊”在他八岁时的夏天，蓓娜拉说道。泰伊、蓓娜拉和他们的堂弟瓦士特走进繁花盛开的林中空地。这里的草非常短，几乎不到他们的脚踝，还有之前秋天余下的成堆发黑树叶。“我们说点别的吧，玩什么好呢？”<BR>
<BR>
泰伊想了一会儿。“我们可以玩奥辛纽姆围城”<BR>
<BR>
“那是什么？”他们的好同伴、小三岁的瓦士特问道。<BR>
<BR>
“奥辛纽姆是兽人的家，深隐沃斯加里安山脉之中，几百年下来，这个城市越来越大越来越大。时不时，兽人会下山，来到高岩劫财劫色。后来，匕首雨的爵勒王和狄亚格纳骑士团的盖登·辛吉还有来自看守者之城的某个人，我忘了名字，他们联手对付奥辛纽姆，奋力不懈地打了三十年。奥辛纽姆有铁墙守护，无论他们如何尝试，就是无法攻破入城”<BR>
<BR>
“后来呢？”蓓娜拉发问。<BR>
<BR>
“你很会凭空捏造故事，干脆就编一下嘛！”<BR>
<BR>
于是他们开始天马行空。泰伊是兽人国王，高高镇守在一棵他们称作奥辛纽姆的树上。蓓娜拉和瓦士特则扮演爵勒王和盖登·辛吉，在泰伊压低了嗓音奚落他们时，朝泰伊丢掷小石头和小树枝。他们三人决定让女神吉娜瑞斯（由蓓娜拉分饰两角）回应盖登·辛吉的祈祷，用滂沱大雨淹没奥辛纽姆，铁墙终于腐朽崩溃。就在此时，泰伊乐地从树上落地，让爵勒王和盖登·辛吉用他们的附魔刀剑将他大卸八块。<BR>
<BR>
第一纪元675年夏天的大多数时间，泰伊几乎感受不到太阳的威力。尽管万里无云，但却几乎每晚下雨，葛尼岛上的植被因此无比繁茂。石头仿佛会随阳光发亮，沟渠则长满绣线菊和荷兰芹；围绕泰伊四周是花朵的轻柔香气和不受风儿打扰的青翠树木——纯绿、蓝绿、灰绿、白绿。宽大的穹顶、弯曲的卵石街道、葛尼岛上小村庄的茅草屋顶，以及杉笛尔之屋那白色巨石，在泰伊眼中好像全撒上了魔法。<BR>
<BR>
可是无论是否清醒，盘据他夜晚的梦境还有那首歌依然持续。<BR>
<BR>
每天早上，泰伊、蓓娜拉和瓦士特都不顾乌黎雅姑姑的训诫，和仆人在户外享用早餐。乌黎雅只可能在室内吃早餐，她的显要访客也没有其他选择，不过客人来访并不频繁，因此她通常都独自一人。佣人们起初都静静用餐，维持应有的礼节，不过后来他们打破了规则，开始用闲聊、传闻、故事和谣言娱乐孩子们。<BR>
<BR>
“可怜的雅尼利又发烧了”<BR>
<BR>
“我说啊，他们被诅咒了，每个人都是。对着仙女小便，她们也会照样回敬你”<BR>
<BR>
“丝达西雅小小姐的肚子附近看起来，呃，是不是有一点点紧呀？”<BR>
<BR>
“才没呢！”<BR>
<BR>
唯一不发一语的仆人，便是泰伊的保母艾蒂芭。虽然她不像其他女仆那样漂亮，但她脸上的疤也没有让她变丑。她断过的鼻子和一头短发，让她有种异于他人的神秘。她只会在大家闲谈时静静微笑，然后以近乎吓人的爱意和忠诚看着泰伊。<BR>
<BR>
有一天吃完早餐后，蓓娜拉小声对泰伊和瓦士特说：“我们得去岛屿另一边的小山丘”<BR>
<BR>
以前她也用过这种命令口吻，而且总是让他们大开眼界：一座藏在蕨类和高耸岩石间的瀑布；一棵酷似蹲下人形的生病橡树；一面在他们想象中有千年历史的坍塌石墙，那儿是落难公主麦蕊拉（名字是他们取的）最后的避难所。<BR>
<BR>
他们三个人穿过森林，来到一片空地。前方几百码，草地陷落干涸的河床，河道上布满光滑的小石子。他们沿着河道走进黑暗的树林，每棵树都高耸入天。潮湿的灌木丛点缀着红与黄的花朵，可是随着孩子们在连绵成荫的橡树和榆树一路前进，灌木丛变得越来越少。气氛因鸟儿而活络，它们断续的合唱，唱出那首歌的小和弦。<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
“我们要去哪里？”泰伊问道。<BR>
<BR>
“重点不是我们要去哪里，而是我们会看到什么”蓓娜拉回答。<BR>
<BR>
浓密的森林团团围住三个孩子，在他们身上洒下阴暗的色调，轻送出虫鸣鸟叫和幽幽叹息。他们轻易就能想象自己其实身在怪兽体内，正沿着它弯弯曲曲的石头脊椎往前走。<BR>
<BR>
蓓娜拉爬上陡峭的山丘，从浓密的大树和灌木之间窥看。泰伊把瓦士特抬出河道，然后自己抓着柔软的草当支撑爬出来。这里没有穿过森林的路径。刺藤和低矮的树枝打在他们身上，仿佛被炼住的野兽伸出利爪。鸟鸣似乎益发响亮，好像在对有人入侵表达不满。有根树枝在瓦士特的脸颊画出一道血痕，但他没有痛喊。就连可以灵活穿梭茂密林间的蓓娜拉，也被刺藤钩住一条辫子，扯坏了之前仆人花费数小时编绑的繁复花样。她停下脚步，松开另一条辫子，让一头自有生命的秀发随意披散身后。现在的她充满野性，像个小仙女带领另外两人穿越她的森林属地。那首歌开始击出节奏，有如失控的脉搏。<BR>
<BR>
他们在一块峭壁下方的突出岩石之上，俯瞰一座极深的峡谷，凝望一大片灰烬。那看来像大型战役的场景，烈火肆虐：烧黑了的箱子、武器军备、动物骸骨，和毁损严重到无法辨认为何的碎屑散落在地。泰伊和瓦士特哑口无言地踏上黑色的土地。蓓娜拉面露微笑，对自己终于找到神秘非凡的奇景，感到无比骄傲。<BR>
<BR>
“这是什么地方？”瓦士特好不容易才能开口。<BR>
<BR>
“我不知道”蓓娜拉耸耸肩。“我本来以为是某种废墟，但是现在我觉得是垃圾堆，只不过跟以前见过的不一样。看看这些东西”<BR>
<BR>
他们三个人开始随意在灰尘满布的土石堆中翻找。蓓娜拉发现一把只有一点点熏黑的怪剑，便开始擦拭好看清楚刀刃上的刻印。瓦士特手脚并用地破坏脆弱的盒子自娱，想象自己是有超大力气的巨人。而泰伊则被一个压扁了的盾牌吸引：它跟那首歌有某种关联。他把盾牌拉出来，将表面擦干净。<BR>
<BR>
“我没看过这个徽饰”蓓娜拉从泰伊的肩上探过头。<BR>
<BR>
“我觉得我有，只是不记得了”泰伊悄声说，试图从梦中唤回记忆。他很确定他曾在梦中看过这个。<BR>
<BR>
“你们看！”瓦士特大喊，打断了泰伊的思绪。男孩高举着一颗水晶球。当他的手滑过球体表面，抹去砂砾和尘土，那首歌的一个音阶突然出现，一阵颤栗窜过泰伊全身。蓓娜拉跑去看瓦士特的宝贝，但泰伊却动弹不得。<BR>
<BR>
“你在哪里找到的？”她上气不接下气，专注凝视着水晶表层下的漩涡。<BR>
<BR>
“在那边那辆马车上”瓦士特指着一堆变黑了的木头，乍看之下跟其他废物堆没什么不同，唯有车身道出它原本的身分。蓓娜拉开始往下挖掘半塌的结构体，因此从外只能看到她的脚。那首歌的力量逐渐增强，席卷而过泰伊。他开始慢慢朝瓦士特走去。<BR>
<BR>
“把那个给我”他几乎认不出那低语的嗓音是自己的。<BR>
<BR>
“不要”瓦士特小声回道，眼睛紧盯着球体中心反射而出的色彩。“这是我的”<BR>
<BR>
蓓娜拉又继续在马车的残骸堆挖了几分钟，不过却没有瓦士特的好运。大部分的东西都已毁坏，剩下的都是普通的玩意儿：断掉的箭、盔甲残片、轧兽的骨头。她相当失望地回到阳光之下。<BR>
<BR>
泰伊一个人站在大峡谷边。<BR>
<BR>
“瓦士特呢？”<BR>
<BR>
泰伊眨眨眼，然后转身耸个肩，咧嘴一笑。“他回去跟大家炫耀他的新发现了。你有找到什么有趣的东西吗？”<BR>
<BR>
“没有”蓓娜拉说。“我们差不多该回去了，免得瓦士特说溜嘴，害我们倒楣”<BR>
<BR>

The Poison Song<BR>
Book II<BR>

Tay felt no guilt, which frightened him. A slow but steady rhythm of panic intensifying as night began to fall, and Vaster had not yet returned.  Baynarah and Tay tearfully (he was surprised how easy it was for him to cry without feeling) admitting where they had been, and leading Uncle Triffith and a crowd of servants to the junk pile and gorge. <BR>
It was thought, from their stricken expressions, that the children felt guilty enough.  They were sent to bed at dawn while the hunt through the woods continued.<BR>
<BR>
Tay was drifting to sleep when his nursemaid Edebah came into his room.  The look of unwavering love and devotion had not left her eyes, and he sank gratefully into his dreams and nightmares with her holding his hand.  The Song wafted almost imperceptibly through his consciousness as he again had the vision of the room in the castle.  The girl and her baby.  The bird in the rafters.  The dying fire.  The sudden explosion of violence.  Breathless, Tay opened his eyes.<BR>
<BR>
Edebah was stealing out the door, softly humming the Song to herself.  In her hand was the crystal globe from his satchel.  For a moment, he hesitated, about to cry out.  How did she know the Song?  Was she aware that he had murdered another boy to get the globe?<BR>
<BR>
Somehow he knew that she was helping him, that she knew all and loved him and sought only to protect him.<BR>
<BR>
The next day, and the next week, and the next month were all the same.  No one spoke very much, and when they did it was to suggest new places to look for the missing boy.  Everywhere had been searched thoroughly.  Tay was curious why they never looked in the gorge, but he understood how inaccessible it was.<BR>
<BR>
A side-effect of Vaster's absence was that the tutorial sessions with Kena Gafrisi took on a more serious, even academic quality.  The younger boy's high spirits and meager attentiveness had always cut the lessons short, but sensible Baynarah and quiet Tay were ideal pupils.  He was particularly impressed by how focused they became during a rather dry history lecture about the heraldic symbols of Houses of Morrowind.<BR>
<BR>
$93The crest of the Hlaalu features a scale,$94 he sniffed disdainfully. $93They see themselves as the great compromisers, as if that were something honorable.  Many hundreds of years ago, they were the tribesmen following Resdayn who chose--$93<BR>
<BR>
$93Pardon me, Kena,$94 asked Baynarah. $93But what is the crest with the insect on it?$94<BR>
<BR>
$93You don't know House Redoran?$94 asked the tutor, lifting up one of the shields.  $93I know you have a sheltered life on Gorne, but you're surely old enough to recognize--"<BR>
<BR>
$93Not that one, Kena,$94 replied Tay. $93I think she means the other crest with an insect.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93I see,$94 nodded Kena Gafrisi, brow furrowed. $93Yes, you would be too young to have ever seen the crest of the Sixth House, the House of Dagoth.  Our enemies together with the accursed heretical Dwemer in the War of the Red Mountain, now totally destroyed, thanks be to Lord, Mother, and Wizard. <BR>
Baynarah and Tay knew they could not speak, but they exchanged knowing glances at one another as the tutor enlarged on the theme of the great wickedness of the Dwemer and the House Dagoth.  As soon as the lesson ended, they walked silently out of Sandil House until they were far from all ears and eyes.<BR>
<BR>
The afternoon sun stretched out the shadows of the spear-like trees surrounding the meadow.  Off in the distance, they could hear the sounds of the workers beginning their preparations for the autumntide harvest, yelling to one another unintelligibly in coarse and familiar accents. <BR>
<BR>
$93That was definitely the symbol on that shield you found at the garbage heap,$94 Baynarah said at last. $93Everything there must be a remnant of the House Dagoth.$94<BR>
<BR>
Tay nodded.  His mind was on the strange crystal globe.  He felt a light vibration of soundless music touch his body, and knew he was discovering a new cadence of the Song.<BR>
<BR>
$93Why would our people have burned and discarded all that?$94 he asked thoughtfully. $93Do you think the House Dagoth was so evil that everything associated with them could have been cursed?$94<BR>
<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

When it looked in her direction, she pulled back, but she saw the face illuminated by the tallows.  It was Edebah, Tay's nursemaid.<BR>
<BR>
The next morning, Baynarah left the castle grounds early, bearing a large sack filled with her treasures.  She carried them to the dumping ground and left them there. <BR>
Edebah was banished from the isle of Gorne without discussion.  She wept, begging to be allowed to say goodbye to Tay, but all believed that would be too dangerous.  When Tay asked what had become of her, he was told she had to return to her family on the mainland.  He had grown too old for a nursemaid.<BR>
<BR>
Baynarah never told him what she knew.  For she was afraid.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
The Poison Song<BR>
Book III<BR>
By Bristin Xel<BR><BR>
