Tay was eighteen in the year 685 of the First Era when he first saw Mournhold, the city of spires, home of the goddess. His cousin Kalkorith, already a senior initiate in the Temple, gave him a couple rooms on the ground floor of the house he had purchased.  They were small and unfurnished, but bittergreen grew outside the windows, and when the wind blew, they filled his bedroom with a lovely spicy air.<BR>
<BR>
The chords of the Song did not trouble him anymore.  Sometimes he was even unconscious to it, so low and melodic it had become.  Occasionally when he was passing through the streets on the way to the Temple for his instruction, someone would pass him and the Song would rise in intensity before falling away again.  Whatever was different about those people, Tay never tried to ascertain.  He remembered the last time he had let the Song lead him, and called for him to murder his young cousin Vaster.  The memory did not trouble him unduly, but he did not want to hurt anyone again unless he had to.<BR>
<BR>
House couriers regularly brought Tay letters from Baynarah, still back in Sandil House on the island of Gorne.  She might have gone to study at the Temple, she was certainly intelligent enough, but she chose not to.  In a year or two at most, she would have to leave and assume her place in House Indoril, but she was not in a hurry.  Tay welcomed the trivial gossipy news the letters brought, and responded back with news of his own studies and romances.<BR>
<BR>
In his third month in Mournhold, he had already met a girl.  She was also a student at the Temple, and her name was Acra. Baynarah replied back merrily that if she had known how blasphemous students of the Temple were allowed to be, she might have become an initiate herself.<BR>

<BR>

<BR>

稳定强劲的狂风将小房间的火焰吹过狭小巷弄，哀伤之城的街道被那熊熊火光照得通红。那情景仿佛达格斯·乌尔本人呼啸而过城市，替他的继承人火上加油。一个正往火焰跑去的房屋卫兵，在泰伊面前停下。他犹豫不决地站在凯寇里斯门前，身体摇晃，手中握着染血的小刀。<BR>
<BR>
“先生，你做了什么？”<BR>
<BR>
泰伊往树林奔去，他的斗篷被咆哮狂风卷起，在身后不停拍打。那个卫兵紧追其后，剑已出鞘。他不需要进屋内确认是否有谋杀。他很清楚。<BR>
<BR>
泰伊在野地间跑了好几小时，那首歌催促他前进。他的追兵渐渐听不到了。终于，树木稀疏了，眼前只剩一片汪洋。百尺高的峭壁插入里海。<BR>
<BR>
那首歌阻止他，要他往北走，温柔地保证那儿会有盟友，而他终将得以休息。那些人不只是朋友，他们将拥戴他，认他为达格斯的继承者。在他慢慢靠近崖边之际，那首歌开始流露威吓，警告他不得逃避命运。死亡不是最终的解脱。<BR>
<BR>
泰伊诅咒他的家族，而后头下脚上跃下峭壁。<BR>
<BR>
那是葛尼岛上另一个美丽的好日子，几星期以来，蓓娜拉第一次感到真正愉快。崔斐斯叔叔有远道而来的重要宾客，而她被要求出席每一场餐会、每一场会议、每一场仪式。她记得小时候，曾经希望可以获得多一点注意。可是现在，能够远离她的职责简直就是天赐的福气。<BR>
<BR>
她只想做一件事，这件事必须在室内进行，就是写信给她的堂弟。但是写信可以等到晚上，她跟自己说。毕竟他已经好几天没有来信了。都是因为那个叫雅可拉的女孩。蓓娜拉倒不会看雅可拉不顺眼，她也知道初恋的威力可以多么强大。至少，她曾在书上读过。<BR>
<BR>
蓓娜拉闲散地穿过长满野花的牧草地，满腹心事的她根本没听到女仆喜莉玛的呼喊。等她转身看到年轻女仆跑上前时，扎扎实实地吓了一跳。<BR>
<BR>
“小姐”她喘着气说。“快过来！有人被冲上岸了！是你的堂弟因多瑞尔·泰伊！”<BR>

乌黎雅沉默了一下，才终于回答。“没错。战争发生时，你还是个婴孩，不知道那时的惨况。晨风省满目疮痍，就连岛上都发生过战役。还记得好多年前，你、泰伊和可怜的瓦士特发现的那堆烧毁残骸吗？那些就是战争的遗迹。战争结束后，那个该诅咒的家族终于溃败，我们看到那些无辜的孩子，这些孤儿唯一的罪过就是有邪恶的父母。我承认有些家族联军的成员，当初赞成将他们赶尽杀绝，彻底歼灭达格斯家，断了他们的血脉。不过最终怜悯之心还是占了上风，那些第六家族的孩子被其他五个家族所收养。我们以为我们同时赢得了战役和和平”<BR>
<BR>
“以神母、上主和巫师之名，如果泰伊深信的一切都是真的，就不可能和平。”蓓娜拉浑身颤抖。“他宣称他的先祖之歌召唤着他，迫使他杀害了三个人，其中两人是我们的家人，凯寇里斯和……他小时候动的手……瓦士特”<BR>
<BR>
乌黎雅用双手遮住自己泪湿的脸，无法言语。<BR>
<BR>
“这些只是开始”蓓娜拉说。“那首歌依然对他传送着信息。他说还有其他人知道事情始末，他们会帮他复兴第六家族。他妹妹……”<BR>
<BR>
“这一定是某种邪恶的幻想”乌黎雅喃喃自语。她发现蓓娜拉正盯着从码头通往大屋的小径。“侄女啊，你在想什么？”<BR>
<BR>
“那个女祭司有跟我们说她的名字吗？”<BR>
<BR>
两个女人飞快跑过小径，一边呼喊守卫。那些渔夫从没见过屋子的女主人如此失控，先是互相张望，然后立刻拿出他们的鱼钩和刀剑紧跟在后。<BR>
<BR>
杉笛尔之屋的前门大大敞开，第一具尸体躺在门口不远处。如今屋子成了屠宰场，鲜血满布。崔斐斯叔叔的贴身男仆阿耐开膛破肚，但依然坐在原本正享用着午后飞令的门厅桌旁；房务女仆莱瑞妮本来正捧着亚麻上楼，如今却断了头；守卫和仆人尸横大厅，仿佛遭吹落的树叶。在楼梯顶端，蓓娜拉看到喜莉玛，差点失声惊叫。她像个破碎的娃娃躺在那儿，她试图穿过窗户逃到外面的狭窄壁架上，却依然惨死刀下。<BR>
<BR>
蓓娜拉、乌黎雅姑姑、渔夫缓缓走过血洗大屋，所有人都默不出声。他们经过泰伊的病房，房间已被破门而入，但里面空无一人。当听到有脚步声从廊道底端蓓娜拉的房间传出来，一行人小心翼翼地慢慢靠近，满怀恐惧。<BR>
<BR>
码头上的那个女祭司站在床边，而蓓娜拉从泰伊手上拿下来的银戒此刻就在她手中。她的另一只手握着一把弯曲的长剑，连同她原本洁净的长袍，都溅上了血迹。她发现自己不再是独自一人，随即露出美丽的笑容，然后鞠躬。<BR>
<BR>
“雅可拉，泰伊在信里描述了这么多，我早该认出是你”蓓娜拉尽可能镇定地说。“我的堂弟在哪里？”<BR>
<BR>
“我比较喜欢自称达格斯·雅可拉”她回应。“你的假堂弟、我的真兄长，已经前去完成他的使命。真遗憾你不在这里，不然他就能跟你来个更永久的道别”<BR>
<BR>
蓓娜拉的脸因愤怒而扭曲。她对那些带着武器上前的渔夫示意：“杀了她”<BR>
<BR>
“第六家族会重振旗鼓，达格斯·泰伊松将是我们的领袖！”雅可拉大笑，在她使出传送术如鬼影消失无踪之际，那些字句依然在房内回荡。<BR>

The magnificent sprawl of the stronghold of Indoranyon was aglow in the light of the setting sun.  Commander Jasrat watched it slowly disappear into the horizon as he led the caravan southwestward.  It was a strange practice for him to lead a night operation, but scarcely more bizarre than anything else he was facing.  He was only seventy years of age, far from old for a Bosmer, and yet he felt like he belonged to another era.  <BR>
<BR>
He had known the land of east Vvardenfell his entire life.  Every forest, every garden, every small village between Red Mountain and the Sea of Ghosts had been home to him.  But now it was all different, twisted into a world he did not recognize since the eruption and the year of Sun's Death.  It made night travel all the more treacherous, but it was a risk he was ordered to take.<BR>
<BR>
The ashmire appeared quite suddenly.  If a sharp-sighted scout hadn't seen it and given the signal, the entire caravan might have been swallowed whole.  Jasrat cursed.  It had not been on the map, but that was hardly surprising.<BR>
<BR>
It was a huge unnamed scathe stretching as far as anyone could see.  The commander considered his options.  He might lead his party to the southeast toward Tel Aruhn and then try an approach due west.  As he consulted his map, he noticed a glimmer of a campfire in the distance.  Accompanied by his lieutenants, Jasrat drove his guar forward to investigate what appeared to be an Ashlander man and woman.<BR>
<BR>
$93This is no longer your realm,$94 he bellowed. $93Don't you know it's been ruled by the Temple that these are House lands now?$94<BR>
<BR>
The couple shuffled to their feet, and began quietly walking away, toward a narrow ridge between hill and ashmire.  Jasrat called them back.<BR>
<BR>
$93Do you know a way around the scathe?$94 he asked.  They nodded, their eyes still to the ground.  Jasrat signaled to his caravan. $93You will lead us then.$94<BR>
<BR>
It was a treacherous winding crossing, almost too tight for the guars.  The wagons themselves scraped as the drivers pulled to avoid the ashmire.  The Ashlander man and woman whispered to one another as they led the caravan.<BR>
<BR>
$93What are you mumbling about, n'wah?$94 Jasrat hollered.<BR>
<BR>
The man did not turn around. $93My sister and I were talking about the Dagoth rebellion, and she was guessing that you were bringing arms to the stronghold at Falensarano, which is why you chose to cross the ashmire rather than taking a road.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93I might have known,$94 Jasrat laughed. $93You Ashlanders are so hopeful whenever you see signs of trouble in the Houses and the Temple.  I hate to dampen your spirits, but what you're speaking of is hardly a rebellion.  Merely a few isolated incidents of... unpleasantness.  Tell your sister that.$94<BR>
<BR>
As they plodded onward, the narrow ridge began to taper even more.  The Ashlanders found a low jagged crevasse in the hills, a crack from a lava flow even predating Sun's Death.  The caravan scored the rock walls at it moved through.  Commander Jasrat, after twenty years of uncertainty in a land he did not understand, felt a twinge of his old instinct.  This, he thought to himself, would be a fine place for an ambush.<BR>
<BR>
$93Ashlander, how close are we?$94 he shouted.<BR>
<BR>
$93We've arrived,$94 Dagoth-Tython replied, and gave the signal.<BR>
<BR>
The assault was over in mere minutes, as it had been calculated from the start.  When the last body of the House guard had sunk beneath the ashmire, only then was the inventory of the caravan revealed.  It was better than they had hoped, virtually everything the rebellion needed.  Daedric swords, dozens of suits of armor, quivers of fine ebony bolts, and rations enough to last for weeks.  <BR>
<BR>
$93Go on ahead to the camp,$94 Tython smiled at his sister. $93I'll lead the caravan.  We should be there within a few hours' time.$94<BR>
<BR>
Acra kissed him passionately, and gave the sign of Recall.  In an instant, she was back in her tent, exactly as she had left it.  Humming the Song, she removed the Ashlander rags and chose an appropriately diaphanous gown from her trunks.  Precisely the sort of dress Tython would love seeing her in when he returned.<BR>
<BR>
$93Muorasa!$94 she called to her servant. $93Summon the troops together!  Tython and the others will be here very soon with all the weapons and rations we need!$94<BR>
<BR>
$93Muorasa can't hear you now,$94 said a voice Acra hadn't heard in weeks.  She turned, expertly removed every trace of surprise from her face.  It was indeed Indoril-Baynarah, but not the quivering creature she had left behind at the massacre at Sandil House.  This woman was an armored warrior, who spoke with mocking confidence. $93She wouldn't be able to summon the troops if she could.  You may have weapons and rations, Acra, but there's no one left to arm or feed.$94<BR>
<BR>
Dagoth-Acra made the sign of Recall, but nothing happened.<BR>
<BR>
$93The moment we heard you banging around in the tent, my battlemages cast a diffusion of all magicka,$94 Baynara smiled, opening the tent further to invite a dozen House soldiers in. $93You won't be leaving.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93If you think that my brother will walk into your trap, you underestimate his allegiance to the Song,$94 Acra sneered. $93It tells him everything he needs to know.  I have convinced him to no longer fight it, and let it lead him and us to our ultimate victory.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93I've known him longer and better than you ever did,$94 said Baynarah coldly. $93Now, I want to hear what the Song is saying to you.  I want to know where I can find Tay.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93Tython, my lady,$94 Acra corrected her. $93He is no longer a slave to your House and the Temple's lies.  You can torture me all you wish, but I swear to you the next time you see him, it will be because he wishes it, not you.  And that will be your very last moment alive.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93Don't you worry, serjo,$94 Baynarah's nightblade winked at her. $93Everyone says they won't break under torture, but everyone always does.$94<BR>
<BR>
Baynarah left the tent.  It was all a part of warfare, she understood that, but there would be little relish in witnessing it.  She could not even watch as the House soldiers disposed of the rebel corpses.  She had hoped she would grow numb to the bloodshed after weeks of following Tython and Acra, massacre after massacre.  It didn't matter to her that now the bodies were of her enemies.  Death was still death.<BR>
<BR>
She had only been in her tent for a few minutes when her nightblade appeared.<BR>
<BR>
$93Not so tough as she appeared, that one,$94 he grinned. $93In point of fact, all I had to do is ask her nice and point my dagger at her belly, and she was blubbering everything. Not too surprising really.  It's always the ones that talk big that crumble fast.  I remember way back a couple years ago, before you was even born -$93<BR>
<BR>
$93Garuan, what did she say?$94 Baynarah asked.<BR>
<BR>
$93The Song, whatever that is, told her brother that she got herself caught, and not to return to camp,$94 the nightblade replied, only a trifle annoyed at having his fascinating story cut short. $93He's got a half dozen mer with him, and they're going to try to assassinate the fella that led the Indoril army in the War. General Indoril-Triffith.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93Uncle Triffith,$94 Baynarah gasped. $93Where is he stationed now?$94<BR>
<BR>
$93I'm not sure myself, serjo.  Do you want me to ask if she knows?$94<BR>
<BR>
$93I'll come with you,$94 said Baynarah.  As they walked towards Acra's tent, cries of alarm sounded.  The situation became abundantly clear even before they reached the site.  Three guards were dead, and the prisoner had escaped.<BR>
<BR>
$93Interesting woman,$94 said Garuan. $93Weak heart, but a strong arm.  Should we send word of warning to General Indoril-Triffith?$94<BR>
<BR>
$93If we can find where he is in time,$94 said Baynarah<BR>

因多拉尼昂要塞的壮观建筑在夕阳照耀下镀上红光。贾思莱指挥官带领着车队往西南方前进，看着落日渐渐消失于地平线。在夜间行动不是他的一贯作风，不过比起他眼前所见，这实在没什么大不了。他才七十岁，对“波斯莫”而言还是壮年，但他却觉得自己属于另一个纪元。<BR>

By Bristin Xel<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Triffith stood on the parapets of Barysimayn and considered the volcano.  Metaphors the poets used fell rather flat in his view.  A festering wound it could be called with its blood-like lava.  The King of Ash, too, could be applied, when one looked at its perpetual crown of smoke.  And yet, none of that would do, for nothing in his experience could convey the sheer magnitude of the mountain.  Red Mountain was many miles away from the fortress, and yet it filled the horizon utterly.<BR>
<BR>
Before he could feel too small, however, he heard his name being called within.  It was some consolation that though he was insignificant compared to the mountain, he was still in possession of certain power and influence.<BR>
<BR>
$93General Indoril-Triffith,$94 said Commander Rael. $93There's trouble at the east gate.$94<BR>
<BR>
The trouble was scarcely more than a skirmish.  An Ashlander, drunk perhaps on shein, had begun a fight with the House guards at the back gate.  As they tried to drive him away, his cousins joined him, and soon there were six Ashlanders altogether brawling with a dozen of Triffith's guards.  If the n'wahs had not been well-armed, the fight could have been finished almost before it began.  As it was, by the time the General arrived with more of his guards, two of the Ashlanders were dead and the others had taken flight.<BR>
<BR>
$93It's the smoke in their brains,$94 Rael shrugged. $93Makes them mad.$94<BR>
<BR>
Triffith climbed back up the stairs and returned to his chamber to dress for dinner.  General Redoran-Vorilk and Counselor Hlaalu-Nothoc would be arriving very shortly to discuss the Temple's plans for reorganizing the House lands of Morrowind.  Mournhold was to be renamed Almalexia.  A great new city in honor of Vivec was to be built, but with whose gold? It made his head hurt.  There were so many details, a long night of argument, threats, and compromises were ahead.<BR>
<BR>
The General's mind was so occupied that he nearly put his House robes on backwards.  He also did not notice the shadowy figure steal out from behind the tapestry and close the door to the bedchamber.  It was not until Triffith heard the sound of the latch-bolt fall that he turned around.<BR>
<BR>
$93Slipped in when I was distracted by the fracas at the back gate.  Very clever, Tay,$94 he said simply. $93Or do you call yourself Dagoth-Tython these days?$94<BR>
<BR>
$93You should know all my names,$94 the young man snarled, unsheathing his sword. $93I was Tython before you butchered my family and sought to dispel my tribe.  I was Tay when you brought me into your House to poison me against my own people.  Now you may call me Vengeance.$94<BR>
<BR>
There was a knock on the door.  Tython and Triffith did not move their eyes from one another.  The knocking became a loud pounding.  $93General Indoril-Triffith, are you well?  Is there something wrong?$94<BR>
<BR>
$93If you're going to kill me, boy, you'd best do it quickly,$94 Triffith growled. $93My men will have that door down in two minutes.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93You don't tell me what to do, 'Uncle,'$94 Tython shook his head. $93I have the Song of my ancestors to instruct me.  It tells me you made my father beg for his life before you killed him, and I want to see you do the same.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93If your ancestors are all-knowing,$94 Triffith smiled. $93Why are they all dead?$94<BR>
<BR>
Tython made an inhuman noise in the back of his throat and advanced.  The door began to buckle at the pounding, but it was sturdy and secure.  The general's estimate of its life expectancy at two minutes seemed clearly erroneous. <BR>
<BR>
The pounding suddenly stopped.  A familiar voice replaced the sound.<BR>
<BR>
$93Tay,$94 called Baynarah. $93Listen to me.$94<BR>
<BR>
Tython smirked, $93You're just in time to hear your uncle beg for his miserable life, 'cousin.' I was afraid you'd be too late.  The next sound you'll hear will be the death rattle of the man who slaved my House.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93The Song is what's enslaved you, not Uncle Triffith.  You can't trust it.  It's poisoning you.  It let you be manipulated first by that mad old woman, and now by that evil witch Acra who calls herself your sister.$94<BR>
<BR>
Tython pressed the tip of his sword so it touched the general's throat.  The older man stepped backwards and Tython advanced.  His eyes followed the length of his arm to the grip of the blade.  The silver ring of Dagoth caught the red light of the volcano from the battlements outside the window.<BR>
<BR>
$93Tay, please don't hurt anyone anymore.  Please.  If you just listen to me, and not the Song just a moment, you'll know what's right.  I love you.$94 Baynarah stifled her sobs to keep her voice clear and calm.  There was a noise on the stairwell behind her.  The general's guard had finally arrived with the battering ram.  <BR>
<BR>
The door splintered and burst open in two strikes.  General Indoril-Triffith was holding his throat, staring out the window.<BR>
<BR>
$93Uncle!  Are you all right?$94 Baynara ran to him.  He nodded his head slowly, and removed his hand.  There was only the barest of scratches on his neck. $93Where's Tay?$94<BR>
<BR>
$93He jumped out the window,$94 said Triffith, pointing out into the distance where a figure was riding a guar toward the volcano. $93I thought he was going to kill himself, but he had an escape figured out.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93We'll get him, serjo general,$94 said Commander Rael, calling to the guards to get their mounts.  Baynarah watched them go, and then kissed her uncle quickly and ran out to her own guar in the courtyard.<BR>
<BR>
Sweat drenched Tay's body as he rode closer and closer toward the summit of Red Mountain.  The guar was breathing hard, trudging along even more slowly, letting out little grunts of complaint about the heat.  Finally, he abandoned his steed and began to climb the near vertical surface.  Ash blew down the face of the volcano into his eyes.  Near-blind, it was almost impossible to ignore the persistent, clamorous notes of the Song.<BR>
<BR>
A silken stream of crimson lava studded with crystalline formations surged a few feet away, close enough that Tay could feel his flesh begin to burn and blister.  He turned from it, and saw a figure emerge through the smoke.  Baynarah.<BR>
<BR>
$93What are you doing, Tay?$94 she cried over the howl of the volcano. $93Didn't I tell you not to listen to the Song?$94<BR>
<BR>
$93For the first time, the Song and I both want the same thing!$94 he yelled back. $93I can't ask you to forgive me, but please try to forget!$94<BR>
<BR>
He pulled himself higher, out of Baynarah's sight.  She screamed his name, scaling the rocks until she found she was close to the open crater.  Waves of boiling gas washed over her, and she dropped to her knees, gasping.  Through the rippling miasma, she saw Tay standing at the mouth of the volcano.  Flames erupted from his clothes and hair.  He turned to her just for a moment and smiled.<BR>
<BR>
Then he leapt.<BR>
<BR>
Baynarah was in a daze as she began the long, treacherous climb down the volcano.  She began to think of the projects ahead.  Were there enough provisions in storage at her house in Gorne for the meeting of the Houses?  The councilors were bound to stay there for weeks, maybe months.  There was much work to be done.  Slowly, as she descended, she began to forget.  It would not last, but it would be a start.<BR>
<BR>
Dagoth-Acra stood as near to the mouth of the volcano as she could stand, blinking her eyes at the ash, soaked by the heat.  She watched all, and smiled.  On the ground was the silver ring with the seal of the House Dagoth.  Tython had been sweating so much, it had slipped off.  She picked it up and put it on her own finger.  Touching her belly, she heard a new refrain of the Poison Song of Morrowind begin.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
毒药之颂<BR>
第七册<BR>
毕斯汀·谢尔　著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
崔斐斯站在拜里西麦恩的挡墙上，审视着火山。跟他眼前景象相较，诗人笔下的隐喻黯然失色。血液般的岩浆，让火山看来仿佛留着脓的伤口。也有人将之比喻为灰烬之王，那终年不歇的浓烟正是王冠。可是这些都不够到位，没有任何事物能精确呈现出这座山的纯粹壮丽。红山距堡垒有几里之遥，但却彻底占据了整个地平线。<BR>
<BR>
他还没来得及感受到自己的渺小，就先听到有人叫唤他的名字。这倒是某种安慰，尽管相较于红山，他不足为道，然而他还是掌握了一定的权势和影响力。<BR>
<BR>
“因多瑞尔·崔斐斯将军”拉尔指挥官开口。“东门出了乱子”<BR>
<BR>
那个麻烦充其量不过是场小冲突。一个灰烬人大概仙饮喝多了，在后城门跟家族守卫打了起来。大家试着把两人拉开时，灰烬人的血亲也加入混战，情势迅速变成六个灰烬人对抗六名家族守卫。要不是那些贱民持有武器，这场纷争大概还没开始就结束了。等将军带着更多人手抵达时，两个灰烬人死了，其余的早已溜之大吉。<BR>
<BR>
“都是他们脑袋里的烟”拉尔耸耸肩。“让他们疯了”<BR>
<BR>
崔斐斯爬上楼梯，返回房间为晚餐治装。瑞多然·佛力克将军和拉鲁·挪梭可议员很快就会抵达，和他一同研讨神殿对晨风省家族领地重划的计划。哀伤之城将改名为阿玛莱西娅，另外还要新建一座荣耀维威克的新城市，不过新城市该使用哪个家族的金币？崔斐斯的头都痛了。有许多细节必须考虑，今晚将异常漫长，充斥着争论、威吓和妥协。<BR>
<BR>
将军满脑子烦心事，差点把家族长袍给穿反了。他也没注意到那个从挂毯后面溜出来把通往卧房的门关上的身影。直到听闻门闩落锁的声音，崔斐斯才转过身。<BR>
<BR>
“趁我调解后城门骚乱的空档溜进来。很聪明啊，泰伊”他简洁说道。“或者该叫你达格斯·泰伊松呢？”<BR>
<BR>
“你应该对我的名字了若指掌”年轻人吼叫着抽剑出鞘。“在你残杀我家人，试图毁我家族之前，我是泰伊松。然后你带我回你家，灌输我跟自己族人对抗的毒药，我成了泰伊。现在，复仇就是我的名字”<BR>
<BR>
敲门声响起，泰伊松和崔斐斯依然四目相对。轻敲成了重捶。“因多瑞尔·崔斐斯将军，你还好吧？有什么不对吗？”<BR>
<BR>
“孩子，如果你要杀我，最好赶快下手”崔斐斯咆哮。“再两分钟，我的人就会拆了那扇门”<BR>
<BR>
“你没资格命令我，‘叔叔’”泰伊松摇着头。“我的先祖之颂会指引我。它告诉我你杀死我父亲之前，让他哀求你饶他一命，我也要你苦苦求饶”<BR>
<BR>
“如果你的祖先全知全能”崔斐斯微笑。“为什么他们全死了呢？”<BR>
<BR>
泰伊松从喉咙深处发出非人类的怒吼，猛往前冲。门开始因为猛烈的捶击而略微松动，但它依然相当坚实而牢靠。将军断言它只剩两分钟性命显然错得离谱。<BR>
<BR>
捶门声愕然中止，取而代之的是一个熟悉的嗓音。<BR>
<BR>
“泰伊”蓓娜拉唤道。“听我说”<BR>
<BR>
泰伊嘻嘻笑道：“你刚好赶上你叔叔求我饶他一命的好戏，‘堂姐’，我还怕你迟到呢。你听到的下一个声音，将会是奴役我家族之人的垂死挣扎”<BR>
<BR>
“奴役你的是那首歌，不是崔斐斯叔叔。你不能尽信它，它正在毒害你。因为它，你先被那个老女人玩弄于股掌间，现在则落入那个自称是你妹妹的邪恶巫婆雅可拉手中，随她揉捏”<BR>
<BR>
泰伊多施了些压力，如今剑尖已经抵住将军的喉咙。年长男人后退，而泰伊进逼。崔斐斯的眼神随剑身移动至紧握的手，达格斯的银戒染上窗外城墙远方的火山红光。<BR>
<BR>
“泰伊，请你别再伤害任何人了。拜托。一下下就好，请你听我而不是那首歌的话，你就会知道孰是孰非。我爱你”蓓娜拉忍住呜咽，让声音平稳又清晰。她身后的楼梯井传来声响，将军的卫兵终于带着破城槌抵达。<BR>
<BR>
房门裂成两半。因多瑞尔·崔斐斯将军手遮喉咙，看着窗外。<BR>
<BR>
“叔叔！你还好吗？”蓓娜拉跑过去。他缓缓点头，移开他的手。他的脖子上仅有极轻微的刮伤。“泰伊呢？”<BR>
<BR>
“他跳出窗户跑了。”崔斐斯说，指着远方一个骑着轧兽往火山而去的身影。“我以为他要自杀，结果他居然逃了”<BR>
<BR>
“我们会抓到他，将军大人”拉尔指挥官说道，下令要卫兵登上座骑。蓓娜拉目送他们离去，很快啄吻了叔叔，然后跑向中庭骑上她的轧兽。<BR>
<BR>
泰伊越来越靠近红山的山峰，大汗淋漓。轧兽呼吸沉重，跋涉的脚步变得缓慢，不时发出抱怨高温的小小哼声。终于，他舍弃了座骑，开始往上攀爬。灰烬刮过火山表面，吹进他的双眼。在视力几乎全失的状况下，要忽视那首歌持续不断的高昂乐音简直不可能。<BR>
<BR>
散布着结晶体的柔滑深红岩浆从几尺外涌出，近得泰伊可以感觉到他的血肉开始烧灼起水泡。他转个方向，看到烟雾中浮现一个身影。是蓓娜拉。<BR>
<BR>
“你在做什么，泰伊？”她扯开喉咙，压过火山的怒吼。“我不是叫你别听那首歌吗？”<BR>
<BR>
“这是第一次，那首歌和我的目标一致！”他喊回去。“我无法要你原谅我，那么就忘了我吧！”<BR>
<BR>
他爬得更高，超出了蓓娜拉的视线。她叫着他的名字，攀爬着岩石，直到她发现自己位在开阔的火山口附近。一阵又一阵的滚烫气体冲刷过她的身躯，她不禁跪下喘息。一波波的沼气之中，她看到泰伊站在火山口，火舌从他的衣服和头发奔窜而出。他转向她，露出笑容。<BR>
<BR>
然后回头一跃而下。<BR>
<BR>
蓓娜拉爬下火山，在这段漫长又危险的路途中，她陷入恍惚状态。她开始想起眼前该做的事。她在葛尼岛上的家中，有足够的食物库存供给家族会议的与会来宾吗？那些议员有可能会被迫待在岛上几星期，甚至几个月。有好多事情要准备。在下山的路上，慢慢的，她开始遗忘。她不可能永远忘记，但起码是个开始。<BR>
<BR>
达格斯·雅可拉尽可能地靠近火山口，站在那儿眨着眼睛抵抗灰烬，沐浴在热气之中。她四下张望，然后露出微笑。有着达格斯家族封印的银色戒指躺在地上。泰伊松留了太多汗让戒指滑落了。她捡起戒指戴上。她抚着肚子，她听到晨风毒颂再次响起新的乐音。<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
CONFESSIONS OF A DUNMER SKOOMA-EATER<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Nothing is more revolting to Dunmer feeling than the sorry spectacle of another Dunmer enslaved by that derivative moon-sugar known as 'skooma.' And nothing is less appetising than listening to the pathetic tales of humiliation and degradation associated with a victim of this addictive drug.<BR>
<BR>
Why, then, do I force myself upon you with this extended and detailed account of my sins and sorrows?<BR>
<BR>
Because I hope that by telling my tale, the hope of redemption from this sorry state shall be more widely known. And because I hope that others who have also fallen into the sorry state of skooma addiction may therefore hear of my story, of how I fell into despair, and how I once again found myself and freed myself from my own self-imposed chains.<BR>
<BR>
Because it is widely known to all Khajiit, who may be expected to know, that there is no cure for addiction to skooma, that once a slave to skooma, always a slave to skooma. Because this is widely known, it is taken to be true. But it is not true, and I am living proof.<BR>
<BR>
There is no miracle cure. There is no potion to be taken. There is no magical incantation which frees you from the thrill of skooma running through your blood.<BR>
<BR>
But it is through the understanding of that thrill, and the acceptance of the lust within oneself for that thrill, and the casting aside of the shame that the thrillseeker feels when he cannot set aside what becomes in the end his only comfort and pleasure, it is through this knowledge and understanding that the victim comes to the place where choices may be made, where despair and hope may be separated.<BR>
<BR>
In short, only knowledge and acceptance can deliver into the slave's hands the key that opens his shackles and sets him free.<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
[The narrative of Tilse Sendas' tale carries the reader through the stages of early infatuation, ecstatic obsession, and profound degradation of her addiction, and in the course of the story she subtly enables the reader to discover that the hopelessness of the addict comes from the addict's own unconscious assumption that only a helpless and foolish person could become addicted to skooma, and that, consequently, no such helpless and foolish person could ever achieve the admittedly difficult task of renouncing, once tasted, the exquisite delights of the skooma. Tilse Sendas shows that once the addict overcomes the burden of her own self-despising, that there is the possibility of redemption. And, against all of society's dearly held beliefs, she says that it is not altogether clear that the addict SHOULD renounce the sugar, but that it is only one of the choices that the skooma addict must make. Tilse Sendas' casual proposition that skooma addiction is not necessarily a sign of moral and personal weakness is essential to her thesis that a cure is possible, but it has not endeared her or her book to the upright and conservative elements of Dunmer society.]<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
一个丹莫斯库玛食用者的自白<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
对丹莫而言，见到另一个丹莫受制于“斯库玛”这种月亮糖精炼而出的毒品而与奴隶无异，是最让人作呕的了。这种成瘾毒药的受害者堕落、尊严尽失，听闻种种跟他们有关的可悲故事，实在叫人难以下咽。<BR>
<BR>
那么，我为什么要强迫自己当着你们的面，巨细靡遗地娓娓道出我的罪孽和遗憾呢？<BR>
<BR>
因为我希望藉由我的故事，能让更多人知晓从这种可悲状态获得救赎而产生的希望。我由衷希望其他也陷入斯库玛毒瘾惨况的人能因此而听到我的故事，听到我曾如何绝望，以及我如何重新找回自我，从自找的束缚中获得释放。<BR>
<BR>
因为卡吉特全都知道只要对斯库玛上瘾，一日为斯库玛之奴，终生为斯库玛之奴。因为这道理尽为人知，所有人因而深信不疑。但那不是不变的真理，我就是活生生的证明。<BR>
<BR>
奇迹的解药是不存在的，这种瘾头无药可医，也没有魔咒能让你脱离奔流血液之中的斯库玛兴奋感。<BR>
<BR>
战胜斯库玛的关键，是要了解那种兴奋感，并接受自己对它的渴望，而且要屏除瘾头发作时所感觉到的羞耻感，那种羞耻感通常源于自己终究屈服于追求自身的舒适安逸。唯有通过这样的认知和理解，受害者才有机会拿回决定的主导权，解开绝望和希望相互纠缠的结。<BR>
<BR>
简言之，只有认识和接受斯库玛，屈服其下的奴隶才有机会拿到钥匙，解开手脚铁铐，重获自由。<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
[蒂尔丝·森达斯的故事叙述带领读者经历了早期的迷恋、狂喜的痴迷和她的毒瘾的深度退化，在故事的过程中她巧妙地让读者发现，瘾君子的绝望来自于上瘾者自己无意识地假设只有一个无助和愚蠢的人才能对斯库玛上瘾，因此，类似这样无助和愚蠢的人没有一个能够完成这项公认的艰巨任务，一旦尝到了斯库玛的精致乐趣，那些人就放弃了。蒂尔斯·森达斯表明，一旦上瘾者克服了自卑的重担，就有救赎的可能。而且，与社会所有深信不疑的信念相反，她说上瘾者是否应该放弃月亮糖还有待讨论，但这只是斯库玛上瘾者必须做出的选择之一。蒂尔斯·森达斯主张，斯库玛成瘾不一定代表着道德和个人弱点，这对她关于治愈是可能的论点至关重要，但它并没有使她或她的书受到丹莫社会正直和保守人士的欣赏。]<BR>

the meat of one mudcrab (two portions)<BR>
1 handful of chopped bittergreen<BR>
<BR>
Beat eggs, wickwheat, and scuttle in a large bowl. Slowly stir in crabmeat and bittergreen. Bake covered in a hot over for one half hour to one hour (when a knife comes out clean).<BR>
<BR>
The Hound and Rat<BR>
<BR>
1 pie crust<BR>
1 pound of ground meat (mixed rat and hound)<BR>
a hand and a half of cooked saltrice<BR>
1 handful of scuttle<BR>
1 small kwama egg<BR>
a pinch of ash salts<BR>
<BR>
Cook the mixed meat in a pan over an open flame. When the meat begins to brown, add the saltrice. Stir for a few moments and add the scuttle and kwama egg. When the kwama egg is fully cooked and the scuttle has melted, pour from the pan into the pie crust. Sprinkle with ash salts and cover the pie crust. Bake for one quarter hour in a hot oven.<BR>
<BR>

> BOOK.FNAM bk_guide_to_vvardenfell
Guide to Vvardenfell
《瓦登费尔指南》

> BOOK.TEXT bk_guide_to_vvardenfell
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
GUIDE TO VVARDENFELL<BR>
<IMG SRC="RedMountain_377_253.tga" WIDTH="377" HEIGHT="253"><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Morrowind is the northeastmost province of the Tamrielic Empire, bounded on the north and east by the Sea of Ghosts, on the west by Skyrim, on the southwest by Cyrodiil (also known as the Imperial Province), and on the south by Black Marsh (also known as Argonia). Vvardenfell District encompasses Vvardefell Island, a great land mass dominated by the giant volcano Red Mountain and cut off from mainland Morrowind by the surrounding Inner Sea.<BR>
<BR>
Only recently open to settlement and trade, most of the island's population is confined to the relatively hospitable west and southwest coast, centered on the ancient city of Vivec and the old Great House district centers at Balmora, Ald'ruhn, and Sadrith Mora. The rest of the island is covered by hostile desert wastes, arid grasslands, and volcanic badlands, and thinly populated by the nomadic Ashlander tribes.<BR>
<BR>
Vvardenfell has nine basic geographic regions, each with their own distinctive plants and terrain features. Scholars have based their classifications on the different types of land described by the native Ashlanders, so the designations are recognized by most local traders, travelers, and adventurers. These geographic regions are called: the Ascadian Isles, the Ashlands, Azura's Coast, the Bitter Coast, the Grazelands, Molag Amur, Red Mountain, the West Gash, and Sheogorad.<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
ASCADIAN ISLES<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
The Ascadian Isles is a region of lush, green, well-watered southern lowlands where most of Vvardenfell's agriculture is found. The area includes Pelagiad, Suran, Vivec City, and Ald Sotha along with the inland lakes and waterways of the Ascadian Isles proper. The urban areas of Vivec and Ebonheart of the southern coast are densely populated; the inland Ascadian Isles are dotted with small farms and large plantations. The climate is temperate and comfortable, with moderate rainfall.<BR>
<BR>
Ebonheart is the seat of the Imperial government for Vvardenfell district, and a busy center of maritime trade. Castle Ebonheart is the home of Duke Vedam Dren, the district's ruler and Emperor's representative. Also located at Castle Ebonheart are the Vvardenfell District Council chambers and the Hawk Moth Legion garrison. The officers, docks, and warehouses of the East Empire Company are also found in Ebonheart.<BR>
<BR>
Vivec City is the largest settlement on Vvardenfell, and one of the largest cities in the East. Each of the great cantons is the size of a complete town. The High Fane and the palace of Vivec are visited by hundreds of tourists and pilgrims daily. Citizens flock to the Arena for entertainments and war games. Outlanders mostly confine themselves to the Foreign Canton, while natives live, work, and shop in the Great House compounds and residential cantons.<BR>
<BR>
Ald Sotha is a splendid Daedric ruin within sight of Vivec City. Though exotic and picturesque, it is a dangerous site, haunted by old magics, dark cultists, and their Daedric summonings, and not recommended for sightseers.<BR>
<BR>
Suran is an agricultural village in the northeastern corner of the fertile Ascadian Isles region. Two popular pilgrimage sites are nearby -- the Fields of Kummu and the Shrine of Molag Bal.<BR>
<BR>
Pelagiad is a newly chartered Imperial village between Balmora and Vivec City on the western edge of the Ascadian Isles region. The village is right outside the Imperial Legion garrison at Fort Pelagiad. The houses and shops are built in the Western Imperial style, and Pelagiad looks more like a village in the western Empire than a Morrowind settlement.<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
THE ASHLANDS<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
The Ashlands are the dry, inhospitable wastelands surrounding the lower slopes of Red Mountain. The Ashlands extend to the Sea of Ghosts in the north, and elsewhere form a wide margin between the blighted Red Mountain region and other geographic regions. The village of Maar Gan is the only sizable permanent Ashlands settlement; Ald'ruhn, the district seat of House Redoran, is on the margin of the region. Ashlanders hunt for game here, and their herds find sparse grazing. It rains rarely, and suffers frequent ash storms.<BR>
<BR>
Maar Gan is a small isolated village in a remote region north of Ald'ruhn. The Maar Gan shrine is an important Temple pilgrimage site.<BR>
<BR>
The Ashlander Urshilaku tribe has a permanent settlement at Urshilaku camp in the Ashlands region north of Maar Gan village.<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
AZURA'S COAST<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
The rugged coast and islands of northern and eastern Vvardenfell are called Azura's Coast. The region is rocky, infertile, and largely uninhabited, except for the outpost at Molag Mar, the Telvanni settlements at Sadrith Mora, the wizard towers at Tel Aruhn, Tel Mora, and Tel Branora, and Ahemmusa camp and the remote fishing villages of Ald Redaynia and Dagon Fel on the north coast. There are no roads; most travel is by boat. Despite the rocky terrain, a variety of plants thrive on the regular rainfall.<BR>
<BR>
Sadrith Mora is the district seat of House Telvanni, and home of the Telvanni Council, though only one Telvanni councilor actually lives in Sadrith Mora. Sadrith Mora is an island settlement, and accessible only by sea and teleportation. The town is large, with many services, but it is open only to Telvanni retainers; outsiders must confine themselves to the Gateway Inn.<BR>
<BR>
Tel Branora is the tower and seat of the eccentric Telvanni wizard named Mistress Therana. The tower and its tiny village are located on a rocky promontory at the southeasternmost tip of Azura's Coast.<BR>
<BR>
Tel Fyr is the Telvanni tower of Sorcerer-Lord Divayth Fyr. Beneath the tower is the Corprusarium, a refuge-prison where the deranged, distorted victims of the deadly corprus disease are housed and tended.<BR>
<BR>
Tel Aruhn is the Telvanni tower of Archmagister Gothren, Telvanni Sorcerer-Lord and head of the Telvanni Council. The associated settlement is a sizable village, and the site of the Festival Slave Market, the largest slave market on Vvardenfell.<BR>
<BR>
Tel Mora is the Telvanni tower of Mistress Dratha, an ancient wizard of the Telvanni Council. The small settlement includes a few craftsfolk and a tradehouse.<BR>
<BR>
Tel Vos is the tower of Telvanni wizard and council member Master Aryon. Tel Vos is a peculiar blend of Telvanni and Western architectural styles, and is close to Vos village.<BR>
<BR>
Bal Fell is the "City of Stone," an ancient First Era ruin in the southeastern islands and promontories of Azura's Coast. The site has a nasty reputation, and several Telvanni wizards currently have competing camps of hirelings and adventurers exploring and looting there. Legend says that Bal Fell was built on the site of an ancient Daedric worship center.<BR>
<BR>
The Ashlander Ahemmusa tribe has a permanent settlement at Ahemmusa camp on a rocky promontory at the northeastern tip of the Vvardenfell mainland in the Azura's Coast region.<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
THE BITTER COAST<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
The western coast of Vvardenfell from Seyda Neen north to Gnaar Mok is called the Bitter Coast. The salt marshes and humid swamps of this region are uninhabited, with the only settlements found at the good harbors of Gnaar Mok, Hla Oad, and Seyda Neen. Also called the Smuggler's Coast, the region's secluded coves and islands provide refuge for criminal trade, and the frequent rain and fog hides small boats from Excise cutters.<BR>
<BR>
The piercing light of the Grand Pharos at the mouth of the harbor of the port village of Seyda Neen is a beacon to mariners throughout the Inner Sea. Most visitors from the Empire make landfall at the port of Seyda Neen, where they are processed by the Imperial Census and Excise Commission agents of the Coastguard station. The Coastguard cutters docked here control smuggling and piracy on the Inner Sea.<BR>
<BR>
Hla Oad is a tiny isolated fishing village on western Vvardenfell in the Bitter Coast region. A rough track along the River Odai connects Hla Oad with the town of Balmora.<BR>
<BR>
Gnaar Mok is a tiny island fishing village in the Bitter Coast region of western Vvardenfell.<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
THE GRAZELANDS<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
The regular rain and dark soils of the Grazelands produce the rich grazing for Ashlander herds that give the region its name. The region lies in the northeast of Vvardenfell, sandwiched between the Ashlands and Azura's Coast. Permanent settlements include Vos village and the towers of Tel Vos and Tel Fyr. The Ashlanders of Zainab camp move their herds across the plains in search of fresh grazing. There are no roads or tracks, but travel is easy across the open plains.<BR>
<BR>
The Ashlander Zainab tribe has a permanent settlement at Zainab camp, near the village of Vos in the Grazelands region.<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
MOLAG AMUR<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
Located inland in the southeast of Vvardenfell, Molag Amur is an uninhabited wasteland of rocky hills, steep-sided ravines, lava pools, and barren ash pavements. Pathfinding and travel is extremely difficult in this trackless wilderness, and is complicated by frequent ash storms. The Ashlanders of Erabenimsun camp hunt game here, but few others venture into this region. The worst part of Molag Amur, called the Great Scathes, is considered impassible even by the Ashlanders.<BR>
<BR>
The outpost at Molag Mar is a fortified stronghold on the southeastern edge of the desolate Molag Amur region. Pilgrims bound for the nearby pilgrimage sites at Mount Assarnibibi and Mount Kand take refuge at the outpost's hostels, comforted by the garrison of Redoran and Buoyant Armiger crusaders stationed at the stronghold.<BR>
<BR>
The Ashlander Erabenimsun tribe has a permanent settlement at Erabenimsun camp, an isolated hut settlement in the middle of the desolate Molag Amur region.<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
RED MOUNTAIN<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
The dominant feature of Vvardenfell, Red Mountain, is a vast volcano in the center of Vvardenfell. The outer slopes are steep and rugged, and the crater is deep and dotted with surface lava. The Ghostfence, a magical barrier which blocks travel as well as seals in the harmful, disease-laden weather called 'blight,' rings the volcano's outer slopes, and is broken only at Ghostgate. Within the Ghostfence, rain never falls and the sun never shines; the only weather is the red and deadly ash-blight.<BR>
<BR>
Ghostgate is the gate citadel of the Ghostfence Ordinator and Buoyant Armiger garrisons. Ghostgate sits astride the only gap through which the monstrous hosts of Dagoth Ur might emerge from Red Mountain to threaten the rest of Morrowind. The Ghostfence itself is a colossal magical artifact that completely encircles Red Mountain and prevents the Blight from spilling its corruption across the rest of Vvardenfell.<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
WEST GASH<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
The western highlands of Vvardefell are called the West Gash. The region extends from the Sea of Ghosts on the northwest coast to the inland town of Balmora, where the region is sandwiched between the Bitter Coast and the Ashlands. The trading village of Gnisis is north of Ald'ruhn, and the fishing villages of Ald Veloth and Khuul lie on the north coast. The town of Caldera lies near Balmora. The herds of the Ashlanders of Urshilaku camp graze on the sparse but hardy highland vegetation.<BR>
<BR>
Balmora is the district seat of House Hlaalu, and the largest settlement on Vvardenfell after Vivec City. Good roads lead north to Ald'ruhn and south to Caldera, Seyda Neen, and Vivec City. The Imperial Legion garrison of Fort Moonmoth lies south of Balmora.<BR>
<BR>
Caldera is a recently chartered Imperial town and mining corporation. The Caldera Mining Company has been granted an Imperial monopoly to remove raw ebony from the rich deposits here. Caldera has the appearance and flavor of a Western Imperial town.<BR>
<BR>
Ald'ruhn is the district seat of House Redoran, and a large settlement. The Redoran Council chambers are located inside the shell of an ancient extinct giant crab. Tracks lead north to Maar Gan and Gnisis villages and south to Balmora.<BR>
<BR>
Gnisis is a small mining and trade village astride the silt strider caravan route between the northwest West Gash and Ald'ruhn.<BR>
<BR>
Ald Velothi and Khuul are tiny fishing villages on the northern coast of the West Gash.<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
SHEOGORAD<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
The large island of Sheogorad lies north of Vvardenfell. This island and its associated lesser islands are a maritime wilderness extending north from Vvardenfell into the Sea of Ghosts. The region is largely hostile and uninhabited, with two small villages at Ald Redaynia and Dagon Fel. Only Dagon Fel is reached by ship services; all other island-to-island transport must be provided by the traveler.<BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
瓦登费尔指南<BR>
<IMG SRC="RedMountain_377_253.tga" WIDTH="377" HEIGHT="253"><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
晨风是泰姆瑞尔帝国的东北部省份，其北部和东部被幽魂之海包围，西面挨着天际省，西南面则是西罗帝尔（也被称为帝国省），南面紧邻黑沼泽（也被称为阿尔贡尼亚）。瓦登费尔地区的主体是瓦登费尔岛，这是一片被巨大的火山“红山”所主导的大片陆地，其周围的内海使其与晨风大陆隔绝。<BR>
<BR>
直到最近，瓦登费尔才对移民和外来贸易开放，岛上的大多数人口都局限在相对适宜居住的西部和西南部海岸，主要集中在古城维威克以及传统大家族的势力中心，巴尔莫拉、奥德-汝因，以及萨德里斯-莫拉。岛上的其他地方被充满敌意的荒漠废土、干旱的草原和火山荒原所覆盖，居住着稀疏的灰烬之民游牧部落。<BR>
<BR>
瓦登费尔有九个基本地理区域，每个区域都有自己独特的植被和地形特征。学者们根据当地灰烬之民所描述的不同类型的对这些地方进行分类，因此大多数当地商人、旅行者和冒险家都认可这些名称。这些地理区域被称为：阿斯卡迪安群岛、灰烬之地、阿祖拉海岸、苦涩海岸、放牧平原、莫拉格-阿穆尔、红山、西境之痕和谢尔格拉德。<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
阿斯卡迪安群岛<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
阿斯卡迪安群岛是一片郁郁葱葱、绿油油、水源充足的南部低地，瓦登费尔的大部分农业都在这里。该地区包括佩拉吉亚德、苏兰、维威克城、奥德-索萨以及阿斯卡迪安群岛的内湖和水道。南部海岸的维威克城和黑檀心人口密集；群岛中部点缀着小农场和大种植园。气候温和舒适，雨量适中。<BR>
<BR>
黑檀心是瓦登费尔地区帝国政府的所在地，也是繁忙的海上贸易中心。黑檀心特城堡是维达姆·德伦公爵的家，他是该地区的统治者和皇帝的代表。同样位于黑檀心城堡的还有瓦登费尔区议会会议厅和鹰蛾军团军团驻军。东帝国公司的官员、码头和仓库也在黑檀心。<BR>
<BR>
维威克城是瓦登费尔上最大的定居点，也是东部最大的城市之一。每个大区的面积都相当于一个完整的城镇。每天都有数百名游客和朝圣者来参观至高神殿和维威克宫。市民们涌向竞技场，观看角斗和戏剧等公共娱乐节目。外乡人大多居住在外埠，而当地人则在大宅院和居民区中居住、工作和交易。<BR>
<BR>
奥德-索萨是一座壮丽的迪德拉遗迹，在维威克城的视线范围内。虽然充满异国情调，风景如画，但这是一个危险的地方，充满了古老的魔法，黑暗的信徒和他们召唤的迪德拉。因此，此地不推荐给观光客。<BR>
<BR>
苏兰是一个农业村，位于富饶的阿斯卡迪安群岛地区的东北角。附近有两个著名的朝圣地——库姆原野和莫拉格·巴尔的圣地。<BR>
<BR>
佩拉吉亚德是一座新特许的帝国村庄，位于巴尔莫拉和维威克城之间，位于阿斯卡迪安群岛地区的西部边缘。这个村庄就在帝国军团驻守的佩拉吉亚德堡外。房子和商店都是按照西方帝国的风格建造的，这使得佩拉吉亚德看起来更像是一个帝国的村庄，而不是一个晨风的定居点。<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
灰烬之地<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
灰烬之地是环绕在红山较低处山坡的干燥、不适宜居住的荒地。灰烬之地的山脉向北部延伸至幽魂之海，其他地方在枯萎的红山地区和其他地理区域之间形成了广阔的边界。马尔-甘村是灰烬之地唯一一个规模可观的永久性定居点；瑞多然众议院的所在地奥德-汝因位于该地区的边缘。灰烬之民在这里狩猎，他们的牧群在这里寻找着稀疏的牧场。该地区很少下雨，经常遭受火山灰风暴。<BR>
<BR>
马尔-甘是位于奥德-汝因北部偏远地区的一个与世隔绝的小村庄。马尔-甘祠是一个重要的神殿朝圣地。<BR>
<BR>
灰烬之民的乌尔希拉库部落在马尔-甘村北部灰烬之地的乌尔希拉库营地有一个永久的定居点。<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
阿祖拉海岸<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
瓦登费尔北部和东部崎岖的海岸及岛屿地区被称为阿祖拉海岸。这一地区多岩石，贫瘠，基本上无人居住，除了莫拉格-玛尔的前哨站、萨德里斯-莫拉的泰瓦尼定居点、泰尔-阿汝因的巫师塔、泰尔-莫拉和泰尔-布勒诺拉、阿希穆萨营地和北部海岸偏远的奥德-瑞达尼亚和大衮-费尔的渔村。此地没有道路，大多数旅行是靠船运。尽管多岩石地形，各种各样的植物还是在有规律的降雨中茁壮成长。<BR>
<BR>
萨德里斯-莫拉是泰瓦尼家族的选区，也是泰瓦尼议会的所在地，尽管实际上只有一位泰瓦尼议员住在萨德里斯-莫拉。萨德里斯-莫拉是一个岛屿定居点，只有通过海上运输和传送魔法才能到达。小镇很大，有很多服务设施，但只对泰瓦尼人开放。外来客必须把自己关在大门客栈里。<BR>
<BR>
泰尔-布勒诺拉是古怪的泰瓦尼巫师西拉娜女士的塔的所在。塔和小村庄坐落在阿祖拉海岸最东南端的岩石海角上。<BR>
<BR>
泰尔-菲尔是术士领主迪维斯·菲尔的泰瓦尼塔。塔下是尸化病疗养院，这是一座难民监狱，在这里，致命尸化病的精神错乱、扭曲的受害者得到了收容和照料。<BR>
<BR>
泰尔-阿汝因是大导师戈瑟伦的泰瓦尼塔，他是泰瓦尼术士领主，也是泰瓦尼家族议会的首领。相关的定居点是一个相当大的村庄，也是节庆奴隶市场的所在地，此地是瓦登费尔最大的奴隶市场。<BR>
<BR>
泰尔-莫拉是德拉萨女士的泰瓦尼塔，她是泰瓦尼议会的一位古老的巫师，这个小定居点包括几名工匠和一处贸易行。<BR>
<BR>
泰尔-沃斯塔是泰瓦尼巫师和议会成员阿里昂大师的塔。泰尔-沃斯是泰瓦尼风格和西方建筑风格融合的独特产物，紧靠泰尔-沃斯村。<BR>
<BR>
巴尔-费尔又称“石头之城”，是东南部岛屿和阿祖拉海岸海角上的一处第一纪元的遗迹。这个地方名声很差，现在一些泰瓦尼巫师及其雇佣兵和冒险家们争相进驻此地，他们在此进行探险和劫掠。传说巴尔-费尔是建立在一个古老的迪德拉崇拜中心的遗址上。<BR>
<BR>
阿希穆萨部族的灰烬之民在阿希穆萨营地有一个永久的定居点，这个营地位于阿祖拉海岸地区，也就是瓦登费尔大陆东北端一个多岩石的海角上。<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
苦涩海岸<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
瓦登费尔的西海岸从赛达-尼恩北部到纳尔-莫克被称为苦涩海岸。这一地区的盐碱地和潮湿沼泽无人居住，只有在纳尔-莫克、哈拉-奥德和赛达-尼恩的良港存在定居点。该地区偏僻的海湾和岛屿为走私贸易提供了庇护所，频繁的雨雾使得走私贩的小船很难被执法者发现，因而此地也被称为走私者海岸。<BR>
<BR>
在赛达-尼恩的港口入口处，大法罗斯灯塔的刺眼光芒整个内海水手都能看到。大多数来自帝国的游客都在赛达-尼恩港登陆，相关事务由帝国人口普查及税务委员会的海岸警卫队站特工处理。海岸警卫队的船停靠在这里，控制内海的走私和海盗活动。<BR>
<BR>
位于寒冷海岸地区的哈拉-奥德是瓦登费尔西部的一个偏僻的小渔村。奥代河上有一条崎岖的小道连接着哈拉-奥德和巴尔莫拉。<BR>
<BR>
纳尔-莫克是瓦登费尔西部沿海地区的一个小岛渔村。<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
放牧平原<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
放牧平原定期的降雨和肥沃的土地为灰烬之民的牧群提供了丰富的牧草，该地区也因此得名。该地区位于瓦登费尔的东北部，夹在灰烬之地和阿祖拉海岸之间。永久的定居点包括沃斯村和泰尔-沃斯塔和泰尔-菲尔塔。哉纳布营地的灰烬之民把牧群赶过平原，寻找新鲜的牧草。这里没有道路和驿道，但是穿越开阔的平原还是很容易的。<BR>
<BR>
哉纳布部落的灰烬之民在哉纳布营地有一个永久的定居点，靠近放牧平原地区的沃斯村。<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
莫拉格-阿穆尔<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
莫拉格-阿穆尔位于瓦登费尔东南部的内陆，是一片无人居住的荒原，此地多岩石山丘、陡峭的峡谷、熔岩池和火山灰覆盖的贫瘠之地。在这片荒原之中，寻路和旅行极其困难，而且频繁的火山灰风暴使情况变得复杂。埃勒比尼姆孙营地的灰烬之民在这里狩猎，但很少有人冒险深入这个地区。莫拉格-阿穆尔最糟糕的地方被称为“大裂痕”，甚至在灰烬之民看来那里也是不可能通行的地方。<BR>
<BR>
莫拉格-玛尔的前哨是一个坚固的据点，位于在荒凉的莫拉格-阿穆尔地区的东南部边缘。前往附近阿萨尼比比山和坎德山圣地的朝圣者，会在哨所的旅舍里避难，他们得到了瑞多然守军和驻扎在要塞的灵动扈从的圣战者的保护。<BR>
<BR>
埃勒比尼姆孙部落的灰烬之民在埃勒比尼姆孙营地有一个永久的定居点，这是一个孤立的棚屋定居点，位于荒凉的莫拉格-阿穆尔地区的中部。<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
红山<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
瓦丹登费尔火山的主要代表就是红山，它是瓦登费尔中心的一座巨大火山。外部斜坡陡峭而崎岖，火山口很深，表面点缀着熔岩。鬼魂之墙是一道神奇的屏障，它不仅阻挡了旅行者，也将那被称为“枯萎病”的有害、致疾的天气封印于其内。它环绕着火山的外部斜坡，只有在鬼魂之门才能进入。在鬼魂之墙之内，雨永远不会落下，太阳永远不会照耀。唯一的天气就是红色和致命的枯萎病。<BR>
<BR>
鬼魂之门是鬼魂之墙神殿卫兵和灵动扈从驻军的大本营。鬼魂之门坐落在该地唯一的隘口上，通过这个隘口，达格斯·乌尔的怪物大军可能会从红山冒出来，威胁到晨风的其余地区。鬼魂之墙本身是一个巨大的魔法制品，完全环绕着红山，防止枯萎病将它的腐败蔓延到瓦登费尔的其他地方。<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
西境之痕<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
瓦登费尔西部高地被称为“西境之痕”。该地区从西北海岸的幽魂之海延伸到内陆的巴尔莫拉，该地区夹在苦涩海岸和灰烬之地之间。尼希斯贸易村位于奥德-汝因北部，奥德-维洛提和库尔渔村位于北部海岸。卡尔德拉镇位于巴尔莫拉附近。乌尔希拉库营地的灰烬之民在稀疏但顽强的高原植被上放牧。<BR>
<BR>
巴尔莫拉是哈拉鲁家族的所在地，是瓦登费尔上仅次于维威克城的第二大定居点。良好的道路向北通向卡尔德拉和奥德-汝因，向南通向赛达-尼恩和维威克城。鹰蛾军团堡的帝国军团驻军位于巴尔莫拉南部。<BR>
<BR>
卡尔德拉是最近特许成立的皇家矿业公司。卡尔德拉矿业公司被帝国授予垄断权，可以从这里丰富的矿藏中开采黑檀岩矿。卡尔德拉具有西方帝国城镇的外观和风味。<BR>
<BR>
奥德-汝因是瑞多然家族的选区所在地，也是一个大型定居点。瑞多然议会大厅位于一种已灭绝的古代巨蟹的壳内。驿道向北通往马尔-甘和尼希斯村，向南通往巴尔莫拉。<BR>
<BR>
尼希斯是一个小型的矿业和贸易村，横跨西境之痕西北和奥德-汝因之间的淤泥阔步沙蚤路线。<BR>
<BR>
奥德-维洛提和库尔是西境之痕北部海岸的小渔村。<BR>
<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><BR>
谢尔格拉德<BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR>
<BR>
谢尔格拉德大岛位于瓦登费尔北部。这个岛及其附属的较小岛屿是一片海洋中的荒野，它们从瓦登费尔岛向北延伸，进入幽魂之海。该地区大部分是蛮荒和无人居住的，除了奥德-瑞达尼亚和大衮-费尔两个小村庄。而只有大衮-费尔是通船的，所有其他岛屿间的运输必须由旅行者自行解决。<BR>

Guide to Vivec

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Guide to Vivec<BR>
<IMG SRC="VivecRegion_377_253.tga" WIDTH="377" HEIGHT="253"><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Vivec City is the largest settlement on Vvardenfell, and one of the largest cities in the East. Each of the great cantons is the size of a complete town. The High Fane and the palace of Vivec are visited by hundreds of tourists and pilgrims daily. Citizens flock to the Arena for public entertainments like mock battles and comic plays. Outlanders mostly confine themselves to the Foreign Canton, while natives live, work, and shop in the Great House compounds and residential cantons. But most of all, this is Lord Vivec's holy city. The Ministry of Truth, the Temple prison, hangs above the great temple of the High Fane, the Halls of Wisdom and Justice, and Lord Vivec's Palace.<BR>
<BR>
Vivec is a city made up of eight cantons, each a little town in itself. On a map, it looks like a cross, with the Foreign Quarter at the top, the Temple Compound, with Vivec's Palace, the High Fane, the Ministry of Truth, and the Hall of Wisdom and the Hall of Justice at the bottom, the Hlaalu Compound to the west, the Telvanni Compound on the east, and four cantons grouped together at the center of the cross -- Redoran Compound northwest, Arena northeast, St. Delyn's Canton southwest, and St. Olms Canton southeast.<BR>
<BR>
The Foreign Quarter<BR>
<BR>
The Foreign Quarter is the large three-tiered canton to the north. Originally, foreigners were not allowed to enter Vivec any further than the Foreign Quarter, but now outlanders can travel throughout Vivec at will. The Imperial Guilds each have guildhalls and complete services here, and an Imperial cult shrine serves the spiritual needs of the Imperial faithful. Various independent tradesmen, craftsmen, and trainers also rent space here. The Black Shalk Cornerclub rents beds to non-guild visitors.<BR>
<BR>
Temple Compound<BR>
<BR>
The High Fane is the largest Tribunal temple on Vvardenfell. Archcanon Saryoni presides over the temple, along with a large staff of priests, healers, and monks. Pilgrims travel from all over Morrowind to view the High Fane and the Ministry of Truth, and to offer prayer and thanks before the Palace of Vivec. The Ministry of Truth, a celestial body suspended by Vivec's mighty power over the Temple Compound, is the headquarters of the Temple Ordinators, and heretics are imprisoned and re-educated there. The Hall of Wisdom and Hall of Justice contain the executive, administrative, judicial, and martial operations of the Tribunal Temple. The Palace of Vivec is the abode of the god-hero Lord Vivec, the Warrior-Poet of the three deities who comprise Almsivi, the divine patrons of the Tribunal Temple. Only the most devout are admitted to the presence of Lord Vivec, and only at his initiation. Beneath the Palace of Vivec is the Puzzle Canal, a place of worship and testing for questing heroes hoping to receive Vivec's favor. Many choice treasures are guarded by Daedric servants in the Puzzle Canal's dark passages.<BR>
<BR>
Hlaalu Compound<BR>
<BR>
Hlaalu Compound is the westmost canton. The Hlaalu Councilor Crassius Curio has a splendid tier-top mansion here. The tiers below contain Hlaalu treasuries, records, holding cells, and various Great House services. There are two public houses: the Elven Nations and the No Name Club. A variety of craftsmen and tradesmen also have shops at Hlaalu Compound. Some House Hlaalu nobles and retainers prefer to maintain their residences in the less-formal St. Delyn and St. Olms cantons.<BR>
<BR>
Telvanni Compound<BR>
<BR>
Telvanni Compound is the eastmost canton. The mage-lord Mavon Drenim is the ranking Telvanni noble. The Telvanni rent the compound from the Temple, and have to make do with a Velothi tower instead of their preferred mushroom towers. The administrative center includes a treasury and a hall of records. Slaves are housed in the lowest tiers, along with cells full of monsters. There are many tradesmen, craftsmen, and trainers, and the Lizard's Head cornerclub provides lodgings for Telvanni kin and mercenaries.<BR>
<BR>
Redoran Compound<BR>
<BR>
Redoran Compound is the canton south of the Foreign Quarter, west of and next to the Arena. The Redoran administrative center there includes the Redoran Treasury, Hall of Records, and Holding Cells. On the lowest tier is a Redoran shrine and ancestral vaults. Two noble families, the Sarens and the Dralors, have top-tier manors. There are many tradesmen, craftsmen, and trainers, and the Flowers of Gold cornerclub provides lodgings for Redoran kin and retainers.<BR>
<BR>
Arena Compound<BR>
<BR>
The Arena Compound lies between the Redoran compound on the west and the Telvanni compound on the east. The Arena is the site of public entertainments and combat sports. The comfortable domed Arena has seating for hundreds of spectators; beneath the Arena are dressing and storage rooms for entertainers and training rooms and animal pens for the combat competitors.<BR>
<BR>
St. Delyn and St. Olms Residential Cantons<BR>
<BR>
St. Delyn Canton and St. Olms Canton are residence cantons for commoners and paupers. The Temple charges very reasonable rents for comfortable workshops, shops, and apartments, and most of Vvardenfell's crafts and light industry are housed in these cantons. The Abbey of St. Delyn the Wise is on the top tier of St. Delyn, and Hlaalu Councilor Yngling Half-Troll has a top-tier manor on St. Olms.<BR>
<BR>
Transportation<BR>
<BR>
Foot bridges connect with the mainland between the Ebonheart region and Hlaalu Compound, between the north bay region and the Foreign Quarter, and between the east bay region and Telvanni Compound. Good roads lead from the Hlaalu Compound bridge south to Ebonheart and north to Seyda Neen and points north. Good roads lead from the Foreign Quarter bridge west towards Seyda Neen, north towards Suran and the Ascadian Isles, and east towards Molag Mar. Roads from the Telvanni Compound bridge are useful mostly for travelers to Molag Mar. Silt strider service is available at the north end of the Foreign Quarter bridge, traveling from Vivec to Suran, Seyda Neen, Balmora, and Molag Mar. Ships from the docks at the Foreign Quarter travel to Ebonheart, Hla Oad, Molag Mar, and Tel Branora. Ships from nearby Ebonheart sail to Hla Oad, Sadrith Mora, Tel Branora, and the Foreign Quarter of Vivec. Low-fare gondolas shuttle passengers from canton to canton via Vivec's canals.<BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
维威克城指南<BR>
<IMG SRC="VivecRegion_377_253.tga" WIDTH="377" HEIGHT="253"><BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
维威克城是坚盾岛上最大的城市，也是东部最大的城市。每一个大区都是一个完整的城镇规模。每天都有数百名游客和朝圣者参观至高神殿和维威克宫殿。市民们涌向竞技场观赏娱乐表演和战争游戏。外地人主要集中在他们的外邦行政区，而当地人的生活、工作和购物都在大家族驻地和生活区。但最重要的是，这里是维威克神王的圣城。真理部，神殿监狱，高悬于至高神殿的伟大神殿、智慧和正义大厅、以及维威克王的宫殿上方。<BR>
<BR>
维威克城由八个社区拼成，每一个社区就像一个小型城镇。从地图上看，像一个十字形，外邦区在顶部，神殿驻地、维威克宫殿、至高神殿、真理部、以及智慧大厅和正义大厅在底部，哈拉鲁驻地在西端，泰瓦尼驻地在东面，四个社区——西北的瑞多然驻地、东北的竞技场、西南的圣·德林行政区、和东南的圣·奥姆斯行政区——一起组成了十字的中央。<BR>
<BR>
外邦区<BR>
<BR>
外邦区是北面的三层大区。最初，外邦人不得进入维威克城外邦区以外的区域，但现在外来者可以随意在维威克各地旅行。帝国公会在这里都设有公署并提供完备的服务，帝国教团圣祠则为帝国信众的精神需求提供服务。各种独立的商人、工匠和训练师也在这里租用场地。黑砂壳虫街角酒吧向非公会游客出租床位。<BR>
<BR>
神殿驻地<BR>
<BR>
至高神殿是瓦登费尔岛上最大的审判席神殿。大主教萨里奥尼主持着神殿，管理着大批的祭司、医疗师和僧侣。朝圣者从晨风各地前往至高神殿和真理部，并到维威克的宫殿前祈祷和拜谢。真理部是一个由维威克的强大力量停滞在神殿驻地上空的天体，是神殿守卫的总部，和异端关押再教育之地。智慧大厅和正义大厅包含行政、管理、司法和审判席神殿的军事行动。维威克神殿是英雄神维威克大人的居所。他是构成奥姆希维的三神之一，被称为“诗武者”，也是审判席神殿的神圣守护者之一。在维威克的神殿之下是迷渠，一处供英雄们朝拜，以及英雄们为祈求得到维威克青睐而前来探求的测试之地。许多奇珍异宝由迪德拉仆人在迷渠的黑暗通道中把守。<BR>
<BR>
哈拉鲁驻地<BR>
<BR>
哈拉鲁驻地是最西面的社区。哈拉鲁议员克拉西乌斯·库里奥在这里有一栋顶级豪宅。下层社区包含哈拉鲁宝库、资料库、拘留所、和各种大家族服务。这里有两个酒吧：精灵国度和无名酒吧。各种工匠和商人也在哈拉鲁驻地开设商店。一些哈拉鲁家族贵族和家臣宁愿把他们的住所安置在没那么多规矩的圣·德林和圣·奥姆斯区。<BR>
<BR>
泰瓦尼驻地<BR>
<BR>
泰瓦尼驻地是最东面的社区。法师领主马文·德雷尼姆是泰瓦尼的贵族。泰瓦尼向神殿租赁了驻地，当做维洛提塔凑合着使用，以代替他们喜欢的蘑菇塔。行政中心包括一个财政部和一个档案室。奴隶被安置在满是怪物的最底层。那里有许多商人，工匠，和训练师，蜥脑街角酒吧为泰瓦尼同族及雇佣兵提供食宿。<BR>
<BR>
瑞多然驻地<BR>
<BR>
瑞多然驻地在外邦区的南面，东面与竞技场相邻。瑞多然行政中心包括瑞多然宝库、资料库大厅、和拘留所。在最底层是瑞多然神龛和祖先地宫。两个贵族家族——萨伦斯和卓洛斯拥有顶级庄园。那里有许多商人、工匠和训练师，金花街角酒吧为瑞多然及其家臣提供食宿。<BR>
<BR>
竞技场驻地<BR>
<BR>
竞技场驻地位于瑞多然驻地的西面和泰瓦尼驻地的东面之间。竞技场是公共娱乐表演和搏斗竞技的场所。宽敞的穹顶竞技场可容纳数百名观众；在竞技场下方是为表演者准备的梳妆室和储藏室，以及为搏斗竞技准备的训练室和动物笼。<BR>
<BR>
圣·德林和圣·奥姆斯住宅区<BR>
<BR>
圣·德林区和圣·奥姆斯区是平民和贫民的住宅区。神殿向安置在这些社区里的工厂、商店、公寓和大多数瓦登费尔岛的工匠和手工业者收取合理的租金。圣·德林修道院的智者是圣·德林中的顶级，哈拉鲁议员英灵·半巨魔在圣·奥姆斯拥有一幢顶级庄园。<BR>
<BR>
交通<BR>
<BR>
天桥连接黑檀心地区与哈拉鲁驻地、北部湾地区和外邦区，和东部湾地区和泰瓦尼驻地之间的大陆。从哈拉鲁驻地桥头起始的大道往南通向黑檀心，往北通向赛达-尼恩和北部地带。从外邦区桥头起始的大道西向赛达-尼恩，北朝苏兰和阿斯卡迪安群岛，东面莫拉格-玛尔。从泰瓦尼驻地桥头起始的道路通常对前往莫拉格-玛尔旅行很有帮助。阔步沙蚤服务站在外邦区桥头的北面尽头，从维威克城出发前往苏兰、赛达-尼恩、巴尔莫拉和莫拉格-玛尔。外邦区的码头渡船前往黑檀心、哈拉-奥德、莫拉格-玛尔和泰尔-布勒诺拉。从邻可近的黑檀心以乘船航向哈拉-奥德、萨德里斯-莫拉、泰尔-布勒诺拉，和维威克城的外邦区。价格低廉的贡多拉渡船在维威克的河渠上穿梭于各区之间接送旅客。<BR>

Guide to Balmora<BR>

Balmora is the district seat of House Hlaalu, and the largest settlement on Vvardenfell after Vivec City. Balmora's four districts are High Town, the Commercial District, Labor Town, and Fort Moonmoth. High Town, on the hill to the west, has the Tribunal Temple, Hlaalu Council Hall, rich manors, better shops, and the Morag Tong guildhall. The Commercial District, just west of the river, is centered on the large plaza north of South Gate, with the strider port along the south wall, east of South Gate. The Fighters Guild and Mages Guild, and most of Balmora's shops and inns, are located along the streets of the Commercial District. Labor Town, east of the river, where the commoners and poor live, has several modest cornerclubs and a few merchants. Fort Moonmoth, a long walk southeast of town, houses the Legion garrison and the Imperial cult.<BR>
<BR>
Services<BR>
<BR>
House Hlaalu services are available at Hlaalu Council Manor in High Town. Temple faithful seek solace and services at the Balmora Temple in the southeast. Outlanders must travel outside the town walls, through South Gate and east along well-marked roads to Fort Moonmoth for Imperial Legion and the Imperial cult services. The guildhalls of the Fighters Guild and Mages Guild are on the street north from the plaza in the Commercial District. Morag Tong services are available at their guildhall in the extreme northwest of High Town. Better shops are in High Town on the hill, with numerous merchants in the Commercial District, west of the river, and a few traders in Labor Town, east of the river.<BR>

<BR>

Ranis Athrys is the Mages Guild steward. Ethasi Rilvayn is the Morag Tong steward. Feldrelo Sadri is the ranking cleric of the Balmora Tribunal Temple. The colorful 'Sugar Lips' Habasi, a freelance facilitator of no fixed address, is often rumored to be the local boss of the Thieves Guild.<BR>
<BR>
Transportation<BR>
<BR>
A good road leads south to Pelagiad, Seyda Neen, Ebonheart, and Vivec. A rugged wilderness track leads southwest along the Odai River to the fishing village of Hla Oad. Improved roads head north to Caldera and Ald'ruhn. The silt strider port is on the west side of the river near South Gate. Silt strider service goes to Ald'ruhn, Suran, Ald'ruhn, and Seyda Neen. Guild guides at the Mages Guild can teleport you to Ald'ruhn, Vivec, Caldera, and Sadrith Mora for a fee. Hla Oad is southwest on the coast. An unimproved trail leads northeast up the ravines of Foyada Mamaea to Ghostgate; the path is easy to follow, but dangerous beasts threaten pilgrims who travel this route to Ghostgate shrine.<BR>

Principle Districts of Ald'ruhn<BR>

Ald'ruhn is the district seat of House Redoran, and one of the largest settlements on Vvardenfell. The three principal districts are Ald'ruhn town, Ald'ruhn-under-Skar, and Buckmoth Fort.<BR>
<BR>
Ald'ruhn town is a large settlement in the Redoran village style, built of local materials, with organic curves and undecorated exteriors inspired by the landscape and by the shells of giant native insects. Most guildhalls, cornerclubs, and merchants are sited in the southwest corner of town, convenient to West Gate and the strider port, while the Temple is located on high ground to the east, and surrounded by a residential section.<BR>
<BR>
Ald'ruhn-under-Skar is the most distinctive architectural feature of Ald'ruhn -- a manor and council district sheltered beneath the shell of an ancient extinct giant crab. The large carapace encloses a central dome, from which radiate the entrances to the Redoran Council chambers, the manors of the Redoran councilors, and shops of a few upscale merchants.<BR>
<BR>
Buckmoth Fort is the Imperial legion garrison for the district. The strong walls and towers of this Western fortress lies a short distance to the south of Ald'ruhn town, through South Gate behind the Mages Guild.<BR>
<BR>
Services<BR>
<BR>
House Redoran services are in the Council House and Councilor's Manors of Ald'ruhn-Under-Skar. The Ald'ruhn Temple on the east side of town provides service for Temple worshipers. Buckmoth Fort offers services to the Imperial Legion and devotees of the Imperial cult, including an Imperial cult altar. The guildhalls of the Fighters Guild and Mages Guild are near the South Gate. Pricy but high-quality clothier, alchemist, and enchanter shops are under Skar as well. Commodities at reasonable prices, but with smaller selections, are available from the smith, clothier, trader, pawnbroker, and bookseller near the entrance to Ald'ruhn-Under-Skar. The Ald Skar Inn and the Council Club cornerclub are found to the west, near West Gate and the silt strider port. The Rat in the Pot cornerclub is in south Ald'ruhn, near the guildhalls.<BR>

Notable figures<BR>
<BR>
All six Redoran councilors, Brara Morvayn, Hlaren Ramoran, Athyn Sarethi, Garisa Llethri, Miner Arobar, and Bolvyn Venim, have manor residences in Ald'ruhn-Under-Skar. Edwinna Elbert is the Mages Guild steward, and Percius Mercius has recently become the Fighters Guild steward. Old Methal Seran is an eminent Temple priest and scholar. Raesa Pullia is commandant of Buckmoth Fort, but Imsin the Dreamer is the chapter steward. The Redguard Hean is priest of the Imperial cult. Goren Andarysis the guild steward of the Morag Tong, whose guildhall is found in Ald'ruhn-Under-Skar.<BR>

Travel and Transportation<BR>
<BR>
Roads lead northwest to Maar Gan and Gnisis villages and by a circuitous western route to Caldera, Balmora, and points south. The road to Balmora swings northwest to avoid the barren wastes, and curves around towards the west until it heads south again to Caldera. Between Ald'ruhn and Caldera are many sidepaths; watch for signposts, or you'll get lost. The silt strider port is along the western town wall, north of West Gate. Silt strider service goes from Ald'ruhn to Balmora, Gnisis, Khuul, or Maar Gan.. Guild guides at the Mages Guild teleport you to Balmora, Vivec, Caldera, and Sadrith Mora for a modest fee. Gnaar Mok is a LONG and exceptionally unpleasant walk west to the coast and then south; there are no trails or marked routes. Casual travelers ill-equipped for the attacks of wild beasts and brigands should keep to the roads and travel services.<BR>

<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
萨德里斯-莫拉是泰瓦尼家族的控制区，也是泰瓦尼议院的所在地，尽管实际上只有一位泰瓦尼议员住在萨德里斯-莫拉。萨德里斯-莫拉是一个岛屿定居点，只有通过海上运输和传送魔法才能到达。小镇很大，有很多服务设施，有许多工匠、商人和驯兽师，但只对泰瓦尼人开放。外来客必须把自己关在闸门客栈和狼獾大厅。狼獾大厅是帝国军团的驻地和会馆。码头在岛西侧的一个隐蔽的海湾里，有一条小路从码头一直延伸到闸门客栈。闸门客栈后面是一个大市场，有许多工匠和商人，还有一个小型的奴隶市场。大市场北面是泰瓦尼议院大厅，这是一个巨大的球体，由巨大的蘑菇杆支撑着。大市场的东边是泰尔-纳加，那是泰瓦尼议员内洛斯大师高耸的魔法塔和住所。<BR>
<BR>
公共服务系统<BR>
<BR>
外来者可以在狼獾大厅寻求战士公会、法师公会和帝国教会的服务。盗贼公会的成员聚集在肮脏穆里尔的街角酒吧。泰瓦尼家族和审判席神殿提供的服务都设在议院大厅，其他的泰瓦尼服务可以在大市场区和泰尔-纳加找到。闸门商务客栈是唯一一家提供公共床位的酒店。当然，战士公会、法师公会、和帝国教会的成员可以在狼獾大厅找到床位。泰瓦尼亲属和仆人们可以住在闸门客栈、狼獾大厅，以及当地的一家街角酒吧或者泰尔-纳加。大市场有许多服务者和商人，其他商户则分散在城里。这里有两家街角酒吧：外来客去肮脏穆里尔的，本地人则去的法拉的墙洞。泰尔-纳加是内洛斯大师的魔法塔。<BR>
<BR>
著名的人物<BR>
<BR>
如果你不是泰瓦尼人或泰瓦尼家仆，你会想要认识闸门商务客栈的酒店总监安加雷德尔和闸门客栈的老板埃瑞。在狼獾大厅，赫仑迪是战斗公会的总管，普卢克恩·尼吉留斯是法师公会的总管，奥尼乌斯·奥特鲁斯是帝国教会的牧师。大个子海伦德是盗贼公会的头目，经常出现在肮脏穆里尔的街角酒吧。泰瓦尼的巫师和家仆们则会前往议院大厅，与泰瓦尼的发言人商议（泰瓦尼发言人是高阶议员们的代言者)。议员内洛斯大师住在泰尔-纳加，巫师塔在镇中心。<BR>
<BR>
交通运输<BR>
<BR>
萨德里斯-莫拉是一座岛屿，没有路或桥连通大陆。要访问大陆，你必须会飞、会游泳、会走水上行走，或者你必须依靠码头上的船长或者法师公会的传送者。码头上加尔斯·阿雷提的船可以带你前往黑檀心、泰尔-布勒诺拉、泰尔-莫拉或大衮-费尔。狼獾大厅法师公会的伊涅尔可以传送你到奥德-汝因、维威克城、卡尔德拉和巴尔莫拉，只收取很少的费用。<BR>
<BR>

This orphan and outcast is called in legend the "Nerevarine," and is supposed to be a reincarnation of the long-dead Dunmer General and First Councilor, Lord Indoril Nerevar.<BR>

<BR>
seven trials<BR>

What is left undone, that shall be done.<BR>
<BR>
first trial<BR>
On a certain day to uncertain parents<BR>
Incarnate moon and star reborn.<BR>

second trial<BR>
Neither blight nor age can harm him.<BR>

third trial<BR>

sixth trial<BR>

He eats their sin, and is reborn.<BR>
<BR>
seventh trial<BR>

Binds the broken, redeems the mad.<BR>
<BR>
one destiny<BR>
He speaks the law for Veloth's people.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
化身的七大异象之七大试炼<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[这是被称为《化身的七大异象之七大试炼》。我将她对我所说的话记录下。]<BR>
<BR>
七大试炼<BR>
他所触及之事，必然完成。<BR>
他所未竟之事，必将完成。<BR>
<BR>
第一个试炼<BR>
在某一天，由某对不确定的父母诞下一婴，<BR>
星与月的化身将重生。<BR>
<BR>
第二个试炼
枯萎与衰老都无法伤害他。<BR>
血肉的诅咒在他面前消散。 <BR>
<BR>
第三个试炼<BR>
在黑暗的洞穴中，在阿祖拉的注视下，<BR>
星与月散发着光辉。<BR>
<BR>
第四个试炼<BR>
异客之声使各大议院团结一心，<BR>
三大家族称之为统谏使。<BR>
<BR>
第五个试炼<BR>
异客之手使维洛斯的人民联合一体，<BR>
四大部落称之为尼瑞瓦因。<BR>
<BR>
第六个试炼<BR>
他尊重着无人哀悼的家族流淌的鲜血，<BR>
他承受着他们的罪孽，重生了。<BR>
