<BR>
突然她感觉很热，就像岩浆泼在她身上一样。幻术！从夜莺那里她已经尝够了这种艺术的苦头。她早就学会了如何感知——现在她感受到了，就像一个盲人能够感受到太阳照射着他的脸庞一样。幻象！但是为什么呢？虽然她的嘴还在陈述哀伤之城的困境，她的脑子却飞速运转起来。虚荣心？人类在精灵面前总是羞愧他们短暂的生命，但是尤利尔塞普汀的脸看起来和他的实际年龄十分相称啊。<BR>
<BR>
巴兰兹娅可不敢在这里使用魔法。即使最低微的贵族都有感知魔法的方法，他们在自己家里一般都有隐藏魔法的方法。在这里使用魔法就和掏出一把匕首一样，绝对会招来皇帝的愤怒。<BR>
<BR>
魔法。<BR>
<BR>
幻象。<BR>
<BR>
突然夜莺出现在她脑海里。他坐在她面前。然后影像转变了，变成了尤利尔·塞普汀。他看起来很悲伤，陷入了困境。然后尤利尔的影像又消失了，另一个人坐在那里。有点像夜莺，又有点不像。苍白的皮肤，血红的眼睛，精灵的耳朵——他饱含着一股恨意，一股先古的力量——一道恐怖的，毁灭性的闪光。这个人无所不能！<BR>
<BR>
然后又一次，她又面对尤利尔·塞普汀。<BR>
<BR>
她怎么确定她是不是沉浸在幻境里？也许她的大脑欺骗了她。她感到十分疲倦，就像她背着一个重担走了好久好远。她决定不去谈那些哀伤之城的事——这些都不是重点——她决定开个玩笑。一个有目的的玩笑。<BR>
<BR>
“还记得吗，陛下，在您父亲的加冕礼后，赛马库斯和我与您全家共进晚餐？那时您还没小莫加大呢。我们很荣幸我们是那晚唯一的客人——当然除了您最好的朋友贾斯丁以外”<BR>
<BR>
“啊，是的”皇帝小心地微笑着，非常小心地，“我想我记得”<BR>
<BR>
“您和贾斯丁是那么好的朋友，陛下。我听说他不久以后就过世了，真是令人惋惜”<BR>
<BR>
“确实如此，直到现在我仍然不愿意谈起他”他的眼神变得空洞——更空洞了。“至于你的请求，夫人，我们会仔细考虑，有结果了会告知你的”<BR>
<BR>
巴兰兹娅鞠了一躬，孩子们也照做了。皇帝点点头让他们退下，于是他们退出了房间。<BR>
<BR>
走出王座间的时候她长舒了一口气。“贾斯丁”是一个想象中的玩伴，尤利尔小时候坚持每顿饭都要给贾斯丁安排一个座位。不仅如此，虽然这个名字听起来是个男孩，实际上贾斯丁是个女孩！尤利尔从小到大，赛马库斯一直把这个当做和尤利尔·塞普汀见面时的笑谈——见面就会假装询问贾斯丁的健康状况。最后一次巴兰兹娅听到贾斯丁是几年前，皇帝显然是精心策划后告诉赛马库斯，贾斯丁遇到了一个热爱旅行但是有点固执的卡吉特青年，并嫁给了他。定居在了利兰德里以种植为生。<BR>
<BR>
坐在王座上的那个人不是尤利尔·塞普汀！难道是夜莺？是的，是的！前思后想以后巴兰兹娅知道她是对的。一定是他！夜莺！假装成了皇帝！赛马库斯全搞错了，错的离谱……<BR>
<BR>
现在怎么办？她快要疯了。尤利尔·塞普汀出了什么事——更重要的，这对于她自己和赛马库斯，以及整个哀伤之城意味着什么？回头想想，巴兰兹娅猜想他们的麻烦全都来自于这个冒牌的皇帝，这个夜莺假扮的家伙——或者不管他是谁。他一定在那些对哀伤之城毫无理由的要求提出前就取代了尤利尔·塞普汀的位置。这就解释了为什么她与泰伯·塞普汀私通了那么久以后，领地与帝国之间的关系才开始恶化（以人类的时间观念来看）。夜莺对赛马库斯的名誉，忠诚，知识以及与塞普汀家族的关系了若指掌，于是策划了这次看不见的完美攻击。如果真是这样，那他们现在就是羊入虎口，她和孩子们正处在他所掌控的帝都内，而赛马库斯则还在哀伤之城处理着夜莺带来的麻烦。<BR>
<BR>
她必须做点什么。巴兰兹娅按住面前的两个孩子，一只手搭在他们一个人肩上，试图冷静，镇定，她的女侍和贴身骑士正尾随其后。终于他们到达了马车旁边。即便他们的住处离皇宫只有几条街，皇家的尊严禁止他们徒步前往——以往她都讨厌这样，这一次却让她觉得些许欣慰。马车现在就好像是避难所一样，虽然她知道事实并非如此。<BR>
<BR>
一个男孩冲到一个卫兵面前并递给他一个卷轴，他指指马车。卫兵把卷轴交给他。男孩站在一旁等着，眼睛睁得老大。书信简短而礼貌，位于高岩行省途歇城的艾德威尔国王久慕哀伤之城的巴兰兹娅女王的威名，希望能结交您。<BR>
<BR>
巴兰兹娅的第一反应是拒绝。她只想快点离开这个城市！她现在可不想和一个昏了头的人类扯上关系。她不悦地抬起头，其中一个卫兵说，“夫人，那个男孩说他的主人在那边等着你回覆”她朝卫兵所指的方向望去，看见了一个骑在马背上的英俊小老头，他旁边有超过半打的侍者和骑士。他们四目相对，男人恭敬地脱帽行礼。<BR>
<BR>
“很好”巴兰兹娅一时冲动，就对男孩说道，“告诉你的主人今晚晚餐过后可以拜访我”艾德威尔国王看起来既有礼貌又严肃，还有点焦急——不过那可不是对恋爱的饥渴。就是那种感觉，她幽幽地想着。<BR>
巴兰兹娅站在塔楼的窗户旁，等待着。她感受到老熟人就在附近。但是因为夜晚的天空对她来说就像白天一样，她还没看见它。这时它突然出现了，从稀薄的云层中透出一个小点。几分钟以后，它完成了它的降落，收起翅膀，爪子搭在她厚厚的皮制臂章上。<BR>
<BR>
她气喘吁吁地把鸟儿放到它的栖息处，她打开鸟腿上取下信匣时双手不耐烦地颤抖着。她打开信匣的时候，老鹰在一旁猛喝几口水，然后精心地梳理自己的羽毛，骄傲地站着。她实在很想赞扬他完美地完成了任务，他有权利休息了……但是手中的事情实在让她没心情。就算是这只鸟类也看得出来，事情不对劲。<BR>
<BR>
她颤抖着打开细细的羊皮纸卷，凝视着那难辨认的字迹。不是赛马库斯那大大方方的字迹！巴兰兹娅缓缓地坐下，手指在纸张上抚摸着，她已经准备好接受任何灾难性的消息了。<BR>
<BR>
确实是灾难性的消息。<BR>
<BR>
帝国卫兵背叛了赛马库斯，加入了反叛军。赛马库斯死了。剩下的皇室军队一败涂地。赛马库斯死了。反叛军首领已经被帝国特使钦点为哀伤之城的新国王。赛马库斯死了。巴兰兹娅和她的孩子们被指控为叛国贼，全国通缉。<BR>
<BR>
赛马库斯死了。<BR>
<BR>
原来今早的觐见只是一个障眼法，一个诡计。这太明显了，皇帝早就知道一切。她就像木偶一样被操纵着，被告知放心，静候佳音，皇后夫人，请尽情享受帝都的一切，想待多久就待多久。享受待在这里？这简直就是拘留，是囚禁。她即将面对的很有可能就是被囚禁。她现在明白自己的处境了，皇帝绝不会再让她离开帝都，至少不会是活着离开。<BR>
<BR>
赛马库斯死了。<BR>
<BR>
“夫人”<BR>
<BR>
巴兰兹娅被接近的侍女吓了一跳，“什……什么事？”<BR>
<BR>
“夫人，那个布莱顿人来了。艾德威尔国王”幸亏她补充了一下，不然巴兰兹娅早忘了这事。看到夜莺，侍女犹豫了一下说道，“夫人，有新的消息吗？”<BR>
<BR>
“没什么，别耽误正事”巴兰兹娅迅速答道，她的声音夹杂着哈欠，听起来空空洞洞。“照顾好夜莺”她站起身来，整了整她的长袍，准备接待她的贵客。<BR>
<BR>
她麻木了……就好像她周围的石墙一样，就好像夜晚的空气一样……麻木的就像一具行尸走肉。<BR>
<BR>
赛马库斯死了。<BR>
<BR>
***<BR>

艾德威尔国王非常恭敬地问候巴兰兹娅，态度甚至可说有点过于浮夸。他自称自己非常崇拜赛马库斯，认为赛马库斯在他家族的历史中占了一席之地。他逐渐地将话题转向巴兰兹娅与皇帝之间的事情，并且不愿放过任何细节，同时也询问哀伤之城的情况是否有出现转机。但当他发现巴兰兹娅似乎不是很在乎他们的这番对谈时，他情绪失控地吼道，“女王夫人，您要信任我。那个皇帝是别人冒充的！我知道这听起来很疯狂，可是我……”<BR>
<BR>
“不用说了”巴兰兹娅语气坚定地说道，“你说的完全正确。国王大人。你说的我都知道”<BR>
<BR>
艾德威尔听了以后终于放松地坐了下来，但他的眼神突然一变，“您居然知道？您不是把我当作疯子在捉弄吧？”<BR>
<BR>
“国王大人，我可以跟您保证我没有在捉弄您”她深深吸了一口气，“但您认为，是谁在冒充皇帝呢？”<BR>
<BR>
“帝国战斗法师杰迦尔·萨恩”<BR>
<BR>
“啊。国王大人，不知您是否曾听过夜莺？”<BR>
<BR>
“我的确有听说过夜莺，夫人。我跟我的盟友认为他跟逃亡中的萨恩是同一个人”<BR>
<BR>
“我就知道！”巴兰兹娅站起来试图隐瞒自己的激动，“夜莺就是杰迦尔·萨恩！但是那男人是恶魔！既邪恶又阴险，却又聪明。他策画毫无破绽的阴谋，让他们堕入深渊！赛马库斯，我的赛马库斯……！”<BR>
<BR>
艾德威尔干咳了几声，“夫人，我……我们……我们需要您的协助”<BR>
<BR>
巴兰兹娅诡异的笑着，这事情的演变实在太过于曲折，“我原本以为，这句话应当从我口中说出来。您说吧，我如何帮得上忙，国王大人？”<BR>
<BR>
艾德威尔很快地把计划说了一遍。法师瑞雅·席曼本是杰迦尔·萨恩的学徒，但她遭到假皇帝以叛国的名义杀害。她找到方法保留了些许的能量，并且成功地联系上她在人界里的亲友。她选出一名勇士，来找寻被那个阴险的术士藏在一个隐密之处的混沌之杖。勇士得要使用唯一能够伤害到杰迦尔·萨恩的混沌之杖来摧毁他，并且救出被囚禁在其他空间的皇帝。但是那位勇者，尽管他还活着，却正在帝国的地窖中受苦。她必须转移萨恩的注意力，让瑞雅的灵魂有足够的时间救出勇士。巴兰兹娅能够吸引皇帝的注意，尤其是他的目光。但是这样就够了吗？<BR>
<BR>
“我应该可以再让假皇帝召见我一次”巴兰兹娅小心翼翼地说道。“但是这样就够了吗？您得知道我跟我的孩子已经被帝国认为是叛国贼了”<BR>
<BR>
“在哀伤之城跟晨风省你们也许是叛徒。但是帝都跟领地不同。一关接着一关的繁复程序，让您无法晋见皇帝跟他的大臣。但同样的程序也会保障您不会在受到一个公正的审判之前被关进地牢里。夫人，因为你们身分的关系，让您跟您的孩子的情况更为复杂。您贵为皇后，您的孩子为王位继承人，基本上没人动的了你们”艾德威尔笑着说道，“我的夫人，帝都的官僚是把双面刃啊”<BR>
<BR>
至少她跟两个小孩暂时不会有事。但她突然想到，“国王大人，您刚才提到我尤其能够吸引到皇帝的目光，那是什么意思？”<BR>
<BR>
艾德威尔面露难色，“从仆从的耳语得知，杰迦尔·萨恩在他的卧室里有着一尊照着您外观制成的神像”<BR>
<BR>
“我懂了”她不禁想到她与夜莺那段疯狂的罗曼史。她曾如着魔般地爱着他。傻女人。那个她曾爱过的男人如今杀了她当真爱的人。爱过的人。爱过。他已经不在了。他……他……她依旧无法相信赛马库斯已经死了。但就算他人死了，我的爱还活着，会继续活下去。他会永远在我心里。那痛楚也会存在。下半辈子缺少他陪伴的痛楚。度过每一天，每一夜，没有他的存在，他的安慰，他的爱情的日子。知道他永远无法看着他的孩子长大成人的痛楚。他的孩子永远无法认识他们的父亲，无法知道他是多么地勇敢、强壮、美好、慈爱……特别是小莫加。<BR>
<BR>
为此，为这一切，为你对我家人所做的这一切。夜莺。你得死。<BR>
<BR>
“这让您感到惊讶吗？”<BR>
<BR>
艾德威尔打断了她的思绪。“什么？什么东西让我惊讶？”<BR>
<BR>
“您的雕像。在萨恩的卧房里”<BR>
<BR>
“喔”她坚定的回道。“对。但也不对”<BR>
<BR>
艾德威尔从她的眼神中看出她想要改变话题。他选择将话题转回到他们的计划。“我们的勇者可能会需要数天的时间才能逃脱，夫人。您能够帮他争取到足够的时间吗？”<BR>
<BR>
“国王大人，为什么您愿意相信我？”<BR>
<BR>
“我们走投无路了，夫人。我们别无选择。但就算我们有的话，对，没错。我还是会选择相信您。我信任您。您的丈夫多年来关照我的家人。赛马库斯大人……”<BR>
<BR>
“死了”<BR>
<BR>
“什么？”<BR>
<BR>
巴兰兹娅简短但冷静地把事情述说一遍。<BR>
<BR>
“夫人……皇后……这太惨了！我……我很抱歉……”<BR>
<BR>
巴兰兹娅寒冰般的心防第一次出现了空隙。面对这股同情心，她感受到自己逐渐无法保持平静。但她最后还是强迫自己维持沉着。<BR>
<BR>
“夫人，这种情况之下，我们无法要求您……”<BR>
<BR>
“不，国王大人。在这种情况之下，我得做出任何可以让我复仇的事。为了我孩子的父亲”一滴眼泪突破她的眼眶。她不耐烦地把脸颊擦干。“我只要求您，尽您所能保护我这两个失去父亲的孩子”<BR>
<BR>
艾德威尔站了起来，两眼发出光芒。“我勇敢且高贵的女王，我在此发誓，会保护他们的安危。以这片土地的神明，还有整片泰姆瑞尔大陆为证”<BR>
<BR>
他的这番话虽然荒谬却又深刻地打动了她。“我打从心里跟灵魂里感谢您。善良的艾德威尔国王。我跟我的孩子都会永远感……感……”<BR>
<BR>
她终究撑不住，倒了下去。<BR>
<BR>
***<BR>
<BR>
她整晚没睡，坐在床边的椅子上，两手环放在大腿上。在黑漆漆的夜晚仔细思考着。她不打算告诉她的孩子们，时候未到，要等到必要时才说。<BR>
<BR>
她不需要再次请求皇帝的召见。隔天一早她就被要求上朝。<BR>
<BR>
她告诉她的孩子们她会离开数天，要求他们不要给仆从带来麻烦后，亲吻他们的脸颊道别。莫加情绪不太好，她在帝都感到无聊并且寂寞。赫尔塞斯看起来有点忧郁，但没说什么。他跟他父亲很像。他父亲……<BR>
<BR>
巴兰兹娅抵达皇宫后没有被送往前次的听政大厅，反而被带去一间较小的会客室。皇帝正单独在里面用餐。皇帝看到巴兰兹娅后点了头并把手指向窗户。“风景很棒吧？”<BR>
<BR>
巴兰兹娅往外看着这座伟大城市林立的塔楼。她突然想起她多年以前是在这里第一次跟泰伯·塞普汀会面。泰伯·塞普汀。另一个她曾爱过的男人。她还爱过哪些人？赛马库斯，泰伯·塞普汀……还有斯图尔。她想起那个在马厩工作的高大、金发男孩，唐突但热情。她直到现在才领悟到自己曾爱过斯图尔。但她从未让他知道。她那时候还好年轻，过着无忧无虑的日子。在现在所有这之前，这一切之前，……在他之前。不是赛马库斯。是夜莺。她被自己的反应吓到。那男人还是能够让她心动。即便现在这个时刻。即便发生了这种种一切。她顿时被一股原始的情感所侵袭。<BR>
<BR>
当她最终冷静下来时，尤利尔·塞普汀消失了，而夜莺坐在他的位子上。<BR>
<BR>
“你早知道了”他边扫着她的脸部表情，平淡地说道，“你早知道了。瞬间就知道了。我原本想给你一个惊喜。你至少可以假装一下吧”<BR>
<BR>
巴兰兹娅将她的手臂放松，试图让体内那股吞噬自己的漩涡平缓下来。“我想我装模作样的本事比不上你，大人”<BR>
<BR>
他叹了口气。“你生气了”<BR>
<BR>
“我承认。是有那么一点”她冰冷地说道。“我不知道你怎么想，但我认为背叛是很严重的冒犯”<BR>
<BR>
“你好有人性啊”<BR>
<BR>
她深深吸了一口气“你要什么？”<BR>
<BR>
“现在换你在演戏了”他起身正面面对着她“你知道我想从你那得到什么”<BR>
<BR>
“你想要折磨我。请。我不会抵抗的。但不要碰我的孩子”<BR>
<BR>
“不、不、不。我不想要那样，巴兰兹娅”他逐渐贴近，用那低沉，抚慰，曾让她全身因愉悦而颤抖的声音说着。那声音现在，这个时刻，对她也有着同样的效果。“你不懂吗？这是唯一的方法”他的手握住了她的手臂。<BR>
<BR>
她感觉到自己的意志不再坚定，对他的厌恶逐渐转弱。“你本来可以带我走”突如其来的泪水湿透了眼眶。<BR>
<BR>
他摇摇头。“我没有那力量。啊，但是如今，现在……！我什么都有了。一切都在我的掌心，由我分享，由我给予……给你”他再次将自己的手指向窗外下的城市。“整个泰姆瑞尔都在你的脚下。而这还只是序章”<BR>
<BR>
“这一切太迟了。太迟了。你让我跟了他”<BR>
<BR>
“他死了。那个农夫死了。只是几年的光阴，那什么都不是”<BR>
<BR>
“孩子们……”<BR>
<BR>
“由我来领养。我们也会有自己的孩子，巴兰兹娅。他们会有多棒啊！我们可以传承下去的东西！你的美貌跟我的魔法。我的力量是你作梦也梦不到的，比你最疯狂的幻想还了不起！”他靠近巴兰兹娅想要吻她。<BR>
<BR>
她摆脱他的掌握，转过身说道。“我不相信你”<BR>
<BR>
“你知道你相信我。你只是心里还在生气罢了”他露出微笑。但他的眼睛却没有在笑。“告诉我你想要什么，巴兰兹娅。巴兰兹娅我的爱人。告诉我你想要什么，你就有什么”<BR>
<BR>
她的一生就这么闪过她眼前。过去，现在跟未知的未来。不同的时刻，不同的生活，不同的巴兰兹娅。哪一个才是真的？哪一个才是真的巴兰兹娅？一旦她做出抉择之后，她就会知道如何塑造她的命运。<BR>
<BR>
她决定了。她知道了。她知道哪一个才是真的巴兰兹娅。也知道自己想要什么。<BR>
<BR>
“在公园里散散步，我的大人”她说道。“或许再唱一两首小曲子”<BR>
<BR>
夜莺笑了。“你想要被追求”<BR>
<BR>
“何不呢？你那么在行。被你追求那也是好久以前的事了，而且，我还记得那滋味有多可口”<BR>
<BR>
他面带微笑说道。“恭敬不如从命，我的女王夫人，巴兰兹娅。你的愿望是我的使命”他拿起她的手并印上了一个吻。“从现在到永远都是”<BR>
<BR>
***<BR>
<BR>
他们就这样度过数个欢乐的日子，散步、一同谈天说笑。皇帝的职责全都丢给他的属下去执行。<BR>
<BR>
“我想要看看那把杖。”巴兰兹娅某天随口说出。“我那次只看到一眼，你还记得吧”<BR>
<BR>
他皱起眉头。“我想满足你所有的心愿，我亲爱的。但这是不可能的”<BR>
<BR>
“你不相信我”巴兰兹娅扁起嘴。但当他的嘴唇靠过来时她又软了下来。<BR>
<BR>
“没这回事，亲爱的。我当然相信你。但是杖不在这里”他咯咯地笑了起来。“事实上，杖不在任何地方”他又亲了她一次，这次更热情。<BR>
<BR>
“你又在说谜语了。我想看那把杖。你不可能把它毁了”<BR>
<BR>
“啊，自从上次之后你学聪明了”<BR>
<BR>
“你似乎激起了我求知的欲望”她站起来说道。“混沌之杖是无法被摧毁的。它也无法被带离泰姆瑞尔，这么做会让这片土地遭受难以想象的灾害”<BR>
<BR>
“啊，你真的很了不起，亲爱的。你说的都没错。它没有被摧毁，也没有被带离泰姆瑞尔。但是，就像我说的，它不在任何地方。你可以解出这个谜吗？”他将她拉近自己身边，而她顺从地窝在他怀里。“接下来还有一个更大的谜题”他悄悄地说道。“要如何让二合而为一？这个，就由我，来告诉你”他们的身体缠绵在一起，四肢缠绕着彼此。<BR>
<BR>
稍晚当他们的躯体稍微分开后，他已熟睡，但她还在睡梦中想着，“二分之一，一分为二，二分为三，三分为二……无法被摧毁，也无法被放逐的，也许被分割了……”<BR>
<BR>
她陡然站起来，眼睛散发光芒。她开始笑了。<BR>
<BR>
***<BR>
<BR>
夜莺平常有写日记的习惯。每晚听取下属的简报后会在里面做些简单的纪载。日记平常被锁在一个箱子内。但开锁不会是问题。毕竟她上一辈子也是盗贼公会的一员……上一辈子……另一个巴兰兹娅……<BR>
<BR>
某一天早晨，巴兰兹娅趁着夜莺在上厕所的时候偷偷阅读了日记的一小部分。她得知混沌之杖的第一个部位被藏在一个叫做利牙巢穴的古老矮人矿坑。但可惜的是矿坑的位置没有明确标示出来。日记的内容除了琐碎之外，速记的方式更是难以在一时之间理解。<BR>
<BR>
全泰姆瑞尔，她想着。在他跟我的手中，可能还有更多地方……但是……<BR>
<BR>
他虽然外在表现出热情如火的样子，但是内在，本该是心的地方却是冰冷空虚的。他自己似乎也没发现，她想着。不时可以发现他的眼神会突然放空，变得如铁石般钢硬。但是他依旧渴望，虽然他对幸福以及被满足仍有所渴求，但他对这两者的定义异于他人。农夫的梦想，巴兰兹娅想着，斯图尔闪过她的眼前，看起来既无助又难过。接着是赛瑞斯，有着卡吉特猫般的微笑。泰伯·塞普汀强大且孤单。赛马库斯，可靠、迟钝的赛马库斯。他知道什么事情该做，就会默默地，有效率地完成那事。夜莺。夜莺既是谜语又是真理。同时是黑暗也是光明。夜莺会统治一切，但不光是统治，他会以秩序之名带来混沌。<BR>
<BR>
巴兰兹娅好不容易才使他同意让她去探望孩子。那两个还不知道自己父亲已经过世，又被皇帝领养的小孩。她终究还是告诉了他们，这并不简单。莫加紧紧抓住她，好似一整个世代之久，啜泣的声音如刀在割着肉一般悲痛。赫尔塞斯独自一人跑去花园，事后也不愿意听任何关于他父亲的事情，也拒绝被她拥进怀里。<BR>
<BR>
艾德威尔国王有来拜访她。她告诉他事情的演变，以及近期的发现，跟他解释她得要继续留在皇宫以便获得更多情报。<BR>
<BR>
夜莺曾嘲笑过她有一个这么老的追求者。他很清楚知道艾德威尔对他的存疑，但是他一点也不在乎。没人会相信一个老疯子。巴兰兹娅甚至还安排两人修补关系。艾德威尔公开忏悔他的过错，而皇帝，他的“老朋友”也原谅他了。他事后每周至少会被请来共进晚餐一次。<BR>
<BR>
孩子们喜欢艾德威尔，就连赫尔塞斯也喜欢他。那个孩子强烈反对他母亲跟皇帝的关系，并且总是表达自己对皇帝的厌恶。随着日子的过去，他的态度逐渐恶化，情绪反应也越来越激动，不时跟他的母亲以及她的爱人吵架。艾德威尔也表达出对于这段关系的不满，但夜莺却乐于在公开场合上刻意展现自己对巴兰兹娅的感情来气这个老人。<BR>
<BR>
他们无法结婚，毕竟尤利尔·塞普汀是有妇之夫了。至少现在还不能结婚。夜莺窃取王位不久之后便将皇后放逐了，但他没有胆子杀害她，选择让她留在至尊神殿内。关于她生重病的传言不断流出，夜莺的特使也散播流言说她精神方面出了问题。皇帝的后裔们也被流放至泰姆瑞尔四处的“学院”，但那些事实上都是监狱。<BR>
<BR>
“她情况迟早会恶化”夜莺随口说道，指的是皇后。同时眼睛满足地盯着巴兰兹娅肿胀的胸部跟隆起的肚子。“至于皇帝的后裔呢……世事总是难料，对吧？我们会结婚。你的孩子会成为我真正的继承人”<BR>
<BR>
他真的很渴望那孩子。巴兰兹娅对这非常确定。但是她可是一点也不确定他对于她的感情。他们现在常常小吵，时而大吵，起因通常都是赫尔塞斯。夜莺想要把他送去夏暮岛，距离帝都最远的省分。巴兰兹娅对于这些争吵却从不闪躲，毕竟夜莺对于平淡无奇的日子不感兴趣。何况他对于床头吵完后，床尾和这件事也乐此不疲。<BR>
<BR>
巴兰兹娅有时会带着小孩们回她们以前的公寓住，并表示她不再愿意跟他有任何瓜葛。但是他总是会马上把她接回去，而她也总是会让自己被接回去。这情形不可言喻，就如同泰姆瑞尔的两个月亮升起跟落下一样。<BR>
<BR>
***<BR>
<BR>
当她解读出混沌之杖最后一个部位的下落时已经怀孕六个月了。最后一个地点不难找，任何一个暗精灵都知道达格斯·乌尔山脉在哪里。<BR>
<BR>
她再次跟夜莺吵架后，就直接跟着艾德威尔一路骑回高岩行省途歇城。夜莺对此感到怒不可遏，但却束手无撤。他的刺客有点无能，但自己也不敢离开王座亲自追逐。而且他也无法直接跟途歇城宣战。依法，他无权处置她跟她肚子里的小孩。不意外的，帝都的贵族阶层反对他跟巴兰兹娅的关系，就如同他们多年前反对她跟泰伯·塞普汀之间的关系一样。对贵族而言，他们乐于看她离开。<BR>
<BR>
途歇城也同样地不信任她，但这个富裕的小城邦的人民却疯狂地热爱他们的国王，也因此愿意妥协于他的一些……怪癖。巴兰兹娅生下她跟夜莺的小孩，一年之后跟艾德威尔完婚。尽管事情的演变不尽人意，但是艾德威尔却溺爱着巴兰兹娅跟她的小孩。她不爱他，但她喜欢他，这样也许也足够了。有一个人在身边很好，而途歇城是一个好所在，适合孩子们成长，适合等待，并祈祷勇者可以成功达成他的任务。<BR>
<BR>
巴兰兹娅希望这位无名的勇者可以尽快达成任务。她是暗精灵，时间对她而言不值钱。她要多少有多少。但是她已经无法爱人了，心中的仇恨也燃烧殆尽了。她一无所有了，只剩下痛楚跟回忆……还有她的孩子们。她只想把她的孩子们拉拔长大，让他们生活无虑，然后自己度过剩下的日子。她确信自己的日子还很长远，她只希望自己的灵魂还有心灵能维持平静跟安宁。农夫的梦想。那是她想要的。那是真的巴兰兹娅渴望的。那就是真的巴兰兹娅。农夫的梦想。<BR>
<BR>
农夫的梦想。<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
* ARRILLE'S TRADEHOUSE *<BR>
<BR>
Port of Seyda Neen<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Hereas at the general Sessions of the Peace held for the District of House Hlaalu at the Town of Balmora on the 16th day of First Seed in the year of the Reign of our Sovereign King Hlaalu Athyn Llethan, by the Grace of All Gods, King of Morrowind, Duke of Mournhold and Hlaalu Province; Defender of the People and the Law; Loyal Servant of the Empire; etc. <BR>
<BR>
Arrille of the Port of Seyda Neen aforesaid, hath entered into Recognizance with Sureties, before us his Majesty's Magistrates of Peace, within the said District, whose Names are hereunder written: <BR>
<BR>
We therefore his Majesty's said Magistrates, have hereby Licensed, and allowed the said Arrille to keep a Common Tradehouse, or Cornerclub, in the House wherein he now dwelleth, in the Port of Seyda Neen aforesaid, for three full years, from henceforth next ensuing, or till such other time as shall be by us, or some of our fellow Magistrates thereunto appointed; Provided that if the said Arrille do not from time to time during that time, well and truly observe the Articles hereafter mentioned, then this License shall presently cease, and be utterly void. <BR>
<BR>
1st Item, That the said Arrille shall not suffer any Stranger, or unknown Traveler, to Lodge, or Stay, in or about his House, above one Day and one Night, without making the same known forthwith to the next Bailiff, or other Officer of this Town, to the end that the said Stranger, or unknown Traveler may be examined, by some Magistrate of Peace near adjoining. <BR>
<BR>
2nd Item, That he shall not suffer any playing at Cards, Tables, Dice, Bowls, Nine-holes, or any other unlawful Game, or any Disorder, or Outrage in his House, Orchard, Garden, or Back-side, but shall keep good Order and Rule in his House.<BR>
<BR>
3rd Item, That he shall not suffer any neighbor's Children, Servants, or Slaves to Tipple in his House at all, nor any other to Tipple in his house, otherwise than by the Statutes are allowed.<BR>
<BR>
4th Item, That he doe not suffer any to Tipple in hours of Prayer, or Lesson, on any Emperor's or Festival days, nor at any time after the eighth hour of Night. <BR>
<BR>
5th Item, That he shall not harbor any Rogues, Vagabonds, Tradeless men, nor other suspicious Persons, in or about his House. <BR>
<BR>
6th Item, That he shall not Buy or take to Pawn, or suffer to be Bought or taken to Pawn in his House (to his knowledge) any goods of any unknown Traveler, or of any Neighbor's children, or Servants, or Slaves, or of any man's Wife, without the consent of their Parents, Masters, or Husbands respectively, and if any such Goods be offered to Sale, or Pawn, by any Stranger, he shall make the same known forthwith to the next Bailiff, or other Officer of the Town. <BR>
<BR>
7th Item, That he doe not sell his best Drink above Four Drakes the Gallon, nor the second sort above Two Drakes the Gallon, nor suffer any Ash-Fowl to be Dressed or Eaten in his House, or on any other Victuals prohibited by the Laws of this Realm. <BR>
<BR>
8th Item, That he shall not suffer any Bawdry, or Criminal Conversation, in or about his house, nor shall procure or cause to be Enticed any man to drink in his house, until he shall be Drunk, or distempered with Drink.<BR>
<BR>
9th Item, That he shall not suffer any Luting, Drumming, or Dancing, in or about his house, on any Lesson Day, nor in time of Divine Service, on any Sacred Festival, or Holy-day. <BR>
<BR>
10th Item, That he shall cause this License to be openly fixed up in the Hall-Room of his dwelling House, to the end that every one may see what Articles he is bound to observe. <BR>
<BR>
Dated the day and year first above written. <BR>
<BR>
Undersigned,<BR>
<BR>
Master Velanda Omani<BR>
Master Nevena Ules<BR>
Master Dram Bero<BR>
Master Crassius Curio<BR>
Master Yngling Half-Troll<BR>

<BR>

<BR>
条款七，在酒水类商品方面，最佳的酒水类商品售价不得超过4龙币/加仑，次佳的酒水类商品售价不得超过2龙币/加仑，不允许在房屋内饲养或者食用任何灰烬禽类，以及本王国法律所禁止的任何食物。<BR>
<BR>
条款八，不得在房屋内或周围与任何通缉人士进行交谈，也不得促使或诱使他人在其房屋内饮酒至引发酗酒事件。<BR>
<BR>
条款九，不得在任何祈祷、授课的时间段内，或是在任何神圣节日或帝国相关的节日内在房屋内或附近组织任何鲁特琴、鼓等乐器演奏以及舞蹈活动。<BR>
<BR>
条款十，上述阿里尔应将本许可证公开置于其住宅主厅内，使每个人都能够看到他所必须遵守的各项条款。<BR>
<BR>
日期为上述第一段中的日期。<BR>

> BOOK.TEXT bk_note
"""<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
I am forever swimming around, amidst this ocean world we call home. My limbs grow weak and weary as my eyes drift skyward in defeat. I remember how warm the earth felt, as I lived and breathed next to her beating heart. I remember enough to keep searching through an ocean of tears, raised to astronomical depths. My dreams offer solace, where I return to distant, faded times. Through trees entwined with cool autumn air, my sorrow is lured by fragrant, bittersweet memories. I am at home as much as my world and consciousness allow. I remember falling into the most beautiful lake I've ever experienced. She swallowed me whole, like a droplet, and I was enraptured and enwombed within her bliss. The lonely windswept desert sky of my soul was filled by her luminous stars and warmed by her sunlit radiance. I gazed downward in awe and saw it all reflected in the shimmering ripples dancing and playing about the surface. It appeared to me as real as the very wonders it was reflecting. I stepped forward to prove to no one and everyone that they were, by belief. For an aching instant I was betwixt the two and the summation. Confusion befell me and I fell through, only to realize I hadn't entered the lake, I had left it. With all of my remaining life I howled at the heavens and collapsed, like a star on the shores of my youth, as my life's breath wandered away from the home it had harbored. I have been drowning on dry land ever since.<BR>
<BR>
I lay there, coital, for heaven knows how long. I felt eons ebb and flow in the spans of seconds. I lived as intently as I could in those endless instants, as the boredom of -after- droned on and on. The fires of my heart grew dim and became only the faintest embers of the roaring blaze they had once been. My limbs, heavy with the weight of the world, protested. I felt the longing of this life which slowly began to ease the agony in my heart. As I was gradually nursed back to health, knowledge of record and history tried desperately to fill the yawning, nauseous chasm of my soul. I began to know the deadpan search for freedom and forgetfulness, and I released the hold on my life. Though it still lurched, pained, in front of me, I just stared back with tired, vacant eyes as if watching the most fascinating of nothing. My mind drifted, only to be slammed back reluctantly, repeatedly, and painfully by those I vaguely remember knowing, as if from a different life and age. I try, in vain, to forgive and forget myself as I paste on those plaster smiles and strain to look levelly. I remember. I forget. I forget again. I remember less. I am saddened at the thought that I have forgotten. I am not who I used to be. Though it pained me so, I was never so real as those lonely, lost times of my undoing. I am torn asunder at the thought of losing forever that, which has changed my life eternally, and that which I fear in the depths of my soul will never be again. That, which has gifted me with more pain than I have ever known in all of my lives or all of the lives that I know through my own.<BR>
<BR>
Who am I to ask this of you?<BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
我永远在这个我们称之为家的海洋世界中游行。当我的眼睛因失败而飘向天空时，我的四肢变得虚弱和疲倦。我记得当我在她跳动的心脏旁边生活和呼吸时，大地感到多么温暖。我记得足够多，一直在泪水的海洋中寻找，上升到天文深度。我的梦想提供了慰藉，在那里我回到了遥远的、褪色的时代。穿过秋天凉爽的空气缠绕的树木，我的悲伤被芬芳，苦乐参半的回忆所吸引。只要我的世界和意识允许，我就在家。我记得掉进了我所经历过的最美丽的湖中。她像一滴水一样把我整个吞了下去，我欣喜若狂，沉浸在她的幸福中。我灵魂孤独的被风吹过的沙漠天空被她明亮的星星填满，被她阳光照耀的光芒所温暖。我敬畏地向下凝视，看到这一切都反映在波光粼粼的涟漪中，在水面上翩翩起舞。在我看来，它就像它所反映的奇迹一样真实。我挺身而出，向任何人和每个人证明他们是，凭着信念。有一瞬间，我在两者和总和之间感到痛苦。混乱降临在我身上，我跌倒了，才意识到我没有进入湖，我已经离开了。余生向天嚎啕倒塌，如同青春海岸上的一颗星，生命的气息从它所藏匿的家中飘散而去。从那以后我就一直淹死在枯地上。<BR>
<BR>
我躺在那里，深陷欲望，天知道躺了多久。我感到万古在几秒钟内潮起潮落。我尽可能专注地生活在那些无休止的瞬间，因为无聊的事后嗡嗡声不断地响起。我心中的火焰变得暗淡，变成了曾经熊熊燃烧的火焰中最微弱的余烬。我的四肢因世界的重量而沉重，抗议。我感受到了对今生的向往，慢慢开始缓解我心中的痛苦。随着我逐渐恢复健康，有关记录和历史的知识拼命地试图填补我灵魂打哈欠、令人作呕的鸿沟。我开始懂得了寻找自由和健忘的面无表情，我也松开了对生活的束缚。尽管它仍然在我面前晃动、疼痛，但我只是用疲倦、空洞的眼睛盯着回看，仿佛在注视着最迷人的一切。我的思绪飘荡，却又不情愿地、反复地、痛苦地被那些我依稀记得认识的人撞了回来，仿佛来自不同的生活和年龄。当我粘贴在那些石膏微笑上并努力看起来平淡时，我试图原谅并忘记自己，但徒劳无功。我记得。我忘了。我又忘记了。我记得比较少。想到自己忘记了，我很难过。我不是以前的我了。虽然这让我很痛苦，但我从来没有像那些孤独、迷失的失败时光那样真实。一想到要永远失去那永远改变了我生活的东西，而我在灵魂深处害怕的东西永远不会再出现，我就心碎了。那给我带来的痛苦比我一生中所知道的或我通过我自己所知道的所有生命中所知道的更多。<BR>
<BR>
我有什么资格向你索求？<BR>"""

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Great Houses of Morrowind<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
In modern times Morrowind is ruled by five Great Houses: House Hlaalu, House Redoran, House Telvanni, House Indoril, and House Dres. Only three of these Houses have interests in Vvardenfell. The three Great Houses on Vvardenfell identify themselves by their traditional colors: red for Redoran, yellow for Hlaalu, and brown for Telvanni. Thus, members of House Hlaalu may be referred to collectively as Yellows.<BR>
<BR>
The Great Houses traditions derive from ancient Dunmer clan and tribes, but now function as political parties. Dunmer Great House membership is largely a matter of birth and marriage, but Imperial colonists may also become retainers of a Great House, or may be adopted into a Great House. Initially an outlander may gain status in a house as an oath-bonded hireling, pledging exclusive loyalty to a single house and forsaking ambitions with all other houses. Later, after faithful service and advancement in lower ranks, an outlander may seek adoption into a Great House. Adoption and advancement to higher ranks in a Great House requires that a Great House councilor stand as sponsor for the candidate's character and loyalty. Finding a councilor to sponsor an outlander often involves performing a great service for the prospective sponsor.<BR>
<BR>
House Redoran is one of the three Dunmer Great Houses with holdings on Vvardenfell. The Redoran prize the virtues of duty, gravity, and piety. Duty is to one's own honor, and to one's family and clan. Gravity is the essential seriousness of life. Life is hard, and events must be judged, endured, and reflected upon with due care and earnestness. Piety is respect for the gods, and the virtues they represent. A light, careless life is not worth living. Redoran settlements are designed in the Dunmer village style, built of local materials, with organic curves and undecorated exteriors inspired by the landscape and by the shells of giant native insects.  Redoran villages are typically centered on Temple compounds and their courtyards, with huts and tradehouses gathered around a central plaza, as in the West Gash village of Gnisis. Ald'ruhn, the Redoran district seat, is exceptional, with its distinctive feature being the colossal prehistoric bug shell that has been adapted as the house's council house.<BR>
<BR>
As a result of its close relationship with the Imperial administration, House Hlaalu has emerged as politically and economically dominant among the Great Houses of Vvardenfell and Morrowind. Hlaalu welcomes Imperial culture and law, Imperial Legions and bureaucracy, and Imperial freedom of trade and religion. Hlaalu still honors the old Dunmer ways -- the ancestors, the Temple, and the noble houses -- but has readily adapted to the rapid pace of change and progress in the Imperial provinces. Unlike the other Great Houses, which are largely hostile to non-Dunmer, House Hlaalu aspires to live in peace and harmony with the other races, and to share in the growth and prosperity of the Empire. Hlaalu public buildings -- tradehouses and craft guilds, manors and council halls -- are designed as simple multi-storied buildings roughly rectangular in plan, featuring arched entranceways and modest decorated exteriors. More modest one-story private dwellings follow the same plan, except with less decoration. Hlaalu plantation estates resemble Temple compounds, with walled precincts enclosing outbuildings for craftsmen and servants, dominated by a grand manor residence in place of a Temple shrine.<BR>
<BR>
The wizard-lords of House Telvanni have traditionally isolated themselves, pursuing wisdom and mastery in solitude. But certain ambitious wizards-lords, their retainers, and clients have entered whole-heartedly into the competition to control and exploit Vvardenfell's land and resources, building towers and bases all along the eastern coast. According to Telvanni principles, the powerful define the standards of virtue, and the Telvanni are unwilling to allow the ambitious Hlaalu to dominate Vvardenfell's untapped resources by default. Telvanni architecture is dominated by the wizards' tower, a fantastic organic form grown and sculpted from stems, caps, and root-like holdfasts of the giant native mushrooms. Telvanni villages are comprised of smaller mushroom pods hollowed out for craftsmen and commoners. Open-air markets often include the giant cages displaying the wares of the slave masters.<BR>
<BR>
House Indoril and House Dres are the two Great Houses without holdings or interest in Vvardenfell. Indoril District occupies the heartland of Morrowind, comprising the lands south of the Inner Sea and the eastern coast. The city of Almalexia is located in Indoril District, and the Indoril are orthodox and conservative supporters of the Temple and Temple authority. House Indoril is openly hostile to Imperial culture and religion, and preserves many traditional Dunmer customs and practices in defiance of Imperial law. Dres District is in the south of Morrowind, bordering the swamps and marshes of Black Marsh. House Dres is an agrarian agricultural society, and its large saltrice plantations rely completely on slave labor for their economic viability. Always firm Temple supporters, House Dres is hostile to Imperial law and culture, and in particular opposed to any attempts to limit the institution of slavery.<BR>
<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
晨风大家族<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
在现代，晨风由五个大家族统治：哈拉鲁家族、瑞多然家族、泰瓦尼家族、因多瑞尔家族和德雷斯家族。这些家族中只有三个对瓦登费尔有兴趣。瓦登费尔上的三个大家族以其传统颜色来标识自己：瑞多然为红色，哈拉鲁为黄色，泰瓦尼为棕色。因此，哈拉鲁家族的成员可以统称为黄旗人。<BR>
<BR>
大家族的传统源自古老的丹莫氏族和部落，但现在作为政党发挥作用。丹莫大家族的成员身份，很大程度上是出身和婚姻的问题，但帝国人殖民者也有可能成为大家族的家臣，或者被收进大家族。最初，外来者可能会在一个家族中获得身份，成为一个誓言契约的雇佣兵，承诺对一个家族完全忠诚，并放弃对所有其他家族的野心。后来，在忠实的服务和较低级别的晋升之后，外来者可能会寻求收养进入大家族。大家族的收养和晋升需要一位大家族议员作为候选人的品格和忠诚度的赞助商。寻找一位赞助外地人的议员通常需要为潜在赞助商提供出色的服务。<BR>
<BR>
瑞多然家族是拥有瓦登费尔的三大丹莫家族之一。瑞多然重视责任、严肃和虔诚的美德。责任是对自己的荣誉，对家庭和宗族。重力是生命本质的严肃性。生活是艰难的，必须以应有的谨慎和认真来判断、忍受和反思事件。虔诚是对诸神及其所代表的美德的尊重。轻率、粗心的生活不值得过。瑞多然定居点采用丹莫村风格设计，采用当地材料建造，具有有机曲线和未装饰的外观，其灵感来自景观和巨型本土昆虫的贝壳。瑞多然村庄通常以寺庙大院及其庭院为中心，小屋和贸易房屋聚集在中央广场周围，如西境之痕的村庄尼希斯。瑞多然区域的中心城镇奥德'汝因与众不同，其独特之处在于巨大的史前帝王蟹的蟹壳被改造成了该家族的议会中心。<BR>
<BR>
由于与帝国政府的密切关系，哈拉鲁家族在瓦登费尔和晨风两大家族中成为政治和经济上的主导者。哈拉鲁欢迎帝国人的文化和法律，帝国人的军团和官僚机构，以及帝国人的贸易和宗教自由。哈拉鲁仍然崇尚古老的丹莫方式——先祖、寺庙和贵族庄园——但已经适应了帝国各省快速变化和进步的步伐。与其他主要对非丹莫敌视的大家族不同，哈拉鲁家族渴望与其他种族和平和谐相处，并分享帝国的发展和繁荣。哈拉鲁公共建筑——贸易行和工艺行会、庄园和议会大厅——被设计成简单的多层建筑，平面大致呈矩形，具有拱形入口和朴素的装饰外观。更朴素的一层私人住宅遵循相同的计划，只是装饰较少。哈拉鲁种植园类似于寺庙大院，有围墙的区域围绕着工匠和仆人的附属建筑，由一座宏伟的庄园住宅代替寺庙神殿。<BR>
<BR>
泰瓦尼家族的巫师领主传统上孤立自己，在孤独中追求智慧和精通。但是某些雄心勃勃的巫师领主、他们的家臣和客户全心全意地参与了争夺瓦登费尔的土地和资源的控制和开发，在东海岸建造塔楼和基地。根据泰瓦尼的原则，强者定义了美德的标准，泰瓦尼人不愿意让野心勃勃的哈拉鲁默认支配瓦登费尔的未开发资源。泰瓦尼的建筑以巫师塔为主，这是一种奇妙的有机形式，由巨大的原生蘑菇的茎、帽和根状固定物生长和雕刻而成。泰瓦尼村庄由为工匠和平民挖空的较小的蘑菇荚组成。露天市场通常包括展示奴隶主商品的巨大笼子。<BR>
<BR>
因多瑞尔家族和德雷斯家族是两个对于瓦登费尔区没有控股或权益的大家族。因多瑞尔区位于晨风的大陆中心地带，包括内海以南和东海岸的土地。阿玛莱西娅的哀伤之城位于因多瑞尔区，因多瑞尔人是正统和保守的审判席以及审判席权威的支持者。因多瑞尔家族公然敌视帝国人的文化和宗教，并保留了许多传统的丹莫习俗和习俗，蔑视帝国人的法律。德雷斯区位于晨风南部，与黑沼泽的影沼接壤。德雷斯家族是一个农业社会，其大型盐田种植园完全依赖奴隶劳动来维持经济生存。一向坚定的审判席支持者，德雷斯家族对帝国人的法律和文化充满敌意，尤其反对任何限制奴隶制度的企图。<BR>

I. Purpose<BR>
<BR>
The Guild of Mages provides benefits to scholars of magic and established laws regarding the proper use of magic. The Guild is dedicated to the collection, preservation, and distribution of magical knowledge with an emphasis on ensuring that all citizens of Tamriel benefit from this knowledge.<BR>
<BR>
II. Authority<BR>
<BR>
The Guild of Mages was established on Summerset Isle in the year 230 of the Second Era by Vanus Galerion and Rilis XII. It was later confirmed by the "Guilds Act" of Potentate Versidue-Shaie.<BR>

III. Rules and Procedures<BR>

Crimes against fellow members of the Guild are treated with the harshest discipline. Whether a member may regain their status in the Guild is determined by the Arch-Mage.<BR>

<BR>
The Guild of Mages only accepts candidates of keen intelligence and dominant will. Candidates must exhibit mastery in the great schools of magic: Destruction, Alteration, Illusion, and Mysticism. Candidates must also display practical knowledge of enchantments and alchemical processes.<BR>
<BR>
V. Applications for Membership<BR>
<BR>
Candidates must present themselves to the Steward of the Guild Hall for examination and approval.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Imperial Charter of the Guild of Fighters<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
I. Purpose<BR>
<BR>
The Guild of Fighters provides employment to free-swords and mercenaries and contracts to local citizens. The Guild of Fighters was established under the section 4 of the "Guilds Act," and this charter was first confirmed under the Potentate Versidue-Shaie in the 321st year of the Second Era.<BR>
<BR>
III. Rules and Procedures<BR>
<BR>
Any member of the Guild of Fighters who strikes or steals from another member shall be expelled from the Guild. Re-admittance is at the discretion of the Guild Stewards.<BR>
<BR>
Citizens who contract with the Guild of Fighters and have a dispute may appeal first to the Guild Steward who accepted the contract and second with the authorities of each Province.<BR>
<BR>
IV. Membership Requirements<BR>
<BR>
The Guild selects candidates who are strong and healthy. A candidate must have some proficiency with long blades, axes, blunt weapons, and shields. Guildsmen must be able to use and maintain heavy armor.<BR>
<BR>
V. Applications for Membership<BR>
<BR>
Candidates must present themselves to the Steward of the Guild Hall for examination and approval.<BR>
<BR>
ATTACHMENT A: Fighters Guild Chapters in Vvardenfell District, Province of Morrowind<BR>
<BR>
Chapters are established in Guild-owned, free-standing guildhalls in the towns of Ald'ruhn and Balmora. The chapter in Sadrith Mora is established in Wolverine Hall under lease from the Telvanni Council. The chapter in Vivec is established in the Foreign Quarter under lease from the Tribunal Temple.<BR>

The Mystery of Princess Talara, Part III<BR>
By Mera Llykith<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Gnorbooth was leaving his favorite pub in Camlorn, The Breaking Branch, when he heard someone calling his name.  His was not the sort of a name that could be mistaken for another.  He turned and saw Lord Eryl, the Royal Battlemage from the palace, emerge from the darkness of the alley.<BR>
<BR>
$93Milord,$94 said Gnorbooth with a pleasant smile.<BR>
<BR>
$93I'm surprised to see you out this evening, Gnorbooth,$94 grinned Lord Eryl with a most unpleasant smile. $93I have not seen you and your master very much since the millennial celebration, but I understand you've been very busy.  What I've been wondering is what you've been busy doing.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93Protecting the Imperial interests in Camlorn is busy work, milord.  But I cannot imagine you would be interested in the minutiae of the ambassador's appointments.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93But I am,$94 said the battlemage. $93Especially as the ambassador has begun acting most mysteriously, most undiplomatically lately.  And I understand that he has taken one of the whores from the Flower Festival into his house.  I believe her name is Gyna?$94<BR>
<BR>
Gnorbooth shrugged: $93He's in love, I would imagine, milord.  It can make men act very strangely, as I'm sure you've heard before.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93She is a most comely wench,$94 laughed Lord Eryl. $93Have you noticed how much she resembles the late Princess Talara?$94<BR>
<BR>
$93I have only been in Camlorn for fifteen years, milord.  I never saw her late majesty.$94<BR>
<BR>

That hardly sounds like molten passion to me, even based on my limited experience.$94 Lord Eryl rolled his eyes. $93And what is this business he has now in - oh, what is the name of that village?$94<BR>
<BR>
$93Umbington?$94 replied Gnorbooth, and immediately wished he hadn't.  Lord Eryl was too canny an actor to reveal it, but Gnorbooth knew at the pit of his stomach that the battlemage did not even know Lord Strale had left the capitol.  He had to get away to let the ambassador know, but there was still a game to be carefully played. $93He's not leaving for there until tomorrow.  I believe it's just to put a stamp on some deed that needs the Imperial seal.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93Is that all?  How tedious for the poor fellow.  I suppose I'll see him when he returns then,$94 Lord Eryl bowed. $93Thank you for being so informative.  Farewell.$94<BR>
<BR>
The moment the royal battlemage turned the corner, Gnorbooth leapt onto his horse.  He had drunk one or two ales too many, but he knew he must find his way to Umbington before Lord Eryl's agents did.  He galloped east out of the capitol, hoping there were signs along the road.<BR>
<BR>
Seated in a tavern that smelled of mildew and sour beer, Lord Strale marveled at how the Emperor's agent Lady Brisienna always found the most public of places for her most private of conferences.  It was harvest time in Umbington, and all of the field hands were drinking away their meager wages in the noisiest of fashions.  He was dressed appropriately for the venue, rough trousers and a simple peasant's vest, but he still felt conspicuous.  In comparison to his two female companions, he certainly was.  The woman to his right was used to frequenting the low places of Daggerfall as a common prostitute.  Lady Brisienna to his left was even more clearly in her element.<BR>
<BR>
$93By what name would you prefer I call you?$94 Lady Brisienna asked solicitously.<BR>
<BR>
$93I am used to the name Gyna, though that may have to change,$94 was her reply. $93Of course, it may not.  Gyna the Whore may be the name writ on my grave.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93I will see to it that there is no attempt on your life like that the Flower Festival,$94 Lord Strale frowned. $93But without the Emperor's help, I won't be able to protect you forever.  The only permanent solution is to capture those who would do you harm and then to raise you to your proper station.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93Do you believe my story?$94 Gyna turned to Lady Brisienna.<BR>
<BR>
$93I have been the Emperor's chief agent in High Rock for many years now, and I have heard few stranger tales.  If your friend the ambassador hadn't investigated and discovered what he has, I would have dismissed you outright as a madwoman,$94 Brisienna laughed, forcing a smile onto Gyna's face to match. $93But now, yes, I do believe you.  Perhaps that makes me the madwoman.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93Will you help us?$94 asked Lord Strale simply.<BR>
<BR>
$93It is a tricky business interfering in the affairs of the provincial kingdoms,$94 Lady Brisienna looked into the depths of her mug thoughtfully. $93Unless there is a threat to the Empire itself, we find it is best not to meddle.  What we have in your case is a very messy assassination that happened twenty years ago, and its aftermath.  If His Imperial Majesty involved itself in every bloody hiccup in the succession in each of his thousand vassal kingdoms, he would never accomplish anything for the greater good of Tamriel.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93I understand,$94 murmured Gyna. $93When I remembered everything, who I was and what happened to me, I resolved to do nothing about it.  In fact, I was leaving Camlorn and going back home to Daggerfall when I saw Lord Strale again.  He was the one who began this quest to resolve this, not me.  And when he brought me back, I only wanted to see my cousin to tell her who I was, but he forbade me.$94<BR>
$93It would have been too dangerous,$94 growled Strale. $93We still don't know yet the depths of the conspiracy.  Perhaps we never will.$94<BR>

But for this to turn out well, you must accomplish two things to the Emperor's satisfaction.  First, you must prove with absolute certainty who is the power behind this plot you've uncovered.  You must get someone to confess.$94<BR>

Lord Strale, Lady Brisienna, and the woman who called herself Gyna discussed how to accomplish their goals for a few hours more.  When it was agreed what had to be done, Lady Brisienna took her leave to find her ally Proseccus.  Strale and Gyna set off to the west, toward Camlorn.  It was not long after beginning their ride through the woods that they heard the sound of galloping hoof beats far up ahead.  Lord Strale unsheathed his sword and signaled for Gyna to position her horse behind him.<BR>

$93I'm sorry, milord,$94 groaned Gnorbooth. $93I tried to warn you as soon as I could.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93In your next life, perhaps you'll remember not to trust your plans to a drunkard!$94 laughed Lord Eryl.  He had them in his sight, and the spell was unleashed.<BR>

Gnorbooth saw him first, by the light of the ball of fire that leapt from his fingertips.  Later, Lord Eryl was to wonder to himself what the fool had intended to do.  Perhaps he was rushing forward to pull Lord Strale out of the path.  Perhaps he was trying to flee the path of destruction, and had simply moved left when he should have moved right.  Perhaps, as unlikely as it seemed, he was willing to sacrifice himself to save his master.  Whatever the reason, the result was the same. <BR>
<BR>
He got in the way.<BR>

On the few square feet where Gnorbooth and his horse had stood was nothing but black glass.  They had been reduced to less than vapor.  Gyna and Lord Strale were thrown back.  Their horse, when it recovered its senses, galloped away as fast as it could.  In the lingering glowing aura of the spell's detonation, Lord Strale looked straight into the woods and into the wide eyes of the battlemage.  <BR>
<BR>
$93Damn,$94 said Lord Eryl and began to run.  The ambassador jumped to his feet and pursued.<BR>
<BR>
$93That was an expensive use of magicka, even for you,$94 said Lord Strale as he ran. $93Don't you know well enough not to use ranged spells unless you are certain your target won't be blocked?$94<BR>
<BR>

<BR>
$93It doesn't matter what you thought,$94 said Lord Strale calmly, flipping the battlemage around and pinning his arms to the ground with his knees. $93I'm not a battlemage, but I knew enough not to use my entire reserve on your little ambush.  Perhaps it's a matter of philosophy, as a government agent, I feel inclined toward conservatism.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93What are you going to do?$94 whimpered Lord Eryl.<BR>
<BR>
$93Gnorbooth was a good man, one of the best, and so I'm going to hurt you quite a lot,$94 the ambassador made a slight movement and his hands began to glow brightly. $93That's a certainty.  How much more I'm going to hurt you after that depends on what you tell me.  I want to hear about the former Duke of Oloine.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93What do you want to know?$94 Lord Eryl screamed.<BR>
<BR>
$93Let's start with everything,$94 replied Lord Strale with perfect patience.<BR>

“我在卡姆隆只待了十五年，我的大人，我从未一睹她的芳容。”<BR>
<BR>
“那我现在能明白他为何创作诗歌了，但恋爱中的男人干嘛还要整天待在宫廷的厨房里，和他的老仆从聊天？即使从我有限的经历来看，那也是十分没意思的一件事。”艾瑞尔大人眼睛一转，?“他现在在处理什么事情——噢，对了，那个村子叫什么名字？”<BR>
<BR>
“乌宾顿？”格诺布斯回答道，但他很快就后悔这么说了。艾瑞尔狡猾地获取了这个情报，但格诺布斯明白至少这个法师还不知道斯查尔大人已经离开了首都。他必须立刻离开通知大使，但是对话的博弈还在继续。“明天之前他还不会启程去那里，我觉得他还需要给一些帝国文件盖章封印。”<BR>
<BR>
“完了？真够无聊的。我相信他回来的时候我会见到他的，”艾瑞尔欠了欠身，“谢谢你告诉我这么多，再会。”<BR>
<BR>
当皇家法师刚刚转过街道的拐角，格诺布斯立刻骑上了他的马。他之前喝了不少啤酒，但他知道他必须赶在艾瑞尔的密探之前到达乌宾顿。他一路向首都以东飞奔，希望路上能有一些标识。<BR>
<BR>
斯查尔王坐在一家散发着霉味和酸啤酒味的小酒馆中，他很惊诧为什么皇帝的代表布里西耶娜女士总会找一个最大众化的地方来进行她的私人会晤。现在已经到了乌宾顿的收获季节，在一片嘈杂中，所有农夫都将自己微薄的收入捐给了酒馆的啤酒。他穿着十分得体，粗布的裤子加简单的外套，但他依然觉得自己很显眼。与他的两个女性同伴相比，他的确是这样。他右边的女的穿着像匕落的下层平民，像一个妓女一样。他左边的布里西耶娜女士比前者更甚。<BR>
<BR>
“请问我应该如何称呼您？”布里西耶娜女士热切地问道。<BR>
<BR>
“我叫吉娜，不过可能要改名了。”她这样回答道，“当然，也可能不会。妓女吉娜或许将刻在我的墓碑上。”<BR>
<BR>
“我相信你以后不会再经历像百花节那样的事情了，”斯查尔王皱了皱眉，“但是没有皇帝的帮助，我也没办法一直保护着你。一劳永逸的唯一办法就是把那些可能伤害你的人抓起来，并给予你合适的地位。”<BR>
<BR>
“你相信我的故事吗？”吉娜问布里西耶娜女士道。<BR>
<BR>
“许多年来我一直都是皇帝在高岩的首席代表，我也没怎么听说过比这还要离奇的故事。如果你的大使朋友没有调查出什么结果，我可能就会误认为你是个疯子。”布里西耶娜笑道，同时吉娜也不得不笑脸以对，“但现在，我的确能相信你。可能它让我也变得疯狂了。”<BR>
<BR>
“你愿意帮助我们吗？”斯查尔直白地问道。<BR>
<BR>
“这件棘手的事情涉及到整个省的王国事务，”布里西耶娜女士看着她面前的大杯沉思道，?“除非它威胁到帝国本身，否则我想还是不要去干涉。你们的事情就是二十年前发生的一件肮脏的刺杀，以及它的余波。如果帝国皇帝要在每个附属国中都插手这样的血腥案件的话，他在泰姆瑞尔将一事无成。”<BR>
<BR>
“我明白，”吉娜咕哝着，“从我记事的时候起，我就决定不再做任何有关这个的事情。事实上，我正离开卡姆隆然后回到匕落的家中的时候又一次看见了斯查尔王。他才是这件事的发起者，不是我。当他把我送回来的时候，我只想告诉我的表姐我是谁，但是他不让我这么做。”<BR>
“那还是太危险了，”斯查尔低声说，“我们还不清楚这个阴谋涉及得有多深。可能我们永远都不会知道。”<BR>
<BR>
“很抱歉，我总是为一个短的问题进行很长的解释。当斯查尔王问我能否提供帮助时，我本该说‘是的’。”布里西耶娜女士不禁对斯查尔王的表情以及吉娜的话感到有趣。“我当然会帮助你们，但是要让这件事顺利，你们必须完成皇帝的两个要求。首先，你们必须找到这件事的幕后操纵者是谁，必须找到一个证人。”<BR>
<BR>
“其次，”斯查尔王点头说道，“要向皇帝证明这是一件关乎他的帝国威严的大事，而不仅仅是一件当地鸡毛蒜皮的小事。”<BR>
<BR>
斯查尔王，布里西耶娜女士，和那个自称吉娜的女人又花了几个小时来讨论如何完成他们的目标。当他们达成共识后，布里西耶娜女士启程找到她的盟友布罗西卡斯。斯查尔和吉娜向西移动，前往卡姆隆。他们在树林中没走多久就听到了前方有一片急促的马蹄声。斯查尔王拔出了他的剑并示意吉娜让她的马紧跟在自己身后。<BR>
<BR>
这时，他们遭到了包围。这是个埋伏，有八个装备着手斧的人，在这里等着他们。<BR>
<BR>
斯查尔王一下把吉娜从马上拉了下来，让她躲在自己身后。他的手做了个灵巧而简单的动作。一个火焰之环出现在他的周围，然后迅速爆发，撞向了那些袭击者。那些人痛苦地叫喊着倒在了地上。斯查尔王跃上了一匹最靠近的马，向西全速飞奔。<BR>
<BR>
“我一直以为你是个大使而不是法师。”吉娜嘲弄道。<BR>
<BR>
“我相信还是有时间利用外交手段的。”斯查尔王回答道。<BR>
<BR>
此时一个他们刚才听到的人骑着马与他们在路上相遇。这个人是格诺布斯，?“大人，那是战斗法师。他发现了你们在乌宾顿！”<BR>
<BR>
“在更缓和的情况下，我可能得多说两句，”艾瑞儿大人的声音从树林间传出，格诺布斯、吉娜和斯查尔王扫视了一圈漆黑的树林，但是什么也没看见。战斗法师的声音好像是无所不在一般。<BR>
<BR>
“对不起，我的大人，”格诺布斯呻吟道，“我已经尽我最快的速度来通知您了。”<BR>
<BR>
“等你下辈子的时候，你要记住千万别向一个醉鬼透露你的计划。”艾瑞儿大人笑道，他看到了他们，然后将魔法发射了出去。<BR>
<BR>
透过他手上火球的闪耀光芒，格诺布斯首先看到了他。很快，艾瑞儿大人不明白这个傻瓜想要去干嘛。可能他想冲到前面把斯查尔王拉开。也可能他想逃跑，然后跑错了方向。也有极小的可能，他会牺牲自己来救他的主人。不管是什么原因，结局已经注定。<BR>
<BR>
他一下就撞上了火球。<BR>
<BR>
一瞬间能量的爆炸照亮了整个漆黑的夜晚，而不绝于耳的巨大响声让一英里内的飞禽都四散奔逃。格诺布斯和他的马之前所处的位置现在只剩一片黑色的晶体。他们被瞬间蒸发了。吉娜和斯查尔王被气浪冲倒。他们的马在恢复意识后，立刻以最快的速度逃窜而去。在爆炸的烟雾弥漫之中，斯查尔一下就在树林中发现了战斗法师的踪迹。<BR>
<BR>
“见鬼，”艾瑞尔大人说着并开始逃跑。大使在他身后紧追不舍。<BR>
<BR>
“即使是对你来说，那也是对魔法的极大消耗，”穷追不舍的斯查尔王说道，“难道你不知道除非你的目标不会被阻挡，否则绝不要使用范围魔法的道理吗？”<BR>
<BR>
“真想不到——那个白痴——”在他哀叹的时候，艾瑞尔被从身后的攻击一下击倒在冰冷的地面上。<BR>
<BR>
“你怎么想已经无关紧要了，”斯查尔王冷静地说道，然后将战斗法师翻了过来并且捆上了他的手脚，“我不是战斗法师，但我很明白你这小小的埋伏不足以让我动用全部的力量。或许这是个哲学问题，作为政府的代表，我更倾向于更传统的方式。”<BR>
<BR>
“你想干嘛？”艾瑞尔呜咽道。<BR>
<BR>
“格诺布斯是个好人，他是最好的护卫，所以你必须为此付出代价。”大使略微移动了下，他的手上也变得越来越亮，“这是毫无疑问的。我要让你吃多少苦头取决于你告诉我多少。告诉我前公爵奥罗尼的事。”<BR>
<BR>
“你想知道什么？”艾瑞尔大人惊声叫道。<BR>
<BR>
“让我们从头开始，”斯查尔王极有耐心地答道。<BR>
<BR>

Aedra and Daedra<BR><BR>

The designations of Gods, Demons, Aedra, and Daedra, are universally confusing to the layman. They are often used interchangeably.<BR>
<BR>
"Aedra" and "Daedra" are not relative terms. They are Elvish and exact. Azura is a Daedra both in Skyrim and Morrowind. "Aedra" is usually translated as "ancestor," which is as close as Cyrodilic can come to this Elven concept. "Daedra" means, roughly, "not our ancestors." This distinction was crucial to the Dunmer, whose fundamental split in ideology is represented in their mythical genealogy.<BR>
<BR>
Aedra are associated with stasis. Daedra represent change.<BR>
<BR>
Aedra created the mortal world and are bound to the Earth Bones. Daedra, who cannot create, have the power to change.<BR>
<BR>
As part of the divine contract of creation, the Aedra can be killed. Witness Lorkhan and the moons.<BR>
<BR>
The protean Daedra, for whom the rules do not apply, can only be banished. <BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
It's been many days since the collapse. I have had many good and exciting adventures. I fear this is the last. I am still unsure what happened. Was it a trap that caused the collapse? I didn't hear the click of any device. Perhaps it was simply a freak accident, and I was simply in the wrong place at the right time. Regardless, I now lie here, half buried in the collapse, with crushed legs. The pain was unbearable for the first day or so. Or was it? Who knows? You lose track of time in a place like this. Especially in a situation such as this. The pain has all but left though. Getting used to pain is a battle all in itself. My time now runs short. I will die here, in this tomb. No better place for a dead man.<BR>
<BR>
My adventures have taken me all over. I have been places that man never knew existed. I have retrieved artifacts and fine treasures that were thought to be myth. From chalices of origins long lost, to gems with power unthought of by man, to powerful religious artifacts that house more interest to madmen than sane. I shall at least take these fine memories with me to the grave.<BR>
<BR>
I shall miss my father. Like me, he was also a man of adventure. I followed in his footsteps, though I was blessed with far more luck than he. Until now, of course. He shall be on his own now. At least I am spared any more jokes about my childhood pet. And my students...how I treasured teaching them the secrets and alien concepts of all things unknown and mysterious. May they be successful.<BR>
<BR>
I do not go down along though. With my crippled body, in this heap of earth, I am accompanied by my trusty leather, my steel, and most of all, my token hat. Unable to reach them under the mass, I know they are untouchable and safe. I will not die alone.<BR>
<BR>
Farewell,<BR>
Indie<BR>
"""
"""<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
从塌陷事故开始已经过去好几天了。我曾经历过许多美好而激动人心的冒险，但恐怕这是最后一次了。我还是不确定到底发生了什么，这到底是意外事故还是人为的陷阱？我没听到过任何设备的咔哒声，也许这就是一场怪异的事故吧，而我只是刚好在这时来到了这里。不管怎么说，我现在躺在这里，腿已经被压断了。第一天左右还感到疼痛难忍，有一天吗？谁知道呢？待在这种地方会让人逐渐忘记时间，尤其是在动弹不得的情况下。痛苦已经差不多过去了，或者说习惯痛苦本身就是和自己身体的一场搏斗。我现在的时间不多了，我会死在这里，死在这个坟墓里面，也没有比这里更好的死者的去处了。<BR>
<BR>
我的冒险为我带来了我的一切。我总是喜欢去探索那些人类从未探索过的地方，我让被认为是神话当中的文物和财宝重见天日，从失传已久的圣杯到人们无法想象其力量的宝石，再到让疯狂的人们趋之若鹜的强大宗教文物。至少，我要把这些美好回忆带进坟墓。<BR>
<BR>

<BR>
不过我不会一个人下去的。带着我残废的身体，在这片土地上，伴随着我的是我赖以生存的皮革护甲，我可靠的钢剑，最重要的是，我象征性的帽子。在这种偏僻的地方，没什么人能触及我的尸体，也就无法触及它们，我知道它们是安全的，我不会孤独地死去的。<BR>
<BR>
永别了，<BR>
因蒂埃<BR>

The final words of a dead man being found near his corpse are so very cliche. <BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
Tamrielic Artifacts<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
The following are notes I have gathered, over the past centuries, of items of unimaginable significance. All have been seen, owned, and lost, again and again throughout Tamriel. Some may be myth, others may be hoax, but regardless, many have lost their lives attempting to find or protect these very coveted items. <BR>
<BR>
Lord's Mail<BR>
<BR>
Sometimes called the Armor of Morihaus or the gift of Kynareth, this is an ancient cuirass of unsurpassable quality. It grants the wearer power to absorb health, resist the effects of spells, and cure oneself of poison when used. It is said that whenever Kynareth deigns the wearer unworthy, the Lord's Mail will be taken away and hidden for the next chosen one.<BR>
<BR>
Ebony Mail<BR>
<BR>
The Ebony Mail is a breastplate created before recorded history by the Dark Elven goddess Boethiah. It is she who determines who should possess the Ebony Mail and for how long a time. If judged worthy, its power grants the wearer added resistance of fire, magicka, and grants a magical shield. It is Boethiah alone who determines when a person is ineligible to bear the Ebony Mail any longer, and the goddess can be very capricious.<BR>
<BR>
Spell Breaker<BR>
<BR>
Spell Breaker, superficially a Dwemer tower shield, is one of the most ancient relics of Tamriel. Aside from its historical importance in the Battle of Rourken-Shalidor, the Spell Breaker protects its wielder almost completely from any spell caster, either by reflecting magicks or silencing any mage about to cast a spell. It is said that Spell Breaker still searches for its original owner, and will not remain the property of anyone else for long. For most, possessing Spell Breaker for any length of time is power enough.<BR>
<BR>
Chrysamere<BR>
<BR>
The Paladin's Blade is an ancient claymore with offensive capabilities surpassed only by its own defenses. It lends the wielder health, protects him or her from fire, and reflects any spells cast against the wielder back to the caster. Seldom has Chrysamere been wielded by any bladesman for any length of time, for it chooses not to favor one champion.<BR>
<BR>
Staff of Magnus<BR>
<BR>
The Staff of Magnus, one of the elder artifacts of Tamriel, was a metaphysical battery of sorts for its creator, Magnus. When used, it absorbs an enemy's health and mystical energy. In time, the Staff will abandon the mage who wields it before he becomes too powerful and upsets the mystical balance it is sworn to protect.<BR>
<BR>
Warlock's Ring<BR>
<BR>
The Warlock's Ring of the Archmage Syrabane is one of the most popular relics of myth and fable. In Tamriel's ancient history, Syrabane saved all of the continent by judicious use of his Ring, and ever since, it has helped adventurers with less lofty goals. It is best known for its ability to reflect spells cast at its wearer and to improve his or her speed and to restore health. No adventurer can wear the Warlock's Ring for long, for it is said that the Ring is Syrabane's alone to command.<BR>
<BR>
Ring of Phynaster<BR>
<BR>
The Ring of Phynaster was made hundreds of years ago by a man who needed good defenses to survive his adventurous life. Thanks to the Ring, Phynaster lived for hundreds of years, and since then it has passed from person to person. The Ring improves its wearer's overall resistance to poison, magicka, and shock. Still, Phynaster was cunning and cursed the ring so that it eventually disappears from its holder's possessions and returns to another resting place, discontent to stay anywhere but with Phynaster himself.<BR>
<BR>
Ring of Khajiit<BR>
<BR>
The Ring of the Khajiit is an ancient relic, hundreds of years older than Rajhin, the thief that made the Ring famous. It was Rajhin who used the Ring's powers to make himself invisible and as quick as the breath of wind. Using the Ring, he became the most successful burglar in Elsweyr's history. Rajhin's eventual fate is a mystery, but according to legend, the Ring rebelled against such constant use and disappeared, leaving Rajhin helpless before his enemies.<BR>
<BR>
Mace of Molag Bal<BR>
<BR>
Also known as the Vampire's Mace, the Mace of Molag Bal drains its victims of magicka and gives it to the bearer. It also has the ability to transfer an enemy's strength to its wielder. Molag Bal has been quite free with his artifact. There are many legends about the Mace. It seems to be a favorite for vanquishing wizards. <BR>
<BR>
Masque of Clavicus Vile<BR>
<BR>
Ever the vain one, Clavicus Vile made a masque suited to his own personality. The bearer of the Masque is more likely to get a positive response from the people of Tamriel. The higher his personality, the larger the bonus. The best known story of the Masque tells the tale of Avalea, a noblewoman of some renown. As a young girl, she was grossly disfigured by a spiteful servant. Avalea made a dark deal with Clavicus Vile and received the Masque in return. Though the Masque did not change her looks, suddenly she had the respect and admiration of everyone. A year and a day after her marriage to a well connected baron, Clavicus Vile reclaimed the Masque. Although pregnant with his child, Avalea was banished from the Baron's household. Twenty one years and one day later, Avalea's daughter claimed her vengeance by slaying the Baron.<BR>
<BR>
Mehrunes Razor<BR>
<BR>
The Dark Brotherhood has coveted this ebony dagger for generations. This mythical artifact is capable of slaying any creature instantly. History does not record any bearers of Mehrune's Razor. However, the Dark Brotherhood was once decimated by a vicious internal power struggle. It is suspected that the Razor was involved.<BR>
<BR>
Cuirass of the Savior's Hide<BR>
<BR>
Another of Hircine's artifacts was the Cuirass of the Savior's Hide. The Cuirass has the special ability to resist magicka. Legend has it that Hircine rewarded his peeled hide to the first and only mortal to have ever escaped his hunting grounds. This unknown mortal had the hide tailored into this magical Cuirass for his future adventures. The Savior's Hide has a tendency to travel from hero to hero as though it has a mind of its own.<BR>
<BR>
Spear of Bitter Mercy<BR>
<BR>
One of the more mysterious artifacts is the Spear of Bitter Mercy. Little to nothing is known about the Spear. There are no recorded histories but many believe it to be of Daedric origin. The only known legend about it is its use by a mighty hero during the fall of the Battlespire. The hero was aided by the Spear in the defeat of Mehrunes Dagon and the recapturing of the Battlespire. Since that time, the Spear of Bitter Mercy has made few appearances within Tamriel.<BR>
<BR>
Daedric Scourge<BR>
<BR>
The Daedric Scourge is a mighty mace forged from sacred ebony in the Fires of Fickledire. The legendary weapon of Mackkan, it was once a fierce weapon used to send spirits of black back into Oblivion. The weapon lhas the ability to summon creatures from Oblivion, Once a tool used against the Daedric Lords in the Battlespire, it now roams the land with adventurers. <BR>
<BR>
Bow of Shadows<BR>
<BR>
Legend has it that the Bow of Shadows was forged by the Daedra Nocturnal. The legendary ranger, Raerlas Ghile, was granted the Bow for a secret mission that failed, and the Bow was lost. Raerlas did not go down without a hearty fight and is said to have, with the aid of the Bow, taken scores of his foes with him. The Bow grants the user the ability of invisibility and increased speed. Many sightings of the Bow of Shadows have been reported, and it is even said that the sinister Dark Elf assassin of the Second Era, Dram, once wielded this bow.<BR>
<BR>
Fists of Randagulf<BR>
<BR>
Randagulf of Clan Begalin goes down in Tamrielic history as one of the mightiest warriors from Skyrim. He was known for his courage and ferocity in battle and was a factor in many battles. He finally met his fate when King Harald conquered Skyrim. King Harald respected this great hero and took Randagulf's gauntlets for his own. After King Harald died, the gauntlets disappeared. The King claimed that the Fists granted the bearer added strength.<BR>
<BR>
Ice Blade of the Monarch<BR>
<BR>
The Ice Blade of the Monarch is truly one of Tamriel's most prized artifacts. Legend has it that the Evil Archmage Almion Celmo enchanted the claymore of a great warrior with the soul of a Frost Monarch, a stronger form of the more common Frost Atronach. The warrior, Thurgnarr Assi, was to play a part in the assassination of a great king in a far off land, and become the new leader. The assassination failed and the Archmage was imprisoned. The Ice Blade freezes all who feel its blade. The Blade circulates from owner to owner, never settling in one place for long.<BR>
<BR>
Ring of Surroundings<BR>
<BR>
Little is known of this prize but it is said that it lends the wearer the ability to blend in with their surroundings.<BR>
<BR>
Boots of the Apostle<BR>
<BR>
The Boots of the Apostle are a true mystery. The wearer of the boots is rumored to be able to levitate, though nobody has ever seen them used.<BR>
<BR>
The Mentor's Ring<BR>
<BR>
This ring is a prized possession for any apprentice to magic. It lends the wearer the ability to increase their intelligence and wisdom, thus making their use of magic more efficient. The High Wizard Carni Asron is said to be the creator of the Ring. It was a construct for his young apprentices while studying under his guidance. After Asron's death, the Ring and several other possessions vanished and have been circulated throughout Tamriel.<BR>
<BR>
Ring of the Wind<BR>
<BR>
No facts are known about this Ring, but the title and the few rumors lend one to think it grants the wearer added speed.<BR>
<BR>
Vampiric Ring<BR>
<BR>
One of the more deadly and rare artifacts in Tamriel is the Vampiric Ring. It is said that the Ring has the power to steal its victim's health and grant it to the wearer. The exact nature and origin of the Ring is wholly unknown, but many elders speak of its evil creation in Morrowind long, long ago by a cult of Vampire followers. The Vampiric Ring is an extremely rare artifact and is only seen every few hundred cycles of the moons.<BR>
<BR>
Eleidon's Ward<BR>
<BR>
Eleidon was a holy knight of legend in Breton history. He was a sought after man for his courage and determination to set all wrongs right. In one story, it is said that he rescued a Baron's daughter from sure death at the hands of an evil warlord. For his reward, the Baron spent all of his riches to have an enchanted shield built for Eidelon. The Shield granted Eleidon the opportunity to heal his wounds.<BR>
<BR>
Staff of Hasedoki<BR>
<BR>
Hasedoki was said to have been a very competitive wizard. He wandered the land in search for a wizard who was greater than he. To the best of all knowledge, he never found a wizard who could meet up to his challenge. It is said that he felt so lonely and isolated because so many feared his power, that he bonded his life-force into his very own staff, where his soul remains to this very day. Magic users all over Tamriel have been searching for this magical staff. Granting its wielder a protection of magicka, it is a sure prize for any magic user.<BR>
<BR>
Bloodworm Helm<BR>
<BR>
The King of Worms was said to have left behind one of his prized possessions, the Bloodworm Helm. The Helm is a construct of magically formed bone. The Helm allows the user to summon skeletons and control the undead. It would be a prized artifact to a necromancer.<BR>
<BR>
Dragonbone Mail<BR>
<BR>
This cuirass is one of the greatest artifacts any collector or hero could own. It is constructed of real dragon bone and was enchanted by the first Imperial Battlemage, Zurin Arctus, in the early years of the Third Era. It is a truly exquisite piece of work and many have sought to possess it. The properties of the Cuirass allow the wearer to be resist fire, and to damage an enemy with a blast of fire. Little is known about the involvement of Zurin Arctus with the enchantment of the Cuirass, but an old tale speaks of a debt that he owed to a traveling warrior. Like the warrior, the Dragonbone Mail never stays put for long.<BR>
<BR>
Skull Crusher<BR>
<BR>
The Skull Crusher is an amazingly large, and powerful weapon. The Warhammer was created in a fire, magically fueled by the Wizard, Dorach Gusal, and was forged by the great weaponsmith, Hilbongard Rolamus. The steel is magically hardened and the weight of the weapon is amazingly light, which makes for more powerful swings and deadly blows. The Warhammer was to be put on display for a festival, but thieves got it first. The Skull Crusher still travels Tamriel in search of its creators.<BR>
<BR>
Goldbrand<BR>
<BR>
This magical Sword is almost a complete mystery. Thieves tell tales about its golden make and how it was actually forged by ancient dragons of the North. Their tales claim that it was given to a great knight who was sworn to protect the dragons. The Sword lends its wielder the ability to do fire damage on an enemy. Goldbrand has not been sighted in recent history and is said to be awaiting a worthy hero.<BR>
<BR>
Fang of Haynekhtnamet<BR>
<BR>
Black Marsh was once known to be inhabited with what the Argonians called the Wamasus. Northern men considered them to be intelligent dragons with lightning for blood. One such mighty beast, Haynekhtnamet, was slain by the Northern men, though it took 7 days and nights, and a score of men. One of the surviving men took a fang home as a trophy. The fang was carved down into a blade and fashioned into a small dagger. The Dagger mysteriously houses some of the beast's magical properties and grants the user the ability to do shock damage on an opponent. This unique Dagger is seen occasionally by traveling heroes.<BR>
<BR>
Umbra Sword<BR>
<BR>
The Umbra Sword was enchanted by the ancient witch Naenra Waerr, and its sole purpose was the entrapment of souls. Used in conjunction with a soul gem, the Sword allows the wielder the opportunity to imprison an enemy's soul in the gem. Naenra was executed for her evil creation, but not before she was able to hide the Sword. The Umbra Sword is very choosy when it comes to owners and therefore remains hidden until a worthy one is found.<BR>
<BR>
Denstagmer's Ring<BR>
<BR>
All that is known of this Ring is that it may grant the user protection from certain elements. Even the name Denstagmer is a mystery.<BR>
<BR>
Helm of Oreyn Bearclaw<BR>
<BR>
One of Valenwood's legendary heroes is Oreyn Bearclaw. Son of King Faume Toad-Eye, he was a respected clan hunter and a future leader. Wood Elven legend claims Oreyn single handedly defeated Glenhwyfaunva, the witch-serpent of the Elven wood, forever bringing peace to his clan. Oreyn would go on to accomplish numerous other deeds, eventually losing his life to the Knahaten Flu. His Helm stood as a monument of his stature for future generations to remember. The Helm was lost eventually, as the Clan split, and is now a treasured artifact for adventurers. The Helm of Oreyn Bearclaw is rumored to improve the wearers agility and endurance.<BR>
Daedric Crescent Blade<BR>
<BR>
Probably the most rare and even outlawed item of all the great prizes is the Daedric Crescent Blade. The Blade was used by Mehrunes Dagon's Daedric forces in the capture of the Imperial Battlespire. These extremely unique Blades were gathered up and destroyed after the Battlespire was recaptured by the Empire. All but one it seems. Though the Empire believes them all to be destroyed, it is rumored that one still remains in existence, somewhere in Tamriel, though none have ever seen it. The Blade lends it's weilder the ability to do great damage on an enemy and allows him to paralyze and put heavy wear on his enemy's armor. Quite the prize for any mighty warrior, if it does indeed exist.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
泰姆瑞尔诸神器<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
下列笔记由我于过去几个世纪中所撰，用以辑录各色超凡法器。下列神器在全泰姆瑞尔大陆失而复得、得而复失、循环往复。其中有些可能是神话传说，有些可能是骗局整蛊，但无论如何，许多人在对此类令人垂涎之物的寻宝和护宝的过程中丧命。<BR>
<BR>
君王链甲<BR>
<BR>
有时亦唤作墨里奥斯之甲或吉娜瑞斯馈赠，是质量无与伦比的古代胸甲。其赋予着甲者吸取生命值、抵御魔法效果并在并在中毒后解毒的神力。据说，当吉娜瑞斯认为着甲者难堪兹位时，君王链甲便会被剥夺，并藏匿至下一位获选者出现。<BR>
<BR>
黑檀链甲<BR>
<BR>
黑檀链甲在史前时代由暗精灵女神波耶西亚所造。谁人穿得此甲，且可保有多久，均决于她手。如果某一着甲者得到认可，护甲的法力会给予着甲者额外的火焰抗性、魔法抗性，并提供魔法护盾。着甲者几时失去着甲资格只由波耶西亚方能决定，而女神可能非常反复无常。<BR>
<BR>
破法者<BR>
<BR>
明面上看是一面锻莫塔盾的破法者是泰姆瑞尔最古老的神器之一。除却其于鲁肯-沙利多之战中的重要戏份以外，破法者几乎可以护持盾者以周全，通过反射魔法或使任何施法中的法师沉默使其免受免受任何施法者侵害。据说，破法者仍眷念故主，并不会久居他人篱下。对大多数人而言，持有破法者不论多久，都是赚到不亏。<BR>
<BR>
克里萨米尔<BR>
<BR>
圣骑士之刃是一柄古老的大剑，攻防俱佳，甚至防御方面更胜一筹。其可为执剑人增益生命，使之免于火焰伤害，并将对执剑人施放的各种法术反弹给施法者。少有剑士可挥舞克里萨米尔哪怕须臾，只因其择勇士豪杰而栖，而非逢迎之物。<BR>
<BR>
玛格努斯之杖<BR>
<BR>
作为泰姆瑞尔上古神器之一的玛格努斯之杖，对其创造者玛格努斯而言是一种形而上学的装置。使用时，其将吸噬敌方的生命和秘法能量。随着时间的推移，法杖会在持有其的法师变得过强，足以破坏法杖誓要捍卫的秘法平衡之前弃他而去。<BR>
<BR>
巫者之戒<BR>
<BR>
大法师席拉拜恩的巫者之戒是神话和寓言中最受欢迎的神器之一。在泰姆瑞尔的古久历史中，席拉拜恩对其戒指的精妙操作拯救了全大陆，自彼时起，戒指还帮助了一些并不志存高远的冒险者。其以能够反弹对佩戴者施放的法术而最为闻名，且可为佩戴者加速并恢复生命。没有冒险者可以长期据有巫者之戒，因为传言说，戒指由席拉拜恩径自发号施令。<BR>
<BR>
菲纳斯特之戒<BR>
<BR>
数百年前，一位需要上乘防护以在冒险生涯中存活的人士制造了菲纳斯特之戒。菲纳斯特数百年的寿数，全仰仗此枚戒指，自其后就在外人间相传起来。戒指提升了佩戴者对毒药、魔法和电击的整体抵御。尽管如此，菲纳斯特仍然狡猾地诅咒这枚戒指，以至于其最终从持有者的所有中消失并返回另一个栖身之地，不满于留在除菲纳斯特本尊以外的他处。<BR>
<BR>
卡吉特之戒<BR>
<BR>
卡吉特之戒是一件古老的遗物，其出现早于使用并令此戒指闻名的盗贼拉津数百年。拉津用戒指的力量令自己隐踪匿迹，风驰电掣。有赖于戒指，他成为了艾斯维尔历史中的头号大盗。拉津的下场是个谜，但据传说，戒指对长期此种勾当以逆反并消失，令拉津在敌人面前束手无策。<BR>
<BR>
莫拉格-巴尔之锤<BR>
<BR>
又名吸血鬼钉锤，莫拉格-巴尔之锤汲取其受害者的法力并移转至持有者，对敌方的体力亦如是，也将之转移给其持有者。莫拉格-巴尔对其神器非常率性。有关此柄钉锤的传说众多，其似乎是征服法师的上佳之选。<BR>
<BR>
卡拉维库斯·维尔面具<BR>
<BR>
古时候，“太虚”卡拉维库斯·维尔制作了一副适合自身个性的面具。面具佩戴者更有可能得到泰姆瑞尔民众的积极响应。其个性越鲜明，增益便越大。此副假面最为人知的故事便是闻名遐迩的贵妇阿瓦莉亚的传说。在少女时代，她被一个恶毒的下人严重毁容。阿瓦莉亚与卡拉维库斯·维尔做了一笔黑暗交易，报酬便是面具。虽然假面没有改变她的相貌，但霎时间她便广受众人尊敬与爱慕。在与一位交往深厚的男爵结婚一年零一天后，卡拉维库斯·维尔重新取回了面具。尽管已经怀了他的种，阿瓦莉亚还是被男爵的家族扫地出门。二十一年零一天后，阿瓦莉亚之女以弑父报仇雪恨。<BR>
<BR>
梅鲁涅斯利刃<BR>
<BR>
历代以来，黑暗兄弟会都垂涎这把黑檀岩匕首。此等神话级法器能够瞬杀任何生物。梅鲁涅斯利刃的任何持有者都于史无据。然而，黑暗兄弟会一度被一场恶性内斗所重挫元气。人皆怀疑此事与利刃有关。<BR>
<BR>
救世主的庇护<BR>
<BR>
希尔辛的另一件神器是救世主的庇护胸甲。胸甲具有抵御魔法的特殊功能。传说希尔辛将其剥皮赐予第一个也是唯一一个逃离其猎场的凡人。这位佚名的凡人将剥皮制作了此件魔法胸甲，为其未来的冒险所用。救世主的庇护有在英豪之间流转的趋势，犹如自作主张一般。<BR>
<BR>
悲悯之枪<BR>
<BR>
悲悯之枪则是更为神秘的神器之一了。世人对此长枪几近一无所知。虽然于史籍已不可考，但多则认同其乃迪德拉本源之说。唯一闻名而与其相关的传说是，在战斗尖塔陷落之时，一名强悍英雄持有此长枪。此英雄倚借长枪襄助，击败了梅鲁涅斯·大衮并重夺战斗尖塔。自彼时后，悲悯之枪便鲜见于泰姆瑞尔。<BR>
<BR>
众魔灾厄<BR>
<BR>
众魔灾厄是一柄强力钉锤，由无常暴烈之火中的神圣黑檀岩锻造而成。其作为麦坎的传奇兵戈，曾是用于将黑暗造物送回湮灭的利器。该武器具有从湮灭召唤生物的能力，过去用于对抗战斗尖塔中对抗迪德拉战将，现在正与冒险者一起浪迹大陆。<BR>
<BR>
暗影之弓<BR>
<BR>
传说中，暗影之弓是由魔君诺克图娜尔铸造。传奇级游侠雷尔拉斯·吉尔为执行秘密任务获赠此弓，然而功败垂成，弓也丢失不见。雷尔拉斯的战败并非激战不敌，据信，凭借此弓，他放倒了许多敌人。此弓给予射手以隐形和提速的能力。暗影之弓的目击记录层出不穷，甚至据说第二纪元时阴狠的暗精灵刺客卓姆便曾持有此弓。<BR>
<BR>
兰达古夫之拳<BR>
<BR>
贝加林氏的兰达古夫以天际最强战士之一之名载入了泰姆瑞尔史册。他以悍勇善战闻名，并且影响了众多战局。当哈拉尔德王征伐天际时，他终于迎来了自己命运的结局。哈拉尔德王敬重此位豪杰，却自将夺走了兰达古夫的腕甲。哈拉尔德王驾崩后，腕甲便消失不见。国王声称兰达古夫之拳腕甲赋予了穿戴者更大的气力。<BR>
<BR>
君主冰刃<BR>
<BR>
君王冰刃实乃泰姆瑞尔最为珍贵的神器之一。传说有闻，邪恶的大法师阿尔米昂·塞尔莫用一只寻常寒霜元素的加强形态——寒霜君王的灵魂附魔了一名勇士的大剑。战士苏尼亚尔·阿西本打算参与对一位域外贤王行刺，并僭祚为新君。暗杀失败，大法师也被囚禁。冰刃会冻结任何剑下之敌。君王冰刃在人际相传，不得久留。<BR>
<BR>
周遭之戒<BR>
<BR>
世人对此件神器知之甚少，但据说其能使佩戴者能够融入周遭环境。<BR>
<BR>
使徒之靴<BR>
<BR>
使徒之靴是一个真正的谜。据信，穿上靴子后着靴者便能悬浮起来，尽管未尝有人目睹如此。<BR>
<BR>
导师之戒<BR>
<BR>
对任何魔法学徒而论，此枚戒指都是珍贵的财富。其可以提升佩戴者更多智慧与智识，从而更高效地使用魔法。据传卡尼·阿斯隆高阶巫师制造了这枚戒指。这是他为聆其教诲的门下年轻弟子所作。在阿斯隆故去后，戒指和其他一些财产散佚，并在整个泰姆瑞尔流转。<BR>
<BR>
疾风之戒<BR>
<BR>
此枚戒指的实质尚不为人知，但望文生义而论，再辅以少数传闻令人认为其可为佩戴者提速。<BR>
<BR>
吸血鬼之戒<BR>
<BR>
吸血鬼之戒是泰姆瑞尔最为致命而稀有的神器之一。据说戒指有能力汲取受害者的生命并转予佩戴者。戒指的确切本性和起源完全未知，但许多长者则称此物乃旧时晨风一众吸血鬼追随者的邪恶创造。吸血鬼之戒是一种极为罕见的神器，每隔上百个双月循环周期才会出现一次。<BR>
<BR>
埃雷唐坚盾<BR>
<BR>
埃雷唐是布莱顿历史上的传奇圣骑士。他因痛改前非的勇气和决心而广受追捧。在一个故事中，据说他将男爵命悬一线的女儿从邪恶战将手中救出。作为报酬，男爵倾尽财帛为埃雷顿打造了一面附魔盾牌。该盾牌可让埃雷唐有几率治愈创伤。<BR>
<BR>
哈斯多奇之杖<BR>
<BR>
哈斯多奇据说是个争强好胜的巫师。他巡游四方，寻觅劲敌。据他所知，他从未找到一个接下战书的巫师。据信，他因为其法力为众多人所畏惧而感到颇为孤寂，便将自己的生命力与其法杖合为一体，其灵魂附于法杖之上，直至当下。泰姆瑞尔全大陆的施法者一直在寻找这魔杖。其可赋予持有者以魔法防护，显然对任何施法者而言都是一件宝具。<BR>
<BR>
血蠕虫头盔<BR>
<BR>
血蠕虫头盔据说是蠕虫之王珍贵的孑遗之一。头盔乃是魔法构建的骨骼的造物。头盔准许佩戴者召唤骷髅并操纵亡灵。此盔对死灵法师而言可谓一件珍贵的神器。<BR>
<BR>
龙骨链甲<BR>
<BR>
此件胸甲是任何收藏家或英雄都可拥有的最顶级神器之一。其由真正龙骨所造，在第三纪元初期被帝国首席战斗法师祖林·阿克图斯附魔。其制作精良、巧夺天工，欲据为己有者甚众。胸甲的魔力是令佩戴者抵御火焰，并以火焰爆能击伤敌人。有关祖林·阿克图斯与胸甲的附魔之间的知之甚少，但一个古老的传说声称他于一位云游勇士有所亏欠。就像战士征战四方一般，龙骨链甲亦从不作久留。<BR>
<BR>
碎颅者<BR>
<BR>
碎颅者是一柄硕大而强力的兵器。此战锤是由巫师多拉克·古萨尔以魔能燃起的炉火为热量，由良匠希尔邦高·罗拉穆斯锻造而成。钢材由魔法硬化，武器的自重惊人地轻，从而使挥击更为强力，捶打更加致命。该战锤本打算是用作节日展览，但盗贼抢先窃据之。碎颅者仍然在泰姆瑞尔寻求与匠人的重逢。<BR>
<BR>
黄金烙印<BR>
<BR>
这柄魔法太刀简直是个彻头彻尾的谜。盗贼们常谈及其黄金构造以及实质地被北境古龙所铸的传说。故事讲到，其本是赠予一名立誓保卫龙族的强大骑士之物。此太刀赋予执剑人以火焰杀伤敌方的能力。黄金烙印在近代不见诸史册，可谓兵刃有利剑，宝刀待英雄。<BR>
<BR>
哈尼赫纳迈之牙<BR>
<BR>
黑沼泽曾经以阿尔贡呼之为“瓦马苏斯”的沼龙的栖息地而闻名。北方人认为他们是智慧的龙族，血脉中流淌着闪电力量。这一族中一只强大的怪兽——哈尼赫纳迈，被北方人在七天七夜之内，以数十人的伤亡为代价所击杀。幸存者中的一员拔下一只尖牙作为战利品带回家。尖牙被雕刻成刀刃，制成了一把短匕。该匕首神秘地附有怪兽本身的一些魔法属性，并令使用者可对对手造成电击伤害。此柄独特的匕首偶尔会为云游四方的英杰们所目睹。<BR>
<BR>
本影剑<BR>
<BR>
本影剑由古代女巫奈茵拉·瓦尔所附魔，其唯一目的即是俘获灵魂。此剑与灵魂石结合使用，令执剑人有机会将敌人的灵魂囚禁在灵魂石中。奈茵拉因其恶堕造物而被处决，但在此前她将本影剑藏匿起来。本影剑对执剑人的选择甚是挑剔，因此在堪当斯任者出现前会一直隐匿不见。<BR>
<BR>
丹斯塔格莫之戒<BR>
<BR>
我们只知道该戒指可予以佩戴者对于某些元素伤害的保护。就连丹斯塔格莫这个名字也是个谜。<BR>
<BR>
奥雷恩·熊爪之盔<BR>
<BR>
奥雷恩·熊爪是威木的传奇英雄之一。身为“蛤目”弗姆王之子，他是受人尊敬的氏族猎手和储君。木精灵传说声称奥瑞因孤身一人击败了精灵森林的蛇妖女巫格伦弗努亚，为其氏族带来了永远的和平。奥瑞因本要实践其王道征途，却最终丧命于纳哈腾流感。他的头盔作为对其伟业的纪念而留存，供后人铭记。随着氏族分裂，头盔最终散佚，现在成了冒险者的争相竞逐的神器。据传，奥雷恩·熊爪之盔可以提升佩戴者的敏捷与耐力。<BR>
迪德拉新月刃<BR>
<BR>
可能所有神器中最稀有，甚至最不为官厅法度所容忍之物便是迪德拉新月刃了。梅鲁涅斯·大衮的迪德拉大军在攻占帝国战斗尖塔时使用了这种刀兵。此类尤其独特的兵器在帝国光复战斗尖塔后便集中销毁。却唯独漏了一把。尽管帝国确信已尽数销毁，但有传言称在泰姆瑞尔的某处仍有一把留存，虽然未尝有人一睹。新月刃令持有者对敌人以巨大杀伤，并允许其麻痹敌人和极大磨损提防护甲。倘若此物确实存在，那对任何猛士而言都是相当不错的神器。<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
The Alchemist's Formulary<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
Healers' Recipes<BR>
<BR>
Healers should all know the recipes for the following popular potions. Fortunately, in most cases, the ingredients are common and cheaply obtained.<BR>
<BR>
To restore health to the afflicted and wounded, combine in equal parts two or more of the following cheap and common ingredients: marshmerrow, wickwheat, corkbulb root, and saltrice. Marshmerrow is an important crop of the Ascadian Isles, but it also grows wild in the Grazelands and on Azura's Coast. Wickwheat is a wild Ashland grain that grows in the Grazelands. Corkbulb grows best in the Ascadian Isles. Most saltrice comes from southeastern Morrowind, but there are also some new and prospering farms and plantations in the Ascadian Isles. Saltrice occasionally grows wild in the Grazelands and on Azura's Coast.<BR>
<BR>
To restore fatigue after heavy exertion, combine two or more of the following: crab meat, bread, small kwama egg, and chokeweed. Crabmeat is taken from the mud crab, commonly found along all coasts. Bread in Morrowind is usually baked from saltrice flour. Kwama eggs are harvested from egg mines, and sold everywhere in Morrowind; the smaller eggs retain properties lost in later states of gestation. Chokeweed is a tough shrub growing in the rocky highlands of the West Gash.<BR>
<BR>
To cure common diseases, combine gravedust and green lichen. Gravedust is spirit-affinitive dust taken from remains buried in consecrated ground. Green lichen is a hardy primitive plant that grows in the Ascadian Isles and Azura's Coast.<BR>
<BR>
To restore magicka for spellcasting, combine comberry and frost salts. Comberry is a bitter berry, used to make wines. It grows mainly in the Ascadian Isles. Frost salts, by contrast, are rare and expensive. These crystalline compounds precipitate from elemental frost in solution. Such residues may be collected from the remains of frost atronachs that have been banished from the mortal plane.<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
Travelers' Recipes<BR>
<BR>
Pilgrims and travelers will find the following inexpensive recipes of particular interest.<BR>
<BR>
Feather reduces the weary traveler's burdens and can be gained from heather and scuttle. Heather is a low evergreen shrub of the Ascadian Isles, known for its small, pinkish-purple flowers. Scuttle, Vvardenfell's favorite local dish, is similar to cheese and made from the flesh of local beetles.<BR>
<BR>
Levitation can be produced from any two of the following ingredients: trama root, racer plumes, and coda flowers. A thick, bitter-tasting root of the trama shrub grows in the Ashlands, Molag Amur, and Red Mountain regions. Racer plumes are plucked from dead cliff racers. Coda flowers are collected from the primitive draggle-tail plant of the Bitter Coast.<BR>
<BR>
The power of Water Breathing is handy for travelers. A potion may be made from two or more of the following ingredients: luminous russula, hackle-lo leaf, and kwama cuttle. Luminous russula is a squat, mottled-brown-and-green toadstool mushroom of the Bitter Coast region. Hackle-lo leaf is a succulent leaf of the Grazelands, prized for its taste and its roborative powers. Kwama cuttle is a tough, waxy substance that comes from sacs in the mouths of kwama.<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
Adventurers' Recipes<BR>
<BR>
Unfortunately, the potions most favored by adventurers require more rare and expensive ingredients. There are exceptions, like the easy and affordable recipe for fire shield. But most such potions require at least one ingredient with high cost in coin or blood.<BR>
<BR>
Fire Shield potions can be made from comberry and sload soap. Comberry is the bitter berry of the Ascadian Isles. Sload soap is a waxy substance made from the immature non-sentient forms of the sload. Sload soap is not expensive, but is only rarely stocked by apothecaries or alchemists, and cannot be collected locally.<BR>
<BR>
An adventurer can fortify his strength with a potion made from ash yams and dreugh wax. Ash yam is a tough tuberous root vegetable common to the Ascadian Isles region. Dreugh wax is a tough, waxy substance scraped from dreugh shells. Dreugh are powerful aquatic creatures, and hunting them for their hides and wax is a dangerous occupation.<BR>
<BR>
Invisibility, one of the most prized effects of potions, can be made only from crushed diamonds and bittergreen petals. Bittergreen is a red flowering plant growing in the Red Mountain region. Diamonds, on the other hand, are very rare and expensive and usually must be purchased from fine alchemists.<BR>
<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
炼金术士配方集<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
治疗师的配方<BR>
<BR>
治疗者都应该知道以下流行药水的配方。幸运的是，在大多数情况下，这些成分都很常见，而且很便宜。<BR>
<BR>
为了恢复受伤者的健康，将以下两种或两种以上的廉价常见成分：沼泽糖蔗、灯芯麦、软木鳞茎根和盐水稻。沼泽糖蔗是阿斯卡迪安群岛的一种重要作物，但它也生长在放牧平原和阿祖拉海岸。灯芯麦是一种生长在放牧平原上的野生灰烬之地谷物。软木鳞类植物在阿斯卡迪安群岛生长得最好。大部分的盐水稻来自于东南部的晨风，但阿斯卡迪安群岛上也有一些新的繁荣的农场和种植园出产它们。盐水稻偶尔也会在放牧平原和阿祖拉海岸的野外生长。<BR>
<BR>
要想在剧烈运动后恢复耐力，可以将以下两种或两种以上的食物混合：蟹肉、面包、小夸蚂卵和窒息草。蟹肉取自泥沼蟹，常见于沿海地区。晨风的面包通常是用含盐的面粉烤成的。夸蚂卵产自卵矿，在晨风随处可见，而较小的卵保留了在妊娠后期丢失的特性。窒息草是一种生长在西境之痕的坚硬的灌木。<BR>
<BR>
治疗常见疾病，应将坟土与绿色地衣混合。坟土是从埋在圣地里的遗骸中取来的与灵有关的尘土。绿色地衣是一种耐寒的原始植物，生长在阿斯卡迪安群岛和阿祖拉海岸。<BR>
<BR>
要恢复法师的施法能力，可以把异梅和霜盐混合在一起。异梅是一种苦味浆果，用于酿酒。它主要生长在阿斯卡迪安群岛。相比之下，霜盐则是稀有且昂贵的。这些结晶化合物是从冰侍灵的融液中沉淀出来的。这些残余物可以从被驱逐出凡人位面的寒冰侍灵尸体中收集到。<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
旅行者的配方<BR>
<BR>
朝圣者和旅行者会发现以下便宜的处方特别有趣。<BR>
<BR>
“轻羽术”可以减轻疲惫的旅行者的负担，此种魔法的效果也从石楠花和虫酪中获得。石楠是阿斯卡迪安群岛的一种低矮的常绿灌木，以其小而粉紫色的花而闻名。虫酪是瓦登费尔最受欢迎的当地菜肴，与奶酪相似，其实是由当地甲虫的肉制成。<BR>
<BR>
“浮空术”的效果可以由以下任意两种成分产生：特拉玛根、迅鸟羽和尾声花。特拉玛灌木的根生长在灰烬之地、莫拉格-阿穆尔河和红山地区。迅鸟羽是从死去的峭壁迅鸟身上拔下来的。尾声花是从苦涩海岸的原始拖尾植物中采集的。<BR>
<BR>
水中呼吸的能力对旅行者来说很方便。产生这种效果的药剂可以由以下两种或两种以上的成分制成：微光红菇、颈羽罗叶和夸蚂膏。微光红菇是一种矮胖的、斑驳的褐绿色毒蕈蘑菇，生长在苦涩海岸地区。颈羽罗叶是一种多汁的草类植物叶子，因其味道和效力而备受赞誉。夸蚂膏是一种坚硬的蜡质物质，来自夸蚂的口腔。<BR>
<BR>
<BR>
冒险家的配方<BR>
<BR>
不幸的是，冒险家最喜欢的魔药需要更稀有和昂贵的成分。当然也有例外，比如制作火盾药水的配方就很简单经济。但大多数此类药剂都需要至少一种成本较高的成分。<BR>
<BR>
火盾药水可以由异梅和斯洛德皂制成。异梅是阿斯卡迪安群岛的苦浆果。斯洛德皂是一种蜡质物质，来自未成熟的无知觉形式的斯洛德。斯洛德皂并不贵，但药剂师或炼金术士很少储备，而且无法在当地收集。<BR>
<BR>
冒险家可以用灰烬山药和蟹灵蜡制成的药剂来增强体力。灰烬山药是一种坚硬的块根类蔬菜，在阿斯卡迪安群岛地区很常见。蟹灵蜡是从蟹灵壳上刮下来的一种坚硬的蜡质物质。蟹灵是强大的水生生物，捕猎它们是非常危险的。<BR>
<BR>
隐形魔药是魔药最珍贵的效果之一，它只能由碎钻石和苦绿花瓣制成。苦绿花是生长在红山地区的一种开花植物。另一方面，钻石是非常稀有和昂贵的，通常必须从优秀的炼金术士那里购买。<BR>
<BR>

Articles of Faith<BR>
<BR>
The Temple believes that Almalexia, Vivec, and Sotha Sil were mortal guardians of Morrowind who walked the earth, defeated the Dunmer's greatest enemies, the Nords and the Dwarves, and achieved divine substance through superhuman discipline and virtue and supernatural wisdom and insight.
