"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
For My Gods and Emperor<BR>
A Handbook for the Imperial Cult<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
What is the Imperial Cult?<BR>
<BR>
The missionary arm of the great faiths, the Imperial cult brings divine inspiration and consolation to the Empire's remote provinces. The cults combine the worship of the Nine Divines, the Aedra Akatosh, Dibella, Arkay, Zenithar, Mara, Stendarr, Kynareth, and Julianos, and the Talos cult, veneration of the divine god-hero Tiber Septim, founder and patron of the Empire. Imperial cult priests provide worship and services for all these gods at Imperial shrines in settlements throughout Vvardenfell. <BR>
<BR>
What is the Virtuous Life? <BR>
<BR>
Our doctrines are simple. We acknowledge the divinity of the Nine Divines: Akatosh, Dibella, Arkay, Zenithar, Mara, Stendarr, Kynareth, Julianos, and Tiber Septim. We preach the Nine Virtues: Humility, Inspiration, Piety, Work, Compassion, Justice, Ambition, Learning, and Civility. Our Emperor is the Defender of the Faith, and the Empire is the worldly working of the Divine Plan. We pledge aid and comfort to all citizens in need, and serve the Emperor and Empire at his will. <BR>
<BR>
The Imperial cults look to the Nine Divines as models for living a good and virtuous life. Each of the Nine represents different aspects of life, and how it should be lived. But the simplest statement of our doctrines is -- help and protect one another. The stronger one is, the wealthier one is, the more one bears responsibility for helping and protecting others. One's first duty, of course, is to one's fellow members of the Imperial Cult. But after that, one should help and protect any needy persons. <BR>
<BR>
We also say, "do not harm one another." It is forbidden to attack another person of the Imperial cult, and of course, forbidden to kill another member. It is forbidden to steal from another member, whether by open theft or by covert pickpocketing. It is forbidden to trespass upon the private property of another member. Break any one of these rules, and be expelled from the cult. <BR>
<BR>
How can I join the Imperial cult? <BR>
<BR>
The Imperial cult accepts all citizens of good character and earnest faith. We ask only a one-time pledge of 50 drakes to aid us in our good works. Thereafter, the only cost of membership comes when you use our health, healing, and blessing shrines -- modest fees which help us spread the blessings of the Nine to those less fortunate than ourselves. <BR>
<BR>
Those who wish to join the Imperial cult in Vvardenfell will find a warm welcome from our cult greeters: Ygfa at Fort Pelagiad, Syloria Siruliulus at Buckmoth Legion Fort, Somutis Vunnis at Moonmoth Legion Fort, Ruccia Conician in the Grand Council Chambers in Ebonheart, or Lalatia Varian in the Imperial Chapels at Ebonheart. <BR>
<BR>
What are the requirements for advancement in the Imperial cult? <BR>
<BR>
Seekers who wish to advance in the service of the Nine must dedicate time and resources to serving the cult, and must strive for personal improvement in their attributes and skills. Only the most distinguished are worthy of advancement to the higher ranks in the Imperial cults. <BR>
<BR>
To serve and glorify the Nine Divines, the faithful must cultivate a noble personality and a strong will. Respect the magical arts, especially the colleges of Restoration, Mysticism, and Conjuration. Those who swear to avoid bloodshed, to take the field unarmored to fight only with blunt weapons, are especially praiseworthy. Knowledge of enchantments and the gift of diplomatic speech are other qualities we value in our initiates. <BR>
<BR>
Imperial cult services<BR>
<BR>
You can find Imperial cult services in Buckmoth Legion Fort, Moonmoth Legion Fort, Pelagiad Legion Fort, Gnisis Legion Fort, Wolverine Hall in Sadrith Mora, Vivec Foreign Quarter, and Imperial chapels in Ebonheart. Seek training at Wolverine Hall, Buckmoth Fort, Moonmoth Fort, Ebonheart Imperial Chapels, Governor's Hall in Caldera, and Ald Velothi Outpost. <BR>
<BR>
Many Imperial cult locations have healing altars. You may pray at Imperial cult healing altars and receive blessings which cure common and blight diseases, cure poisons, and restore damaged attributes. Non-members pay 25 drakes. Non-members pay 25 drakes. Newer members pay 10 drakes, while higher-ranking members receive blessings free. Healing altars are found in: Vivec Foreign Quarter; Wolverine Hall in Sadrith Mora; Buckmoth Legion Fort; Moonmoth Legion Fort; Pelagiad Legion Fort; Gnisis Legion Fort; and Imperial Chapels in Ebonheart. <BR>
<BR>
Opportunities for service<BR>
<BR>
Lay healers gather ingredients for health and healing potions, and minister to the sick and hurt in poor and isolated communities. It is difficult and sometimes dangerous work, but the spiritual rewards are great. Lay healers need only the skills of the prudent traveler, being often on the road and in the wilderness, gathering herbs and potion components. They should avoid trouble where possible, and so need not be masters of the arts of war. Those interested should speak to Synnolian Tunifus at the Imperial Chapels in Ebonheart.<BR>
<BR>
Almoners gather alms from members and friends of the faith. We depend on donations to fund most of our good works. Almoners who are successful at bringing in generous donations may rise in the ranks of Imperial Cults service. Almoners must travel in town and village, and should be skilled in persuasion and mercantile matters. Also, almoners with personal wealth are in a position to better serve the cult. Those interested should speak to Iulus Truptor at the Imperial Chapels in Ebonheart. <BR>
<BR>
A shrine sergeant helps keep order at the shrines, carries messages and packages, and sometimes escorts priests and lay servants on dangerous missions. This occasional service is ideal for bold, free-spirited adventurers. Shrine sergeants are called upon to serve the Nine with weapon, armor, and spell. New shrine sergeants are given the easiest tasks, but later, missions may demand higher levels of combat proficiency. Those interested should speak to Kaye at the Imperial Chapels in Ebonheart. <BR>
<BR>
Oracle's Quests are the most demanding of all Imperial cult missions. Only members of the higher ranks are invited to assist the Oracle, and the challenges require the skill and courage found only in heroes of legend. <BR>
<BR>
How do the Imperial cults view the other factions of Vvardenfell? <BR>
The Imperial cults have a very close relationship with the Imperial legions, and a friendly and supportive relationship with the Imperial Guilds -- especially the Fighters and Mages Guilds. We also have a friendly and supportive relationship with House Hlaalu, which strongly supports the Emperor and Imperial principles. Though we cannot condone the actions of the Thieves Guild, we praise their faithful dedication to the Emperor and to Imperial culture. <BR>
<BR>
The Imperial cults have the greatest respect for the high moral principles of House Redoran and the Morag Tong, and honors their different but noble conceptions of Divine Inspiration. <BR>
<BR>
We disapprove of the primitive heathen beliefs of the Ashlanders, and of the impious and inhumane practices of the Telvanni. The Imperial cult especially disapproves of the practice of slavery, and looks forward to the day when slavery is illegal in all Imperial provinces. The Imperial cult also disapproves of the lawless and greedy Camonna Tong, and their ruthless exploitation of the poor and weak. <BR>
<BR>

帝国教团手册<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
什么是帝国教团？<BR>
<BR>
帝国教团是伟大信仰的传教者，为帝国的偏远省份带来神圣的鼓舞与安慰。教团结合了九圣灵崇拜：崇拜阿卡托什、蒂贝拉、阿尔凯、泽尼萨尔、玛拉、斯坦达尔、吉娜瑞斯、尤利安诺斯等艾德拉以及崇拜第三帝国的创建者，神圣的英雄泰伯·塞普汀——也就是塔洛斯神教。帝国教团的祭司们在瓦登费尔各个定居点的帝国神殿为这些神灵提供信仰和各种服务。<BR>
<BR>
美德的生活是什么样的？<BR>
<BR>
我们的教义很简单，我们承认九圣灵的神性：阿卡托什、蒂贝拉、阿尔凯、泽尼萨尔、玛拉、斯坦达尔、吉娜瑞斯、尤利安诺斯以及泰伯·塞普汀。我们宣扬这九种美德：谦逊、乐观、虔诚、勤奋、慈悲、正义、理想、学习以及文明。我们的皇帝是信仰的捍卫者，帝国则是神圣的世俗体现。我承诺为所有有需要的公民提供援助以及慰藉，并按照皇帝的意愿为皇帝和帝国服务。<BR>
<BR>
帝国教团以九圣灵为楷模，追求美德的生活。九圣灵中每一位都代表着生活的不同方面。但是如果要以最简单的方式来概述我们的教义，那就是互相帮助、互相守护。越强大越富有的人，也就越有保护和帮助他人的责任。首先有责任要帮助的，自然是其他帝国教团的同胞，在这之后就是去帮助所有处于困难中的人们。<BR>

<BR>
如何加入帝国教团？<BR>
<BR>
帝国教团接受所有品德高尚、信仰坚定的公民。我们只要求一次捐赠50龙币来维持我们的组织运作，此后当您使用我们的恢复、治愈和祝福祭坛时，只需要提交适当的费用即可——这可以帮助我们将九圣灵的祝福传播给比我们更为不幸的人们。<BR>
<BR>
那些希望加入瓦登费尔帝国教团的人们将会受到我们教团迎宾员的热烈欢迎：佩拉吉雅德的耶格法、雄蛾军团要塞的叙洛莉雅·西鲁里乌卢斯、月蛾军团要塞的苏穆蒂斯·文尼斯、黑檀心大议会厅的鲁西亚·康尼奇安以及黑檀心帝国教堂的拉拉蒂亚·瓦里安。<BR>
<BR>
如何在帝国教团中晋升？<BR>
<BR>
希望能够进一步为九圣灵服务的求道者们必须投入时间与资源来为教团服务，必须努力提高自身的属性与能力。只有足够杰出的人才有资格在帝国教团中晋升到更高的级别。<BR>
<BR>
为了服务九圣灵，为九圣灵增添光彩，信徒们必须培养高尚的人格和坚强的意志力。尊重魔法的艺术，尤其是恢复系学派、神秘系学派和召唤系学派。那些发誓不愿沾染血液、不身着盔甲、使用钝器作战的信徒们尤其值得称赞。附魔知识与口才天赋也是我们比较看重的品质。<BR>
<BR>
帝国教团的服务<BR>

你可以在雄蛾军团要塞、月蛾军团要塞、佩拉吉雅德军团要塞、尼希斯军团要塞、萨德里斯-莫拉的狼獾大厅、维威克城的外邦区以及黑檀心的帝国教堂找到帝国教团的服务。如果想要接受训练，可以在狼獾大厅、雄蛾要塞、月蛾要塞、黑檀心帝国教堂、卡尔德拉的总督府以及奥德-维洛提的前哨寻找训练者。<BR>

为教团服务的机会<BR>
<BR>
业余治疗师们的主要任务是收集恢复和治愈药水的材料以及在贫困地区为病人和伤者们服务。这是一项艰巨的任务，有时候甚至会有危险，但是这在精神上的回报是巨大的。业余治疗师们需要提高自己在旅行中的观察力，经常在道路上和荒野中采集草药材料。业余治疗师们并不需要特别会战斗，但是他们需要能够尽可能避开危险。对此有兴趣的人可以去和黑檀心帝国教堂的辛诺里安·图尼夫斯谈谈。<BR>

<BR>
帝国教团如何看待瓦登费尔的其他势力？<BR>
<BR>

<BR>

$93I arrest the King of Camlorn, the former Duke of Oloine, by my right as an Imperial Commanding Officer and Ambassador,$94 said Lord Strale. $93By the right of law of the Emperor of Tamriel which supercedes all provincial royal authority.$94<BR>
<BR>
Gyna came forward and tried to put her hand on Jyllia's arm, but she was coldly rebuffed.  Quietly, she sat down at the foot of the throne in the now empty audience chamber.<BR>
<BR>
$93This young lady came to me, having completely recovered her memory, but the story she told was beyond incredible, I simply couldn't believe it,$94 said Lord Strale. $93But she was so convinced of it, I had to investigate.  So I talked to everyone who was here at the palace twenty years ago to see if there could be any truth to it.  Of course, at the time of the King and Queen's murder, and the Princess's disappearance, there was a full inquiry made, but I had different questions to ask this time.  Questions about the relationship between the two little cousins, Lady Jyllia Raze and the Princess.$94<BR>

There has never been a question in my mind that you witnessed a horrible murder, and that your memory lapse and hers,$94 said Lord Strale, gesturing toward Gyna $93Are both very real. The story I heard from the servants and other people at the palace was that the little girls were inseparably close.  There were no other playmates, and as the Princess's place was to be close to her parents, so the little Lady Jyllia was always there as well.  When the assassin came to murder the Royal Family, the King and Queen were in their bedroom, and the girls were playing in the throne room.$94<BR>

I was on the throne, playing Empress, and you were hiding behind the dais, pretending you were in a dungeon I had sent you to.  A man I had never seen burst into the room from the Royal bedchamber, his blade soaked in blood.  He came at me, and I ran for my life.  I remember starting to run for the dais, but I saw your face, frozen in fear, and I didn't want to lead him to you.  So I ran for the window.<BR>
<BR>

You and I on the castle wall, and the King calling up to me, telling me how to get down.  But that day, I couldn't hold on, I was trembling so much.  I just fell, and landed in the river.<BR>

When I finally pulled myself out of the river, many miles away, I had no idea who I was.  And so it stayed,$94 Gyna smiled. $93Until now.$94<BR>

He confessed immediately to the murders of the Royal Family.  The Princess, he said, he had thrown out the window to her death.  A servant down below heard the scream, and saw something fly past his window, so he knew it to be true.<BR>

Ramke was very protective of you,$94 Strale said, nodding to Jyllia. $93She insisted on putting you to your room right away, and sent word the Duke of Oloine that the Royal Family was dead, and that his daughter had witnessed the murders but survived.$94<BR>
<BR>

I remember I just wanted it all to be play time still, I don't know why.  And then, I remember being bundled up and taken to that asylum.$94<BR>
<BR>

When I heard that, that no one but the Duke and his personal guard saw the assassin after he gave his initial confession, and that no one was present but the Duke and his guards when the assassin was killed trying to escape, I thought that very significant.<BR>
<BR>
$93I spoke with Lord Eryl, who I knew was one of those present, and I had to bluff him, pretending I had more evidence than I did.  I got the reaction I was hoping for, though it was a dangerous gambit.  At last he confessed to what I already knew to be true.<BR>

The Duke decided that it would be cheaper to silence him, so he murdered him then and there, so the man would never tell anyone what really happened,$94 Lord Strale shrugged. $93No tragic loss as far as murders go.  In a few years' time, you returned from the sanitarium, a little shaken but back to normal, except for a complete absence of memory about your childhood.  And in that time, the former Duke of Oloine had taken his brother's place as the King of Camlorn. It was no small maneuver.$94<BR>
<BR>
$93No,$94 said Jyllia, quietly. $93He must have been very busy.  He remarried and had another child.  No one ever came to visit me in the sanitarium but Ramke.$94<BR>

$93If he had visited and seen you,$94 said Gyna. $93This story might have turned out very differently.$94<BR>
<BR>

<BR>

<BR>
$93The two of you look remarkably alike now after twenty years of living very different lives, and as little girls and constant playmates, you looked nearly identical.<BR>
<BR>
$93At the time of the assassination, the murderer who had never been there before, only saw one girl on the throne, who he assumed to be his quarry.<BR>
<BR>

The nursemaid was the only single person who knew both Princess Talara and the Lady Jyllia who visited you while you were in the sanitarium.<BR>
<BR>
$93Finally,$94 said Lord Strale, $93Consider the fact that when you returned to court from the sanitarium, five years had past, and you had grown from a child to a young lady.  You looked familiar, but not quite the same as your family remembered you, which is only natural.$94<BR>
<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
The War of the First Council<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[This account by the Imperial scholar Agrippa Fundilius is based on various Imperial and Dunmer sources, and written for Western readers.]<BR>
<BR>
The War of the First Council was a First Age religious conflict between the secular Dunmer Houses Dwemer and Dagoth and the orthodox Dunmer Houses Indoril, Redoran, Dres, Hlaalu, and Telvanni. The First Council was the first pan-Dunmer governing body, which collapsed over disputes about sorceries and enchantments practiced by the Dwemer and declared profane by the other Houses.<BR>
<BR>
The Secular Houses, less numerous, but politically and magically more advanced, and aided by Nord and Orc clans drawn by promise of land and booty, initially campaigned with great success in the north of Morrowind, and occupied much of the land now comprising Redoran, Vvardenfell, and Telvanni District. The Orthodox Houses, widely dispersed and poorly organized, suffered defeat after defeat until Nerevar was made general of all House troops and levies.<BR>
<BR>
Nerevar secured the aid of nomad barbarian tribesmen, and contrived to force a major battle at the Secular stronghold of Red Mountain on Vvardenfell. The Secular forces were outmaneuvered and defeated with the help of Ashlander scouts, and the survivors forced to take refuge in the Dwemer stronghold at Red Mountain.<BR>
<BR>
After a brief siege, treason permitted Nerevar and his troops to enter the stronghold, where the Secular leaders were slain, and Nerevar mortally wounded. General slaughter followed, and Houses Dwemer and Dagoth were exterminated. Nerevar died shortly thereafter of his wounds.<BR>
<BR>
Three of Nerevar's associates among the Orthodox Houses, Vivec, Almalexia, and Sotha Sil, succeeded to control of the re-created First Council, re-named the Grand Council of Morrowind, and went on to be come the god-kings and immortal rulers of Morrowind known as the Tribunal, or Almsivi.<BR>
<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
第一议会之战<BR><BR>

[这份由帝国学者阿格里帕·冯迪里奥斯撰写的记述基于大量帝国人与丹莫的资料而完成，并且是写给西部的读者看的。]<BR>

第一议会的战争是发生在第一纪元的宗教战争，由世俗派丹莫家族的锻莫、达格斯对阵保守派丹莫家族：因多瑞尔、瑞多然、德雷斯、哈拉鲁和泰瓦尼。第一议会是最早的泛丹莫的统治集团，但却在围绕锻莫练习使用巫术魔法产生的争论纠纷，以及其他部族公然的挑衅亵渎中土崩瓦解。<BR>

On Morrowind<BR>
the Imperial Province<BR>
by Erramanwe of Sunhold<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
After the conquest of Hammerfell, Imperial legions massed along the northeastern borders of Cyrodiil, and invasion fleets prepared in Skyrim.<BR>
<BR>
Initially, though the Imperial legions and navy were widely considered undefeatable, House Indoril and the Temple hierarchy proposed to resist to the death. Redoran and Dres stood by Indoril, with Telvanni remaining neutral. Hlaalu proposed accommodation.<BR>
<BR>
Contrived border incidents in Black Marsh ended inconclusively, but the swampy terrain did not favor legion and navy coordination. Against the legions massed west of Silgrad Tower and Kragenmoor, and the legions west of Blacklight and Cormaris View, Morrowind had pitifully small militias stiffened by small companies of Redoran mercenaries and elite units of house nobles and Temple Ordinators and Armigers. Further complicating matters was the refusal of Indoril, Dres, Hlaalu, and Telvanni to garrison the western borders; Indoril and Dres proposed, rather than defend the western border, instead to withdraw to the interior and fight a guerilla war. With Hlaalu advocating accommodation, and Telvanni remaining neutral, Redoran therefore faced the prospect of standing alone against the Empire.<BR>
<BR>
The situation changed radically when Vivec appeared in person in Vivec City to announce his negotiation of a treaty with Emperor Tiber Septim, reorganizing Morrowind as a province of the Empire, but guaranteeing "all rights of faith and self-government." A shocked Temple hierarchy, which apparently had not been consulted, greeted the announcement with awkward silence. Indoril swore they would resist to the death, with the loyal support of Dres, while Redoran, grateful for a graceful excuse to avoid facing the legions unsupported, joined with Hlaalu in welcoming the agreement. Telvanni, seeing which way the wind blew, joined with Hlaalu and Redoran in supporting the treaty.<BR>
<BR>
Nothing is known of the circumstances of the personal meeting between Septim and Vivec, or where it took place, or the preliminaries which must have preceded the treaty. The public reason was to protect the identities of the agents involved. In the West, speculation has centered around the role of Zurin Arctus in brokering the agreement; in the East, rumors suggest that Vivec offered Numidium to aid in the conquest of the Altmer and Sumerset Isle in return for significant concessions to preserve self-rule, house traditions, and religious practices in Morrowind.<BR>
<BR>
The Lord High Councilor of the Grand Council, an Indoril, refused to accept the treaty, and refused to step down. He was assassinated, and replaced by a Hlaalu. House Hlaalu took the opportunity to settle some old scores with House Indoril, and a number of local councils changed hands in bloody coups. More blood was shed in these inter-house struggles than against the Imperial Legions during Morrowind's transition from an independent nation to a province of the Empire.<BR>
<BR>
The generals of the legions had dreaded an invasion of Morrowind. The Dunmer were widely regarded as the most dreadful and fanatic foes, further inspired by their Temple and clan traditions. The generals had not grasped the political weaknesses of Morrowind, which Emperor Tiber Septim recognized and exploited. At the same time, given the tragic depopulation and destruction experienced by the other provinces conquered by Septim, and the swift and efficient assimilation of Morrowind into the Imperial legal systems and economy, with relatively small impact on lower or upper classes of Morrowind's citizens, the Tribunal also deserves some credit for recognizing the hopelessness of Morrowind's defense, and the chance of gaining important concessions at the treaty table by being the first to offer peace.<BR>
<BR>
By contrast, many Indoril nobles chose to commit suicide rather than submit to the Empire, with the result that the House was significantly weakened during the period of transition, guaranteeing that they would lose much of their influence and power to House Hlaalu, whose influence and power was waxing with its enthusiastic accommodation with the Empire. The Temple hierarchy more skillfully managed their loss of face, remaining aloof from political struggles, and earning the good will of the people by concentrating on their economic, educational, and spiritual welfare.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
A Short History of Morrowind<BR>
by Jeanette Sitte<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[from the Introduction]<BR>
<BR>
Led by the legendary prophet Veloth, the ancestors of the Dunmer, exiles from Altmer cultures in present-day Summerset Isle, came to the region of Morrowind. In earliest times the Dunmer were harassed or dominated by Nord sea raiders. When the scattered Dunmer tribes consolidated into the predecessors of the modern Great House clans, they threw out the Nord oppressors and successfully resisted further incursions.<BR>
<BR>
The ancient ancestor worship of the tribes was in time superseded by the monolithic Tribunal Temple theocracy, and the Dunmer grew into a great nation called Resdayn. Resdayn was the last of the provinces to submit to Tiber Septim; like Black Marsh, it was never successfully invaded, and was peacefully incorporated by treaty into the Empire as the Province of Morrowind.<BR>
<BR>
Almost four centuries after the coming of the Imperial Legions, Morrowind is still occupied by Imperial legions, with a figurehead Imperial King, though the Empire has reserved most functions of the traditional local government to the Ruling Councils of the Five Great Houses....<BR>
<BR>
[on Vvardenfell District]<BR>
<BR>
In 3E 414, Vvardenfell Territory, previously a Temple preserve under Imperial protection, was reorganized as an Imperial Provincial District. Vvardenfell had been maintained as a preserve administrated by the Temple since the Treaty of the Armistice, and except for a few Great House settlements sanctioned by the Temple, Vvardenfell was previously uninhabited and undeveloped. But when the centuries-old Temple ban on trade and settlement of Vvardenfell was revoked by King of Morrowind, a flood of Imperial colonists and Great House Dunmer came to Vvardenfell, expanding old settlements and building new ones.<BR>
<BR>
The new District was divided into Redoran, Hlaalu, Telvanni, and Temple Districts, each separately administered by local House Councils or Temple Priesthoods, and all under the advice and consent of Duke Dren and the District Council in Ebonheart. Local law became a mixture of House Law and Imperial Law in House Districts, jointly enforced by House guards and Legion guards, with Temple law and Imperial law enforced in the Temple district by Ordinators. The Temple was still recognized as the majority religion, but worship of the Nine Divines was protected by the legions and encouraged by Imperial cult missions.<BR>
<BR>
The Temple District included the city of Vivec, the fortress of Ghostgate, and all sacred and profane sites (including those Blighted areas inside the Ghostfence) and all unsettled and wilderness areas on Vvardenfell. In practice, this district included all parts of Vvardenfell not claimed for Redoran, Hlaalu, or Telvanni Districts. The Temple stubbornly fought all development in their district, and were largely successful.<BR>
<BR>
House Hlaalu in combination with Imperial colonists embarked on a vigorous campaign of settlement and development. In the decades after reorganization, Balmora and the Ascadian Isles regions have grown steadily. Caldera and Pelagiad are completely new settlements, and all legion forts were expanded to accommodate larger garrisons.<BR>
<BR>
House Telvanni, normally conservative and isolationist, has been surprisingly aggressive in expanding beyond their traditional tower villages. Disregarding the protests of the other Houses, the Temple, the Duke, and the District council, Telvanni pioneers have been encroaching on the wild lands reserved to the Temple. The Telvanni council officially disavows responsibility for these rogue Telvanni settlements, but it is an open secret that they are encouraged and supported by ambitious Telvanni mage-lords.<BR>
<BR>
Under pressure from the Temple, conservative House Redoran has steadfastly resisted expansion in their district. As a result, House Redoran and the Temple are in danger of being politically and economically marginalized by the more aggressive and expansionist Hlaalu and Telvanni interests.<BR>
<BR>
The Imperial administration faces many challenges in the Vvardenfell district, but the most serious are the Great House rivalries, animosity from the Ashlander nomads, internal conflicts within the Temple itself, and the Red Mountain blight. Struggles between Great House, Temple, and Imperial interests to control Vvardenfell's resource could at any time erupt into full-scale war. Ashlanders raid settlements, plunder caravans, and kill foreigners on their wild lands. The Temple has unsuccessfully attempted to silence criticism and calls for reform within its ranks.<BR>
<BR>
But most serious are the plagues and diseased hosts produced by the blight storms sweeping out from Red Mountain. Vvardenfell and all Morrowind have long been menaced by the legendary evils of Dagoth Ur and his ash vampire kin dwelling beneath Red Mountain. For centuries the Temple has contained this threat within the Ghostfence. But recently the Temple's resources and will have faltered, and the threat from Red Mountain has grown in scale and intensity. If the Ghostfence should fail, and hosts of blighted monsters were to spill out across Vvardenfell's towns and villages, the Empire might have no choice but to evacuate Vvardenfell district and abandon it to disease and corruption.<BR>

"""<DIV ALIGN="CENTER"><FONT COLOR="000000" SIZE="3" FACE="Magic Cards"><BR>
晨风简史<BR>
让娜塔·西特　著<BR><BR>
<DIV ALIGN="LEFT"><BR><BR>
[导言]<BR>
<BR>
在传奇的先知维洛斯引领下，与傲特莫文化不相容而从如今的夏暮岛被放逐丹莫祖先们，来到了晨风。最早，丹莫受到诺德海盗的骚扰和控制。当分散的丹莫部落合并成了当代大家族的前身后，他们终于把诺德压迫者赶了出去，并且成功抵挡了以后的入侵。<BR>
<BR>
丹莫部落的祖先崇拜在一段时间后被铁板一块的、政教合一的审判席教会所取代，形成了一个叫做瑞斯戴恩的强大国家。瑞斯戴恩是各行省中最后一个听命于泰伯·塞普汀的；跟黑沼泽一样，从来没有被成功侵入过，而是通过条约和平地并入了帝国，成为了晨风省。<BR>
<BR>
距帝国军团的首次到来，已经快四个世纪了。帝国军团控制着晨风，名义上听令于作为帝国傀儡的晨风国王，虽然帝国把大部分地方政府的职能交给了五大家族的统治议会……<BR>
<BR>
[瓦登费尔地区]<BR>
<BR>
瓦登费尔地区原先作为审判席神殿的保留地受到帝国保护，在第三纪元的414年，该地被重组为帝国省份地区。自停战条约签订以来，瓦登费尔就一直以保留地的身份接受神殿的管理，除少量经神殿批准的大家族居住点外，瓦登费尔在过去不可居住，也从未被开发。然而，当神殿对瓦登费尔地区长达数世纪的贸易与居住禁令被晨风国王废止后，帝国殖民者与大家族的丹莫洪水一般涌上了瓦登费尔，扩展旧有居住地的同时也修建了新的定居点。<BR>
<BR>
新区被划分为瑞多然、哈拉鲁、泰瓦尼和神殿四个区域，每个区域都由本地的家族议会或神殿牧师独立管理，而所有议会都要遵从德伦公爵以及位于檀心城的地区议会的建议，行事也要获得他们的批准。家族区中的当地法律混合了家族律法与帝国法，由家族守卫与帝国守卫共同执行，而神殿区的神殿律法和帝国法则由神殿卫兵负责维护。审判席神殿依旧是主要宗教，但对九圣灵的崇拜则受到帝国军团的保护，且帝国教的传教士们鼓励宗教的传播。<BR>
<BR>
神殿区包括维威克城、幽魂之门要塞，以及所有神圣或亵渎的地点（也包括幽魂之墙以内的枯萎病地区），还有瓦登费尔全部无人居住的荒郊野地。实际上，所有未标明为瑞多然、哈拉鲁或泰瓦尼区的区域都属于神殿区。神殿顽固地反对在他们区域内的一切开发，就此取得了很大成功。<BR>
<BR>
哈拉鲁家族与帝国殖民者一道着手于朝气蓬勃的定居点修建和开发。在重组之后的数十年内，巴尔莫拉与阿斯卡迪安群岛区一直在稳定发展。卡尔德拉与佩拉吉亚德都是完全新建的定居点，而所有的军团要塞都为了适应规模更大的卫队而进行了扩建。<BR>
<BR>
泰瓦尼家族通常是保守的孤立主义者，如今却在他们传统的塔村之外进行着令人惊讶的侵略性扩张。泰瓦尼的先锋占据了本应属于神殿的野地，对来自其他家族、神殿、公爵以及地区议会的各类抗议完全不加理会。泰瓦尼议会在正式场合否认他们对这些游荡泰瓦尼定居点负有任何责任，但这些游荡法师获得了来自野心勃勃的泰瓦尼法师领主的鼓励与支持，这早已是公开的秘密。<BR>
<BR>
迫于神殿的压力，保守的瑞多然家族一直抵抗着扩张区域的诱惑毫不动摇。结果就是瑞多然家族与神殿无论在政治上还是经济上都处于被边缘化的危险之中，因为他们在哈拉鲁家族和泰瓦尼家族中的对手更具侵略性与扩张性。<BR>
<BR>
帝国的管理在瓦登费尔区面临着多重挑战，但其中最为严重的就是大家族间的彼此敌对，来自灰烬民游牧部落的敌视，审判席神殿的内部冲突以及红山的枯萎病。大家族、神殿与帝国为控制瓦登费尔的资源而在彼此间爆发的冲突随时都可能演变成全面战争。灰烬民抢掠定居点、抢劫商队，还会杀死出现在他们野地上的异邦人。而神殿试图平息批评之声与内部要求改革的呼吁，结果却并不成功。<BR>
<BR>
但最为严重的还是由自红山吹来的枯萎风暴带来的瘟疫和疾病宿主。瓦登费尔乃至整个晨风长久以来都一直受到居住在红山之下的达格斯·乌尔以及他手下灰烬吸血鬼的威胁。许多个世纪里神殿一直将这份威胁关押在幽魂之墙之内。但最近神殿的资源与决心都在动摇，而来自红山的威胁则在尺度与密度上都有所增长。一旦幽魂之墙失效，身带枯萎病的怪物就将遍布瓦登费尔的城镇村落，而帝国大概别无选择，只能撤离瓦登费尔区，将其留给疾病与腐败。<BR>

> INFO.NAME fines and compensation 967483371183231512

That may sound like a sweet deal -- kill an enemy, then pay the fine -- but folks who have enough money to pay such fines are almost always House lords, and House Wars customs means the Great House of the victim usually buys a writ with the Morag Tong to assassinate the murderer. So murderers pay, and THEN they get killed, too.

定居在瓦登费尔的三个丹莫大家族拥有各具特色的建筑和生活方式。贵族出身、好战的瑞多然家族偏爱宽敞、不规定、有机的建筑风格。哈拉鲁家族是一种积极进取的商业贸易文化，强烈崇拜帝国文化并受其影响，喜欢更简单、更现代、人口更稠密的定居点，而怪异的巫师塔楼则主导着泰瓦尼家族术士领主们的蘑菇小屋村庄。 {忙,帝国人,帝国教团}

> INFO.NAME three main cultures 32294599181092411
Three major cultural groupings have settled Vvardenfell: the Ashlander nomads, the Imperial Provincial culture, and the Dunmer Great House culture. The smallest settlements are the Ashlander nomadic camps, comprised of small portable huts. Recent Imperial colonies like Pelagiad display the same sturdy half-timbered homes and stone castles as might be found in Daggerfall or any other Western province. But the dominant culture is the native Dunmer Great House culture.
在瓦登费尔定居的主要有三大文化群体：灰烬之民游牧民族、帝国省文化和丹莫大家族文化。最小的定居点是灰烬之民的游牧营地，由可移动的小木屋组成。佩拉吉亚德等新近建立的帝国人殖民地也展示了与匕落或其他西方行省一样的坚固的半木结构房屋和石头城堡。但占主导地位的文化是本地的丹莫大家族文化。

> INFO.NAME morrowind's economy 26568306262210324108

在西方，廉价的铁、钢和银制重甲被大量制造，供军团使用，许多人都接受过使用训练。在东方，昂贵的黑檀和迪德拉式重甲仅限于贵族家庭使用。黑檀和迪德拉铠甲代代相传，在大贵族的个人财富中占有相当大的比重。

> INFO.NAME light armor styles 269463199827123017
Both the Western 'militia' and eastern 'Ashlander' armor styles depends on light, cheap leather armors. The Eastern reinforced chitin armor, however, is distinctly superior to Western-style leather armors, and offers better protection, pound for pound and drake for drake, than any other armor. The 'glass' light armors of the noble Great Houses are in the high Altmer style, strikingly light and stylish, and comparable with the ebony and daedric in protection, but are expensive and in short supply.

> INFO.NAME exotic armor types 3075976112588917522
Fur armor is a light armor style popular among Nord barbarians. Dreugh is a remarkably strong Dunmer medium armor, made from Dreugh hide. But the most famous exotic armor is Dwemer, or Dwarvish armor, a highly ornate heavy armor valued as much for its rarity and antique craftsmanship as for its distinctive impact-absorbing qualities in combat.
毛皮甲是诺德人野蛮人中流行的一种轻甲样式。蟹灵甲是一种异常坚固的丹莫中甲，由蟹灵皮制成。但最著名的异域盔甲是锻莫（或矮人盔甲），这是一种高度华丽的重甲，因其稀有性和古董般的工艺以及在战斗中独特的冲击吸取能力而备受重视。

> INFO.NAME material and craft 1647324345213796668
Weapons popular in Morrowind can be categorized according to their material and craft. In approximate order of value and utility, the types are: chitin, iron, steel, silver, dwarven, nordic, glass, ebony, and daedric.
晨风中流行的武器可根据其材料和工艺进行分类。按照价值和实用性的大致顺序排列为：甲壳制、铁制、钢制、银制、矮人风格、诺德风格、玻璃制、黑檀制和迪德拉式。 {诺德人}

> INFO.NAME diseased creatures 26472799563596420
The following creatures are susceptible to common diseases: scrib; kwama worker, cliff racer, alit, shalk, kagouti, and rat. Since disease is contracted by contact, after an encounter with these creatures, make sure you haven't gotten a disease.
以下生物容易感染常见疾病：幼虫；夸蚂工虫、峭壁迅鸟、鳄蜥、砂壳虫、盾角蜥和老鼠。由于疾病是通过接触传染的，所以在遇到这些生物后，要确保自己没有感染疾病。 {工作,沙尔,合同}

> INFO.NAME daedric summonings 3204822843910829785
Certain Daedric summonings are more often encountered on Vvardenfell. Good Daedra are the Daedra associated with Boethiah, Azura, and Mephala -- the winged twilight and the hunger. Bad Daedra are associated with Mehrunes Dagon, Malacath, Sheogorath, and Molag Bal. Atronachs are unaligned Daedra of the elemental planes. But don't judge a summoning by its patron. The summoner commands a summoning, and, good or bad, nice or nasty, they must do the summoner's bidding.
某些迪德拉召唤物在瓦登费尔更常遇到。善良的迪德拉造物是与波耶西亚、阿祖拉和梅法拉有关的迪德拉——比如曙暮翼魔和饥饿魔。邪恶的迪德拉造物与梅鲁涅斯·大衮、谢尔格拉斯、马拉卡斯和莫拉格·巴尔有关。元素侍灵是元素界不结盟的迪德拉。但不要根据召唤物的守护者来判断召唤物的善恶。但凡是召唤者指挥的召唤物，无论好坏、善恶，它们都必须听从召唤者的命令。 {迪德拉式,计划,资助者}

> INFO.NAME attribute-draining 861951363362084
Attribute-draining spells reduce the eleven fundamental attributes of natural and supernatural beings: agility, endurance, fatigue, health, intelligence, luck, personality, speed, strength, willpower, magica. The reduction is only temporary, and the attribute returns to normal after the duration of the magical effect elapses. The most common of these destruction spells are: clumsiness, distraction, exhaustion, gash spirit , misfortune, spite, strain, temptation, torpor, weakness, and wound.
毁灭系法术中的属性削弱法术会降低自然生物和超自然生物的十一种基本属性：敏捷、耐力、体力、生命、智力、幸运、魅力、速度、力量、意志和魔力。状态减损只是暂时的，在魔法效果持续时间结束后，属性就会恢复正常。最常见的毁灭系法术有：笨拙、涣散、疲惫、裂灵术、厄运、怨恨、竭力、诱惑、迟钝、虚弱和创伤。

> INFO.NAME attribute-damaging 95046402805215634
Attribute-damaging spells actually destroy the eleven fundamental attributes of natural and supernatural beings: agility, endurance, fatigue, health, intelligence, luck, personality, speed, strength, willpower, magica. The victim's attributes are reduced permanently. The most common of these destruction spells are: curse agility, curse endurance, curse fatigue, curse health, curse intelligence, curse luck, curse personality, curse speed, curse strength, curse willpower, and curse spell points.
毁灭系法术中的属性伤害法术实际上是破坏自然生物和超自然生物的十一种基本属性：敏捷、耐力、体力、生命、智力、幸运、魅力、速度、力量、意志和魔力。受害者的属性会永久降低。最常见的毁灭系法术有：诅咒敏捷、诅咒耐力、诅咒体力、诅咒生命、诅咒智力、诅咒幸运、诅咒魅力、诅咒速度、诅咒力量、诅咒意志和诅咒魔力。

> INFO.NAME bound armor spells 177942089766420471
Bound armor spells summon lesser daedra constrained within the form of magical armor for the duration of the magical effect. The armor pieces are impossibly light, superbly formed, and supernaturally durable. The most common spells of this variety are: bound cuirass, bound helm, bound boots, bound shield, and bound gauntlets.
束缚盔甲类法术可以在魔法效果持续期间召唤被束缚在魔法铠甲中的较小的迪德拉。这些铠甲轻巧无比，造型精湛，而且超乎寻常地耐用。最常见的此类法术有：束缚盔甲、束缚头盔、束缚靴子、束缚盾牌和束缚腕甲。

> INFO.NAME ashlander courtesy 289832792271198350
Ashlanders may challenge a stranger who enters a yurt without invitation. Customs differ with different tribes, but leave when requested, and you may be forgiven. Be particularly careful about ashkhans -- tribal chiefs -- and wise women -- tribal seers and counselors. Some are welcoming, some are hostile. Be courteous, and leave if requested. If offended, they may attack.
灰烬之民可能会对未经邀请而进入帐篷的陌生人提出质疑。不同的部落有不同的习俗，但如果有人只是要求你离开，你可能会被原谅。要特别小心灰烬可汗（部落酋长）和女智者（部落先知和顾问）。他们有的热情好客，有的则充满敌意。要有礼貌，如果被要求就离开。如果冒犯了他们，他们可能会攻击你。 {女人,咨询}

> INFO.NAME dunmer urban style 16269162871052125074
Dunmer towns are typically organized around a dominant central feature, either the Temple or the grand manor residences of the Great House nobles. Simple multi-storied public and commercial buildings -- tradehouses, craftguilds, and such -- are usually rectangular in floor plan, built from local materials, featuring organic curves with decorated exteriors. More modest one-story private dwellings follow the same plan, except with less decoration.
丹莫城镇通常是围绕着一个主要的中心特征组织起来的，要么是神殿，要么是大家族贵族的大庄园住宅。简单的多层公共和商业建筑——贸易行、手工业公会等——通常是长方形平面，用当地材料建造，以有机曲线和装饰外墙为特色。较普通的单层私人住宅也采用相同的设计，只是装饰较少。 {计划}

> INFO.NAME absorption spells 189562236611077547
Absorption spells transfer fundamental attributes from the victim to the caster. For the duration of the spell, the victim's attributes are drained, while the caster's attributes are increased. At the end of the spell effect, attributes return to normal. The most common of these mysticism spells are: absorb agility, absorb endurance, absorb fatigue, absorb health, absorb intelligence, absorb luck, absorb personality, absorb speed, absorb strength, absorb willpower, and absorb spell points.
吸收类法术会将目标的基本属性转移给施法者。在法术持续期间，目标的属性会被削弱，而施法者的属性则会增加。法术效果结束时，属性恢复正常。这些神秘系法术中最常见的有：吸取敏捷、吸取耐力、吸取体力、吸取生命、吸取智力、吸取幸运、吸取魅力、吸取速度、吸取力量、吸取意志力和吸取法术点数。

The most common of these mysticism spells are: absorb agility, absorb endurance, absorb fatigue, absorb health, absorb intelligence, absorb luck, absorb personality, absorb speed, absorb strength, absorb willpower, and absorb spell points.
吸收类法术会将目标的基本属性转移给施法者。在法术持续期间，目标的属性会被削弱，而施法者的属性则会增加。法术效果结束时，属性恢复正常。这些神秘系法术中最常见的有：吸取敏捷、吸取耐力、吸取体力、吸取生命、吸取智力、吸取幸运、吸取魅力、吸取速度、吸取力量、吸取意志力和吸取法术点数。

> INFO.NAME domination spells 15682663842864130
Domination spells permit the caster to bend the will of creatures and humanoids to the caster's service. Affected creatures and humanoids will not, alas, listen to or follow orders, but they will feel a compulsion to aid and protect the caster. Most otherworldly creatures are unaffected, though the undead can be compelled to avoid the caster. The most common domination spells are: turn undead, command creatures, and command humanoids.
支配类法术允许施法者将人形和非人形生物的意志屈从于施法者。受影响的人形和非人形生物不会直接听从或服从命令，但他们会感到一种想要帮助和保护施法者的冲动。大多数迪德拉生物都不会受到影响，不过亡灵会被蛊惑然后避开施法者。最常见的支配法术有：转化亡灵、控制生物和控制人形生物。 {指示}

> INFO.NAME mercantile skills 10349197382984120600
Mercantile skills are the skills of evaluation and negotiation -- the estimation of worth, and the resolution of conflicts over worth. The immediate goal is profit, of course, but more important is the long-term relationship, the client's loyalty and confidence. > INFO.NAME ashlander customs 1764488981313229729
Take care when visiting an Ashlander camp. Among clan and kin, Ashlander courtesy is very proper and polite, but you are a stranger, so remember that Ashlanders hate foreigners. Ashlander challenges are very solemn and serious things; do not make a challenge lightly. I quote from Jeanette Sitte's 'Short History of Morrowind'. 'Led by the legendary prophet Veloth, the ancestors of the Dunmer, exiles from Altmer cultures in present-day Summerset Isles, came to the region of Morrowind. > INFO.NAME ashlander culture 6348107772987417634
The Ashlander culture is an anachronistic survival of the ancestor-worshipping tribal culture that evolved into the theocratic Great House culture of the native Dunmer. The Ashlanders perversely prefer the impoverished physical culture and subsistence economy of the Ashland nomadic herder-hunter, and their ancestor worship is shamanistic and primitive by Dunmer and Imperial standards.
灰烬之民文化是一种不合时宜的崇拜先祖的部落文化的延续，这种部落文化早已演变成了本地丹莫的神权大家族文化。灰烬之民反常地偏爱灰烬之地游牧狩猎者贫乏的物质文化和自给自足的经济，按照丹莫和帝国人的标准，他们的祖先崇拜是萨满教式的原始崇拜。

> INFO.NAME native creatures 18093102351602022738
Vvardenfell has many native creatures, some more dangerous than others. The main varieties are: kwama, flying creatures, herd animals, large bipedal predators, small predators, and water creatures. Two types of creatures are particularly dangerous, because they carry disease: diseased creatures -- creatures suffering from milder local common diseases -- and blighted creatures -- creatures suffering from the more dangerous blight diseases.
瓦登费尔有许多本地生物，有些比其他生物更危险。主要种类有：夸蚂、飞行生物、群居动物、大型双足食肉动物、小型掠食者和水生动物。有两类生物特别危险，因为它们携带疾病：患病的生物——患有较轻的当地常见疾病的生物；枯萎病生物——因枯萎病瘟疫而患有较危险的枯萎病的生物。

> INFO.NAME flying creatures 1245215081680511722
Two kinds of flying creatures are common on Vvardenfell: netch and cliff racers. Bull netch are giant, peaceful floating creatures with long tentacles that dangle to the ground. Betty netch are smaller than the bull netch, but more aggressive and dangerous. Cliff racers are winged, leathery flying creatures larger than a man, with long wicked beaks and flailing tails. They're a serious threat, especially in packs.
瓦登费尔常见的飞行生物有两种：气母和峭壁迅鸟。雄性气母是一种巨大而安详的漂浮生物，长长的触须垂到地面上。雌性气母比雄性气母小，但更具攻击性和危险性。峭壁迅鸟是一种长着翅膀、皮膜覆身的飞行生物，体型比人还大，长着凶恶的长喙与甩动的尾刺。它们是致命的威胁，尤其是成群出没时。

Here is a list of the most basic destruction spells, representing all the fundamental classes of elemental damage effects: flame, flamebolt, spark, sparkbolt, shard, shardbolt, poison, and poisonbolt. In general, these effects cause damage on touch or at range, and the '-bolt' version is the ranged variant of the spell.

> INFO.NAME summoning spells 840729737232129082
Summoning spells summon otherworldly creatures from the outer realms to ward and protect the caster for the duration of the magical effect. More common spells of this sort include: summon ancestral ghost, summon least bonewalker, summon greater bonewalker, summon skeletal minion, and summon scamp. More powerful spells of this class, like summon dremora and summon daedroth, expend too much magicka to be practical for all but master sorcerers.

> INFO.NAME imperial culture 28195284501790522903
Persons of all races and creeds can advance in wealth and status in commerce, the bureaucracy, and the military. However, moral and political corruption at the highest levels of Imperial society, and the economic strain of maintaining military occupations in widely separated hostile provinces like Morrowind, signals the impending decline of the Empire.
所有种族和信仰的人都可以在商业、官僚体制和军队中提升财富和地位。然而，帝国社会最高层的道德和政治腐败，以及在像晨风这样相距甚远的敌对省份维持军事占领所带来的经济压力，预示着泰姆瑞尔帝国即将走向衰落。 {帝国人}

> INFO.NAME imperial culture 1722344857439856
Imperial culture is a pragmatic melting pot of the various contrasting cultures of the Imperial provinces, unified by a strong hereditary emperor and bureaucracy, the rule of law, a powerful professional army, and tolerance of disparate polytheistic cult worships. Education and wealth is broadly distributed through all social classes where Imperial culture has flourished; many citizens are literate and protected under Imperial law.
帝国文化是各个帝国省份各种截然不同文化的实用主义大熔炉，由强大的世袭皇帝和官僚体制、法治、强大的职业军队以及对不同多神教崇拜的宽容统一起来。在帝国文化繁荣的地方，教育和财富广泛分布于各个社会阶层；许多公民都识字，并受到帝国法律的保护。 {帝国人,帝国教团}

> INFO.NAME affairs of honor 2282729956131537934
Native Dunmer and Imperials alike recognize a noble's obligation to answer a challenge of honor. A challenge of honor is a public declaration of a scandal against a private party. Only nobles fight duels, and the higher the rank, the stronger the obligation. Law and custom despises dishonorable duelists. If the victim was bullied, intimidated, or goaded by a stronger party with suspect motives, magistrates often convict the stronger party of foul murder.
丹莫本地人和帝国人都承认贵族有义务回应荣誉挑战。荣誉挑战是针对个人的公开丑闻声明。只有贵族才参加决斗，等级越高，义务越重。法律和习俗鄙视不光彩的决斗者。如果受害者受到动机可疑的强势一方的欺凌、恐吓或诱导，地方法官通常会判定强势一方犯有谋杀罪。

> INFO.NAME dwemer language 2099524978108755870
The Dwemer language is unknown, perhaps unknowable. Some Dwemer books, especially records dating from after the founding of Resdayn, were written in Aldmeris, making them accessible to modern scholars. > INFO.NAME blight diseases 70601556299415606
Blight diseases resist common herbal and magical treatments, and are of two kinds: wasting diseases which attack one or more of an organism's systems, and abnormal growth diseases, which distort the organism's functions and structures. Natives avoid exposure to the Blight, and wear special protective garments when traveling in Blight-prone regions.
枯萎之症难以被普通草药和魔法治疗治愈，一般分为两种：一种是消耗性疾病，会侵袭生物体的一个或多个系统；另一种是异常生长疾病，会扭曲生物体的功能和结构。本地人会避免接触枯萎病，在枯萎病瘟疫严重的地区旅行时会穿上特殊的防护服。

> INFO.NAME foreign quarter 5024239721273824353
The Foreign Quarter is the large three-tiered canton to the north. Originally, foreigners were not allowed to enter Vivec any further than the Foreign Quarter, but now outlanders can travel throughout Vivec at will. The Imperial Guilds each have guildhalls and complete services here, and an Imperial cult shrine serves the spiritual needs of the Imperial faithful. Various independent tradesmen, craftsmen, and trainers also rent space here. The Black Shalk Cornerclub rents beds to non-guild visitors.
外邦区是北面的三层大区。最初，外邦人不得进入维威克城外邦区以外的区域，但现在外地人可以随意在维威克各地旅行。帝国公会在这里都设有公会大厅并提供完备的服务，帝国教团圣祠则为帝国信众的精神需求提供服务。各种独立的商人、工匠和训练师也在这里租用场地。黑砂壳虫街角酒吧向非公会游客出租床位。 {帝国人,需要,信仰,沙尔}

> INFO.NAME hlaalu compound 38874683121713974
Hlaalu Compound is the westmost canton. Councilor Crassius Curio has a splendid tier-top mansion here. The tiers below contain Hlaalu treasuries, records, holding cells, and various services. There are two public houses: the Elven Nations and the No Name Club. A variety of craftsmen and tradesmen also have shops at Hlaalu Compound. Some House Hlaalu nobles maintain residences in the less-formal St. Delyn and St. Olms cantons. Councilor Velanda Omani's manor is east of the city on Elmas Island.
哈拉鲁驻地是最西边的区域。克拉西乌斯·库里奥议员在这里有一座华丽的顶级豪宅。下面几层是哈拉鲁财政部、资料室、监狱和各种服务设施。这里有两个公共场所：精灵国度和无名酒吧。各种工匠和商人也在哈拉鲁大院开店。哈拉鲁家族的一些贵族在不太正式的圣·德林区和圣·奥姆斯行政区也有住所。维兰达·奥曼尼庄园位于城东的埃尔马斯岛。 {棍棒}

> INFO.NAME st. olms canton 7890181971676018509
St. Delyn Canton and St. Olms Canton are residence cantons for commoners and paupers. The Temple charges very reasonable rents for comfortable workshops, shops, and apartments, and most of Vvardenfell's crafts and light industry is housed in these cantons. The Abbey of St. Delyn the Wise is on the top tier of St. Delyn, and Hlaalu Councilor Yngling Half-Troll has a top-tier manor on St. Olms.
圣·德林行政区和圣·奥姆斯行政区是平民和贫民的居住区。神殿为舒适的作坊、商店和公寓收取非常合理的租金，瓦登费尔的大部分手工业和轻工业都在这些屯驻。智者圣·德林的修道院位于圣·德林的顶层，哈拉鲁议员英灵·半巨魔庄园位于圣·奥姆斯行政区。

> INFO.NAME palace of vivec 19137103203183431130
The Palace of Vivec is the abode of the mortal form of the god-hero Lord Vivec, the Warrior-Poet of the three deities who comprise Almsivi, the divine patrons of the Tribunal Temple. Only the most devout are admitted to the presence of Lord Vivec, and only at his initiation. Beneath the Palace of Vivec is the Puzzle Canal, a place of worship and testing for questing heroes hoping to receive Vivec's favor. Many choice treasures are guarded by Daedric servants in the Puzzle Canal's dark passages.
维威克神殿是维威克大人的凡间居所，他是组成审判席神殿包括奥姆希维在内的三位神祗中的诗武者。只有最虔诚的信徒才能见到维威克神，而且只有在他的授意下才能见到。维威克神殿下面是谜渠，是希望得到维威克恩宠的探险英雄们接受崇拜和考验之地。迪德拉的仆人在谜渠的暗道中守护着许多精选宝物。 {资助者,忙,瓜尔,卫兵,迪德拉式}

> INFO.NAME tribunal temple 2853011934596714848
The Temple believes that Almalexia, Vivec, and Sotha Sil were mortal guardians of Morrowind who walked the earth, defeated the Dunmer's greatest enemies, the Nords and the Dwarves, and achieved divine substance through superhuman discipline and virtue and supernatural wisdom and insight. > INFO.NAME specific place 15667164162493410640
Tel Fyr is the wizard's tower of the Telvanni Mage-Lord Divayth Fyr. It's also known as the Corprusarium, because this is where all victims of corprus disease are sent. Let me tell you the basics about weapon wear. Weapons become less effective with wear. Eventually they break, and are useless until you repair them, but a worn weapon does only a fraction of the damage it should do. You'll hack and stab and slash away, and suddenly realize you're doing almost nothing to your enemy. So learn the basics of weapon repair, and touch up your weapons before every big fight, or pay a smith to keep your weapons in top shape.
让我来告诉你关于武器磨损的基本知识。武器会随着磨损而降低效能。最终，它们会断裂，在你修复之前毫无用处，但磨损的武器只能造成其应有伤害的一小部分。你砍啊捅啊劈啊，突然就会发现自己的攻击对敌人几乎毫无作用。因此，请学习武器维修的基础知识，在每场大战之前修整一下武器，或者花钱请铁匠让你的武器保持最佳状态。

An adventurer should know the basics of Imperial law concerning life and property. Verbal assault, pickpocketing, and trespassing are malfeasances, punishable by fines and compensation of less than 100 drakes, or by punitive labor. Theft and foul murder are felonies. The Emperor should put a stop to slavery, but the Dunmer claim the right to own slaves is guaranteed by the Armistice.
在晨风的法理当中，奴隶制度受法律保护。在泰姆瑞尔帝国的其他地方，奴隶制都是非法的。但一些丹莫仍在捍卫他们拥有奴隶的“古老权利”。在晨风，奴隶们被附魔的奴隶手镯束缚。手镯会耗尽奴隶的魔力，因此他们无法使用魔法逃跑。除非你有钥匙，否则无法取下奴隶臂环。皇帝应该制止奴隶制度，但丹莫声称拥有奴隶的权利得到了停战协定的保障。

But certain ambitious wizards-lords, their retainers, and clients have entered whole-heartily into the competition to control and exploit Vvardenfell's land and resources, building towers and bases all along the eastern coast. > INFO.NAME current events 32030551020854759

> INFO.NAME humanoid races 1763323927231112605
Offspring of inter-racial matings have the racial appearance of the mother, but may occasionally share inherited characteristics and abilities of the father. Sloads, dragons, and other sentient races cannot mate with Men, Elves, or Beastmen, and are not considered 'human.' Exceptional accounts of matings between men and daedra do not fit smoothly into this scheme.
异族通婚的后代拥有母亲的种族外表，但偶尔也会拥有父亲的遗传特征和能力。斯洛德、龙和其他有生命的种族不能与人类、精灵或兽人交配，也不能被视为“人类”。人类和迪德拉之间的罕见交配并不完全适用于这个规律。

> INFO.NAME humanoid races 1647531923350923226
Elves consider themselves the only 'truly human race,' being descended directly from the gods, and regard the Manish and Beast races as highly intelligent animals. On the other hand, Imperial scholars consider Men, Elves, and Beastmen as 'men,' on the basis that individuals of all three groups can mate with one another.
精灵认为自己是神的直系后裔，是唯一的“真正的人类”，并将人种和兽人视为高智商的动物。另一方面，帝国学者认为人族、精灵族和兽人族都是“人”，理由是这三个种族的个体都可以相互交配。 {帝国人}

> INFO.NAME summerset isle 181210435207935152
The Summerset Isle is a green and pleasant land of fertile farmlands, woodland parks, and ancient towers and manors. Most settlements are small and isolated, and dominated by ruling seats of the local wizard or warlord. The Isle has few good natural ports, and the natives are unwelcoming to foreigners, so the ancient, chivalric high culture of the Aldmer is little affected by modern Imperial mercantilism.
夏暮岛是一片绿色宜人的土地，这里有肥沃的农田、林地公园、古老的塔楼和庄园。大多数定居点都很小，与世隔绝，由当地的巫师或军阀统治。岛上几乎没有天然良港，当地人也不欢迎外邦人，因此奥德莫古老的骑士高尚文化几乎没有受到现代帝国人重商主义的影响。

> INFO.NAME little advice 190453052515814369

If you want to make your mark as a mage, you haven't got much choice. It's the Mages Guild or nothing. Oh, you can pick up experience and education from the Temple or the Imperial cult, but here in the settled West, the Mages Guild has all the best people, best libraries and facilities, best work opportunities. Of course, all the REAL wizards are Telvanni Dunmer, out on the east coast. But they are all either cranky or crazy or just plain mean. You got to be tough just to TALK with those wizard-lords.
如果你想成为一名法师，那你的选择不多。要么加入法师公会，要么一无所有。哦，你可以在神殿或帝国教团学习积累经验，但在定居点的西部，法师公会拥有最好的人、最好的图书馆和设施、最好的工作机会。当然，真正的法师都是东海岸的泰瓦尼家族的丹莫。但他们要么脾气暴躁，要么疯疯癫癫，要么就是很刻薄。要想和那些巫师大人交谈，你得有过硬的本领。 {帝国人}

如果你想成为一名法师，那你的选择不多。要么加入法师公会，要么一无所有。哦，你可以在神殿或帝国教团学习积累经验，但在定居点的西部，法师公会拥有最好的人、最好的图书馆和设施、最好的工作机会。当然，真正的法师都是东海岸的泰瓦尼家族的丹莫。但他们要么脾气暴躁，要么疯疯癫癫，要么就是很刻薄。要想和那些巫师大人交谈，你得有过硬的本领。 {帝国人}

> INFO.NAME little advice 2349213562990526938
The easy way to get started is to join a Guild. Do their jobs, earn your way up the ranks, get the discounts, training, and other services. Gets you out and around in Vvardenfell, a little at a time, get to know the country and the people. The Guild takes an interest in you, doesn't send you in over your head. The Fighters Guild and the Legion, anyway. The Mages Guild is another story. Some old chair-polisher, doesn't have a clue what he's sending you into, doesn't much care.
入门的简单方法就是加入公会。给他们做一些活，靠自己的努力晋级，获得折扣、训练和其他服务。让你在瓦登费尔四处漫游，一点一点地了解这片土地和人民。公会会对你感兴趣，不会把你送上绝路。反正战士公会和军团是这样。法师公会则另当别论。一些老法师，不知道他派你去做什么，也不太关心。

> INFO.NAME little advice 32730501277161293
Outlanders new in Vvardenfell do best in Balmora. House Hlaalu is Imperial through and through, and you get a good mix of native and Imperial people and services. Not as friendly to outlanders up north in House Redoran country, or down in big Vivec City, and DEFINITELY not friendly out east with the Telvanni wizards. Shop the outfitters, then check out the guilds for work. If you want to be adopted by a Great House, you'll need a patron, and that's easier when you've got a reputation.
对于初到瓦登费尔的外地人来说，巴尔莫拉是最佳的落脚点。哈拉鲁家族彻头彻尾效忠帝国，巴尔莫拉这里汇聚着本土居民与帝国移民，各类服务设施一应俱全。相比之下，北部的瑞多然家族领地和南部的维威克城对外地人并不友好，而东部泰瓦尼巫师的领地更是绝对的敌对之地。先逛逛装备商铺，然后再去各个公会找点工作干。要是想被大家族收为义子，你需要一位庇护者——而声望越高，获得庇护就越容易。 {帝国人,资助者}

> INFO.NAME blunt weapons 2555317621637121248
Clubs and staves are cheap, easy-to-master, all-purpose weapons for travelers and militias. The mace and morningstar are one-handed, the warhammer is two-handed, slow, and heavy; all three are proper weapons for professional warriors. Rank them by effectiveness as club, staff, mace, morningstar, and warhammer, with club least effective.
对于旅行者和民兵来说，棍棒和长棍是廉价、易于掌握的万能武器。钉锤和流星锤是单手武器，战锤是双手武器，速度慢，重量大；这三种武器都是职业战士的合适武器。按效果排序，它们分别是棍棒、杖、钉锤、流星锤和战锤，其中棍棒效果最差。

> INFO.NAME dwarven ghost 331320671528726561
Dwarven ghosts are encountered in the ancient abandoned Dwemer ruins. They are aggressive and dangerous, but ectoplasm, a filmy residue that remains after the revenant spirit of a Dwemer has been banished from the mortal plane, is a rare, valuable substance with modest magical properties. Normal weapons do not harm them; only enchanted or silver weapons or deadly spells affect them.
在古老的废弃锻莫遗迹中会遇到矮人幽灵。它们具有攻击性，也很危险，但锻莫灵质是一种残留的薄膜状物质，是锻莫的复仇之魂被驱逐出凡间后留下的，是一种稀有珍贵的物质，具有适度的魔法属性。普通武器不会对它们造成伤害，只有附魔的或银制的武器或致命的咒语才会对它们造成影响。 {计划}

> INFO.NAME toxic potions 857213029220214132
Toxic potions are potions with undesirable effects. They are not available commercially, and when found, usually represent clumsy or ill-informed attempts to make useful potions by unskilled alchemists. Toxic potions include: drain strength, drain intelligence, drain willpower, drain agility, drain speed, drain personality, drain luck, drain health, drain spell points, drain fatigue, drain endurance, and paralyze.
毒性药水是具有不良效果的药水。它们无法在市场上买到，即使被发现，也通常是不熟练的炼金术士笨拙或不明真相地尝试制作有用的药水。毒性药水包括：削弱力量、削弱智力、削弱意志、削弱敏捷、削弱速度、削弱魅力、削弱幸运、削弱生命、削弱魔力、削弱体力、削弱耐力和麻痹。 {这些药水}

The most common of these destruction spells are: weakness to fire, weakness to frost, weakness to shock, weakness to magicka, and weakness to poison.

> INFO.NAME house indoril 16166129550895167
House Indoril is one of the five Dunmer Great Houses, and one of the two houses without holdings or interest in Vvardenfell. The city of Almalexia is located in Indoril District, and the Indoril are orthodox and conservative supporters of the Temple and Temple authority. House Indoril is openly hostile to Imperial culture and religion, and preserves many traditional Dunmer customs and practices in defiance of Imperial law.

The light armor styles, called 'militia' in the West and 'Ashlander' in the East, favor speed and agility. > INFO.NAME short blades 134419081525912824
The dagger and short sword are Western Imperial weapons. The tanto and wakizashi are styled after Akaviri blades. These weapons are light and fast, most effective against lightly armored opponents, but a skilled user can outlast more heavily armed and armored opponents. The dagger, tanto, and short sword are thrusting weapons, the wakizashi a chopping and slashing weapon. Rank them by effectiveness as dagger, tanto, short sword, and wakizashi, with dagger least effective.
匕首和短剑是西方帝国人的武器。短刀和胁差则是仿照阿卡维尔刀刃的造型。这些武器又轻又快，对付轻型装甲的对手最有效，但熟练的使用者可以在重型武器和装甲的对手面前立于不败之地。匕首、短刀和短剑是刺击武器，胁差则是劈砍武器。将它们按效果排列为匕首、短刀、短剑和胁差，其中匕首的效果最差。 {刀锋}

> INFO.NAME worn weapons 9705265311226428655
Weapons become less effective with wear. Eventually they break, and are useless until you repair them, but a worn weapon does only a fraction of the damage it should do. You'll hack and stab and slash away, and suddenly realize you're doing almost nothing to your enemy. So learn the basics of weapon repair, and touch up your weapons before every big fight, or pay a smith to keep your weapons in top shape.
武器会随着磨损而降低功效。最终，它们会折断，在你修复之前毫无用处，但磨损的武器只能造成其应有伤害的一小部分。你砍啊捅啊劈啊，突然发现自己对敌人几乎毫无作用。因此，要学习武器维修的基础知识，在每次大战之前都要修整一下武器，或者花钱请铁匠铺让你的武器保持最佳状态。

The salt marshes and humid swamps of this region are uninhabited, with the only settlements found at the good harbors of Gnaar Mok, Hla Oad, and Seyda Neen. > INFO.NAME imperial law 92007572166935078
An adventurer should know the basics of Imperial law concerning life and property. Verbal assault, pickpocketing, and trespassing are minor crimes, punished by fines or hard labor. Theft and foul murder are felonies. Theft is punished by fines proportional to the value of the property stolen, or by hard labor. Foul murder is punishable by fines of at least 1000 drakes, or by hard labor.

> INFO.NAME speechcraft 2541711780999925546
Speechcraft involves the allied arts of verbal communication, entertainment, and persuasion. A master of speechcraft understands the subtleties of language, and teases meaning out of obscure mysteries. An entertainer with speechcraft skill knows how to move his audience, how to reinforce a tales' moral, and how to make a tale come alive for the listener. A diplomat -- or fast-talking con man -- can sway the judgements and emotions of a listener to achieve his own ends.
口才涉及语言交流、娱乐和说服等相关艺术。言语艺术大师了解语言的精妙之处，并能从晦涩难懂的谜语中挖掘含义。一个有口才技巧的艺人知道如何打动听众，如何强化故事的寓意，如何让故事生动地展现在听众面前。一个外交家或快嘴骗子可以左右听众的判断和情绪，从而达到自己的目的。 {谈}

> INFO.NAME body armor 1035711811142564239
First, wear as much armor as you can carry and still fight without passing out. Second, use armor that matches the style you are skilled in -- light, medium, or heavy armored style. Third, keep your armor in good shape. Worn armor is less effective; badly-worn armor is just as heavy as new armor, but provides almost no protection. Fourth, buy the best quality armor you can afford. Fifth, if you're trained in unarmored style, you may be better protected without armor than with armor.
首先，要尽可能多地穿戴盔甲，并且保证在战斗时不会晕倒。其次，使用与你擅长的风格相匹配的盔甲——轻甲、中甲或重甲风格。第三，保持盔甲完好。破旧的盔甲效果较差；严重磨损的盔甲和新盔甲一样重，但几乎起不到任何保护作用。第四，购买质量最好的盔甲。第五，如果你接受的是无甲的训练，那么不穿盔甲可能比穿盔甲更能保护你。

> INFO.NAME worn armor 13821120613079123294
As it wears out, armor becomes less effective. Broken armor is completely useless until you repair it, but worn armor stops only a fraction of the damage that new or well-maintained armor does. Learn the basics of armor repair, and go over your armor, piece by piece, before every big battle. Or visit a smith regularly to keep your armor in good shape.
随着磨损，盔甲的效果会越来越差。损坏的盔甲在修复之前完全无用，但破旧的盔甲只能阻止好盔甲所能阻止的部分伤害。学习基本的盔甲维修知识，在每次大战之前逐件检查你的盔甲。或者定期拜访铁匠铺，让盔甲保持良好状态。

> INFO.NAME battle axe 1313622452283312898
The term 'battle axe' includes all very heavy axes used two-handed. Most battle axes are double-bladed, but the Nordic battle axe has a single blade. The great mass and efficiency of the battle axe enables a strong warrior to penetrate heavy armor, but the battle axe is also a powerful shock weapon against massed, lightly armored opponents.
“巨斧”一词包括所有双手使用的重型斧类武器。大多数巨斧都是双刃的，但诺德风格巨斧是单刃的。巨斧的重量大、效率高，使强壮的战士能够穿透重甲，同时巨斧也是一种强大的冲击武器，可用于对付集结在一起的轻甲对手。 {诺德人}

> INFO.NAME broadsword 9626320352768611401
Long popular in the West, the mass-produced, one-handed, double-edged heavy broadsword commonly used by the Legions is descended from the original elaborate, decorated Breton broadsword designs. The Nordic broadsword developed independently, and is a more plain, practical weapon. All broadswords are commonly used with sword-and-shield techniques, the Bretons favoring the heavy tower shield, while the legions prefer a smaller standard-sized shield.
长期以来流行于西方、军团常用的大规模生产的单手双刃重型阔剑是最初精心装饰的布莱顿人阔剑设计的后裔。诺德风格阔剑是独立发展起来的，是一种更加朴素、实用的武器。所有阔剑都常用剑盾术，布莱顿人偏爱重型塔盾，而军团则偏爱较小的标准尺寸盾。 {诺德人,忙}

> INFO.NAME molag amur 141685183207992798

The Ashlanders of Erabenimsun camp hunt game here, but few others venture into this region. The worst part of Molag Amur is considered impassible even by the Ashlanders.

> INFO.NAME house wars 142861203130612691
By the immemorial custom of Dunmer society, a House may challenge the honor of another House in the person of one of the House's ranking nobles. The ranking noble of the impugned House is 'marked for death' -- in ancient times, actually formally marked with a black banner, but in modern times, served with a formal written public announcement. If within a year of the challenge, the marked noble still lives, the challenging House must publicly forego any further complaint or scandal on the matter.
根据丹莫社会自古以来的习俗，一个家族可以由该家族的一位顶级贵族来挑战另一个家族的荣誉。被质疑家族的高级贵族将被“标记为死亡”——在古代，实际上是用黑色旗帜正式标记，但在现代，则是用正式的书面令状送达。如果在质疑一年内，被标记的贵族仍然活着，质疑的家族必须公开放弃对此事的任何进一步投诉或丑闻。

So Rule Number Two is that now I visit you, and after this visit, you never do anything ever again. Except feed the worms. And Rule Number Three is don't push your luck with me. Or I kill you. Nothing personal. Just part of my job.
第一条规则：老板说了，要么跟他做买卖，要么就别做买卖。不知道老板是谁？那你就别做买卖。简单。第二条规则：你做了买卖，但没跟老板做——因为你坏了第一条规则。所以这第二条规则就是：我来找你。等我找完你，你往后什么也做不了了，也就配喂喂虫子。第三条规则：别跟我耍横。不然我宰了你。没别的意思，就是公事公办。 {幸运}

> INFO.NAME ebonheart 63024203196178239
Ebonheart is south on the road from Pelagiad, built on the western shore of the water-founded city of Vivec. Ebonheart is the seat of the Imperial government for Vvardenfell district, and a busy center of maritime trade. Castle Ebonheart is the home of Duke Vedam Dren, the district's ruler and Emperor's representative. Also located at Castle Ebonheart are the Vvardenfell District Council chambers and the Hawk Moth Legion garrison. The East Empire Company has its headquarters in Ebonheart.
黑檀心在佩拉吉亚德南边的路上，建在水城维威克的西岸。黑檀心是帝国人在瓦登费尔地区的政府所在地，也是繁忙的海上贸易中心。黑檀心城堡是该地区统治者兼皇帝代表维达姆·德伦公爵的居所。位于黑檀心城堡的还有瓦登费尔地区会议厅和鹰蛾军团驻军。东帝国公司的总部就设在黑檀心城堡。 {忙着}

> INFO.NAME ebonheart 199783992971714668
Because the East Empire Company is chartered directly by the Emperor, its offices, warehouses, and docks are adjacent to the castle, and its security is assured by the Imperial garrisons. The provinces of Skyrim and Black Marsh maintain diplomatic missions within the walls of Castle Ebonheart to insure that their political interests are respected by the laws and policies of the Duke and Grand Council.
由于东帝国公司由帝国人直接特许经营，因此其办公室、仓库和码头都毗邻城堡，其安保也由帝国驻军保证。天际和黑沼泽省在黑檀心城堡的城墙内设有外交使团，以确保其政治利益受到公爵和大议会的法律和政策的尊重。 {开锁}

> INFO.NAME ebonheart 293918267120432404
Castle Ebonheart is the seat of Imperial authority on Vvardenfell. Here Duke Vedam Dren, Duke of Ebonheart, and the Vvardenfell Grand Council determine law and policy for the Vvardenfell administrative district. The Imperial cult shrine here serves the Duke, his retainers, and the castle's garrisons, and is also an administrative center for the Imperial cult presence on Vvardenfell. A unit of the Imperial Guard protects the Duke, and the Hawkmoth Legion is also garrisoned within the walls of the castle.
黑檀心城堡是帝国人在瓦登费尔的权力机构所在地。在这里，黑檀心公爵维达姆·德伦公爵和瓦登费尔大议会决定瓦登费尔行政区的法律和政策。这里的帝国教团圣祠为公爵、他的家臣和城堡驻军服务，同时也是帝国教团在瓦登费尔的行政中心。一支帝国卫兵驻军地保护着公爵，鹰蛾军团也驻扎在城堡内。 {作家,瓜尔}

> INFO.NAME high rock 2369613016247696787
High Rock encompasses the many lands and clans of Greater Betony, the Dellese Isles, the Bjoulsae River tribes, and, by tradition, the Western Reach. The rugged highland strongholds and isolated valley settlements have encouraged the fierce independence of the various local Breton clans, and this contentious tribal nature has never been completely integrated into a provincial or Imperial identity. Nonetheless, their language, bardic traditions, and heroic legends are a unifying common legacy.
高岩囊括了大贝托尼许多的土地和部族，德莱斯群岛、彼欧塞河部落，以及传统意义上西境的河流。崎岖的高地堡垒和与世隔绝的山谷聚居地促使当地各布莱顿人氏族激烈独立，这种争斗不休的部落性质使其从未完全融入省级或帝国的身份认同中。尽管如此，他们的语言、吟游诗人传统和英雄传说仍是统一的共同遗产。 {帝国人}

> INFO.NAME valenwood 248287792242618693
Valenwood is a largely uninhabited forest wilderness. The coasts of Valenwood are dominated by mangrove swamps and tropical rain forests, while heavy rainfalls nurture the temperate inland rain forests. The Bosmer live in timber clanhouses at sites scattered along the coast and through the interior, connected only by undeveloped foot trails. The few Imperial roads traverse vast dense woodlands, studded with tiny, widely separated settlements, and carry little trade or traffic of any kind.
瓦伦森林是一片基本无人居住的森林荒野。瓦伦森林的海岸主要是红树林沼泽和热带雨林，而暴雨则孕育了温带内陆雨林。波斯莫居住在散布于沿海和内部的木制氏族房屋中，只有未开发的小径将他们连接起来。为数不多的帝国公路穿越广袤茂密的林地，沿途分布着许多相距甚远的小定居点，几乎没有任何贸易或交通往来。 {帝国人,瓦斯}

The Ashlands extend to the Sea of Ghosts to the north, and elsewhere form a wide margin between the blighted Red Mountain region and other geographic regions. > INFO.NAME factions 76348684226081278
Observers of Vvardenfell's politics have identified eleven main factions, some aligned with Imperial interests, some aligned with native Dunmer interests. The primary Imperial factions are the Imperial cult, the Imperial legions, and the Fighters, Mages, and Thieves Guilds. The primary native Dunmer factions are the three Great Houses, Redoran, Hlaalu, and Telvanni, the Temple, and the Morag Tong. The Ashlander barbarians are native Dunmer, but are opposed to both the Empire and the settled Dunmer.
瓦登费尔的政治观察家们发现了十一个主要派系，有些与帝国的利益一致，有些与本地丹莫的利益一致。帝国人的主要派系是帝国教团、帝国军团以及战士公会、法师公会和盗贼公会。主要的本地丹莫派系是瑞多然、哈拉鲁和泰瓦尼三大家族，神殿和莫拉格堂。灰烬之民是土生土长的丹莫，但同时反对帝国和定居的丹莫。 {泰姆瑞尔帝国}

> INFO.NAME aldmeris 1005424931737131547
Aldmeris is the original Elvish language, still spoken as a first language among isolated Elven communities, and spoken and written by all educated Elves, and the language of the Elven arts. The root '-mer' is analogous with the root '-man' or '-men' in human language; thus, the Elves are mer as Humans are men.
奥德莫瑞语是最初的精灵语，在与世隔绝的精灵族群中仍作为第一语言使用，所有受过教育的精灵都会说和写这种语言，它也是精灵艺术的语言。词根“-mer”与人类语言中的词根“-man”或“-men”类似；因此，精灵是“莫”（mer），人类是“人”（men）。 {令状}

> INFO.NAME aldmeris 209182738170817653
Aldmeris is the original Elvish language, still spoken as a first language among isolated Elven communities, and spoken and written by all educated Elves, and the language of the Elven arts. The root '-mer' is analogous with the root '-man' or '-men' in human language; thus, the Elves are mer as Humans are men.
奥德莫瑞语是最初的精灵语，在与世隔绝的精灵族群中仍作为第一语言使用，所有受过教育的精灵都会说和写这种语言，它也是精灵艺术的语言。词根“-mer”与人类语言中的词根“-man”或“-men”类似；因此，精灵是“莫”（mer），人类是“人”（men）。 {令状}

> INFO.NAME vampires 28134581168723745
Vampires are monsters that feed on humanoid blood. Once they were human like you and me, but they get the blood disease from another vampire, and they become vampires themselves. That's why they still exist. Everyone hates them, yet no one wants to come near one. But doesn't prophecy say the Nerevarine has nothing to fear from disease? So you have nothing to worry about, I'm sure.
吸血鬼是吸食人血的怪物。曾经他们和你我一样是人类，但他们从另一个吸血鬼身上染上了血液病，自己就变成了吸血鬼。这就是他们依然存在的原因。每个人都恨他们，但没人愿意接近他们。但预言不是说，尼瑞瓦因不用害怕疾病吗？所以你不用担心。我确定。

> INFO.NAME vampires 14870871278879258
Vampires are loathsome monsters, creations of false gods and Western necromancers. The kinsmen of Lord Dagoth have been called 'ash vampires' by the ignorant, but they are not vampire in any way. They are wise and powerful, long-lived and masterful in sorcery -- but they are ageless, immortal wizards, like all of Lord Dagoth's kin -- and not vampires.
吸血鬼是令人厌恶的怪物，是伪神和西方死灵法师的产物。达格斯大人的亲族被无知的人称为“灰烬吸血鬼”，但他们绝不是吸血鬼。他们智慧强大，寿命悠长，精通巫术——但他们是不老不死的巫师，就像达格斯大人的所有亲族一样——而不是吸血鬼。

> INFO.NAME vampires 1899743161758025545
Imperial culture regards blood vampires as destructive monsters to be hunted and destroyed. However, romantic notions of noble, virtuous vampires persist in Imperial traditions, and vampires are thought to pass unrecognized in the Mages Guild and the Imperial aristocracy.
帝国文化将血族吸血鬼视作必须被猎杀殆尽的灾祸怪物。然而，在帝国传统中，关于品行高贵的吸血鬼的浪漫观念依然存在，并且吸血鬼被认为可以在法师公会和帝国人贵族中不被察觉、畅通无阻。 {帝国教团}

帝国文化将血族吸血鬼视作必须被猎杀殆尽的灾祸怪物。然而，在帝国传统中，关于品行高贵的吸血鬼的浪漫观念依然存在，并且吸血鬼被认为可以在法师公会和帝国人贵族中不被察觉、畅通无阻。 {帝国教团}

> INFO.NAME vampires 3539264032092816621
The Dunmer hate necromancy and the undead, and hate blood vampires in particular. Blood vampires are powerful undead creatures that feed on humanoid blood. The vampire curse is contracted from disease-contaminated blood; victims of vampire attacks sometimes become vampires. There is no known cure for vampirism but the destruction of the vampire. Ash vampires are not blood vampires; though both are powerful immortal undead, ash vampire do not feed on blood, and have no connection with blood vampires.
丹莫痛恨死灵法术和亡灵，尤其痛恨血族吸血鬼。血族吸血鬼是以类人血液为食的强大不死生物。吸血鬼的诅咒是从被疾病污染的血液中感染的；吸血鬼袭击的受害者有时也会变成吸血鬼。目前还没有已知的治疗吸血病的方法，只能消灭吸血鬼。灰烬吸血鬼不是血液吸血鬼；虽然两者都是强大的亡灵生物，但灰烬吸血鬼不以血液为食，与血族吸血鬼没有任何联系。 {合同,毁灭}

> INFO.NAME eggmines 260789333224231777
Kwama eggs are a principal agricultural commodity of Vvardenfell District. Kwama live and breed in large communal subterranean colonies. Miners protect kwama eggs from poachers, predators, and raiding kwama foragers from other colonies, and harvest judiciously, preserving sufficient eggs to sustain colony growth. Consumed locally or exported by ship to the rest of the Empire, kwama eggs are eaten boiled, roasted, or raw, and remain fresh for weeks.
夸蚂卵是瓦登费尔地区的主要农产品。夸蚂生活和繁殖在大型公共地下群落中。卵矿矿工保护夸蚂觅食者的卵免受偷猎者、掠食者和其他聚居地的夸蚂觅食者的袭击，并谨慎采收，保存足够的卵以维持聚居地的生长。夸蚂卵可在当地食用，也可乘船出口到泰姆瑞尔帝国其他地方，煮熟、烤熟或原矿食用，新鲜度可保持数周之久。

> INFO.NAME cyrodiil 2519088302265817520
Cyrodiil is the cradle of Human Imperial high culture on Tamriel. It is the largest region of the continent, and most is endless jungle. The Imperial City is in the heartland, the fertile Nibenay Valley. The densely populated central valley is surrounded by wild rain forests drained by great rivers into the swamps of Argonia and Topal Bay. The land rises gradually to the west and sharply to the north. Between its western coast and its central valley are deciduous forests and mangrove swamps.
西罗帝尔是泰姆瑞尔人类帝国人高级文化的摇篮。它是大陆上最大的地区，大部分地区都是一望无际的丛林。帝国人的帝都位于心脏地，即肥沃的尼本内山谷。人口稠密的中部山谷被荒凉的雨林环绕，雨林被大河排入阿尔贡尼亚和托帕尔湾的沼泽。地势向西逐渐上升，向北急剧上升。西部海岸和中部峡谷之间是落叶林和红树林沼泽。

> INFO.NAME enchant 1466113995903511607
The enchant discipline concerns imbuing physical items with magical properties called enchantments. The simplest enchantment are magical scrolls with a single enchantment that are destroyed with one use. The most complex enchantments are enchanted artifacts, objects with one or more magical effects powered by built-in soul gems. Skilled enchanters also use enchanted items more efficiently, with less waste of the magicka trapped in the soul gems.
附魔师的职责是为物理物品注入被称为附魔之术的魔法属性。最简单的附魔是带有单一附魔的魔法卷轴，使用一次就会销毁。最复杂的附魔是附魔神器，即由内置灵魂石提供一种或多种魔法效果的物品。熟练的附魔师还能更有效地使用附魔物品，减少对灵魂宝石中蕴藏的魔力的浪费。 {魔法疾病}

Alchemical potions can provide a broad spectrum of long-lasting magical effects, from healing and curing disease to water-walking, magical shields, and fortification of bodily attributes.

> INFO.NAME aldmeri 31225188215069417
Elves are conditionally fertile -- that is, they only conceive when population pressure is low -- so expanding populations do not force them to explore or war with neighbors. The arts, literature, sorceries, technology and theology that have flourished within ancient Elven cultures have profoundly shaped the development of the Empire's manish and beast races.
精灵的生育能力是有条件的——也就是说，他们只有在人口压力较低的时候才会受孕——因此人口的扩张并不会迫使他们去探索或与邻国开战。古代精灵文化中繁荣发展的艺术、文学、巫术、技术和神学深刻地影响了帝国的人种族和野兽种族的发展。 {泰姆瑞尔帝国}

> INFO.NAME aldmeri 23455186551905221555
Aldmeri -- the Imperial usage is 'Elves' -- are long-lived, culturally conservative humanoids distinct from Tamriel's "manish" races of the north and "beast peoples" races of the southeast. By contrast with the manish tribes, Elven cultures and social institutions are stable and persistent; Elven nations are neither economically expansive nor militarily adventurous.
奥德莫瑞——帝国人称之为“精灵”——是长寿、文化保守的类人种族，有别于泰姆瑞尔北方的“人类”种族和东南方的“野兽”种族。与人类族群相比，精灵的文化和社会制度稳定而持久；精灵国家既不在经济上扩张，也不在军事上冒险。

Aldmeri -- the Imperial usage is 'Elves' -- are long-lived, culturally conservative humanoids distinct from Tamriel's "manish" races of the north and "beast peoples" races of the southeast. By contrast with the manish tribes, Elven cultures and social institutions are stable and persistent; Elven nations are neither economically expansive nor militarily adventurous.
奥德莫瑞——帝国人称之为“精灵”——是长寿、文化保守的类人种族，有别于泰姆瑞尔北方的“人类”种族和东南方的“野兽”种族。与人类族群相比，精灵的文化和社会制度稳定而持久；精灵国家既不在经济上扩张，也不在军事上冒险。

The Khajiit of the southern Elsweyr jungles and river basins are settled city dwellers with ancient mercantile traditions and a stable agrarian aristocracy based on sugarcane and saltrice plantations. The nomadic tribal Khajiit of the dry northern wastes and grasslands are, by contrast, aggressive and territorial tribal raiders periodically united under tribal warlords. While the settled south has been quick to adopt Imperial ways, the northern nomadic tribes cling to their warlike barbarian traditions.

> INFO.NAME orc 16989109032530530263
The Orc peoples of the Wrothgarian and Dragontail Mountains are brave and hardy barbarians. Once they were feared and hated by everyone else in Tamriel. Now many have gained an education and Imperial citizenship through service in the legions. Their armorers are the finest in the world, and Orc warriors in heavy armor are the best front-line troops in all Tamriel. Detractors say that Orcs are rough and cruel, but Orcs say they are hard, but fair, and stern, but just.

> INFO.NAME orc 278223239230132690
Orcs are the beast barbarians of the Wrothgarian and Dragontail Mountains. They are wonderful warriors and armorers, but they are not civilized beings, and they worship the Bad Daedra. They have come as legion veterans to settle in Morrowind, and by law, they have rights as citizens. Many serve us as reliable mercenaries and hirelings, and as a people, they may someday come to be civilized. But many Orcs are savages and outlaws, and as a race they cannot be trusted.
兽人是沃斯加里安山脉和龙尾山脉的野兽蛮族。他们擅长战斗、修理，是出色的战士和铁匠，但他们不是文明人，他们崇拜邪恶的迪德拉。他们作为军团老兵来到晨风定居，根据法律，他们享有公民的权利。许多人作为可靠的雇佣兵和武器匠为我们服务，作为一个民族，他们也许有一天会成为文明人。但许多兽人是野蛮人和亡命之徒，作为一个种族，他们不可信任。

> INFO.NAME rat 15683254982582712181
The rat is a hardy, abundant hunter-scavenger, found on the land surface and in natural and excavated underground environments. Rat meat is tough and greasy, with an unpleasant odor and taste. Nonetheless, it is cheap, abundant, and nutritious, and palatable when cooked in a stew and masked by strong spices.
老鼠是一种耐寒、数量庞大的猎食者兼清道夫，在陆地表面、自然界和挖掘的地下环境中都能找到。老鼠肉坚硬油腻，气味和味道都很难闻。尽管如此，老鼠肉价格低廉、数量丰富、营养丰富，炖煮后用香料掩盖也很可口。
